text_en: It would be good if we scanned the old books whose copyright has expired to upload them to the Internet. That way, these books will not be forgotten.
en_notes: Normalized 'that we scan' to 'if we scanned' for a more natural conditional construction. The speaker and addressee genders remain neutral and female respectively as there are no specific cues in the text.

es_latam: Sería bueno que escaneáramos los libros antiguos cuyos derechos de autor han expirado para subirlos a Internet. De esa manera, estos libros no serán olvidados.
fr: Il serait bon que nous numérisions les vieux livres dont les droits d'auteur ont expiré pour les mettre sur Internet. De cette façon, ces livres ne seront pas oubliés.
de: Es wäre gut, wenn wir die alten Bücher, deren Urheberrecht abgelaufen ist, einscannen würden, um sie ins Internet hochzuladen. Auf diese Weise werden diese Bücher nicht vergessen.
it: Sarebbe bene se scansionassimo i vecchi libri il cui copyright è scaduto per caricarli su Internet. In questo modo, questi libri non saranno dimenticati.
pt: Seria bom se digitalizássemos os livros antigos cujos direitos autorais expiraram para enviá-los para a Internet. Dessa forma, esses livros não serão esquecidos.
ru: Было бы хорошо, если бы мы отсканировали старые книги, срок действия авторских прав на которые истек, чтобы выложить их в Интернет. Таким образом, эти книги не будут забыты.

zh: 如果我们能扫描那些版权已过期的旧书并上传到互联网上就好了。这样，这些书就不会被遗忘。
ja: 著作権が切れた古い本をスキャンしてインターネットにアップロードできればいいですね。そうすれば、これらの本が忘れられることはないでしょう。
ko: 저작권이 만료된 고서들을 스캔해서 인터넷에 올리면 좋을 것 같아요. 그렇게 하면 이 책들이 잊히지 않을 거예요.
vi: Sẽ thật tốt nếu chúng ta quét những cuốn sách cũ đã hết hạn bản quyền để tải chúng lên Internet. Bằng cách đó, những cuốn sách này sẽ không bị lãng quên.
sv: Det vore bra om vi skannade de gamla böckerna vars upphovsrätt har gått ut för att ladda upp dem på internet. På så sätt kommer dessa böcker inte att glömmas bort.
fi: Olisi hyvä, jos skannaisimme vanhat kirjat, joiden tekijänoikeus on umpeutunut, ladataksemme ne internetiin. Tällä tavoin näitä kirjoja ei unohdeta.
nl: Het zou goed zijn als we de oude boeken waarvan het auteursrecht is verlopen zouden scannen om ze op internet te uploaden. Op die manier zullen deze boeken niet vergeten worden.
el: Θα ήταν καλό αν σκανάραμε τα παλιά βιβλία των οποίων τα πνευματικά δικαιώματα έχουν λήξει για να τα ανεβάσουμε στο Διαδίκτυο. Με αυτόν τον τρόπο, αυτά τα βιβλία δεν θα ξεχαστούν.
ar: سيكون من الجيد لو قمنا بمسح الكتب القديمة التي انتهت صلاحية حقوق الطبع والنشر الخاصة بها لرفعها على الإنترنت. بهذه الطريقة، لن تُنسى هذه الكتب.

hi: निरर्थकता सिर्फ इसलिए इतनी अच्छी है क्योंकि व्यावहारिक बुद्धि बहुत सीमित है।

vi: Sự vô lý thật tuyệt vời chỉ vì lẽ thường quá hạn hẹp.

fi: Mielettömyys on niin hyvää vain siksi, että maalaisjärki on niin rajoittunutta.
nl: Onzin is alleen zo goed omdat het gezond verstand zo beperkt is.
el: Το παράλογο είναι τόσο καλό μόνο και μόνο επειδή η κοινή λογική είναι τόσο περιορισμένη.
ar: الهراء جيد جداً فقط لأن المنطق السليم محدود للغاية.
corrections_summary: fr: 'L'absurdité' is slightly too heavy for 'nonsense' in this philosophical context, 'Le non-sens' is more accurate. pt: 'muito' used instead of 'tão' for 'so limited'. hi: 'बकवास' (bakwaas) sounds like 'rubbish/garbage' rather than the philosophical 'nonsense', 'निरर्थकता' is better. ko: '터무니없는 소리' is too literal/colloquial, '넌센스' or '무의미' is better for this aphorism.

text: You are my equal; not my inferior or superior.

corrections_summary: it: 'il mio pari' is slightly unnatural for 'my equal' in this context → changed to 'mio pari'; zh: the translation focused too much on workplace hierarchy (subordinate/boss) → adjusted to a more general sense of equality; ja: '君' and '僕' are specific to certain relationships → adjusted to more neutral terms; ko: '너' is informal/low register → adjusted to '당신' to better fit the neutral/formal tone of the vocabulary; vi: 'Anh' assumes a specific age relationship → adjusted to 'Bạn' for a neutral address.

text: She seems to have known the secret.

es: —¿Cómo estás? —Estoy bien. ¿Y tú? —Yo también estoy bien.
es_latam: —¿Cómo estás? —Estoy bien. ¿Y tú? —Yo también estoy bien.
fr: — Comment ça va ? — Ça va bien. Et toi ? — Ça va bien aussi.
de: „Wie geht es dir?“ „Mir geht es gut. Und dir?“ „Mir geht es auch gut.“
it: «Come stai?» «Sto bene. E tu?» «Anch'io sto bene.»
pt: — Como você está? — Estou bem. E você? — Eu também estou bem.
ru: — Как дела? — Хорошо. А у тебя? — Тоже хорошо.
hi: — तुम कैसे हो? — मैं ठीक हूँ। तुम बताओ? — मैं भी ठीक हूँ।
zh: “你好吗？”“我很好。你呢？”“我也很好。”
ja: 「元気？」「元気だよ。君は？」「僕も元気だよ。」
ko: “잘 지내?” “응, 잘 지내. 너는?” “나도 잘 지내.”
vi: “Bạn khỏe không?” “Mình khỏe. Còn bạn?” “Mình cũng khỏe.”
sv: — Hur mår du? — Jag mår bra. Du då? — Jag mår också bra.
fi: – Mitä kuuluu? – Hyvää. Entä sinulle? – Minullekin kuuluu hyvää.
nl: “Hoe gaat het met je?” “Goed. En met jou?” “Met mij gaat het ook goed.”
el: «Πώς είσαι;» «Είμαι καλά. Εσύ;» «Κι εγώ καλά είμαι.»
corrections_summary: hi: gender-neutral English was translated with masculine agreement → changed to gender-neutral/inclusive phrasing; ja: '私' (watashi) is slightly formal for an informal 'Genki?' exchange → changed to 'うん' and '僕/私' context or omitted subject for naturalness; fi: 'Myös minulle kuuluu hyvää' is grammatically correct but slightly stiff → changed to 'Minullekin kuuluu hyvää' for better flow.

text: It's certain that some things can be changed, but on the whole they have managed as best as they can.
text_en: It's certain that some things can be changed, but on the whole they have managed as best as they can.
en_notes: The sentence is a general observation about a third party ('they'), so there is no direct addressee. The speaker gender defaults to the pre-assigned value as there are no gendered cues.
es: Es cierto que algunas cosas pueden cambiarse, pero en general se han desenvuelto lo mejor que han podido.
es_latam: Es cierto que algunas cosas pueden cambiarse, pero en general se han desempeñado lo mejor que han podido.
fr: Il est certain que certaines choses peuvent être changées, mais dans l'ensemble, ils se sont débrouillés du mieux qu'ils ont pu.
de: Es ist sicher, dass einige Dinge geändert werden können, aber im Großen und Ganzen haben sie es so gut wie möglich gemeistert.
it: È certo che alcune cose possono essere cambiate, ma nel complesso se la sono cavata al meglio delle loro possibilità.
pt: É certo que algumas coisas podem ser mudadas, mas, no geral, eles se saíram o melhor que puderam.
ru: Несомненно, некоторые вещи можно изменить, но в целом они справились настолько хорошо, насколько могли.
hi: यह निश्चित है कि कुछ चीजें बदली जा सकती हैं, लेकिन कुल मिलाकर उन्होंने अपनी पूरी कोशिश की है।
zh: 可以肯定的是，有些事情是可以改变的，但总的来说，他们已经尽力做到了最好。
ja: いくつかのことは変えられるのは確かですが、全体として彼らはできる限りのことをしてきました。
ko: 어떤 것들은 바뀔 수 있다는 것이 확실하지만, 전반적으로 그들은 할 수 있는 최선을 다해왔습니다.
vi: Chắc chắn rằng một số thứ có thể thay đổi được, nhưng nhìn chung họ đã xoay xở tốt nhất có thể.
sv: Det är säkert att vissa saker kan ändras, men på det hela taget har de klarat sig så gott de har kunnat.
fi: On varmaa, että joitakin asioita voidaan muuttaa, mutta kaiken kaikkiaan he ovat selviytyneet niin hyvin kuin ovat voineet.
nl: Het is zeker dat sommige dingen veranderd kunnen worden, maar over het algemeen hebben ze het zo goed mogelijk gedaan.
el: Είναι βέβαιο ότι ορισμένα πράγματα μπορούν να αλλάξουν, αλλά συνολικά τα έχουν καταφέρει όσο καλύτερα μπορούσαν.
ar: من المؤكد أن بعض الأشياء يمكن تغييرها، ولكنهم في المجمل قد تدبروا أمرهم بأفضل ما يمكنهم.
corrections_summary: ja: fixed grammatical particle error (変えられるのは → 変えられることは) for better flow and accuracy.

text: The port is filled with vessels of all kinds.
text_en: The port is filled with vessels of all kinds.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual statement about a location. No specific addressee is implied, and the speaker's gender remains neutral as per the default.

es_latam: El puerto está lleno de embarcaciones de todo tipo.
fr: Le port est rempli de navires de toutes sortes.

it: Il porto è pieno di imbarcazioni di ogni tipo.
pt: O porto está cheio de embarcações de todos os tipos.
hi: बंदरगाह हर तरह के जहाजों से भरा हुआ है।

ja: 港はあらゆる種類の船舶でいっぱいです。
ko: 항구는 온갖 종류의 선박들로 가득 차 있습니다.
vi: Cảng đầy rẫy các loại tàu thuyền.
sv: Hamnen är fylld med fartyg av alla slag.

el: Το λιμάνι είναι γεμάτο με πλοία κάθε είδους.
ar: الميناء مليء بسفن من جميع الأنواع.

text: She told her children an amusing story.
text_en: She told her children an amusing story.
en_notes: The speaker gender is female as indicated by the pronoun 'She'. The addressee gender is not applicable because the children are the objects of the sentence, not the direct addressees of the utterance.
es: Ella les contó a sus hijos una historia divertida.
es_latam: Ella les contó a sus hijos una historia divertida.
fr: Elle a raconté une histoire amusante à ses enfants.
de: Sie erzählte ihren Kindern eine amüsante Geschichte.
it: Lei ha raccontato ai suoi figli una storia divertente.
pt: Ela contou uma história divertida para seus filhos.
ru: Она рассказала своим детям забавную историю.
hi: उसने अपने बच्चों को एक मनोरंजक कहानी सुनाई।
zh: 她给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
ja: 彼女は子供たちに面白い話をしました。
vi: Cô ấy đã kể cho các con mình nghe một câu chuyện thú vị.
sv: Hon berättade en rolig historia för sina barn.
nl: Ze vertelde haar kinderen een grappig verhaal.
el: Είπε στα παιδιά της μια διασκεδαστική ιστορία.

text: No, I do not see anyone.
text_en: No, I do not see anyone.

es_latam: No, no veo a nadie.
fr: Non, je ne vois personne.
de: Nein, ich sehe niemanden.
it: No, non vedo nessuno.
pt: Não, eu não vejo ninguém.
hi: नहीं, मुझे कोई नहीं दिख रहा है।
ja: いいえ、誰も見えません。
vi: Không, tôi không thấy ai cả.
sv: Nej, jag ser ingen.
nl: Nee, ik zie niemand.
el: Όχι, δεν βλέπω κανέναν.

text: When will the law go into force?
text_en: When will the law go into force?
en_notes: The phrase 'go into force' is a standard legal idiom meaning to become legally binding or effective. The genders are set to the defaults as there are no specific cues in the text.
es: ¿Cuándo entrará en vigor la ley?
es_latam: ¿Cuándo entrará en vigencia la ley?
fr: Quand la loi entrera-t-elle en vigueur ?

it: Quando entrerà in vigore la legge?

text: Once you have decided to do something, stick to it.
text_en: Once you have decided to do something, stick to it.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative advice. The addressee gender defaults to male as per instructions, and the addressee number is singular as is typical for direct advice.
es: Una vez que hayas decidido hacer algo, mantente firme.
es_latam: Una vez que hayas decidido hacer algo, mantente firme.
fr: Une fois que tu as décidé de faire quelque chose, tiens-toi à ta décision.
de: Sobald du dich entschieden hast, etwas zu tun, bleib dabei.
it: Una volta che hai deciso di fare qualcosa, non mollare.
pt: Uma vez que você tenha decidido fazer algo, mantenha-se firme.
ru: Раз уж ты решил что-то сделать, придерживайся своего решения.
hi: एक बार जब आप कुछ करने का निर्णय ले लें, तो उस पर टिके रहें।
zh: 一旦你决定做某事，就要坚持下去。
ja: 一度何かをすると決めたら、それを貫き通しなさい。
ko: 무언가를 하기로 결정했다면, 끝까지 밀고 나가라.
vi: Một khi bạn đã quyết định làm điều gì đó, hãy kiên trì với nó.
sv: När du väl har bestämt dig för att göra något, håll fast vid det.
fi: Kun olet päättänyt tehdä jotain, pysy siinä.
nl: Als je eenmaal hebt besloten iets te doen, houd je er dan aan vast.
el: Μόλις αποφασίσεις να κάνεις κάτι, μείνε πιστός σε αυτό.
ar: بمجرد أن تقرر فعل شيء ما، فالتزم به.
corrections_summary: fr: 'tiens-t'y' is grammatically awkward and rare in this context → changed to 'tiens-toi à ta décision' for better flow; it: 'mantieni il proposito' is slightly formal/stilted → changed to 'non mollare' for a more natural imperative advice; hi: 'तुम' (tum) is informal, 'आप' (aap) is better for neutral register advice → updated to 'आप' and corresponding verb forms; ar: 'التزم به' is correct but 'فالتزم به' improves the flow of the conditional-like structure.

text: Are you scared of big trucks?
text_en: Are you scared of big trucks?
en_notes: The sentence is a direct question. The addressee number is set to singular as the most common default for a direct question, and the addressee gender remains neutral as there are no specific cues.

es_latam: ¿Te dan miedo los camiones grandes?

de: Hast du Angst vor großen Lastwagen?

text: His story was simplicity itself.
text_en: His story was simplicity itself.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the male default as there are no cues. The subject 'His' refers to a third party, not the speaker or addressee. 'Simplicity itself' is a figurative idiom meaning extremely simple.
es: Su historia era la sencillez misma.
es_latam: Su historia era la sencillez misma.
fr: Son histoire était la simplicité même.
de: Seine Geschichte war die Einfachheit selbst.
it: La sua storia era la semplicità stessa.
pt: A história dele era a própria simplicidade.
hi: उसकी कहानी सादगी की मिसाल थी।
ja: 彼の話は至って単純だった。
vi: Câu chuyện của anh ấy chính là sự đơn giản.
sv: Hans historia var enkelheten själv.
nl: Zijn verhaal was de eenvoud zelve.
el: Η ιστορία του ήταν η ίδια η απλότητα.
corrections_summary: zh: literal translation of 'itself' was unnatural → changed to a more idiomatic structure meaning 'simplicity itself'.

text: We're actually quite similar.
text_en: We're actually quite similar.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral declarative statement. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues to suggest otherwise.

es_latam: En realidad somos bastante parecidos.

it: In realtà siamo piuttosto simili.
pt: Na verdade, somos bem parecidos.
ru: На самом деле мы довольно похожи.
hi: असल में हम काफी समान हैं।
ja: 実は、私たちはかなり似ています。
vi: Thực ra chúng ta khá giống nhau.
sv: Vi är faktiskt ganska lika.
nl: We lijken eigenlijk best veel op elkaar.
el: Στην πραγματικότητα είμαστε αρκετά παρόμοιοι.
corrections_summary: ar: The translation used 'تماماً' (completely) which changes the meaning of 'quite' (fairly/rather) in this context, and the plural masculine form 'متشابهون' is used for a group of 3+, whereas for a speaker and one addressee, the dual form 'متشابهان' is more precise.

text_en: Send us the bill.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative command. The addressee gender defaults to male as per the pre-assigned instructions, and the speaker is neutral.
es: Envíanos la cuenta.
es_latam: Envíanos la cuenta.
fr: Envoie-nous la facture.
de: Schick uns die Rechnung.
it: Mandaci il conto.
pt: Envie-nos a conta.
hi: हमें बिल भेजें।
ja: 請求書を送ってください。
vi: Hãy gửi hóa đơn cho chúng tôi.
sv: Skicka oss räkningen.
nl: Stuur ons de rekening.
el: Στείλε μας τον λογαριασμό.

text: He has started his work.
text_en: He has started his work.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as there are no internal cues. The subject is explicitly male ('He'), but the speaker is a third party. Addressee is not applicable as this is a declarative statement about a third person.
es: Él ha empezado su trabajo.
es_latam: Él ha comenzado su trabajo.
fr: Il a commencé son travail.
de: Er hat seine Arbeit begonnen.

pt: Ele começou o seu trabalho.

vi: Anh ấy đã bắt đầu công việc của mình.

nl: Hij is aan zijn werk begonnen.
el: Έχει ξεκινήσει τη δουλειά του.

text: Tom said it was easier to do that than he expected.
text_en: Tom said it was easier to do that than he expected.
en_notes: The speaker_gender is set to male because the subject 'Tom' is a typically male name and is referred to by the pronoun 'he'. The addressee fields are not applicable as this is a declarative statement about a third party.
es: Tom dijo que era más fácil hacer eso de lo que esperaba.
es_latam: Tom dijo que era más fácil hacer eso de lo que esperaba.
fr: Tom a dit que c'était plus facile à faire qu'il ne s'y attendait.

it: Tom ha detto che era più facile farlo di quanto si aspettasse.
pt: Tom disse que era mais fácil fazer isso do que ele esperava.
ru: Том сказал, что сделать это было проще, чем он ожидал.
hi: टॉम ने कहा कि इसे करना उसकी उम्मीद से ज़्यादा आसान था।
zh: 汤姆说做那件事比他预想的要容易。
ja: トムは、それをするのは思っていたよりも簡単だったと言いました。
ko: 톰은 그것을 하는 것이 생각했던 것보다 더 쉬웠다고 말했습니다.

ar: قال توم إن القيام بذلك كان أسهل مما توقع.
corrections_summary: fr: 'prévoyait' (foreseen) is less accurate than 'espérait' or 's'y attendait' for 'expected' in this context → changed to 's'y attendait'.

text: Mary wondered if Tom liked her as much as she liked him.
text_en: Mary wondered if Tom liked her as much as she liked him.
en_notes: The speaker gender is neutral as this is a third-person narrative. The names Mary and Tom, along with the pronouns 'she' and 'him', clearly define the genders of the subjects within the story.
es: Mary se preguntaba si a Tom le gustaba ella tanto como él le gustaba a ella.
es_latam: Mary se preguntaba si a Tom le gustaba ella tanto como él le gustaba a ella.
fr: Mary se demandait si Tom l'aimait autant qu'elle l'aimait.
de: Mary fragte sich, ob Tom sie genauso sehr mochte, wie sie ihn mochte.

zh: 玛丽想知道汤姆是否像她喜欢他那样喜欢她。

ko: 메리는 자신이 톰을 좋아하는 만큼 톰도 자신을 좋아하는지 궁금해했습니다.

sv: Mary undrade om Tom tyckte om henne lika mycket som hon tyckte om honom.
fi: Mary mietti, pitikö Tom hänestä yhtä paljon kuin hän piti Tomista.
nl: Mary vroeg zich af of Tom haar net zo leuk vond als zij hem.
el: Η Μαίρη αναρωτιόταν αν άρεσε στον Τομ όσο της άρεσε εκείνος.
ar: تَساءَلَت ماري عَمّا إذا كان توم يُحِبُّها بِقَدْرِ ما تُحِبُّه.

text: They have a very welcoming smile.
text_en: They have a very welcoming smile.
en_notes: The pronoun 'they' is used here as a singular epicene pronoun referring to one person of unknown gender, or as a third-person plural. Translations reflect the plural form as it is the most natural equivalent in the target languages.
es: Tienen una sonrisa muy acogedora.
es_latam: Tienen una sonrisa muy acogedora.
fr: Ils ont un sourire très accueillant.
de: Sie haben ein sehr herzliches Lächeln.
it: Hanno un sorriso molto accogliente.
pt: Eles têm um sorriso muito acolhedor.
hi: उनकी मुस्कान बहुत मिलनसार है।
ja: 彼らはとても温かい笑顔をしています。
ko: 그들은 매우 따뜻한 미소를 가지고 있습니다.
vi: Họ có một nụ cười rất niềm nở.
sv: De har ett mycket välkomnande leende.
nl: Ze hebben een zeer gastvrije glimlach.
el: Έχουν ένα πολύ φιλόξενο χαμόγελο.
corrections_summary: No corrections needed. The translations correctly interpret 'they' as plural, which is the standard grammatical approach for these languages when translating the singular 'they' or the generic plural 'they' in a neutral context.

text: You could wait a little longer if you want me to.
text_en: You could wait a little longer if you want me to.
en_notes: The sentence is a polite suggestion or offer, making the register neutral. The addressee is singular by default in a conversational context.

es_latam: Podrías esperar un poco más si quieres.

de: Du könntest noch ein wenig länger warten, wenn du möchtest.
it: Potresti aspettare ancora un po' se vuoi che lo faccia.
pt: Você poderia esperar um pouco mais se quiser.
ru: Ты могла бы подождать еще немного, если хочешь, чтобы я это сделал.

corrections_summary: es: 'que lo haga' is ambiguous/unnatural here → changed to 'que me quede' or similar to imply staying/waiting with her, but for accuracy to the English 'if you want me to [wait]', 'si quieres' is sufficient; es_latam: same as es; fr: 'que je le fasse' is unnatural for waiting → changed to 'si tu veux'; de: 'dass ich es tue' is clunky → simplified to 'wenn du möchtest'; pt: 'que eu o faça' is overly formal/unnatural → simplified; zh: added '陪你' (accompany you) to make the 'want me to' natural in Chinese context; ja: ensured the polite but neutral tone matches the suggestion.

en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of fact or opinion, so the addressee fields are marked as not applicable. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: El software de aprendizaje de idiomas, por muy bien que se vea y funcione, es tan bueno como los datos que utiliza.
es_latam: El software de aprendizaje de idiomas, sin importar qué tan bien se vea y funcione, es tan bueno como los datos que utiliza.
fr: Un logiciel d'apprentissage des langues, quel que soit son aspect et son fonctionnement, ne vaut que par les données qu'il utilise.
de: Sprachlernsoftware ist, egal wie gut sie aussieht und funktioniert, nur so gut wie die Daten, die sie verwendet.
it: Un software per l'apprendimento delle lingue, a prescindere da quanto sia bello e funzionale, vale quanto i dati che utilizza.
pt: Um software de aprendizado de idiomas, por melhor que pareça e funcione, é tão bom quanto os dados que utiliza.
ru: Программное обеспечение для изучения языков, как бы хорошо оно ни выглядело и ни работало, эффективно лишь в той мере, в какой качественны используемые им данные.
hi: भाषा सीखने का सॉफ़्टवेयर, चाहे वह दिखने और काम करने में कितना भी अच्छा क्यों न हो, केवल उतना ही अच्छा होता है जितना कि वह डेटा जिसका वह उपयोग करता है।
zh: 语言学习软件，无论其外观和功能多么出色，其效果都取决于它所使用的数据。
ja: 言語学習ソフトウェアは、見た目や動作がいかに優れていても、使用されるデータの質次第です。
ko: 언어 학습 소프트웨어는 외관이나 기능이 아무리 훌륭하더라도 결국 사용하는 데이터만큼만 유용합니다.
vi: Phần mềm học ngôn ngữ, dù giao diện và cách hoạt động có tốt đến đâu, cũng chỉ tốt bằng dữ liệu mà nó sử dụng.
sv: Programvara för språkinlärning är, oavsett hur snygg den är och hur väl den fungerar, bara så bra som den data den använder.
fi: Kieltenoppimisohjelmisto on, riippumatta siitä kuinka hyvältä se näyttää ja kuinka hyvin se toimii, vain yhtä hyvä kuin sen käyttämä data.
nl: Software voor het leren van talen is, hoe mooi het er ook uitziet en hoe goed het ook werkt, slechts zo goed als de gegevens die het gebruikt.
el: Το λογισμικό εκμάθησης γλωσσών, ανεξάρτητα από το πόσο ωραίο φαίνεται και λειτουργεί, είναι τόσο καλό όσο και τα δεδομένα που χρησιμοποιεί.
ar: إن برنامج تعلم اللغات، مهما كان مظهره وأداؤه جيدين، لا تتعدى جودته جودة البيانات التي يستخدمها.

text: As human beings are social animals, friendship is an essential part of life.
text_en: As human beings are social animals, friendship is an essential part of life.
en_notes: The sentence is a general philosophical statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned. The pre-assigned speaker gender is used as a default.
es: Dado que los seres humanos son animales sociales, la amistad es una parte esencial de la vida.
es_latam: Dado que los seres humanos son animales sociales, la amistad es una parte esencial de la vida.
fr: Comme les êtres humains sont des animaux sociaux, l'amitié est une partie essentielle de la vie.
de: Da Menschen soziale Wesen sind, ist Freundschaft ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des Lebens.
it: Poiché gli esseri umani sono animali sociali, l'amicizia è una parte essenziale della vita.
pt: Como os seres humanos são animais sociais, a amizade é uma parte essencial da vida.
ru: Поскольку люди являются социальными существами, дружба — это неотъемлемая часть жизни.
hi: चूंकि मनुष्य सामाजिक प्राणी हैं, इसलिए मित्रता जीवन का एक अनिवार्य हिस्सा है।
zh: 由于人类是社会性动物，友谊是生活中不可或缺的一部分。
ja: 人間は社会的動物であるため、友情は人生の不可欠な要素です。
ko: 인간은 사회적 동물이기 때문에 우정은 삶의 필수적인 부분입니다.
vi: Vì con người là động vật xã hội, tình bạn là một phần thiết yếu của cuộc sống.
sv: Eftersom människor är sociala varelser är vänskap en väsentlig del av livet.
fi: Koska ihmiset ovat sosiaalisia eläimiä, ystävyys on olennainen osa elämää.
nl: Aangezien mensen sociale wezens zijn, is vriendschap een essentieel onderdeel van het leven.
el: Καθώς οι άνθρωποι είναι κοινωνικά όντα, η φιλία είναι ένα ουσιαστικό μέρος της ζωής.
ar: بما أن البشر كائنات اجتماعية، فإن الصداقة جزء أساسي من الحياة.

text: Are you talking about whales?
text_en: Are you talking about whales?

es_latam: ¿Estás hablando de ballenas?
fr: Est-ce que tu parles des baleines ?
de: Sprichst du gerade über Wale?
it: Stai parlando di balene?
pt: Você está falando de baleias?
hi: क्या आप व्हेल के बारे में बात कर रहे हैं?
ja: クジラの話をしていますか？
vi: Bạn đang nói về cá voi phải không?
sv: Pratar du om valar?
nl: Heb je het over walvissen?
el: Μιλάς για φάλαινες;

text: He is nice.
text_en: He is nice.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default male as it is not specified. The addressee gender is set to not_applicable because this is a declarative statement about a third party, not a direct address.
es: Él es simpático.
es_latam: Él es amable.
fr: Il est gentil.
de: Er ist nett.
it: Lui è simpatico.
pt: Ele é legal.
hi: वह अच्छा है।
ja: 彼は親切です。
vi: Anh ấy tử tế.
sv: Han är snäll.
nl: Hij is aardig.
el: Είναι ευγενικός.

text: The baby takes after its father.
text_en: The baby takes after its father.
en_notes: The sentence uses the phrasal verb 'takes after' to mean 'resembles'. The speaker and addressee genders are set to neutral and female respectively as there are no contextual cues to override the defaults.
es: El bebé se parece a su padre.
es_latam: El bebé se parece a su padre.
fr: Le bébé ressemble à son père.
de: Das Baby kommt ganz nach seinem Vater.
it: Il bambino somiglia a suo padre.
pt: O bebê se parece com o pai.
hi: बच्चा अपने पिता पर गया है।
ja: 赤ちゃんは父親似です。
vi: Đứa bé giống hệt bố nó.
sv: Barnet brås på sin far.
nl: De baby lijkt op zijn vader.
el: Το μωρό μοιάζει στον πατέρα του.

text: Do you live far from your parents?
text_en: Do you live far from your parents?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry in the simple present tense. Register is neutral, and the addressee is singular by default for a direct question.
es: ¿Vives lejos de tus padres?
es_latam: ¿Vives lejos de tus padres?
fr: Est-ce que tu habites loin de chez tes parents ?
de: Wohnst du weit weg von deinen Eltern?
it: Vivi lontana dai tuoi genitori?
pt: Você mora longe dos seus pais?
ru: Ты живёшь далеко от своих родителей?
hi: क्या तुम अपने माता-पिता से दूर रहती हो?
ja: 両親から遠くに住んでいますか？
vi: Bạn có sống xa bố mẹ không?
sv: Bor du långt ifrån dina föräldrar?
nl: Woon je ver bij je ouders vandaan?
el: Μένεις μακριά από τους γονείς σου;

text: A friend is easier lost than found.
text_en: A friend is easier lost than found.
en_notes: This is a general proverb or aphorism. The speaker and addressee genders are set to neutral as it expresses a universal truth rather than a personal statement.
es: Es más fácil perder a un amigo que encontrarlo.
es_latam: Es más fácil perder a un amigo que encontrarlo.
fr: Il est plus facile de perdre un ami que d'en trouver un.
de: Einen Freund verliert man leichter, als man einen findet.
it: È più facile perdere un amico che trovarne uno.
pt: É mais fácil perder um amigo do que encontrar um.
hi: मित्र को पाना कठिन है, पर खोना आसान।
ja: 友を得るのは難しく、失うのは易しい。
vi: Tìm một người bạn thì khó, mất một người bạn thì dễ.
sv: Det är lättare att förlora en vän än att finna en.
fi: Ystävä on helpompi menettää kuin löytää.
nl: Een vriend is makkelijker verloren dan gevonden.
el: Ένας φίλος χάνεται πιο εύκολα απ' ό,τι βρίσκεται.
ar: خسارة الصديق أسهل من العثور عليه.

text: I wish I had a couple of bottles of good wine.
text_en: I wish I had a couple of bottles of good wine.
en_notes: The sentence expresses a wish about the present using the subjunctive 'had'. The speaker gender defaults to the pre-assigned female as there are no cues to the contrary.
es: Ojalá tuviera un par de botellas de buen vino.
es_latam: Ojalá tuviera un par de botellas de buen vino.
fr: J'aimerais avoir quelques bouteilles de bon vin.
de: Ich wünschte, ich hätte ein paar Flaschen guten Wein.
it: Vorrei avere un paio di bottiglie di buon vino.
pt: Eu gostaria de ter algumas garrafas de bom vinho.
ru: Я бы хотела, чтобы у меня было несколько бутылок хорошего вина.
hi: काश मेरे पास अच्छी शराब की दो बोतलें होतीं।
zh: 我真希望我有几瓶好酒。
ja: いいワインが2、3本あればいいのに。
ko: 좋은 와인 두어 병이 있으면 좋겠어요.
vi: Ước gì tôi có vài chai rượu vang ngon.
sv: Jag önskar att jag hade ett par flaskor gott vin.
fi: Toivon, että minulla olisi pari pulloa hyvää viiniä.
nl: Ik wou dat ik een paar flessen goede wijn had.
el: Μακάρι να είχα δυο μπουκάλια καλό κρασί.
ar: أتمنى لو كان لدي زجاجتان من النبيذ الجيد.

text: I don't care if the early bird gets the worm. I want to sleep.
text_en: I don't care if the early bird gets the worm. I want to sleep.
en_notes: The sentence contains the idiom 'the early bird gets the worm', making the literal_figurative field 'figurative'. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: No me importa si a quien madruga Dios le ayude. Quiero dormir.
es_latam: No me importa que al que madruga Dios lo ayude. Quiero dormir.
fr: Peu m'importe que l'avenir appartienne à ceux qui se lèvent tôt. Je veux dormir.
de: Es ist mir egal, ob Morgenstund Gold im Mund hat. Ich will schlafen.
it: Non m'importa se il mattino ha l'oro in bocca. Voglio dormire.
pt: Não me importa se quem cedo madruga Deus ajuda. Eu quero dormir.
ru: Мне плевать, что там «кто рано встаёт, тому Бог подаёт». Я хочу спать.
hi: मुझे फर्क नहीं पड़ता कि जो जल्दी जागता है उसे फल मिलता है। मैं सोना चाहती हूँ।
zh: 我不在乎早起的鸟儿有虫吃。我想睡觉。
ja: 早起きは三文の徳なんてどうでもいいわ。私は寝たいの。
ko: 일찍 일어나는 새가 벌레를 잡든 말든 상관없어. 난 자고 싶어.
vi: Tôi không quan tâm chuyện chim dậy sớm thì bắt được sâu. Tôi muốn ngủ.
sv: Jag bryr mig inte om att morgonstund har guld i mund. Jag vill sova.
fi: Minua ei kiinnosta, vaikka aikainen lintu madon nappaisi. Haluan nukkua.
nl: Het kan me niet schelen dat de vroege vogel de worm vangt. Ik wil slapen.
el: Δεν με νοιάζει αν το πρωινό ξύπνημα βγάζει σε καλό. Θέλω να κοιμηθώ.
ar: لا يهمني أن الصباح رباح. أريد أن أنام.
corrections_summary: es: used a proverb that changes the grammatical structure awkwardly → adjusted to 'si' for better flow; ru: used a proverb that requires a slightly different lead-in for naturalness → adjusted to 'что там кто рано встаёт'; hi: added feminine agreement for speaker_gender; ja: ensured feminine sentence ending for speaker_gender; ar: adjusted to a more common idiomatic expression for the early bird.

text: It couldn't have been done by itself.
text_en: It couldn't have been done by itself.
en_notes: The sentence uses a modal of deduction in the past. 'It' refers to an inanimate object or situation, and 'itself' reinforces that the action required an external agent.
es: No pudo haber sido hecho por sí solo.
es_latam: No pudo haber sido hecho por sí solo.
fr: Cela n'aurait pas pu être fait tout seul.
de: Es hätte nicht von selbst getan werden können.
it: Non avrebbe potuto essere fatto da solo.
pt: Não poderia ter sido feito por si só.
ru: Это не могло быть сделано само по себе.
hi: यह अपने आप नहीं किया जा सकता था।
zh: 它不可能靠它自己完成。
ja: それがひとりでにできたはずがありません。
vi: Nó không thể nào tự nó được thực hiện.
sv: Det kunde inte ha gjorts av sig självt.
fi: Sitä ei olisi voinut tehdä itsestään.
nl: Het had niet vanzelf gedaan kunnen worden.
el: Δεν θα μπορούσε να είχε γίνει από μόνο του.
ar: لم يكن من الممكن أن يتم ذلك من تلقاء نفسه.
corrections_summary: zh: '自动完成' implies 'automatically' rather than 'by itself' (lack of external agent) → corrected to '靠它自己完成'; vi: 'tự xong' is too colloquial and implies 'finishing' rather than 'being done' → corrected to 'tự nó được thực hiện'; fi: 'tapahtua' means 'happen' rather than 'be done' → corrected to 'tehty'.

text: You should call your parents at least once a month.
text_en: You should call your parents at least once a month.
en_notes: The sentence is a piece of advice, which typically carries a neutral register. The addressee is treated as singular by default, and the pre-assigned genders are maintained as there are no specific cues to override them.
es: Deberías llamar a tus padres al menos una vez al mes.
es_latam: Deberías llamar a tus padres al menos una vez al mes.
fr: Tu devrais appeler tes parents au moins une fois par mois.
de: Du solltest deine Eltern mindestens einmal im Monat anrufen.
it: Dovresti chiamare i tuoi genitori almeno una volta al mese.
pt: Você deveria ligar para os seus pais pelo menos uma vez por mês.
ru: Тебе стоит звонить родителям хотя бы раз в месяц.
hi: तुम्हें महीने में कम से कम एक बार अपने माता-पिता को फोन करना चाहिए।
zh: 你应该每月至少给父母打一次电话。
ja: 少なくとも月に一度は両親に電話すべきです。
ko: 적어도 한 달에 한 번은 부모님께 전화하는 게 좋겠어요.
vi: Bạn nên gọi điện cho bố mẹ ít nhất mỗi tháng một lần.
sv: Du borde ringa dina föräldrar minst en gång i månaden.
fi: Sinun pitäisi soittaa vanhemmillesi vähintään kerran kuukaudessa.
nl: Je zou je ouders minstens één keer per maand moeten bellen.
el: Θα έπρεπε να τηλεφωνείς στους γονείς σου τουλάχιστον μία φορά το μήνα.
ar: يجب عليك الاتصال بوالديك مرة واحدة على الأقل في الشهر.

text: This sort of music is not to the taste of everybody.
text_en: This sort of music is not to everyone's taste.
en_notes: The sentence was normalized to 'everyone's taste' for a more natural flow, though the meaning remains identical. The register is neutral as it is a general observation.
es: Este tipo de música no es del gusto de todos.
es_latam: Este tipo de música no es del gusto de todos.
fr: Ce genre de musique n'est pas du goût de tout le monde.
de: Diese Art von Musik ist nicht jedermanns Sache.
it: Questo genere di musica non è del gusto di tutti.
pt: Esse tipo de música não agrada a todos.
ru: Такая музыка не всем по вкусу.
hi: इस तरह का संगीत हर किसी को पसंद नहीं आता।
zh: 这种音乐并不符合每个人的口味。
ja: この種の音楽は、誰もが好むわけではありません。
ko: 이런 종류의 음악은 모든 사람의 취향에 맞는 것은 아닙니다.
vi: Loại nhạc này không phải ai cũng thích.
sv: Den här sortens musik faller inte alla i smaken.
fi: Tällainen musiikki ei ole kaikkien makuun.
nl: Dit soort muziek valt niet bij iedereen in de smaak.
el: Αυτό το είδος μουσικής δεν είναι για όλα τα γούστα.
ar: هذا النوع من الموسيقى لا يروق للجميع.

text: We've decided to adopt your idea.
text_en: We've decided to adopt your idea.
en_notes: The sentence uses the present perfect tense to indicate a recent decision. The speaker gender is neutral as it refers to a group ('we'), and the addressee gender follows the pre-assigned default.
es: Hemos decidido adoptar tu idea.
es_latam: Hemos decidido adoptar tu idea.
fr: Nous avons décidé d'adopter ton idée.
de: Wir haben uns entschieden, deine Idee zu übernehmen.
it: Abbiamo deciso di adottare la tua idea.
pt: Nós decidimos adotar a sua ideia.
hi: हमने तुम्हारे विचार को अपनाने का फैसला किया है।
zh: 我们已经决定采纳你的想法。
ja: あなたのアイデアを採用することにしました。
vi: Chúng tôi đã quyết định áp dụng ý tưởng của bạn.
sv: Vi har bestämt oss för att anta din idé.
nl: We hebben besloten om jouw idee over te nemen.
el: Αποφασίσαμε να υιοθετήσουμε την ιδέα σου.
corrections_summary: fr: grammatical error (vowel elision) → changed 'ta idée' to 'ton idée' for euphony; ko: register mismatch → changed informal '너의' (neo-ui) to neutral/polite '당신의' (dangsin-ui) to match the neutral register and plural 'we' context.

text: Did I mention that his father is a billionaire?
text_en: Did I mention that his father is a billionaire?
en_notes: The speaker and addressee genders are kept as neutral as there are no specific cues. The pronoun 'his' refers to a third party, not the speaker or addressee.
es: ¿Mencioné que su padre es multimillonario?
es_latam: ¿Mencioné que su padre es multimillonario?
fr: Ai-je mentionné que son père est milliardaire ?
de: Habe ich erwähnt, dass sein Vater Milliardär ist?
it: Ho menzionato che suo padre è un miliardario?
pt: Eu mencionei que o pai dele é bilionário?
ru: Я упоминал(а), что его отец — миллиардер?
hi: क्या मैंने उल्लेख किया था कि उसके पिता एक अरबपति हैं?
zh: 我提过他父亲是亿万富翁吗？
ja: 彼の父親が億万長者だと言いましたっけ？
vi: Tôi có nhắc đến việc cha anh ấy là một tỷ phú không?
sv: Nämnde jag att hans far är miljardär?
fi: Mainitsinko, että hänen isänsä on miljardööri?
nl: Heb ik vermeld dat zijn vader miljardair is?
el: Ανέφερα ότι ο πατέρας του είναι δισεκατομμυριούχος;

text: What did they ask?
text_en: What did they ask?
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward question in the past tense. Gender and number for the addressee are neutral as there are no specific markers.
es: ¿Qué preguntaron?
es_latam: ¿Qué preguntaron?
fr: Qu'ont-ils demandé ?
de: Was haben sie gefragt?
it: Cosa hanno chiesto?
pt: O que eles perguntaram?
hi: उन्होंने क्या पूछा?
ja: 彼らは何を聞きましたか？
vi: Họ đã hỏi gì?
sv: Vad frågade de?
nl: Wat vroegen ze?
el: Τι ρώτησαν;

text: May I talk with you in private about the matter?
text_en: May I talk with you in private about the matter?
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request, suggesting a formal or neutral register. The genders are set to the pre-assigned defaults as there are no linguistic cues to indicate otherwise.
es: ¿Podría hablar con usted en privado sobre el asunto?
es_latam: ¿Podría hablar con usted en privado sobre el asunto?
fr: Puis-je m'entretenir avec vous en privé au sujet de cette affaire ?
de: Darf ich mit Ihnen unter vier Augen über die Angelegenheit sprechen?
it: Potrei parlarle in privato della questione?
pt: Poderia falar com a senhora em particular sobre o assunto?
ru: Могу ли я поговорить с Вами наедине по этому делу?
hi: क्या मैं आपसे इस मामले के बारे में निजी तौर पर बात कर सकती हूँ?
zh: 我可以就此事私下与您谈谈吗？
ja: この件について、内密にお話しさせていただけますか？
ko: 이 문제에 대해 사적으로 대화할 수 있을까요?
vi: Tôi có thể nói chuyện riêng với bà về vấn đề này được không?
sv: Får jag tala med er i enrum om ärendet?
fi: Voisinko puhua kanssanne kahden kesken tästä asiasta?

text: I treated him like my own son.
text_en: I treated him like my own son.
en_notes: The speaker gender defaults to female as pre-assigned. The object 'him' refers to a third party, not the addressee, so the addressee gender remains female and the addressee number is not applicable as they are not mentioned in the sentence.

es_latam: Lo traté como a mi propio hijo.

ru: Я относилась к нему как к собственному сыну.

corrections_summary: it: 'un figlio mio' is slightly less natural than 'mio figlio' for 'my own son' in this context → fixed to 'L'ho trattato come mio figlio'; ar: 'الخاص' (private/special) is less natural for 'own son' than 'فلذة كبدي' or simply 'ابني' or 'ابني الحقيقي' → fixed to 'عاملته كأنه ابني تماماً' for better flow.

text: We could see the river, and the distant hills beyond.
text_en: We could see the river and the distant hills beyond.
en_notes: The sentence is a descriptive declarative statement. The modal 'could' indicates past ability or perception. No specific gender or addressee is implied.

es_latam: Podíamos ver el río y las colinas distantes más allá.

pt: Podíamos ver o rio e as colinas distantes além.
ru: Мы видели реку и далекие холмы за ней.
hi: हम नदी और उसके आगे की दूर की पहाड़ियों को देख सकते थे।
zh: 我们可以看到河流以及之外远处的山丘。
ja: 川とその向こうに広がる遠くの丘が見えました。
ko: 우리는 강과 그 너머의 먼 언덕들을 볼 수 있었습니다.

fi: Saatoimme nähdä joen ja kaukaiset kukkulat sen takana.
nl: We konden de rivier en de verre heuvels daarachter zien.
el: Μπορούσαμε να δούμε το ποτάμι και τους μακρινούς λόφους πέρα από αυτό.
ar: كنا نستطيع رؤية النهر والتلال البعيدة وراءه.
corrections_summary: it: 'oltre' at the end of the sentence is unnatural without an object → changed to 'oltre di esso'; zh: missing the 'beyond' nuance → added '之外' to capture the spatial relationship.

text: Sami changed his mentality.
text_en: Sami changed his mentality.

sv: Sami ändrade sin inställning.
nl: Sami veranderde zijn mentaliteit.
el: Ο Σάμι άλλαξε νοοτροπία.

text: Poor as he is, he is happy.
text_en: Poor as he is, he is happy.
en_notes: The sentence describes a third party ('he'), so the speaker and addressee genders remain as the pre-assigned defaults. The structure is a concessive clause meaning 'Although he is poor'.

es_latam: A pesar de ser pobre, es feliz.

de: So arm er auch ist, er ist glücklich.

pt: Por mais pobre que ele seja, ele é feliz.
ru: Несмотря на то, что он беден, он счастлив.
hi: वह गरीब होने के बावजूद खुश है।

vi: Dù nghèo nhưng anh ấy vẫn hạnh phúc.

fi: Vaikka hän on köyhä, hän on onnellinen.
nl: Hoe arm hij ook is, hij is gelukkig.
el: Όσο φτωχός κι αν είναι, είναι ευτυχισμένος.
ar: على الرغم من فقره، إلا أنه سعيد.
corrections_summary: es: 'Pobre como es' is a literal translation that sounds unnatural in this concessive context → changed to 'Por muy pobre que sea' to better reflect the meaning 'Poor as he is'.

text: We've finally done what we've never been able to do before.
text_en: We've finally done what we've never been able to do before.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement using the first-person plural. There is no specific addressee mentioned, so addressee fields are marked as not applicable.

ru: Мы наконец-то сделали то, чего никогда раньше не могли сделать.

zh: 我们终于做到了以前从未能做到的事。
ja: 私たちは、これまでずっとできなかったことをついに成し遂げました。
ko: 우리는 마침내 이전에는 결코 할 수 없었던 일을 해냈어요.
vi: Cuối cùng chúng tôi đã làm được điều mà trước đây chúng tôi chưa từng làm được.
sv: Vi har äntligen gjort det vi aldrig tidigare har kunnat göra.
fi: Olemme vihdoin tehneet sen, mitä emme ole koskaan aiemmin pystyneet tekemään.
nl: We hebben eindelijk gedaan wat we nooit eerder hebben kunnen doen.
el: Επιτέλους κάναμε αυτό που δεν είχαμε μπορέσει ποτέ να κάνουμε πριν.
ar: لقد فعلنا أخيراً ما لم نكن قادرات على فعله من قبل.
corrections_summary: it: gender mismatch → changed 'stati' (masculine plural) to 'state' (feminine plural) to match speaker_gender: female; ar: gender mismatch → changed 'qadirin' (masculine plural) to 'qadirat' (feminine plural) to match speaker_gender: female.

text: He has kept that promise.

en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no cues; the subject 'He' is the person being spoken about, not the speaker or addressee.

corrections_summary: de: The German translation used the perfect tense (habe gearbeitet) which often implies a completed event; the imperfect (arbeitete) or a more descriptive phrase better captures the habitual 'used to' in a neutral register. ru: Removed the parenthetical gender markers to provide a clean neutral/masculine default as is standard for neutral speaker metadata. hi: Removed parenthetical gender markers to provide a clean masculine default for neutral speaker metadata.

vi: Đội nào sẽ thi đấu?
sv: Vilket lag kommer att spela?
nl: Welk team zal spelen?
el: Ποια ομάδα θα παίξει;

text: Don't press it.
text_en: Don't press it.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative command. The addressee gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no contextual cues to override it.
es: No lo pulses.
es_latam: No lo presiones.
fr: N'appuie pas dessus.
de: Drück es nicht.
it: Non premerlo.
pt: Não o pressione.
hi: इसे मत दबाओ।
ja: それを押さないで。
vi: Đừng ấn nó.
sv: Tryck inte på den.
nl: Druk er niet op.
el: Μην το πατήσεις.

text: The town has many high buildings.
text_en: The town has many high buildings.
en_notes: No disambiguation needed. The sentence is a straightforward factual statement with no addressee or speaker-specific markers.
es: La ciudad tiene muchos edificios altos.
es_latam: La ciudad tiene muchos edificios altos.
fr: La ville possède de nombreux bâtiments élevés.
de: Die Stadt hat viele hohe Gebäude.
it: La città ha molti edifici alti.
pt: A cidade tem muitos edifícios altos.
hi: शहर में कई ऊँची इमारतें हैं।
zh: 这个城镇有许多高大的建筑。
ja: その町には高い建物がたくさんあります。
ko: 그 마을에는 높은 건물이 많이 있습니다.
vi: Thị trấn có nhiều tòa nhà cao tầng.
sv: Staden har många höga byggnader.
nl: De stad heeft veel hoge gebouwen.
el: Η πόλη έχει πολλά ψηλά κτίρια.
ar: المدينة بها الكثير من المباني العالية.

text: If you can't sleep, try counting sheep.
text_en: If you can't sleep, try counting sheep.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative suggestion. The register is informal due to the use of a common idiom for insomnia.
es: Si no puedes dormir, intenta contar ovejas.
es_latam: Si no puedes dormir, intenta contar ovejas.
fr: Si tu n'arrives pas à dormir, essaie de compter les moutons.
de: Wenn du nicht schlafen kannst, versuche, Schafe zu zählen.
it: Se non riesci a dormire, prova a contare le pecore.
pt: Se você não conseguir dormir, tente contar carneirinhos.
ru: Если не можешь уснуть, попробуй посчитать овец.
hi: अगर तुम्हें नींद नहीं आ रही है, तो भेड़ें गिनने की कोशिश करो।
zh: 如果你睡不着，试着数羊吧。
ja: 眠れないなら、羊を数えてみて。
ko: 잠이 안 오면 양을 세어 봐.
vi: Nếu cậu không ngủ được, hãy thử đếm cừu xem sao.
sv: Om du inte kan sova, prova att räkna får.
fi: Jos et saa unta, yritä laskea lampaita.
nl: Als je niet kunt slapen, probeer dan schaapjes te tellen.
el: Αν δεν μπορείς να κοιμηθείς, δοκίμασε να μετρήσεις προβατάκια.
ar: إذا كنت لا تستطيع النوم، فحاول عد الخراف.

text: The door to my house is usually unlocked and frequently open.
text_en: The door to my house is usually unlocked and frequently open.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement about a habit or state; no specific addressee is implied, so addressee fields are set to not_applicable.
es: La puerta de mi casa suele estar sin llave y con frecuencia está abierta.
es_latam: La puerta de mi casa suele estar sin llave y frecuentemente está abierta.
fr: La porte de ma maison n'est généralement pas verrouillée et elle est souvent ouverte.
de: Die Tür zu meinem Haus ist gewöhnlich nicht abgeschlossen und häufig offen.
it: La porta di casa mia di solito non è chiusa a chiave ed è spesso aperta.
pt: A porta da minha casa geralmente não está trancada e frequentemente fica aberta.
ru: Дверь моего дома обычно не заперта и часто открыта.
hi: मेरे घर का दरवाज़ा आमतौर पर बिना ताले के होता है और अक्सर खुला रहता है।
zh: 我家门通常不锁，而且经常开着。
ja: 私の家のドアはたいてい鍵がかかっておらず、頻繁に開いています。
ko: 우리 집 문은 보통 잠겨 있지 않고 자주 열려 있습니다.
vi: Cửa nhà tôi thường không khóa và thường xuyên mở.
sv: Dörren till mitt hus är vanligtvis olåst och ofta öppen.
fi: Taloni ovi on yleensä lukitsematta ja usein auki.
nl: De deur van mijn huis is meestal niet op slot en vaak open.
el: Η πόρτα του σπιτιού μου είναι συνήθως ξεκλείδωτη και συχνά ανοιχτή.
ar: عادةً ما يكون باب منزلي غير مقفل وغالباً ما يكون مفتوحاً.

text: Will someone read me a story?
text_en: Will someone read me a story?
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request or inquiry. The speaker and addressee genders remain neutral as there are no specific cues in the text.
es: ¿Alguien me leerá un cuento?
es_latam: ¿Alguien me leerá un cuento?
fr: Est-ce que quelqu'un me lira une histoire ?
de: Wird mir jemand eine Geschichte vorlesen?
it: Qualcuno mi leggerà una storia?
pt: Alguém lerá uma história para mim?
hi: क्या कोई मुझे कहानी सुनाएगा?
zh: 有人会给我读个故事吗？
ja: 誰か私に物語を読んでくれますか？
vi: Sẽ có ai đó đọc truyện cho tôi nghe chứ?
sv: Kommer någon att läsa en saga för mig?
nl: Zal iemand mij een verhaal voorlezen?
el: Θα μου διαβάσει κάποιος μια ιστορία;

text: By participating in discussions, one can quickly learn new words.
text_en: By participating in discussions, one can quickly learn new words.
en_notes: The sentence uses the impersonal pronoun 'one' to make a general statement, so the speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults. The register is formal due to the use of 'one' instead of 'you'.
es: Al participar en discusiones, se pueden aprender palabras nuevas rápidamente.
es_latam: Al participar en discusiones, uno puede aprender palabras nuevas rápidamente.
fr: En participant à des discussions, on peut apprendre rapidement de nouveaux mots.
de: Durch die Teilnahme an Diskussionen kann man schnell neue Wörter lernen.
it: Partecipando alle discussioni, si possono imparare rapidamente nuove parole.
pt: Ao participar de discussões, pode-se aprender palavras novas rapidamente.
ru: Участвуя в дискуссиях, можно быстро выучить новые слова.
hi: चर्चाओं में भाग लेकर, कोई भी नए शब्द जल्दी सीख सकता है।
zh: 通过参与讨论，人们可以快速学习新单词。
ja: 議論に参加することで、新しい単語を素早く学ぶことができます。
ko: 토론에 참여함으로써 새로운 단어를 빠르게 익힐 수 있습니다.
vi: Bằng cách tham gia thảo luận, người ta có thể nhanh chóng học được những từ mới.
sv: Genom att delta i diskussioner kan man snabbt lära sig nya ord.
fi: Osallistumalla keskusteluihin voi oppia nopeasti uusia sanoja.
nl: Door deel te nemen aan discussies kan men snel nieuwe woorden leren.
el: Συμμετέχοντας σε συζητήσεις, μπορεί κανείς να μάθει γρήγορα νέες λέξεις.
ar: من خلال المشاركة في المناقشات، يمكن للمرء تعلم كلمات جديدة بسرعة.

text: The star of the film festival gave Adriano a VIP pass.
text_en: The star of the film festival gave Adriano a VIP pass.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains neutral as it is a third-person narrative. The addressee_gender is set to male because Adriano is a typically male name, overriding the default.
es: La estrella del festival de cine le dio a Adriano un pase VIP.
es_latam: La estrella del festival de cine le dio a Adriano un pase VIP.
fr: La vedette du festival du film a donné un laissez-passer VIP à Adriano.
de: Der Star des Filmfestivals gab Adriano einen VIP-Pass.
it: La stella del festival del cinema ha dato ad Adriano un pass VIP.
pt: A estrela do festival de cinema deu a Adriano um passe VIP.
hi: फिल्म फेस्टिवल के स्टार ने एड्रियानो को एक वीआईपी पास दिया।
zh: 电影节的明星给了阿德里亚诺一张VIP通行证。
ja: 映画祭のスターがアドリアーノにVIPパスを渡しました。
ko: 영화제의 스타가 아드리아노에게 VIP 패스를 주었습니다.
vi: Ngôi sao của liên hoan phim đã tặng Adriano một thẻ VIP.
sv: Filmfestivalens stjärna gav Adriano ett VIP-pass.
nl: De ster van het filmfestival gaf Adriano een VIP-pas.
el: Το αστέρι του φεστιβάλ κινηματογράφου έδωσε στον Αντριάνο ένα πάσο VIP.
ar: أعطى نجم مهرجان الأفلام أدريانو بطاقة VIP.

text: Please try to understand.
text_en: Please try to understand.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative request. The register is neutral to polite, and the addressee is singular by default in a general context.
es: Por favor, intenta comprender.
es_latam: Por favor, intenta entender.
fr: S'il vous plaît, essayez de comprendre.
de: Bitte versuche zu verstehen.
it: Per favore, cerca di capire.
pt: Por favor, tente entender.
hi: कृपया समझने की कोशिश करें।
ja: 理解しようとしてください。
vi: Làm ơn hãy cố gắng hiểu cho.
sv: Snälla, försök att förstå.
nl: Probeer het alsjeblieft te begrijpen.
el: Παρακαλώ, προσπάθησε να καταλάβεις.
corrections_summary: fr: 'S'il te plaît' is informal (T-form), changed to 'S'il vous plaît' or neutral phrasing to better match the neutral register requirement for a general context.

text: I'm not sure that it's worth looking into.
text_en: I'm not sure that it's worth looking into.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral declarative statement. The phrasal verb 'looking into' is considered figurative as it means to investigate rather than physically looking inside an object.
es: No estoy seguro de que valga la pena investigarlo.
es_latam: No estoy seguro de que valga la pena investigarlo.
fr: Je ne suis pas sûr que cela vaille la peine d'examiner la question.
de: Ich bin mir nicht sicher, ob es sich lohnt, dem nachzugehen.
it: Non sono sicuro che valga la pena approfondire.
pt: Não tenho certeza se vale a pena investigar isso.
ru: Я не уверен, стоит ли в этом разбираться.
hi: मुझे पक्का नहीं पता कि इसकी जाँच करना फ़ायदेमंद है या नहीं।
zh: 我不确定这是否值得去深入了解。
ja: それを調べる価値があるかどうか、確信が持てません。
ko: 그걸 조사할 가치가 있는지 잘 모르겠어요.
vi: Tôi không chắc là việc tìm hiểu điều này có đáng hay không.
sv: Jag är inte säker på att det är värt att titta närmare på.
fi: En ole varma, onko siihen syytä perehtyä tarkemmin.
nl: Ik weet niet zeker of het de moeite waard is om uit te zoeken.
el: Δεν είμαι σίγουρος αν αξίζει τον κόπο να το ψάξω.
ar: لستُ متأكداً من أن الأمر يستحق البحث فيه.

text: Only this will ensure that the message gets across.
text_en: Only this will ensure that the message gets across.
en_notes: The sentence uses the phrasal verb 'gets across' which is figurative, meaning to be understood. The tense is simple future based on the modal 'will'.
es: Solo esto asegurará que el mensaje llegue.
es_latam: Solo esto asegurará que el mensaje llegue.
fr: Seul cela permettra de faire passer le message.
de: Nur dies wird sicherstellen, dass die Botschaft ankommt.
it: Solo questo garantirà che il messaggio arrivi a destinazione.
pt: Somente isso garantirá que a mensagem seja transmitida.
ru: Только это обеспечит то, что сообщение дойдет до адресата.
hi: केवल यही सुनिश्चित करेगा कि संदेश समझ में आ जाए।
zh: 只有这样才能确保信息传达到位。
ja: これによってのみ、メッセージが確実に伝わるようになるでしょう。
ko: 이것만이 메시지가 제대로 전달되도록 보장할 것입니다.
vi: Chỉ có điều này mới đảm bảo thông điệp được truyền tải.
sv: Endast detta kommer att säkerställa att budskapet går fram.
fi: Vain tämä varmistaa, että viesti menee perille.
nl: Alleen dit zal ervoor zorgen dat de boodschap overkomt.
el: Μόνο αυτό θα διασφαλίσει ότι το μήνυμα θα γίνει κατανοητό.
corrections_summary: ru: present tense used instead of future → changed to 'гарантирует' to 'гарантирует' (though 'гарантирует' can be habitual, 'обеспечит' or 'гарантирует' with future context is better, but specifically 'обеспечит' fits 'ensure' better); fi: present tense used → changed to 'varmistaa' to 'varmistaa' (future is often present in Finnish, but 'tulee varmistamaan' or keeping present is okay, however 'varmistaa' is technically present, 'tämä vain varmistaa' is fine but 'tämä ainoastaan varmistaa' is more precise); el: literal translation of 'pass' → changed to 'γίνει κατανοητό' to better reflect 'gets across' (understood).

text: Sheep cheese is the best.
text_en: Sheep cheese is the best.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of opinion. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no cues to suggest otherwise.
es: El queso de oveja es el mejor.
es_latam: El queso de oveja es el mejor.
fr: Le fromage de brebis est le meilleur.
de: Schafskäse ist der beste.
it: Il formaggio di pecora è il migliore.
pt: Queijo de ovelha é o melhor.
hi: भेड़ का पनीर सबसे अच्छा होता है।
ja: 羊のチーズが一番です。
vi: Phô mai cừu là ngon nhất.
sv: Fårost är bäst.
nl: Schapenkaas is de beste.
el: Το πρόβειο τυρί είναι το καλύτερο.

text: Did you tie your shoes tightly?
text_en: Did you tie your shoes tightly?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard interrogative. The addressee is assumed to be singular and gender-neutral based on the default provided, as there are no specific cues to indicate otherwise.
es: ¿Te has atado bien los zapatos?
es_latam: ¿Te ataste bien los zapatos?
fr: As-tu bien serré tes lacets ?
de: Hast du deine Schuhe fest gebunden?
it: Ti sei legato bene le scarpe?
pt: Você amarrou bem os sapatos?
hi: क्या तुमने अपने जूते कसकर बाँधे?
ja: 靴紐をきつく結びましたか？
vi: Bạn đã buộc chặt dây giày chưa?
sv: Knöt du skorna hårt?
nl: Heb je je schoenen strak gestrikt?
el: Έδεσες τα κορδόνια σου σφιχτά;
corrections_summary: pt: 'com força' (with force) is less natural for shoes than 'bem' or 'firme' → changed to 'bem'; ru: masculine agreement used for neutral addressee → changed to gender-neutral/masculine default past tense 'завязал' is acceptable but 'крепко ли ты завязал' or checking the adverb placement improves flow; hi: present perfect used for simple past → adjusted to simple past.

text: Are you happy with the result?
text_en: Are you happy with the result?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard question with no specific gender markers, so the pre-assigned speaker and addressee genders were maintained. The addressee number is assumed to be singular as the most common default for direct inquiry.
es: ¿Estás satisfecho con el resultado?
es_latam: ¿Estás satisfecho con el resultado?
fr: Es-tu satisfait du résultat ?
de: Bist du mit dem Ergebnis zufrieden?
it: Sei soddisfatto del risultato?
pt: Você está satisfeito com o resultado?
hi: क्या तुम परिणाम से खुश हो?
ja: 結果に満足していますか？
vi: Bạn có hài lòng với kết quả không?
sv: Är du nöjd med resultatet?
nl: Ben je tevreden met het resultaat?
el: Είσαι ικανοποιημένος με το αποτέλεσμα;

text: The house is on the most level part of the ground.
text_en: The house is on the most level part of the ground.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual observation. 'Level' is used in its literal sense meaning flat or horizontal.
es: La casa está en la parte más llana del terreno.
es_latam: La casa está en la parte más nivelada del terreno.
fr: La maison se trouve sur la partie la plus plane du terrain.
de: Das Haus steht auf dem ebensten Teil des Grundstücks.
it: La casa si trova sulla parte più pianeggiante del terreno.
pt: A casa fica na parte mais plana do terreno.
ru: Дом стоит на самом ровном участке земли.
hi: घर ज़मीन के सबसे समतल हिस्से पर है।
zh: 房子坐落在地面最平坦的地方。
ja: 家は敷地内の最も平らな場所にあります。
ko: 집은 땅의 가장 평평한 곳에 있습니다.
vi: Ngôi nhà nằm trên phần bằng phẳng nhất của khu đất.
sv: Huset står på den mest plana delen av marken.
nl: Het huis staat op het vlakste gedeelte van het terrein.
el: Το σπίτι βρίσκεται στο πιο επίπεδο μέρος του εδάφους.
ar: يقع المنزل على الجزء الأكثر استواءً من الأرض.

text: Do you see these great buildings?
text_en: Do you see these great buildings?
en_notes: The sentence is a direct question using the simple present tense. Gender and number for the addressee are based on the provided defaults as there are no contextual clues to the contrary.
es: ¿Ves estos grandes edificios?
es_latam: ¿Ves estos grandes edificios?
fr: Vois-tu ces grands bâtiments ?
de: Siehst du diese großen Gebäude?
it: Vedi questi grandi edifici?
pt: Você vê estes grandes edifícios?
hi: क्या तुम ये बड़ी इमारतें देखती हो?
zh: 你看见这些宏伟的建筑吗？
ja: これらの立派な建物が見えますか？
vi: Bạn có thấy những tòa nhà lớn này không?
sv: Ser du dessa stora byggnader?
nl: Zie je deze grote gebouwen?
el: Βλέπεις αυτά τα μεγάλα κτίρια;
corrections_summary: hi: used present continuous instead of simple present → changed to simple present; zh: '看到' implies 'can you see' or 'did you see', '看见' or '看' is better for simple present → adjusted to '看见'; ja: '素晴らしい' means 'wonderful', '立派な' or '大きな' is better for 'great' (grand/large) buildings → adjusted to '立派な'; ko: '보이나요' means 'are they visible', '보나요' or '보입니까' is better for 'do you see' → adjusted to '보이나요' (kept for naturalness but ensured it aligns with direct address).

text: Pietro spotted Melissa again.
text_en: Pietro spotted Melissa again.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as the speaker is a narrator. Pietro is a masculine name and Melissa is a feminine name, but they are subjects/objects within the narrative, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Pietro volvió a ver a Melissa.
es_latam: Pietro volvió a ver a Melissa.
fr: Pietro a de nouveau aperçu Melissa.
de: Pietro hat Melissa wieder entdeckt.
it: Pietro ha avvistato di nuovo Melissa.
pt: Pietro avistou Melissa novamente.
hi: पिएत्रो ने मेलिसा को फिर से देखा।
zh: 皮埃特罗再次发现了梅丽莎。
ja: ピエトロは再びメリッサを見つけた。
vi: Pietro lại phát hiện ra Melissa.
sv: Pietro fick syn på Melissa igen.
nl: Pietro zag Melissa weer.
el: Ο Πιέτρο εντόπισε ξανά τη Μελίσα.

text: He's quite stubborn, isn't he?
text_en: He's quite stubborn, isn't he?
en_notes: The sentence uses a tag question to seek agreement. The subject is male, but the speaker and addressee genders are not explicitly defined, so they follow the pre-assigned defaults.
es: Es bastante testarudo, ¿verdad?
es_latam: Es bastante terco, ¿no?
fr: Il est assez têtu, n'est-ce pas ?
de: Er ist ziemlich stur, oder?
it: È piuttosto testardo, vero?
pt: Ele é bem teimoso, não é?
ru: Он довольно упрямый, не так ли?
hi: वह काफी जिद्दी है, है ना?
ja: 彼はかなり頑固ですね。
vi: Anh ấy khá bướng bỉnh, phải không?
sv: Han är ganska envis, eller hur?
fi: Hän on melko itsepäinen, eikö niin?
nl: Hij is nogal koppig, nietwaar?
el: Είναι αρκετά πεισματάρης, έτσι δεν είναι;

text: They look so similar that I don't know who is who.
text_en: They look so similar that I don't know who is who.
en_notes: The sentence is a general observation with no specific addressee. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default.
es: Se parecen tanto que no sé quién es quién.
es_latam: Se parecen tanto que no sé quién es quién.
fr: Ils se ressemblent tellement que je ne sais pas qui est qui.
de: Sie sehen sich so ähnlich, dass ich nicht weiß, wer wer ist.
it: Si somigliano così tanto che non so chi sia chi.
pt: Eles se parecem tanto que eu não sei quem é quem.
ru: Они так похожи, что я не знаю, кто из них кто.
hi: वे इतने समान दिखते हैं कि मुझे नहीं पता कि कौन कौन है।
zh: 他们看起来太像了，我分不清谁是谁。
ja: 彼らはとても似ているので、誰が誰だかわかりません。
ko: 그들은 너무 닮아서 누가 누구인지 모르겠어요.
vi: Họ trông giống nhau đến mức tôi không biết ai là ai.
sv: De är så lika att jag inte vet vem som är vem.
fi: He ovat niin samannäköisiä, etten tiedä kuka on kuka.

text: Your father and I are proud of you, the accomplishments you have made in the time frame you set for yourself.
text_en: Your father and I are proud of you and the accomplishments you have made in the time frame you set for yourself.
en_notes: The speaker is identified as the mother because she refers to 'Your father and I'. The addressee gender remains male as per the default since no specific gender cues are present for the child.
es: Tu padre y yo estamos orgullosos de ti y de los logros que has conseguido en el plazo que te propusiste.
es_latam: Tu padre y yo estamos orgullosos de ti y de los logros que has alcanzado en el plazo que te propusiste.

pt: Seu pai e eu estamos orgulhosos de você e das conquistas que você realizou no prazo que estabeleceu para si mesmo.
ru: Твой отец и я гордимся тобой и успехами, которых ты достиг за установленный тобой срок.
hi: तुम्हारे पिता और मैं तुम पर और उन उपलब्धियों पर गर्व करते हैं जो तुमने अपनी तय की गई समय सीमा में हासिल की हैं।
zh: 你父亲和我为你以及你在自己设定的期限内所取得的成就感到骄傲。
ja: お父さんと私は、あなたが自分で決めた期限内に成し遂げた成果、そしてあなたのことを誇りに思っています。
ko: 네 아버지와 나는 너와, 네가 스스로 정한 기간 내에 이룬 성과들이 정말 자랑스럽구나.

el: Ο πατέρας σου και εγώ είμαστε περήφανοι για εσένα και τα επιτεύγματα που σημείωσες στο χρονικό πλαίσιο που έθεσες στον εαυτό σου.
ar: أنا ووالدك فخوران بك وبالإنجازات التي حققتها في الإطار الزمني الذي وضعته لنفسك.
corrections_summary: fr: 'accomplissements' is less natural than 'accomplis' or 'progrès' in this context, but 'réalisations' is the standard term for achievements → changed to 'réalisations'; hi: 'तुम्हारे पिता और मुझे' is grammatically incorrect for 'proud of' → changed to 'तुम्हारे पिता और मैं... गर्व महसूस करते हैं'; vi: 'Cha và mẹ' is more natural for 'Your father and I' when the mother is speaking → kept as is but ensured the tone is appropriate.

corrections_summary: it: 'membri' is masculine plural, but since the speaker is female and the other person is male, the masculine plural is grammatically correct as the default gender-neutral form in Italian; however, 'eravamo soci' is often more natural for club membership. ar: The dual form 'عضوين' is correct, but the word order 'أنا وهو' is more natural than 'هو وأنا' in MSA. text: The number of words that a language has is finite but the number of sentences is infinite, which is quite interesting. You can make countless numbers of sentences.
text_en: The number of words that a language has is finite, but the number of sentences is infinite, which is quite interesting. You can make countless numbers of sentences.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual observation followed by a direct address to the listener. The 'you' is interpreted as a singular addressee in a neutral, informative context.
es: El número de palabras que tiene una lengua es finito, pero el número de frases es infinito, lo cual es bastante interesante. Puedes crear un número incontable de frases.
es_latam: El número de palabras que tiene un idioma es finito, pero el número de oraciones es infinito, lo cual es muy interesante. Puedes crear un número incontable de oraciones.

zh: 一种语言拥有的词汇数量是有限的，但句子的数量是无限的，这很有趣。你可以造出无数个句子。
ja: 言語が持つ単語の数は有限ですが、文章の数は無限であり、それは非常に興味深いことです。あなたは無数の文章を作ることができます。
ko: 언어가 가진 단어의 수는 유한하지만 문장의 수는 무한한데, 이는 꽤 흥미롭습니다. 무수히 많은 문장을 만들 수 있습니다.

text: Everyone's perception of colour is different. What I call 'yellow', others call 'orange'.
text_en: Everyone's perception of color is different. What I call 'yellow', others call 'orange'.
en_notes: The spelling of 'color' was normalized to the US standard. The sentence is a general statement with no specific addressee or gendered pronouns.
es: La percepción del color de cada persona es diferente. Lo que yo llamo 'amarillo', otros lo llaman 'naranja'.
es_latam: La percepción del color de cada persona es diferente. Lo que yo llamo 'amarillo', otros lo llaman 'naranja'.
fr: La perception des couleurs de chacun est différente. Ce que j'appelle « jaune », d'autres l'appellent « orange ».
de: Jeder nimmt Farben anders wahr. Was ich als „Gelb“ bezeichne, nennen andere „Orange“.
it: La percezione del colore di ognuno è diversa. Quello che io chiamo 'giallo', altri lo chiamano 'arancione'.
pt: A percepção de cor de cada pessoa é diferente. O que eu chamo de 'amarelo', outros chamam de 'laranja'.
ru: Восприятие цвета у всех разное. То, что я называю «жёлтым», другие называют «оранжевым».
hi: रंगों को लेकर हर किसी का नज़रिया अलग होता है। जिसे मैं 'पीला' कहता/कहती हूँ, दूसरे उसे 'नारंगी' कहते हैं।
zh: 每个人对颜色的感知都不同。我所说的“黄色”，别人称之为“橙色”。
ja: 色の感じ方は人それぞれです。私が「黄色」と呼ぶものを、他の人は「オレンジ色」と呼びます。
ko: 색에 대한 사람들의 인식은 저마다 다릅니다. 내가 '노란색'이라고 부르는 것을 다른 사람들은 '주황색'이라고 부릅니다.
vi: Cảm nhận về màu sắc của mỗi người là khác nhau. Những gì tôi gọi là 'màu vàng', người khác lại gọi là 'màu cam'.
sv: Varje persons uppfattning av färg är olika. Det jag kallar 'gult' kallar andra för 'orange'.
fi: Jokaisen väriaisti on erilainen. Sitä, mitä minä kutsun keltaiseksi, muut kutsuvat oranssiksi.
nl: Ieders perceptie van kleur is anders. Wat ik 'geel' noem, noemen anderen 'oranje'.
el: Η αντίληψη του χρώματος είναι διαφορετική για τον καθένα. Αυτό που εγώ ονομάζω «κίτρινο», άλλοι το ονομάζουν «πορτοκαλί».
ar: إدراك الجميع للألوان مختلف. ما أسميه 'أصفر'، يسميه الآخرون 'برتقالي'.

text: I was unsure what to expect.
text_en: I was unsure what to expect.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement in the past tense. There are no gender markers, so the pre-assigned speaker gender is used.
es: No estaba seguro de qué esperar.
es_latam: No estaba seguro de qué esperar.
fr: Je n'étais pas sûr de ce à quoi m'attendre.
de: Ich war mir unsicher, was mich erwarten würde.
it: Non ero sicuro di cosa aspettarmi.
pt: Eu não tinha certeza do que esperar.
ru: Я не был уверен, чего ожидать.
hi: मैं अनिश्चित था कि क्या उम्मीद की जाए।
ja: 何を期待すべきかわかりませんでした。
vi: Tôi đã không chắc chắn nên mong đợi điều gì.
sv: Jag var osäker på vad jag skulle förvänta mig.
nl: Ik wist niet zeker wat ik kon verwachten.
el: Δεν ήμουν σίγουρος για το τι να περιμένω.
ar: لم أكن متأكداً مما يجب توقعه.

text: The light goes on and off.
text_en: The light goes on and off.
en_notes: The sentence describes a repetitive action in the present. No specific speaker or addressee is implied, so gender defaults to neutral and addressee fields are set to not_applicable.

es_latam: La luz se prende y se apaga.
fr: La lumière s'allume et s'éteint.

sv: Ljuset tänds och släcks.
nl: Het licht gaat aan en uit.
el: Το φως ανάβει και σβήνει.

text: The situation is far more serious than we thought.
text_en: The situation is far more serious than we thought.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement using the simple present for the current state and simple past for the previous thought. Gender and register are neutral as there are no specific markers.
es: La situación es mucho más grave de lo que pensábamos.
es_latam: La situación es mucho más grave de lo que pensábamos.
fr: La situation est bien plus grave que ce que nous pensions.
de: Die Situation ist weitaus ernster, als wir dachten.
it: La situazione è molto più grave di quanto pensassimo.
pt: A situação é muito mais grave do que pensávamos.
ru: Ситуация гораздо серьезнее, чем мы думали.
hi: स्थिति हमारी सोच से कहीं अधिक गंभीर है।
zh: 情况比我们想象的要严重得多。
ja: 状況は私たちが思っていたよりもずっと深刻です。
ko: 상황이 우리가 생각했던 것보다 훨씬 더 심각합니다.
vi: Tình hình nghiêm trọng hơn nhiều so với chúng ta nghĩ.
sv: Situationen är mycket allvarligare än vi trodde.
fi: Tilanne on paljon vakavampi kuin luulimme.
nl: De situatie is veel ernstiger dan we dachten.
el: Η κατάσταση είναι πολύ πιο σοβαρή από ό,τι νομίζαμε.
ar: الوضع أخطر بكثير مما كنا نعتقد.

text: She's hoping we'll do that for her.
text_en: She's hoping we'll do that for her.
en_notes: The sentence uses female pronouns ('She', 'her') to refer to the subject, but the speaker's gender remains the pre-assigned default. 'We' implies a group including the speaker.
es: Ella espera que hagamos eso por ella.
es_latam: Ella espera que hagamos eso por ella.
fr: Elle espère que nous ferons cela pour elle.
de: Sie hofft, dass wir das für sie tun werden.
it: Lei spera che lo faremo per lei.
pt: Ela espera que façamos isso por ela.

hi: वह उम्मीद कर रही है कि हम उसके लिए ऐसा करेंगे।

ja: 彼女は私たちが彼女のためにそうしてくれることを望んでいます。

ar: إنها تأمل أن نفعل ذلك من أجلها.

text: Come back in the morning.
text_en: Come back in the morning.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative command or request. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues to override them.

es_latam: Vuelve por la mañana.

sv: Kom tillbaka på morgonen.
nl: Kom 's ochtends terug.
el: Επίστρεψε το πρωί.
corrections_summary: fr: 'le matin' implies 'during the morning' in general, 'demain matin' or 'au matin' is more natural for a command to return; hi: 'आना' is slightly informal, 'आइए' or 'आना' is okay but 'वापस आना' is better as 'वापस आइए' for neutral register; zh: added '吧' to soften the imperative to a neutral register; ko: '오세요' is polite/formal, '와요' or '돌아오세요' fits neutral better but '오세요' is acceptable; ar: 'عُد' is correct for male addressee.

text: How much longer to you think I need to do this?

es_latam: ¿Cuánto tiempo más crees que necesito hacer esto?

ar: كم من الوقت تعتقدين أنني بحاجة للقيام بهذا؟
corrections_summary: es: grammatical error (needless 'de' before infinitive) → removed 'de', es_latam: grammatical error (needless 'de' before infinitive) → removed 'de'

text: I decided to become a lawyer.
text_en: I decided to become a lawyer.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. The speaker gender is set to the pre-assigned default of male as there are no gendered cues in the text.

es_latam: ¿Procederemos según lo planeado?

es_latam: Siempre me río cuando leo sus historietas.

text: Sami is currently in a relationship.
text_en: Sami is currently in a relationship.
en_notes: The name Sami is typically a masculine name in Arabic contexts or a diminutive of Samuel/Samantha; however, since the sentence is a general statement about a third party, the speaker and addressee genders remain at their defaults. The addressee_number is not applicable as this is a declarative statement not directed at a specific 'you'.

sv: Sami är i ett förhållande just nu.

el: Ο Σάμι είναι σε σχέση αυτή τη στιγμή.

text: Aren't you the one who saved me?
text_en: Aren't you the one who saved me?

es: ¿No eres tú el que me salvó?
es_latam: ¿No eres tú el que me salvó?

it: Non sei tu colui che mi ha salvato?
pt: Você não é aquele que me salvou?
ru: Разве не ты тот, кто спас меня?
hi: क्या तुम वही नहीं हो जिसने मुझे बचाया था?
zh: 难道你不是救了我的那个人吗？
ja: 僕を助けてくれたのは君じゃないのか？

nl: Ben jij niet degene die mij gered heeft?

text: Our rival was an honest, competitive person as well.
text_en: Our rival was an honest, competitive person as well.

es_latam: Nuestro rival también era una persona honesta y competitiva.
fr: Notre rival était aussi une personne honnête et compétitive.

it: Anche il nostro rivale era una persona onesta e competitiva.
pt: Nosso rival também era uma pessoa honesta e competitiva.
ru: Наш соперник тоже был честным и конкурентоспособным человеком.
hi: हमारा प्रतिद्वंद्वी भी एक ईमानदार और प्रतिस्पर्धी व्यक्ति था।
zh: 我们的竞争对手也是一个诚实且有竞争意识的人。
ja: 私たちのライバルもまた、正直で競争心のある人でした。

vi: Đối thủ của chúng tôi cũng là một người trung thực và có tính cạnh tranh.

fi: Kilpailijamme oli myös rehellinen ja kilpailunhaluinen henkilö.
nl: Onze rivaal was ook een eerlijk en competitief persoon.
el: Ο αντίπαλός μας ήταν επίσης ένα έντιμο και ανταγωνιστικό άτομο.
ar: كان منافسنا شخصاً صادقاً وتنافسياً أيضاً.

text: Yanni wanted to eat some cereal.
text_en: Yanni wanted to eat some cereal.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default. Yanni is treated as the subject of the sentence, and the name Yanni is typically a masculine diminutive of Ioannis in Greek culture.

es_latam: Yanni quería comer cereal.
fr: Yanni voulait manger des céréales.
de: Yanni wollte Müsli essen.
it: Yanni voleva mangiare dei cereali.
pt: Yanni queria comer cereal.
hi: यान्नी अनाज खाना चाहता था।
ja: ヤンニはシリアルを食べたがっていました。
vi: Yanni đã muốn ăn một ít ngũ cốc.
sv: Yanni ville äta lite flingor.
nl: Yanni wilde wat ontbijtgranen eten.
el: Ο Γιάννης ήθελε να φάει δημητριακά.
ar: أراد ياني أن يأكل بعض الحبوب.
corrections_summary: zh: '谷物麦片' is redundant, simplified to '麦片' for naturalness; ja: 'ヤニ' can be a slang term, 'ヤンニ' is a safer phonetic transcription for the name Yanni.

text: I love this cup.

es_latam: Me encanta esta taza.
fr: J'adore cette tasse.

it: Amo questa tazza.
pt: Eu amo esta xícara.
hi: मुझे यह कप बहुत पसंद है।
ja: このカップが大好きです。
vi: Tôi thích chiếc cốc này.
sv: Jag älskar den här koppen.
nl: Ik hou van dit kopje.
el: Λατρεύω αυτό το φλιτζάνι.

text: You enjoy working here, don't you?
text_en: You enjoy working here, don't you?
en_notes: The sentence is a tag question used for confirmation. The register is neutral to informal, and the addressee is treated as a single individual by default.

es_latam: Te gusta trabajar aquí, ¿no?

it: Ti piace lavorare qui, vero?
pt: Você gosta de trabalhar aqui, não gosta?
ru: Тебе нравится здесь работать, не так ли?

zh: 你喜欢在这里工作，对吧？
ja: ここで働くのは楽しいですよね？
vi: Bạn thích làm việc ở đây, đúng không?
sv: Du trivs med att jobba här, eller hur?
nl: Je werkt hier graag, nietwaar?
el: Σου αρέσει να δουλεύεις εδώ, έτσι δεν είναι;

text: A robin sits on a tree branch.
text_en: A robin sits on a tree branch.
en_notes: The sentence is a general observation with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned; pre-assigned genders are used as placeholders.
es: Un petirrojo se posa en la rama de un árbol.
es_latam: Un petirrojo se posa en la rama de un árbol.
fr: Un rouge-gorge est perché sur la branche d'un arbre.

it: Un pettirosso è posato sul ramo di un albero.
pt: Um pintarroxo pousa no galho de uma árvore.
hi: एक रॉबिन पेड़ की शाखा पर बैठा है।
zh: 一只知更鸟停在树枝上。
ja: コマドリが木の枝に止まっています。
ko: 울새 한 마리가 나뭇가지에 앉아 있다.
vi: Một con chim oanh đậu trên cành cây.
sv: En rödhake sitter på en trädgren.
nl: Een roodborstje zit op een tak van een boom.
el: Ένας κοκκινολαίμης κάθεται σε ένα κλαδί δέντρου.
ar: طائر أبو الحناء يجلس على غصن شجرة.
corrections_summary: pt: 'pisco-de-peito-ruivo' is the European Portuguese term; changed to 'sabiá-laranjeira' (or the generic 'pintarroxo') which is more common in Brazil, though 'pintarroxo' is the direct equivalent for robin. Using 'pintarroxo' for Brazilian Portuguese naturalness.

text: The villagers believed in life after death.
text_en: The villagers believed in life after death.
en_notes: The sentence is a general narrative statement in the past tense. There is no specific speaker or addressee mentioned, so addressee fields are marked as not applicable.
es: Los aldeanos creían en la vida después de la muerte.
es_latam: Los aldeanos creían en la vida después de la muerte.
fr: Les villageois croyaient en la vie après la mort.
de: Die Dorfbewohner glaubten an ein Leben nach dem Tod.
it: Gli abitanti del villaggio credevano nella vita dopo la morte.
pt: Os aldeões acreditavam na vida após a morte.
ru: Жители деревни верили в жизнь после смерти.
hi: गांववाले मृत्यु के बाद जीवन में विश्वास करते थे।
zh: 村民们相信死后的生活。
ja: 村人たちは死後の生を信じていた。
vi: Những người dân làng đã tin vào sự sống sau cái chết.
sv: Byborna trodde på ett liv efter döden.
nl: De dorpelingen geloofden in leven na de dood.
el: Οι χωρικοί πίστευαν στη ζωή μετά τον θάνατο.

text: Give her a moment.
text_en: Give her a moment.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative addressed to a listener. The speaker and addressee genders are neutral as they are not specified, but the object of the sentence is female.
es: Dale un momento.
es_latam: Dale un momento.
fr: Donne-lui un moment.
de: Gib ihr einen Moment.
it: Dalle un momento.
pt: Dê um momento a ela.
hi: उसे एक पल दो।
ja: 彼女に少し時間をあげてください。
vi: Hãy cho cô ấy một chút thời gian.
sv: Ge henne ett ögonblick.
nl: Geef haar een moment.
el: Δώσε της μια στιγμή.
corrections_summary: fr: register was formal (Donnez-lui) but metadata specified neutral/singular → changed to 'Donne-lui' to match singular addressee in a neutral context.

text: I've never seen anything like it in my entire life.
text_en: I've never seen anything like it in my entire life.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement using the present perfect tense to describe a life experience. No specific gender cues are present, so the pre-assigned male default is used for the speaker.
es: Nunca he visto nada parecido en toda mi vida.
es_latam: Nunca he visto nada parecido en toda mi vida.
fr: Je n'ai jamais rien vu de tel de toute ma vie.
de: Ich habe in meinem ganzen Leben noch nie so etwas gesehen.
it: Non ho mai visto nulla di simile in tutta la mia vita.
pt: Eu nunca vi nada parecido em toda a minha vida.
ru: Я никогда в жизни не видел ничего подобного.
hi: मैंने अपने पूरे जीवन में ऐसा कुछ कभी नहीं देखा है।
zh: 我这辈子从未见过这样的事情。
ja: これまでの人生で、このようなものは一度も見たことがありません。
ko: 평생 이런 것은 본 적이 없습니다.
vi: Tôi chưa bao giờ thấy bất cứ điều gì giống như vậy trong suốt cuộc đời mình.
sv: Jag har aldrig sett något liknande i hela mitt liv.
fi: En ole koskaan elämässäni nähnyt mitään vastaavaa.
nl: Ik heb in mijn hele leven nog nooit zoiets gezien.
el: Δεν έχω δει ποτέ κάτι παρόμοιο σε όλη μου τη ζωή.
ar: لم أرَ شيئاً كهذا في حياتي كلها قط.

text: Let's pool all our money.
text_en: Let's pool all our money.
en_notes: The sentence is an invitation or suggestion using 'let's', which functions as an imperative. 'Pool' is used figuratively to mean combining resources.
es: Juntemos todo nuestro dinero.
es_latam: Juntemos todo nuestro dinero.
fr: Mettons tout notre argent en commun.
de: Legen wir all unser Geld zusammen.
it: Mettiamo insieme tutti i nostri soldi.
pt: Vamos juntar todo o nosso dinheiro.
ru: Давайте сложим все наши деньги вместе.
hi: चलो हम अपने सारे पैसे एक साथ मिला लेते हैं।
zh: 让我们把所有的钱凑在一起吧。
ja: みんなのお金を出し合いましょう。

sv: Låt oss lägga ihop alla våra pengar.
nl: Laten we al ons geld bij elkaar leggen.
el: Ας βάλουμε όλοι μαζί τα χρήματά μας.

text: Martino heard Melissa open the door next to his room.
text_en: Martino heard Melissa open the door next to his room.
en_notes: The speaker gender is neutral as it is a third-person narrative. 'Martino' and the possessive pronoun 'his' identify the subject as male, while 'Melissa' is identified as female.
es: Martino oyó a Melissa abrir la puerta de al lado de su habitación.
es_latam: Martino oyó a Melissa abrir la puerta de al lado de su habitación.
fr: Martino a entendu Melissa ouvrir la porte à côté de sa chambre.
de: Martino hörte, wie Melissa die Tür neben seinem Zimmer öffnete.
it: Martino sentì Melissa aprire la porta accanto alla sua stanza.
pt: Martino ouviu Melissa abrir a porta ao lado do seu quarto.
ru: Мартино услышал, как Мелисса открыла дверь рядом с его комнатой.
hi: मार्टिनो ने मेलिसा को अपने कमरे के बगल वाला दरवाज़ा खोलते हुए सुना।
zh: 马蒂诺听到梅丽莎打开了他房间隔壁的门。
ja: マルティーノはメリッサが自分の部屋の隣のドアを開けるのを聞いた。
ko: 마르티노는 멜리사가 자신의 방 옆 문을 여는 소리를 들었다.
vi: Martino nghe thấy Melissa mở cánh cửa cạnh phòng mình.
sv: Martino hörde Melissa öppna dörren bredvid hans rum.
fi: Martino kuuli Melissan avaavan huoneensa vieressä olevan oven.
nl: Martino hoorde Melissa de deur naast zijn kamer openen.
el: Ο Μαρτίνο άκουσε τη Μελίσα να ανοίγει την πόρτα δίπλα στο δωμάτιό του.
ar: سمع مارتينو ميليسا وهي تفتح الباب المجاور لغرفته.
corrections_summary: fi: 'hänen' is ambiguous or refers to someone else; used 'huoneensa' to clearly indicate Martino's own room.

text: The car pulled up to Claudio.
text_en: The car pulled up to Claudio.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no cues. Claudio is a typically male name, but since he is the object of the preposition and not the addressee, addressee_gender remains 'not_applicable'.
es: El coche se detuvo junto a Claudio.
es_latam: El carro se detuvo junto a Claudio.
fr: La voiture s'est arrêtée à la hauteur de Claudio.
