pt: O carro parou ao lado de Claudio.
hi: गाड़ी क्लाउडियो के पास आकर रुकी।
zh: 汽车停在了克劳迪奥身边。
ja: 車はクラウディオのそばに止まった。
vi: Chiếc xe dừng lại bên cạnh Claudio.
sv: Bilen stannade till vid Claudio.
nl: De auto stopte bij Claudio.

text: We lost out to our rival in price competition.
text_en: We lost out to our rival in price competition.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual statement about a business outcome. The speaker gender is set to female per the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Perdimos ante nuestro rival en la competencia de precios.
es_latam: Perdimos ante nuestro rival en la competencia de precios.
fr: Nous avons perdu face à notre rival lors de la concurrence par les prix.
de: Wir haben gegen unseren Rivalen im Preiswettbewerb verloren.

pt: Perdemos para o nosso rival na competição de preços.
ru: Мы проиграли нашему конкуренту в ценовой борьбе.
hi: हम मूल्य प्रतिस्पर्धा में अपने प्रतिद्वंद्वी से हार गए।
zh: 我们在价格竞争中输给了对手。
ja: 価格競争でライバルに敗れました。

sv: Vi förlorade mot vår rival i priskonkurrensen.
nl: We hebben het afgelegd tegen onze rivaal in de prijsconcurrentie.
el: Χάσαμε από τον ανταγωνιστή μας στον ανταγωνισμό τιμών.
ar: لقد خسرنا أمام منافسنا في منافسة الأسعار.
corrections_summary: hi: The verb ending 'हार गईं' (plural feminine) is grammatically incorrect for a group 'we' unless the entire group is exclusively female; 'हार गए' is the standard neutral/masculine plural used for mixed or general groups in Hindi business contexts. → changed to 'हार गए' for naturalness.

text: Tobias was in the living room, watching cartoons.
text_en: Tobias was in the living room, watching cartoons.

es_latam: Tobias estaba en la sala, viendo caricaturas.

el: Ο Τομπίας ήταν στο σαλόνι και έβλεπε κινούμενα σχέδια.
ar: كان توبياس في غرفة المعيشة يشاهد الرسوم المتحركة.

text: We have to make up for lost time.
text_en: We have to make up for lost time.

es_latam: Tenemos que recuperar el tiempo perdido.

ja: 失われた時間を取り戻さなければなりません。
vi: Chúng ta phải bù đắp cho khoảng thời gian đã mất.
sv: Vi måste ta igen förlorad tid.
fi: Meidän on otettava menetetty aika takaisin.
nl: We moeten de verloren tijd inhalen.
el: Πρέπει να αναπληρώσουμε τον χαμένο χρόνο.

text: You're the most amazing person I've ever met.

es_latam: Eres la persona más increíble que he conocido.

ja: あなたは私が今まで出会った中で最も素晴らしい人です。

text: They put their heads down.

es_latam: Bajaron la cabeza.

text: Tom sure is a fast runner.
text_en: Tom sure is a fast runner.

es_latam: Tom sí que es un corredor rápido.

sv: Tom är verkligen en snabb löpare.
nl: Tom is echt een snelle loper.
el: Ο Τομ είναι σίγουρα γρήγορος δρομέας.

text: Sami is still on his antibiotics.
text_en: Sami is still on his antibiotics.
en_notes: The name 'Sami' and the possessive pronoun 'his' identify the subject as male. The speaker gender is set to the female default as there are no cues to the contrary.
es: Sami todavía está tomando sus antibióticos.
es_latam: Sami todavía está tomando sus antibióticos.

corrections_summary: ar: The active participle 'مُرَكِّزاً' is less natural for a state of being than the passive participle 'مُرَكِّزاً' (concentrating) vs 'مُرَكِّزاً' (focused); 'مُتَرَكِّزاً' or 'مُرَكِّزاً' are often used, but 'مُركِّز' is more common for 'concentrating'. For 'focused' as a state, 'مُركِّز' is acceptable but 'مُركِّزاً' in the accusative requires the subject to be the focus. A more natural MSA rendering for 'He was focused' is 'كانَ مُرَكِّزاً' or 'كانَ مُنْتَبِهاً', but 'مُرَكِّزاً' is grammatically correct. However, 'مُرَكِّزاً' is often used for 'concentrating'. A more standard term for 'focused' (state) is 'مُركِّز'. No changes made as it is technically correct, but 'كان مركزا' is the standard.

text: Some people always expect reward from others. Something like a hobby may be self-rewarding.
text_en: Some people always expect a reward from others. Something like a hobby may be self-rewarding.
en_notes: Added the indefinite article 'a' before 'reward' for better grammatical flow. The sentence is a general statement with no specific addressee.
es: Algunas personas siempre esperan una recompensa de los demás. Algo como un pasatiempo puede ser gratificante por sí mismo.
es_latam: Algunas personas siempre esperan una recompensa de los demás. Algo como un pasatiempo puede ser gratificante por sí mismo.
fr: Certaines personnes attendent toujours une récompense de la part des autres. Quelque chose comme un loisir peut être gratifiant en soi.
de: Manche Menschen erwarten immer eine Belohnung von anderen. Etwas wie ein Hobby kann an sich belohnend wirken.
it: Alcune persone si aspettano sempre una ricompensa dagli altri. Qualcosa come un hobby può essere gratificante di per sé.
pt: Algumas pessoas sempre esperam uma recompensa dos outros. Algo como um passatempo pode ser gratificante por si só.
ru: Некоторые люди всегда ждут вознаграждения от других. Что-то вроде хобби может приносить удовлетворение само по себе.
hi: कुछ लोग हमेशा दूसरों से इनाम की उम्मीद करते हैं। शौक जैसी कोई चीज़ अपने आप में ही संतोषजनक हो सकती है।
zh: 有些人总是期望得到他人的回报。像爱好之类的事情本身就可以是一种奖励。
ja: 他人に常に報酬を期待する人がいます。趣味のようなものは、それ自体が報酬になり得ます。
ko: 어떤 사람들은 항상 타인에게 보상을 기대합니다. 취미 같은 것은 그 자체로 보상이 될 수 있습니다.
vi: Một số người luôn mong đợi phần thưởng từ người khác. Một thứ gì đó như sở thích có thể tự mang lại phần thưởng.
sv: Vissa människor förväntar sig alltid en belöning från andra. Något som en hobby kan vara givande i sig själv.
fi: Jotkut ihmiset odottavat aina palkkiota muilta. Jokin harrastuksen kaltainen voi olla itsessään palkitsevaa.
nl: Sommige mensen verwachten altijd een beloning van anderen. Iets als een hobby kan op zichzelf al belonend zijn.
el: Κάποιοι άνθρωποι περιμένουν πάντα μια ανταμοιβή από τους άλλους. Κάτι όπως ένα χόμπι μπορεί να είναι από μόνο του ανταποδοτικό.
ar: يتوقع بعض الناس دائماً مكافأة من الآخرين. شيء مثل الهواية قد يكون مجزياً في حد ذاته.
corrections_summary: de: 'belohnend' is rarely used as an adjective in this context → changed to 'belohnend wirken' or 'selbstbelohnend'; hi: 'फल' (fruit) is slightly too figurative for 'reward' → changed to 'इनाम' or 'प्रतिफल' for better accuracy; vi: 'mang lại phần thưởng cho chính nó' is a bit clunky → changed to 'tự mang lại phần thưởng' for naturalness.

ru: Я могу рассказать своему лучшему другу всё что угодно.
hi: मैं अपने सबसे अच्छे दोस्त को कुछ भी बता सकता/सकती हूँ।
zh: 我什么都可以跟我最好的朋友说。
ja: 親友には何でも話せます。
ko: 나는 내 제일 친한 친구에게 무엇이든 말할 수 있다.
vi: Tôi có thể kể cho người bạn thân nhất của mình nghe bất cứ điều gì.
sv: Jag kan berätta vad som helst för min bästa vän.
fi: Voin kertoa parhaalle ystävälleni mitä tahansa.
nl: Ik kan mijn beste vriend alles vertellen.
el: Μπορώ να πω τα πάντα στον καλύτερό μου φίλο.
ar: أستطيع أن أقول لصديقي المفضل أي شيء.

text: Tom kept his true identity secret.
text_en: Tom kept his true identity secret.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female per the default. The subject 'Tom' and the possessive pronoun 'his' indicate the person being spoken about is male, but the speaker's identity is not specified by the text. Addressee fields are not applicable as this is a declarative statement.
es: Tom mantuvo en secreto su verdadera identidad.
es_latam: Tom mantuvo en secreto su verdadera identidad.
fr: Tom a gardé sa véritable identité secrète.
de: Tom hielt seine wahre Identität geheim.
it: Tom ha mantenuto segreta la sua vera identità.
pt: Tom manteve sua verdadeira identidade em segredo.
ru: Том держал свою истинную личность в тайне.
hi: टॉम ने अपनी असली पहचान गुप्त रखी।
zh: 汤姆对他的真实身份保密。
ja: トムは本当の正体を秘密にしていた。
ko: 톰은 자신의 진짜 정체를 비밀로 유지했다.
vi: Tom đã giữ bí mật danh tính thực sự của mình.
sv: Tom höll sin sanna identitet hemlig.
nl: Tom hield zijn ware identiteit geheim.
el: Ο Τομ κράτησε μυστική την πραγματική του ταυτότητα.
corrections_summary: ru: 'личность' (personality/personhood) is less natural than 'личность' in this context; 'сохранил в тайне' is okay but 'держал в тайне' or 'скрывал' is more common for ongoing secrecy, however, the most accurate correction for 'identity' in this context is 'личность' but the phrasing 'личность в тайне' is slightly clunky → improved to 'скрывал свою настоящую личность' or 'держал свою истинную личность в тайне'. zh: '隐瞒' (concealed) is good, but '保持' or '保密' is closer to 'kept... secret' → refined for naturalness.

text: He isn't capable of self-reflection.
text_en: He isn't capable of self-reflection.
en_notes: The speaker and addressee genders are set to the pre-assigned defaults as the sentence describes a third party ('He').
es: Él no es capaz de hacer autocrítica.
es_latam: Él no es capaz de autocrítica.
fr: Il n'est pas capable d'autoréflexion.
de: Er ist nicht zur Selbstreflexion fähig.
it: Lui non è capace di autoriflessione.
pt: Ele não é capaz de autorreflexão.
hi: वह आत्म-चिंतन करने में सक्षम नहीं है।
zh: 他不具备自我反省的能力。
ja: 彼には自己反省の能力がありません。
ko: 그는 자기 성찰을 할 능력이 없어요.
vi: Anh ấy không có khả năng tự suy xét.
sv: Han är inte kapabel till självreflektion.
nl: Hij is niet in staat tot zelfreflectie.
el: Δεν είναι ικανός για αυτοστοχασμό.
ar: إنه غير قادر على مراجعة الذات.
corrections_summary: es_latam: 'capaz de la autocrítica' is grammatically awkward → changed to 'capaz de autocrítica' for naturalness; zh: '没有...的能力' is slightly wordy → changed to '不具备自我反省的能力' for better flow; ja: 'できません' implies a lack of skill/permission → changed to '能力がありません' to better reflect 'not capable' as a character trait.

text: He's thirsty.
text_en: He's thirsty.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains female as per the default since it is not specified. The subject 'He' refers to a third party, not the addressee, so addressee_gender is not applicable.
es: Tiene sed.
es_latam: Tiene sed.
fr: Il a soif.
de: Er hat Durst.
it: Ha sete.
pt: Ele está com sede.
hi: उसे प्यास लगी है।
ja: 彼は喉が渇いています。
vi: Anh ấy đang khát.
sv: Han är törstig.
nl: Hij heeft dorst.
el: Διψάει.

text: They said they want to be your friend.
text_en: They said they want to be your friend.
en_notes: The sentence uses the third-person plural 'they' for the subject. The addressee gender and speaker gender follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no specific gender markers in the text.
es: Dijeron que quieren ser tus amigos.
es_latam: Dijeron que quieren ser tus amigos.
fr: Ils ont dit qu'ils voulaient être tes amis.
de: Sie haben gesagt, dass sie deine Freunde sein wollen.
it: Hanno detto che vogliono essere tuoi amici.
pt: Eles disseram que querem ser seus amigos.
ru: Они сказали, что хотят быть твоими друзьями.
hi: उन्होंने कहा कि वे तुम्हारे दोस्त बनना चाहते हैं।
ja: 彼らは君の友達になりたいと言っていたよ。
ko: 그들은 너의 친구가 되고 싶다고 말했어.
vi: Họ nói rằng họ muốn làm bạn với em.
sv: De sa att de vill vara dina vänner.
nl: Ze zeiden dat ze je vrienden willen zijn.
el: Είπαν ότι θέλουν να γίνουν φίλοι σου.
ar: قالوا إنهم يريدون أن يكونوا أصدقاءكِ.
corrections_summary: sv: 'vän' should be plural 'vänner' to match the plural subject 'they' → fixed to 'vänner'; fi: 'ystäväsi' is plural but the construction 'olla ystäviäsi' is slightly less natural than 'olla ystäviäsi' or 'ystäväsi' depending on context, but specifically 'ystäväsi' is correct for plural, however, the possessive suffix was fine, but the phrasing 'olla ystäviäsi' implies 'to be your friends' which is correct. No change needed for fi. sv: fixed plural agreement.

text: He focused on his work.
text_en: He focused on his work.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female per the default, as the speaker is a third-party narrator. The subject of the sentence is male, but he is neither the speaker nor the addressee.
es: Él se concentró en su trabajo.
es_latam: Él se concentró en su trabajo.
fr: Il s'est concentré sur son travail.
de: Er konzentrierte sich auf seine Arbeit.
it: Lui si è concentrato sul suo lavoro.
pt: Ele se concentrou em seu trabalho.
hi: उसने अपने काम पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया।
ja: 彼は仕事に集中しました。
vi: Anh ấy đã tập trung vào công việc của mình.
sv: Han fokuserade på sitt arbete.
nl: Hij concentreerde zich op zijn werk.
el: Επικεντρώθηκε στην εργασία του.

text: I think I will buy the red car, or I will lease the blue one.
text_en: I think I will buy the red car, or I will lease the blue one.
en_notes: The sentence expresses a future intention or decision-making process. No specific gender cues are present, so the speaker gender remains neutral and the addressee gender defaults to male as per instructions.
es: Creo que compraré el coche rojo o alquilaré el azul.
es_latam: Creo que compraré el carro rojo o arrendaré el azul.
fr: Je pense que j'achèterai la voiture rouge ou que je louerai la bleue.
de: Ich glaube, ich werde das rote Auto kaufen oder das blaue leasen.
it: Penso che comprerò l'auto rossa o prenderò in leasing quella blu.
pt: Acho que comprarei o carro vermelho ou alugarei o azul.
ru: Думаю, я куплю красную машину или возьму в лизинг синюю.
hi: मुझे लगता है कि मैं लाल कार खरीदूँगा, या मैं नीली वाली लीज पर लूँगा।
zh: 我想我会买那辆红色的车，或者租那辆蓝色的。
ja: 赤い車を買うか、青い方をリースしようと思います。
ko: 빨간색 차를 사거나 파란색 차를 리스할 것 같아요.
vi: Tôi nghĩ tôi sẽ mua chiếc xe màu đỏ, hoặc tôi sẽ thuê chiếc màu xanh.
sv: Jag tror att jag kommer att köpa den röda bilen, eller så kommer jag att leasa den blå.
fi: Luulen, että ostan punaisen auton tai leasaan sinisen.
nl: Ik denk dat ik de rode auto zal kopen, of de blauwe zal leasen.
el: Νομίζω ότι θα αγοράσω το κόκκινο αυτοκίνητο ή θα μισθώσω το μπλε.
ar: أعتقد أنني سأشتري السيارة الحمراء، أو سأستأجر الزرقاء.
corrections_summary: hi: removed gender slashes to provide a clean neutral/default masculine version as per standard practice for neutral speaker gender → मुझे लगता है कि मैं लाल कार खरीदूँगा, या मैं नीली वाली लीज पर लूँगा।

text: We watched the sun as it sunk below the horizon.
text_en: We watched the sun as it sank below the horizon.
en_notes: The verb 'sunk' was changed to 'sank' to follow standard past tense grammar. The speaker and addressee genders remain neutral/default as there are no specific cues in the text.
es: Observamos el sol mientras se ponía bajo el horizonte.
es_latam: Observamos el sol mientras se ponía bajo el horizonte.
fr: Nous avons regardé le soleil alors qu'il descendait sous l'horizon.
de: Wir beobachteten die Sonne, wie sie unter den Horizont sank.
it: Abbiamo guardato il sole mentre scendeva sotto l'orizzonte.
pt: Observamos o sol enquanto ele se punha abaixo do horizonte.
ru: Мы наблюдали за солнцем, когда оно опускалось за горизонт.
hi: हमने सूरज को क्षितिज के नीचे डूबते हुए देखा।
zh: 我们看着太阳沉入地平线。
ja: 私たちは太陽が地平線に沈むのを眺めました。
ko: 우리는 태양이 지평선 아래로 저무는 것을 지켜보았습니다.
vi: Chúng tôi đã ngắm nhìn mặt trời khi nó lặn xuống dưới chân trời.
sv: Vi betraktade solen när den sjönk under horisonten.
fi: Seurasimme aurinkoa, kun se laskeutui horisontin taakse.
nl: We keken naar de zon terwijl die onder de horizon zakte.
el: Παρακολουθούσαμε τον ήλιο καθώς έδυε κάτω από τον ορίζοντα.
ar: شاهدنا الشمس وهي تغرب تحت الأفق.

text: They said that they'd go to church.
text_en: They said that they would go to church.
en_notes: The contraction 'they'd' was expanded to 'they would' for clarity. The speaker gender is set to the pre-assigned female default as the sentence does not provide gendered cues for the narrator.
es: Dijeron que irían a la iglesia.
es_latam: Dijeron que irían a la iglesia.
fr: Ils ont dit qu'ils iraient à l'église.
de: Sie sagten, dass sie in die Kirche gehen würden.
it: Hanno detto che sarebbero andati in chiesa.
pt: Eles disseram que iriam à igreja.
ru: Они сказали, что пойдут в церковь.
hi: उन्होंने कहा कि वे चर्च जाएंगे।
ja: 彼らは教会に行くと言いました。
vi: Họ nói rằng họ sẽ đi nhà thờ.
sv: De sa att de skulle gå till kyrkan.
nl: Ze zeiden dat ze naar de kerk zouden gaan.
el: Είπαν ότι θα πήγαιναν στην εκκλησία.

text: It's a beautiful house that you have there. Did you buy it or build it yourself?
text_en: It's a beautiful house that you have there. Did you buy it or build it yourself?
en_notes: The sentence is split between a declarative compliment and an interrogative question. The register is neutral to informal, typical of a friendly conversation between acquaintances.
es: Es una casa preciosa la que tienes ahí. ¿La compraste o la construiste tú?
es_latam: Es una casa hermosa la que tienes ahí. ¿La compraste o la construiste tú?
fr: C'est une belle maison que tu as là. Tu l'as achetée ou tu l'as construite toi-même ?
de: Das ist ein schönes Haus, das du da hast. Hast du es gekauft oder selbst gebaut?
it: È una bella casa quella che hai lì. L'hai comprata o l'hai costruita tu?
pt: É uma bela casa que você tem aí. Você a comprou ou a construiu você?
ru: У тебя там прекрасный дом. Ты его купил или построил сам?
hi: वहाँ तुम्हारा घर बहुत सुंदर है। क्या तुमने इसे खरीदा था या खुद बनाया था?
zh: 你在那里的房子真漂亮。是你买的还是你自己建的？
ja: そこにあるのは素敵な家ですね。買ったのですか、それとも自分で建てたのですか？
ko: 거기 정말 아름다운 집이 있네요. 직접 사셨나요, 아니면 직접 지으셨나요?
vi: Đó là một ngôi nhà đẹp mà bạn có ở đó. Bạn đã mua nó hay tự mình xây dựng nó?
sv: Det är ett vackert hus du har där. Köpte du det eller byggde du det själv?
fi: Sinulla on siellä kaunis talo. Ostitko sen vai rakensitko sen itse?
nl: Het is een prachtig huis dat je daar hebt. Heb je het gekocht of zelf gebouwd?
el: Είναι ένα όμορφο σπίτι αυτό που έχεις εκεί. Το αγόρασες ή το έχτισες εσύ;
ar: إنه منزل جميل الذي تملكه هناك. هل اشتريته أم بنيته بنفسك؟
corrections_summary: es: gendered 'tú mismo' assumes male addressee → changed to neutral 'tú'; es_latam: gendered 'tú mismo' assumes male addressee → changed to neutral 'tú'; it: gendered 'tu stesso' assumes male addressee → changed to neutral 'tu'; pt: gendered 'você mesmo' assumes male addressee → changed to neutral 'você'; ru: plural/formal 'Вы' used for singular neutral register → changed to 'Ты'; hi: formal 'आपने' used for neutral/informal register → changed to 'तुमने'; ko: formal '계시네요' used for neutral register → changed to '있네요'; el: gendered 'μόνος σου' assumes male addressee → changed to neutral 'εσύ'

text: I felt positive about my journey ahead.
text_en: I felt positive about my journey ahead.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement in the past tense. The speaker's gender remains neutral as there are no specific cues to override the default.
es: Me sentí optimista sobre el viaje que tenía por delante.
es_latam: Me sentí optimista sobre el viaje que tenía por delante.
fr: Je me sentais optimiste quant au voyage qui m'attendait.
de: Ich blickte meinem bevorstehenden Weg positiv entgegen.
it: Mi sentivo ottimista riguardo al viaggio che mi attendeva.
pt: Eu me senti otimista em relação à jornada que tinha pela frente.
ru: У меня был позитивный настрой по поводу предстоящего пути.
hi: मैंने अपनी आगे की यात्रा को लेकर सकारात्मक महसूस किया।
zh: 我对未来的旅程感到乐观。
ja: これからの旅路に前向きな気持ちでした。
ko: 나는 앞으로의 여정에 대해 긍정적으로 느꼈다.
vi: Tôi cảm thấy tích cực về hành trình phía trước của mình.
sv: Jag kände mig positiv inför min kommande resa.
nl: Ik voelde me positief over de reis die voor me lag.
el: Ένιωθα θετικά για το ταξίδι που είχα μπροστά μου.

text: She worked hard in school.
text_en: She worked hard in school.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains neutral as the speaker is an unidentified narrator. The subject 'She' identifies the person being spoken about, but does not change the speaker or addressee gender.
es: Ella trabajó duro en la escuela.
es_latam: Ella trabajó duro en la escuela.
fr: Elle a travaillé dur à l'école.
de: Sie hat in der Schule hart gearbeitet.
it: Lei ha lavorato sodo a scuola.
pt: Ela trabalhou duro na escola.
hi: उसने स्कूल में कड़ी मेहनत की।
ja: 彼女は学校で一生懸命勉強しました。
vi: Cô ấy đã học tập chăm chỉ ở trường.
sv: Hon arbetade hårt i skolan.
nl: Ze werkte hard op school.
el: Εκείνη δούλεψε σκληρά στο σχολείο.

text: Everyone please be quiet.
text_en: Everyone, please be quiet.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative addressed to a group, so addressee_number is plural. The speaker_gender follows the female default as there are no gendered cues.
es: Por favor, guardad silencio todos.
es_latam: Por favor, guarden silencio todos.
fr: Tout le monde, s'il vous plaît, faites silence.
de: Bitte seid alle leise.
it: Per favore, fate silenzio tutti.
pt: Por favor, fiquem todos em silêncio.
hi: कृपया सभी शांत रहें।
ja: 皆さん、静かにしてください。
vi: Mọi người hãy giữ im lặng.
sv: Snälla, var tysta allihopa.
nl: Iedereen, wees alsjeblieft stil.
el: Παρακαλώ, κάντε όλοι ησυχία.
corrections_summary: fr: 'faites silence tout le monde' is slightly unnatural → changed to 'tout le monde, s'il vous plaît, faites silence' for better flow; nl: 'stilte alsjeblieft' is a noun phrase → changed to 'wees stil' to match the imperative verb in the source.

text: We need to resolve this matter.
text_en: We need to resolve this matter.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral declarative statement. No gendered cues are present, so the speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default.

es_latam: Tenemos que resolver este asunto.

hi: हमें इस मामले को सुलझाने की ज़रूरत है।
ja: この問題を解決する必要があります。
vi: Chúng ta cần giải quyết vấn đề này.
sv: Vi behöver lösa det här ärendet.
nl: We moeten deze zaak oplossen.
el: Πρέπει να επιλύσουμε αυτό το ζήτημα.
ar: نحن بحاجة إلى حل هذه المسألة.

text: Mary wasn't thirsty, so she didn't drink anything.
text_en: Mary wasn't thirsty, so she didn't drink anything.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as the narrator is not identified. The addressee gender and number are not applicable as this is a third-person narrative statement.
es: Mary no tenía sed, así que no bebió nada.
es_latam: Mary no tenía sed, así que no tomó nada.
fr: Mary n'avait pas soif, donc elle n'a rien bu.
de: Mary hatte keinen Durst, also hat sie nichts getrunken.
it: Mary non aveva sete, quindi non ha bevuto nulla.
pt: Mary não estava com sede, então ela não bebeu nada.
ru: Мэри не хотела пить, поэтому она ничего не выпила.
hi: मैरी को प्यास नहीं लगी थी, इसलिए उसने कुछ नहीं पिया।
zh: 玛丽不渴，所以她什么也没喝。
ja: メアリーは喉が渇いていなかったので、何も飲みませんでした。
ko: 메리는 목이 마르지 않아서 아무것도 마시지 않았어요.
vi: Mary không khát, nên cô ấy đã không uống gì cả.
sv: Mary var inte törstig, så hon drack ingenting.
fi: Marylla ei ollut jano, joten hän ei juonut mitään.
nl: Mary had geen dorst, dus ze dronk niets.
el: Η Μαίρη δεν διψούσε, οπότε δεν ήπιε τίποτα.
ar: لم تكن ماري عطشى، لذا لم تشرب أي شيء.

text: Some say the new film is not a visual tour de force like others in its genre, but it is worth seeing for other reasons.
text_en: Some say the new film is not a visual tour de force like others in its genre, but it is worth seeing for other reasons.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement with no specific addressee. 'Tour de force' is classified as figurative as it is an idiomatic expression for a masterpiece.
es: Hay quienes dicen que la nueva película no es un prodigio visual como otras de su género, pero vale la pena verla por otros motivos.
es_latam: Algunos dicen que la nueva película no es un prodigio visual como otras de su género, pero vale la pena verla por otros motivos.
fr: Certains disent que le nouveau film n'est pas une prouesse visuelle comme d'autres du même genre, mais il mérite d'être vu pour d'autres raisons.
de: Einige sagen, der neue Film sei kein visuelles Meisterwerk wie andere seines Genres, aber er ist aus anderen Gründen sehenswert.
it: Alcuni dicono che il nuovo film non sia un capolavoro visivo come altri del suo genere, ma vale la pena vederlo per altri motivi.
pt: Alguns dizem que o novo filme não é um prodígio visual como outros do seu gênero, mas vale a pena vê-lo por outros motivos.
ru: Говорят, что новый фильм не является визуальным шедевром, как другие в этом жанре, но его стоит посмотреть по другим причинам.
hi: कुछ लोग कहते हैं कि नई फिल्म अपने जॉनर की अन्य फिल्मों की तरह विजुअल मास्टरपीस नहीं है, लेकिन यह अन्य कारणों से देखने लायक है।
zh: 有人说这部新电影不像同类型的其他电影那样具有视觉震撼力，但出于其他原因，它仍然值得一看。

text: I don't anticipate a problem.

corrections_summary: hi: speaker gender was masculine → changed to neutral/inclusive by using the oblique infinitive with 'hoga' or providing the standard masculine as default while noting neutrality, but for a single string 'मापूँगा' (masculine) is replaced with 'मापूँगा/मापूँगी' or the more common neutral 'मापूँगा' is accepted if forced, however, to truly match 'neutral' speaker gender in Hindi, the future can be expressed, but 'मापूँगा' is specifically male. I will provide the version that is most standard for neutral/unknown: 'मैं घोड़े का वजन मापूँगा।'; ja: '重さ' (heaviness) is okay but '体重' (body weight) is more natural for animals → updated to '体重'.

hi: धरती हमारी जरूरतों को पूरा कर सकती है, लेकिन हमारे लालच को नहीं।
zh: 地球能满足我们的需求，但不能满足我们的贪婪。
ja: 地球は私たちの必要を満たすことはできますが、強欲を満たすことはできません。
ko: 지구는 우리의 필요는 충족시킬 수 있지만, 탐욕은 충족시킬 수 없습니다.
vi: Trái đất có thể đáp ứng nhu cầu của chúng ta nhưng không thể đáp ứng lòng tham của chúng ta.
sv: Jorden kan tillfredsställa våra behov, men inte vår girighet.
fi: Maa voi tyydyttää tarpeemme, mutta ei ahneuttamme.
nl: De aarde kan onze behoeften bevredigen, maar niet onze hebzucht.
el: Η γη μπορεί να ικανοποιήσει τις ανάγκες μας, αλλά όχι την απληστία μας.
ar: تستطيع الأرض أن تلبي احتياجاتنا، لكن ليس جشعنا.

text: They didn't let us park there.
text_en: They didn't let us park there.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement in the past tense. No specific gender or register cues are present, so defaults are used.
es: No nos dejaron aparcar allí.
es_latam: No nos dejaron estacionar allí.
fr: Ils ne nous ont pas laissé nous garer là-bas.
de: Sie haben uns dort nicht parken lassen.
it: Non ci hanno permesso di parcheggiare lì.
pt: Eles não nos deixaram estacionar lá.
ru: Они не разрешили нам там припарковаться.
hi: उन्होंने हमें वहां पार्क नहीं करने दिया।
zh: 他们不让我们停在那儿。
ja: 彼らはそこに駐車させてくれませんでした。
ko: 그들은 우리가 그곳에 주차하는 것을 허락하지 않았어요.
vi: Họ đã không cho chúng tôi đỗ xe ở đó.
sv: De lät oss inte parkera där.
fi: He eivät antaneet meidän pysäköidä sinne.
nl: Ze lieten ons daar niet parkeren.
el: Δεν μας άφησαν να παρκάρουμε εκεί.

text: He saw to it that both boys were well provided for.
text_en: He saw to it that both boys were well provided for.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as the sentence is a third-person narrative. The subject 'He' refers to the person performing the action, not the speaker.
es: Él se encargó de que ambos niños estuvieran bien atendidos.
es_latam: Él se aseguró de que ambos niños estuvieran bien atendidos.
fr: Il a veillé à ce que les deux garçons ne manquent de rien.
de: Er sorgte dafür, dass beide Jungen gut versorgt waren.
it: Si assicurò che entrambi i ragazzi fossero ben sistemati.
pt: Ele cuidou para que ambos os meninos estivessem bem amparados.
ru: Он позаботился о том, чтобы оба мальчика были всем обеспечены.
hi: उसने यह सुनिश्चित किया कि दोनों लड़कों का अच्छी तरह से भरण-पोषण हो।
zh: 他确保两个男孩都得到了妥善的照顾。
ja: 彼は二人の少年が十分に養われるように取り計らった。
ko: 그는 두 소년이 충분히 지원받을 수 있도록 조치했습니다.
vi: Ông ấy đã lo liệu để cả hai cậu bé đều được chu cấp đầy đủ.
sv: Han såg till att båda pojkarna var väl försörjda.
fi: Hän piti huolen siitä, että molemmista pojista huolehdittiin hyvin.
nl: Hij zorgde ervoor dat beide jongens goed verzorgd waren.
el: Φρόντισε ώστε και τα δύο αγόρια να είναι πλήρως εξασφαλισμένα.
ar: لقد حرص على أن يحصل كلا الصبيين على كل ما يحتاجانه.
corrections_summary: es: 'provistos' is slightly literal/clunky in this context → changed to 'atendidos' for better flow; es_latam: 'provistos' changed to 'atendidos' for naturalness; hi: corrected the phrasing to better reflect 'provided for' (financial/material support) rather than just 'cared for' → changed to 'भरण-पोषण';

text: Did you call the authorities?
text_en: Did you call the authorities?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard interrogative. I have used the pre-assigned female gender for both speaker and addressee as there are no contextual cues to suggest otherwise.
es: ¿Llamaste a las autoridades?
es_latam: ¿Llamaste a las autoridades?
fr: As-tu appelé les autorités ?
de: Hast du die Behörden angerufen?
it: Hai chiamato le autorità?
pt: Você ligou para as autoridades?
hi: क्या तुमने अधिकारियों को फोन किया?
ja: 当局に電話しましたか？
vi: Chị đã gọi cho chính quyền chưa?
sv: Ringde du myndigheterna?
nl: Heb je de autoriteiten gebeld?
el: Κάλεσες τις αρχές;

text: He did not finish the marathon.
text_en: He did not finish the marathon.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no cues; the subject of the sentence is male based on the pronoun 'he', but the speaker's identity is neutral.
es: Él no terminó la maratón.
es_latam: Él no terminó el maratón.
fr: Il n'a pas fini le marathon.
de: Er hat den Marathon nicht beendet.
it: Lui non ha finito la maratona.
pt: Ele não terminou a maratona.
hi: उसने मैराथन पूरी नहीं की।
ja: 彼はマラソンを完走しませんでした。
vi: Anh ấy đã không hoàn thành cuộc chạy marathon.
sv: Han fullföljde inte maratonet.
nl: Hij heeft de marathon niet uitgelopen.
el: Δεν τερμάτισε τον μαραθώνιο.
corrections_summary: es: In Spain, 'maratón' is predominantly feminine → changed to 'la maratón'.

text: We made a pact that we wouldn't abandon one another.
text_en: We made a pact that we wouldn't abandon one another.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement about a past agreement. The speaker and addressee genders are set to neutral and not_applicable respectively, as the sentence describes a collective action ('we') without a specific direct addressee.
es: Hicimos un pacto de no abandonarnos.
es_latam: Hicimos un pacto de no abandonarnos.
fr: Nous avons fait le pacte de ne pas nous abandonner.
de: Wir haben einen Pakt geschlossen, dass wir einander nicht im Stich lassen würden.
it: Abbiamo fatto il patto di non abbandonarci l'un l'altro.
pt: Fizemos um pacto de que não abandonaríamos uns aos outros.
ru: Мы заключили пакт о том, что не бросим друг друга.
hi: हमने एक समझौता किया था कि हम एक-दूसरे को नहीं छोड़ेंगे।
ja: 私たちはお互いを見捨てないという約束を交わしました。
vi: Chúng tôi đã lập một giao ước rằng chúng tôi sẽ không bỏ rơi nhau.
sv: Vi slöt en pakt om att inte överge varandra.
nl: We sloten een pact dat we elkaar niet in de steek zouden laten.
el: Κάναμε μια συμφωνία ότι δεν θα εγκαταλείπαμε ο ένας τον άλλον.
ar: عقدنا عهدًا بأن لا يتخلى بعضنا عن بعض.
corrections_summary: es: 'pacto de que' is slightly awkward → changed to 'pacto de no abandonarnos' for better flow; es_latam: same as es; fr: 'pacte de ne pas' is grammatically correct but 'pacte selon lequel' or 'pacte de ne pas' is fine, however, 'les uns les autres' is redundant with 'nous' in this context → streamlined; it: 'patto che' requires 'di' or 'secondo cui' → fixed to 'patto di non abbandonarci'; zh: '协议' (agreement) is a bit formal for a personal pact → changed to '约定' (promise/pact) for naturalness.

text: You emerged from your rest.
text_en: You emerged from your rest.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. I have maintained the pre-assigned female gender for both speaker and addressee as there are no contextual cues to suggest otherwise.
es: Saliste de tu descanso.
es_latam: Saliste de tu descanso.
fr: Tu es sortie de ton repos.
de: Du bist aus deiner Ruhe erwacht.
it: Sei uscita dal tuo riposo.
pt: Você saiu do seu descanso.
hi: तुम अपने विश्राम से बाहर निकली।
ja: あなたは休息から抜け出しました。
vi: Bạn đã bước ra từ giấc nghỉ ngơi của mình.
sv: Du kom ut ur din vila.
nl: Je kwam uit je rust tevoorschijn.
el: Βγήκες από την ανάπαυσή σου.
corrections_summary: de: 'hervorgegangen' implies emerging as a result or from an origin, changed to 'erwacht' or 'hervorgetreten' for physical emergence; ru: 'состояния покоя' is overly clinical, simplified to 'отдыха'; hi: 'निकलीं' is plural/honorific, changed to 'निकली' for singular neutral; zh: '走出来了' implies walking out, changed to '苏醒' or '结束' for a more natural 'emerging from rest' context.

text: Tom tried to regain his balance.
text_en: Tom tried to regain his balance.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female per the default as there are no cues to override it. The subject 'Tom' and the possessive pronoun 'his' identify the person described in the narrative, but not the speaker or an addressee.
es: Tom intentó recuperar el equilibrio.
es_latam: Tom intentó recuperar el equilibrio.
fr: Tom a essayé de retrouver son équilibre.
de: Tom versuchte, sein Gleichgewicht wiederzufinden.
it: Tom ha cercato di recuperare l'equilibrio.
pt: Tom tentou recuperar o equilíbrio.
hi: टॉम ने अपना संतुलन वापस पाने की कोशिश की।
ja: トムはバランスを取り戻そうとした。
vi: Tom đã cố gắng lấy lại thăng bằng.
sv: Tom försökte återfå balansen.
nl: Tom probeerde zijn evenwicht te herstellen.
el: Ο Τομ προσπάθησε να ανακτήσει την ισορροπία του.

text: She's taken a day off.
text_en: She's taken a day off.
en_notes: The subject pronoun 'She' identifies the person who took the day off, but the speaker's gender remains neutral/pre-assigned as female. The sentence is a statement about a third party.
es: Ella se ha tomado un día libre.
es_latam: Ella se tomó un día libre.
fr: Elle a pris un jour de congé.
de: Sie hat sich einen Tag frei genommen.
it: Lei si è presa un giorno di riposo.
pt: Ela tirou um dia de folga.
hi: उसने एक दिन की छुट्टी ली है।
ja: 彼女は一日休みを取りました。
vi: Cô ấy đã nghỉ một ngày.
sv: Hon har tagit en ledig dag.
nl: Ze heeft een dag vrij genomen.
el: Έχει πάρει μια μέρα άδεια.

text: That's a very funny story!
text_en: That's a very funny story!
en_notes: The sentence is an exclamatory statement. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults as there are no contextual cues to suggest otherwise.
es: ¡Esa es una historia muy divertida!
es_latam: ¡Esa es una historia muy divertida!
fr: C'est une histoire très drôle !
de: Das ist eine sehr lustige Geschichte!
it: È una storia molto divertente!
pt: Essa é uma história muito engraçada!
hi: यह बहुत मज़ेदार कहानी है!
zh: 那是一个非常有趣的故事！
ja: それはとても面白い話ですね！
vi: Đó là một câu chuyện rất buồn cười!
sv: Det är en väldigt rolig historia!
nl: Dat is een erg grappig verhaal!
el: Αυτή είναι μια πολύ αστεία ιστορία!

text: I can't blame you for that.
text_en: I can't blame you for that.
en_notes: The sentence is a standard declarative statement. Gender defaults were used as there are no contextual clues to indicate otherwise.
es: No puedo culparte por eso.
es_latam: No puedo culparte por eso.
fr: Je ne peux pas t'en vouloir pour ça.
de: Ich kann dir das nicht verübeln.
it: Non posso fartene una colpa.
pt: Eu não posso te culpar por isso.
ru: Я не могу тебя в этом винить.
hi: मैं इसके लिए तुम्हें दोष नहीं दे सकती।
ja: それについてあなたを責めることはできません。
ko: 그 일로 당신을 탓할 수는 없어요.
vi: Em không thể trách anh về điều đó.
sv: Jag kan inte klandra dig för det.
nl: Ik kan je dat niet kwalijk nemen.
el: Δεν μπορώ να σε κατηγορήσω γι' αυτό.
ar: لا أستطيع أن ألومك على ذلك.

text: Is there any chance that you could do that for me?
text_en: Is there any chance that you could do that for me?
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request, which typically leans towards a neutral or slightly formal register. No gendered cues are present, so the pre-assigned defaults were used.
es: ¿Hay alguna posibilidad de que puedas hacer eso por mí?
es_latam: ¿Hay alguna posibilidad de que puedas hacer eso por mí?
fr: Y a-t-il une chance que tu puisses faire ça pour moi ?
de: Gibt es eine Möglichkeit, dass du das für mich tun könntest?
it: C'è qualche possibilità che tu possa farlo per me?
pt: Existe alguma chance de você fazer isso por mim?
ru: Есть ли какая-то возможность, что ты могла бы сделать это для меня?
hi: क्या इस बात की कोई संभावना है कि तुम मेरे लिए वह कर सको?
zh: 有没有可能你能帮我做那件事？
ja: それを私のためにしてくれる可能性はありますか？
ko: 나를 위해 그것을 해줄 수 있는 가능성이 있을까요?
vi: Có khả năng nào bạn có thể làm điều đó cho tôi không?
sv: Finns det någon chans att du skulle kunna göra det för mig?
fi: Onko mitään mahdollisuutta, että voisit tehdä tuon puolestani?
nl: Is er een kans dat je dat voor me zou kunnen doen?
el: Υπάρχει καμία πιθανότητα να μπορούσες να το κάνεις αυτό για μένα;
ar: هل هناك أي فرصة لأن تقومي بذلك من أجلي؟
corrections_summary: No corrections needed. All translations correctly reflect the neutral register, singular addressee, and female-to-female gender agreement where applicable (notably in Russian and Arabic).

text: Something funny's going on.
text_en: Something funny's going on.
en_notes: The phrase 'funny's going on' is an informal contraction of 'funny is going on'. The term 'funny' is used figuratively to mean suspicious or strange rather than humorous.
es: Aquí pasa algo raro.
es_latam: Algo raro está pasando.
fr: Il se passe un truc bizarre.
de: Hier geht was Komisches vor.
it: Sta succedendo qualcosa di strano.
pt: Tem algo estranho acontecendo.
hi: कुछ गड़बड़ चल रही है।
ja: 何か変なことが起きているよ。
vi: Có gì đó lạ đang xảy ra.
sv: Något skumt är på gång.
nl: Er is iets geks aan de hand.
el: Κάτι περίεργο συμβαίνει.

text: Can you really blame us?
text_en: Can you really blame us?
en_notes: The sentence is a rhetorical question in the simple present tense. The addressee number is interpreted as singular by default, and the pre-assigned female genders are used as there are no contextual cues to override them.
es: ¿De verdad puedes culparnos?
es_latam: ¿De verdad puedes culparnos?
fr: Peux-tu vraiment nous en vouloir ?
de: Kannst du uns wirklich die Schuld geben?
it: Puoi davvero incolparci?
pt: Você pode realmente nos culpar?
hi: क्या तुम सच में हमें दोष दे सकती हो?
ja: 本当に私たちを責められる？
vi: Bạn có thực sự có thể đổ lỗi cho chúng tôi không?
sv: Kan du verkligen klandra oss?
nl: Kun je ons echt de schuld geven?
el: Μπορείς πραγματικά να μας κατηγορήσεις;

text: I don't know what she did, but it worked.
text_en: I don't know what she did, but it worked.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the female default as the sentence does not specify it. The addressee gender is not applicable as this is a declarative statement not directed at a specific 'you'.
es: No sé qué hizo ella, pero funcionó.
es_latam: No sé qué hizo ella, pero funcionó.
fr: Je ne sais pas ce qu'elle a fait, mais ça a marché.
de: Ich weiß nicht, was sie getan hat, aber es hat funktioniert.
it: Non so cosa abbia fatto lei, ma ha funzionato.
pt: Não sei o que ela fez, mas funcionou.
ru: Я не знаю, что она сделала, но это сработало.
hi: मुझे नहीं पता कि उसने क्या किया, लेकिन यह काम कर गया।
zh: 我不知道她做了什么，但成功了。
ja: 彼女が何をしたのか分かりませんが、うまくいきました。
ko: 그녀가 무엇을 했는지 모르겠지만, 효과가 있었어요.
vi: Tôi không biết cô ấy đã làm gì, nhưng nó đã hiệu quả.
sv: Jag vet inte vad hon gjorde, men det fungerade.
fi: En tiedä, mitä hän teki, mutta se toimi.
nl: Ik weet niet wat ze deed, maar het werkte.
el: Δεν ξέρω τι έκανε, αλλά λειτούργησε.
ar: لا أعرف ماذا فعلت، لكن ذلك نجح.

text: Everyone came except for Marco.
text_en: Everyone came except for Marco.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. Marco is a typically male name, but he is the subject of the exclusion, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Todos vinieron excepto Marco.
es_latam: Todos vinieron excepto Marco.
fr: Tout le monde est venu sauf Marco.
de: Alle kamen außer Marco.
it: Sono venuti tutti tranne Marco.
pt: Todos vieram, exceto o Marco.
hi: मार्को को छोड़कर सब आए।
ja: マルコ以外は全員来ました。
vi: Mọi người đều đã đến ngoại trừ Marco.
sv: Alla kom utom Marco.
nl: Iedereen kwam, behalve Marco.
el: Ήρθαν όλοι εκτός από τον Μάρκο.

text: Mary is experienced, isn't she?
text_en: Mary is experienced, isn't she?
en_notes: The speaker is female by default, and the addressee is female by default. The subject 'Mary' and the tag question 'isn't she' confirm the subject of the sentence is female, but do not dictate the speaker or addressee genders.
es: Mary tiene experiencia, ¿verdad?
es_latam: Mary tiene experiencia, ¿no es así?
fr: Mary est expérimentée, n'est-ce pas ?
de: Mary ist erfahren, nicht wahr?
it: Mary ha esperienza, vero?
pt: Mary é experiente, não é?
hi: मैरी अनुभवी है, है न?
ja: メアリーは経験豊富ですよね？
vi: Mary có kinh nghiệm, phải không?
sv: Mary är erfaren, eller hur?
nl: Mary is ervaren, nietwaar?
el: Η Μαίρη είναι έμπειρη, έτσι δεν είναι;

text: He is a kind of gentleman.
text_en: He is a kind of gentleman.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains neutral as there are no cues in the text. The addressee gender is not applicable as the sentence is a statement about a third party ('He').
es: Él es una especie de caballero.
es_latam: Él es una especie de caballero.
fr: C'est une sorte de gentleman.
de: Er ist eine Art Gentleman.
it: È una sorta di gentiluomo.
pt: Ele é um tipo de cavalheiro.
hi: वह एक प्रकार के सज्जन व्यक्ति हैं।
ja: 彼は一種の紳士です。
vi: Anh ấy là một kiểu quý ông.
sv: Han är en sorts gentleman.
nl: Hij is een soort heer.
el: Είναι ένας κάποιου είδους τζέντλεμαν.
corrections_summary: en_notes: Corrected note to clarify that 'addressee_gender' is irrelevant for this third-person statement; zh: Adjusted to a more natural phrasing for 'a kind of'; ar: Refined to better capture the nuance of 'a kind of gentleman' using a more standard MSA structure.

text: I want to be a millionaire.
text_en: I want to be a millionaire.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Quiero ser millonario.
es_latam: Quiero ser millonario.
fr: Je veux être millionnaire.
de: Ich möchte Millionär werden.
it: Voglio essere milionario.
pt: Eu quero ser milionário.
hi: मैं करोड़पति बनना चाहता हूँ।
ja: 私は百万長者になりたいです。
vi: Tôi muốn trở thành triệu phú.
sv: Jag vill bli miljonär.
nl: Ik wil miljonair worden.
el: Θέλω να γίνω εκατομμυριούχος.

text: We'll do our best, thank you.
text_en: We'll do our best, thank you.
en_notes: The sentence is a polite declarative statement. The speaker gender is neutral as it refers to a group ('we'), and the addressee gender follows the pre-assigned default.
es: Haremos todo lo posible, gracias.
es_latam: Haremos todo lo posible, gracias.
fr: Nous ferons de notre mieux, merci.
de: Wir werden unser Bestes geben, danke.
it: Faremo del nostro meglio, grazie.
pt: Faremos o nosso melhor, obrigado.
hi: हम अपनी पूरी कोशिश करेंगे, धन्यवाद।
ja: 最善を尽くします、ありがとうございます。
vi: Chúng tôi sẽ cố gắng hết sức, cảm ơn cô.
sv: Vi ska göra vårt bästa, tack.
nl: We zullen ons best doen, bedankt.
el: Θα κάνουμε το καλύτερο δυνατό, ευχαριστώ.

text: It was only recently that she changed her mind.
text_en: It was only recently that she changed her mind.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains male as per the default since the narrator is not specified. The subject of the sentence is female, but she is not the speaker or addressee.
es: Fue hace poco cuando cambió de opinión.
es_latam: Fue hace poco que ella cambió de parecer.
fr: Ce n'est que récemment qu'elle a changé d'avis.
de: Erst vor kurzem hat sie ihre Meinung geändert.
it: È stato solo di recente che ha cambiato idea.
pt: Foi apenas recentemente que ela mudou de ideia.
hi: हाल ही में उसने अपना इरादा बदला।
zh: 直到最近她才改变主意。
ja: 彼女が考えを変えたのは、つい最近のことでした。
ko: 그녀가 마음을 바꾼 것은 불과 얼마 전이었습니다.

text: The sun soon emerged from behind the clouds.

el: Όλοι έφυγαν εκτός από αυτήν.

text: We're all fired up.

text: She can rightly be proud of her daughter.

text: Yanni started laying down his rules.

text: They resemble each other in all respects.

text: How many days will it take to do that?

fi: Kuinka monta päivää sen tekeminen vie?

text: They sure didn’t miss out on what I provided!

es_latam: ¡De seguro no se perdieron nada de lo que proporcioné!

de: Die haben sich bestimmt nichts von dem entgehen lassen, was ich bereitgestellt habe!

ru: Они точно не упустили ничего из того, что я дал!
hi: जो मैंने दिया, उसे उन्होंने पक्का नहीं छोड़ा!

corrections_summary: es: used 'te di' (gave to you) which incorrectly implies the addressee received it, rather than 'proporcioné/ofrecí' (provided); es_latam: used 'te di' incorrectly and redundant 'de' → fixed to 'proporcioné'.

es_latam: ¡No te achiques!

text: He always does the opposite of what I tell him to do.

corrections_summary: zh: phrasing is slightly unnatural/clunky → rephrased for better flow; hi: added a more direct translation of 'what I tell him to do' to match the simple present structure.

text: Modern technology gives us many new things.

text: The house is opposite the church. You can't miss it.

vi: Họ vẫn chưa bán ngôi nhà của mình.
sv: De har ännu inte sålt sitt hus.
fi: He eivät ole vielä myyneet taloaan.
nl: Ze hebben hun huis nog niet verkocht.
el: Δεν έχουν πουλήσει ακόμα το σπίτι τους.

text: Patty was so short that she couldn't reach the branch.
text_en: Patty was so short that she couldn't reach the branch.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female per the default. The subject 'Patty' and the pronoun 'she' confirm the character described is female, though she is not the speaker or addressee.
es: Patty era tan bajita que no podía alcanzar la rama.
es_latam: Patty era tan bajita que no podía alcanzar la rama.
fr: Patty était si petite qu'elle ne pouvait pas atteindre la branche.
de: Patty war so klein, dass sie den Ast nicht erreichen konnte.
it: Patty era così bassa che non riusciva a raggiungere il ramo.
pt: Patty era tão baixa que não conseguia alcançar o galho.
ru: Пэтти была такой маленькой, что не могла дотянуться до ветки.
hi: पैटी इतनी छोटी थी कि वह टहनी तक नहीं पहुँच सकती थी।
zh: 帕蒂太矮了，够不到树枝。
ja: パティは背が低すぎて、枝に手が届きませんでした。
ko: 패티는 키가 너무 작아서 나뭇가지에 닿을 수 없었습니다.
vi: Patty quá thấp nên cô ấy không thể với tới cành cây.
sv: Patty var så kort att hon inte kunde nå grenen.
fi: Patty oli niin lyhyt, ettei hän ylettynyt oksaan.
nl: Patty was zo klein dat ze niet bij de tak kon.
el: Η Πάτι ήταν τόσο κοντή που δεν μπορούσε να φτάσει το κλαδί.
ar: كانت باتي قصيرة جداً لدرجة أنها لم تستطع الوصول إلى الغصن.

text: I sat at the front in order to hear the lecture clearly.
text_en: I sat at the front in order to hear the lecture clearly.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement in the past tense. No specific gender or addressee is implied, so defaults are used.
es: Me senté en la parte delantera para oír la conferencia con claridad.
es_latam: Me senté al frente para escuchar la conferencia claramente.
fr: Je me suis assis(e) à l'avant pour bien entendre la conférence.
de: Ich saß ganz vorne, um den Vortrag deutlich zu hören.
it: Mi sono seduto/a davanti per sentire chiaramente la lezione.
pt: Eu me sentei na frente para ouvir a palestra com clareza.
ru: Я сел(а) впереди, чтобы четко слышать лекцию.
hi: व्याख्यान को स्पष्ट रूप से सुनने के लिए मैं सामने बैठा।
zh: 为了听清讲座，我坐在了前排。
ja: 講義をはっきりと聞くために、私は前の方に座りました。
ko: 강의를 명확하게 듣기 위해 저는 앞자리에 앉았습니다.
vi: Tôi đã ngồi ở phía trước để nghe bài giảng một cách rõ ràng.
sv: Jag satt längst fram för att höra föreläsningen tydligt.
nl: Ik zat vooraan om de lezing duidelijk te kunnen horen.
el: Κάθισα μπροστά για να ακούσω τη διάλεξη καθαρά.
ar: جلستُ في المقدمة لكي أسمع المحاضرة بوضوح.
corrections_summary: fr: masculine agreement used for neutral speaker → changed to neutral/inclusive phrasing 'Je me suis assis(e)', it: masculine agreement used for neutral speaker → changed to neutral/inclusive phrasing 'Mi sono seduto/a', ru: masculine agreement used for neutral speaker → changed to neutral/inclusive phrasing 'Я сел(а)'

text: After a sudden pause in the conversation she unexpectedly said goodbye.
text_en: After a sudden pause in the conversation, she unexpectedly said goodbye.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female because the subject 'she' is the one performing the action of speaking/saying goodbye. Added a comma after the introductory phrase for better readability.
es: Tras una pausa repentina en la conversación, ella se despidió inesperadamente.
es_latam: Después de una pausa repentina en la conversación, ella se despidió inesperadamente.
fr: Après un silence soudain dans la conversation, elle a dit au revoir de manière inattendue.
de: Nach einer plötzlichen Pause im Gespräch verabschiedete sie sich unerwartet.
it: Dopo un'improvvisa pausa nella conversazione, lei si è congedata inaspettatamente.
pt: Após uma pausa repentina na conversa, ela se despediu inesperadamente.
ru: После внезапной паузы в разговоре она неожиданно попрощалась.
hi: बातचीत में अचानक आए ठहराव के बाद, उसने अप्रत्याशित रूप से विदा ली।
zh: 在谈话突然停顿后，她出人意料地说了再见。
ja: 会話が突然途切れた後、彼女は不意に別れを告げました。
ko: 대화가 갑자기 끊긴 후, 그녀는 예기치 않게 작별 인사를 했습니다.
vi: Sau một quãng tạm dừng đột ngột trong cuộc trò chuyện, cô ấy đã bất ngờ nói lời tạm biệt.
sv: Efter en plötslig paus i samtalet sa hon oväntat adjö.
fi: Keskustelun äkillisen tauon jälkeen hän sanoi odottamatta hyvästit.
nl: Na een plotselinge stilte in het gesprek nam ze onverwacht afscheid.
el: Μετά από μια ξαφνική παύση στη συζήτηση, εκείνη αποχαιρέτησε αναπάντεχα.
ar: بعد توقف مفاجئ في المحادثة، ودّعت بشكل غير متوقع.
corrections_summary: ar: The pronoun 'هي' (she) was placed after the verb which is grammatically redundant and unnatural in this context → moved/removed for better flow; zh: '中断' (interruption/break) is slightly too strong for 'pause' → changed to '停顿' (pause).

text: They're doing great.
text_en: They're doing great.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral declarative statement about a third party. The speaker and addressee genders are set to neutral as there are no contextual cues to override the defaults.
es: Lo están haciendo muy bien.
es_latam: Lo están haciendo muy bien.
fr: Ils s'en sortent très bien.
de: Sie machen sich hervorragend.
it: Se la stanno cavando benissimo.
pt: Eles estão indo muito bem.
hi: वे बहुत अच्छा कर रहे हैं।
ja: 彼らはとてもうまくやっています。
vi: Họ đang làm rất tốt.
sv: Det går jättebra för dem.
nl: Ze doen het uitstekend.
el: Τα πάνε περίφημα.

text: Do you believe that statement?
text_en: Do you believe that statement?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry. Register is neutral, and the addressee is assumed to be singular as is typical for direct questions unless context specifies otherwise.
es: ¿Crees esa afirmación?
es_latam: ¿Crees esa afirmación?
fr: Crois-tu cette affirmation ?
de: Glaubst du diese Aussage?
it: Credi a quella dichiarazione?
pt: Você acredita nessa afirmação?
hi: क्या आप उस कथन पर विश्वास करते हैं?
ja: その発言を信じますか？
vi: Bạn có tin vào tuyên bố đó không?
sv: Tror du på det påståendet?
nl: Geloof je die uitspraak?
el: Πιστεύεις αυτή τη δήλωση;
corrections_summary: fr: register was formal (vous) → changed to neutral/informal (tu) to match singular neutral register; de: register was formal (Sie) → changed to neutral (du); ru: register was formal (Вы) → changed to neutral (Ты); fi: register was formal (Uskotteko) → changed to neutral singular (Uskotko)

text: They paid attention to her attitude.
text_en: They paid attention to her attitude.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no cues. The object 'her' refers to a third party, not the addressee. The sentence is a narrative statement with no direct addressee.
es: Prestaron atención a su actitud.
es_latam: Prestaron atención a su actitud.
fr: Ils ont prêté attention à son attitude.
de: Sie achteten auf ihre Einstellung.
it: Hanno prestato attenzione al suo atteggiamento.
pt: Eles prestaram atenção à atitude dela.
ru: Они обратили внимание на её отношение.
hi: उन्होंने उसके व्यवहार पर ध्यान दिया।
zh: 他们注意到了她的态度。
ja: 彼らは彼女の態度に注目した。
vi: Họ đã chú ý đến thái độ của cô ấy.
sv: De uppmärksammade hennes attityd.
nl: Ze besteedden aandacht aan haar houding.
el: Πρόσεξαν τη στάση της.
corrections_summary: nl: used present tense instead of simple past → fixed to 'letten' (past plural) or 'hadden aandacht voor'. Using 'letten' in Dutch is the past tense form of 'letten', but 'besteedden aandacht aan' is more precise for 'paid attention'.

text: All our mothers are nurses.
text_en: All our mothers are nurses.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default 'male' as the sentence does not provide specific cues. The addressee gender is 'not_applicable' because this is a general declarative statement not directed at a specific listener.
es: Todas nuestras madres son enfermeras.
es_latam: Todas nuestras madres son enfermeras.
fr: Toutes nos mères sont infirmières.
de: Alle unsere Mütter sind Krankenschwestern.
it: Tutte le nostre madri sono infermiere.
pt: Todas as nossas mães são enfermeiras.
hi: हमारी सभी माताएँ नर्स हैं।
ja: 私たちの母親は皆、看護師です。
vi: Tất cả các bà mẹ của chúng tôi đều là y tá.
sv: Alla våra mammor är sjuksköterskor.
nl: Al onze moeders zijn verpleegsters.
el: Όλες οι μητέρες μας είναι νοσοκόμες.

text: The clouds are slowing clearing out the sky so that the sun can break through the sky.
text_en: The clouds are slowly clearing out of the sky so that the sun can break through.
en_notes: Normalized 'slowing' to 'slowly' and removed the redundant 'the sky' at the end of the sentence for better flow. The sentence is a general observation with no specific speaker or addressee.
es: Las nubes se están despejando lentamente del cielo para que el sol pueda abrirse paso.
es_latam: Las nubes se están despejando lentamente del cielo para que el sol pueda salir.
fr: Les nuages se dissipent lentement pour que le soleil puisse percer.
de: Die Wolken verziehen sich langsam vom Himmel, damit die Sonne durchbrechen kann.
it: Le nuvole si stanno lentamente diradando dal cielo affinché il sole possa spuntare.
pt: As nuvens estão se dissipando lentamente do céu para que o sol possa aparecer.
ru: Облака медленно рассеиваются с неба, чтобы солнце могло пробиться сквозь них.
hi: बादल धीरे-धीरे आकाश से छँट रहे हैं ताकि सूरज निकल सके।
zh: 云层正从天空中慢慢散去，好让太阳露出来。
ja: 太陽が顔を出せるように、空からゆっくりと雲が消えていっています。
ko: 태양이 비칠 수 있도록 하늘에서 구름이 천천히 걷히고 있습니다.
vi: Những đám mây đang dần tan đi trên bầu trời để ánh nắng có thể xuyên qua.
sv: Molnen skingras långsamt från himlen så att solen kan bryta igenom.
fi: Pilvet hälvenevät hitaasti taivaalta, jotta aurinko pääsee paistamaan läpi.
nl: De wolken trekken langzaam weg uit de lucht, zodat de zon kan doorbreken.
el: Τα σύννεφα διαλύονται αργά από τον ουρανό, ώστε να μπορέσει να προβάλει ο ήλιος.
ar: تتبدد الغيوم ببطء من السماء لكي تتمكن الشمس من البزوغ.

text: Could you explain to me the meaning of this sentence?
text_en: Could you explain the meaning of this sentence to me?
en_notes: The sentence was slightly reordered for better flow. The register is neutral-polite, and the addressee is treated as singular by default for a direct request.
es: ¿Podrías explicarme el significado de esta frase?
es_latam: ¿Podrías explicarme el significado de esta oración?
fr: Pourriez-vous m'expliquer le sens de cette phrase ?
de: Könntest du mir die Bedeutung dieses Satzes erklären?
it: Potresti spiegarmi il significato di questa frase?
pt: Você poderia me explicar o significado desta frase?
ru: Не могли бы вы объяснить мне значение этого предложения?
hi: क्या आप मुझे इस वाक्य का अर्थ समझा सकते हैं?
zh: 您能不能向我解释一下这个句子的意思？
ja: この文の意味を説明していただけますか？
ko: 이 문장의 의미를 설명해 주실 수 있나요?
vi: Bạn có thể giải thích ý nghĩa của câu này cho tôi được không?
sv: Skulle du kunna förklara innebörden av den här meningen för mig?
fi: Voisitko selittää minulle tämän lauseen merkityksen?
nl: Zou je me de betekenis van deze zin kunnen uitleggen?
el: Θα μπορούσες να μου εξηγήσεις τη σημασία αυτής της πρότασης;
ar: هل يمكنك أن تشرح لي معنى هذه الجملة؟
corrections_summary: fr: 'tu' is too informal for a neutral/polite request to an unspecified addressee → changed to 'vous' (formal/neutral), ru: 'ты' is too informal → changed to 'вы' (formal/neutral), zh: added conditional nuance to better match 'could' → changed to '能不能'

text: You're sunning yourself again.
text_en: You're sunning yourself again.
en_notes: The sentence uses the present continuous tense to describe a current or habitual action. The register is informal due to the use of a contraction and the casual nature of the observation.
es: Estás tomando el sol otra vez.
es_latam: Te estás asoleando otra vez.
fr: Tu es encore en train de prendre le soleil.
de: Du sonnst dich schon wieder.
it: Stai prendendo il sole di nuovo.
pt: Você está se bronzeando de novo.
hi: तुम फिर से धूप सेंक रहे हो।
ja: また日光浴してるんだね。
vi: Anh lại đang tắm nắng nữa rồi.
sv: Du solar dig igen.
nl: Je bent weer aan het zonnen.
el: Λιάζεσαι πάλι.

text: She didn't return the favor.
text_en: She didn't return the favor.
en_notes: The speaker gender is female based on the pre-assigned default. The subject 'She' indicates the person who failed to return the favor is female, but the addressee is not explicitly mentioned.
es: Ella no devolvió el favor.
es_latam: Ella no devolvió el favor.
fr: Elle n'a pas renvoyé l'ascenseur.
de: Sie hat sich nicht revanchiert.
it: Lei non ha ricambiato il favore.
pt: Ela não retribuiu o favor.
hi: उसने एहसान नहीं चुकाया।
ja: 彼女は恩返しをしませんでした。
vi: Cô ấy đã không đáp lại ơn huệ đó.
sv: Hon återgäldade inte tjänsten.
nl: Ze heeft de gunst niet vergolden.
el: Δεν ανταπέδωσε τη χάρη.
corrections_summary: es: added 'me' (to me) which wasn't in the source → removed 'me' for a more faithful translation; es_latam: added 'me' which wasn't in the source → removed 'me'; el: added 'μου' (to me) which wasn't in the source → removed 'μου'

text: I'm looking forward to doing that.
text_en: I'm looking forward to doing that.
en_notes: The sentence is a standard expression of anticipation. The speaker and addressee genders remain neutral as there are no contextual cues to specify them.
es: Tengo muchas ganas de hacer eso.
es_latam: Tengo muchas ganas de hacer eso.
fr: J'ai hâte de faire ça.
de: Ich freue mich darauf, das zu tun.
it: Non vedo l'ora di farlo.
pt: Estou ansioso para fazer isso.
ru: Я с нетерпением жду возможности сделать это.
hi: मैं ऐसा करने के लिए उत्सुक हूँ।
ja: それをするのを楽しみにしています。
vi: Tôi đang mong chờ được làm điều đó.
sv: Jag ser fram emot att göra det.
nl: Ik kijk ernaar uit om dat te doen.
el: Ανυπομονώ να το κάνω αυτό.
corrections_summary: pt: 'Estou com vontade de' means 'I feel like' or 'I want to', which lacks the anticipatory meaning of 'looking forward to' → changed to 'Estou ansioso para fazer isso'.

text: You don't have to spend much money here to have fun.
text_en: You don't have to spend much money here to have fun.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement or advice given to a listener. The register is neutral, and the addressee is treated as singular by default.
es: No tienes que gastar mucho dinero aquí para divertirte.
es_latam: No tienes que gastar mucho dinero aquí para divertirte.
fr: Tu n'as pas besoin de dépenser beaucoup d'argent ici pour t'amuser.
de: Du musst hier nicht viel Geld ausgeben, um Spaß zu haben.
it: Non devi spendere molti soldi qui per divertirti.
pt: Você não precisa gastar muito dinheiro aqui para se divertir.
ru: Тебе не нужно тратить здесь много денег, чтобы повеселиться.
hi: मज़े करने के लिए आपको यहाँ ज़्यादा पैसे खर्च करने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।
zh: 在这里玩得开心不需要花很多钱。
ja: ここで楽しむために、たくさんのお金を使う必要はありません。
ko: 여기서 즐겁게 지내기 위해 돈을 많이 쓸 필요는 없어요.
vi: Bạn không cần phải tiêu nhiều tiền ở đây để vui chơi.
sv: Du behöver inte spendera mycket pengar här för att ha roligt.
fi: Täällä ei tarvitse tuhlata paljon rahaa pitääkseen hauskaa.
nl: Je hoeft hier niet veel geld uit te geven om plezier te hebben.
el: Δεν χρειάζεται να ξοδέψεις πολλά χρήματα εδώ για να διασκεδάσεις.
ar: لا يتعين عليك إنفاق الكثير من المال هنا لكي تستمتع.

text: Let's add him to the guest list.
text_en: Let's add him to the guest list.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default male. The addressee gender is set to the default male, though the 'let's' construction implies a group including the speaker and at least one other person. The pronoun 'him' refers to a third party, not the addressee.
es: Añadámoslo a la lista de invitados.
es_latam: Agreguémoslo a la lista de invitados.
fr: Ajoutons-le à la liste des invités.
de: Fügen wir ihn der Gästeliste hinzu.
it: Aggiungiamolo alla lista degli invitati.
pt: Vamos adicioná-lo à lista de convidados.
ru: Давайте добавим его в список гостей.
hi: चलो उसे मेहमानों की सूची में जोड़ते हैं।
zh: 让我们把他加进宾客名单吧。
ja: 彼を招待客リストに加えましょう。
vi: Hãy thêm anh ấy vào danh sách khách mời.
sv: Låt oss lägga till honom på gästlistan.
nl: Laten we hem toevoegen aan de gastenlijst.
el: Ας τον προσθέσουμε στη λίστα των καλεσμένων.

text: I am here on holiday.
text_en: I am here on holiday.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple declarative statement. The speaker gender is set to female based on the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Estoy aquí de vacaciones.
es_latam: Estoy aquí de vacaciones.
fr: Je suis ici en vacances.
de: Ich bin hier im Urlaub.
it: Sono qui in vacanza.
pt: Estou aqui de férias.
hi: मैं यहाँ छुट्टियों पर हूँ।
ja: 休暇でここに来ています。
vi: Tôi đang ở đây để nghỉ lễ.
sv: Jag är här på semester.
nl: Ik ben hier op vakantie.
el: Είμαι εδώ για διακοπές.

text: I gave the police my statement as to what happened.
text_en: I gave the police my statement as to what happened.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual report of an action. The speaker and addressee genders remain as the defaults because there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Di mi declaración a la policía sobre lo que pasó.
es_latam: Di mi declaración a la policía sobre lo que pasó.
fr: J'ai fait ma déclaration à la police sur ce qui s'est passé.
de: Ich gab der Polizei meine Aussage zu dem, was passiert ist.
it: Ho reso la mia dichiarazione alla polizia su quanto accaduto.
pt: Eu dei meu depoimento à polícia sobre o que aconteceu.
ru: Я дал полиции показания о том, что произошло.
hi: मैंने पुलिस को जो हुआ उसके बारे में अपना बयान दिया।
zh: 我向警方陈述了发生的事情。
ja: 何が起きたかについて警察に供述しました。
ko: 나는 경찰에게 일어난 일에 대해 진술했습니다.
vi: Tôi đã đưa ra lời khai với cảnh sát về những gì đã xảy ra.
sv: Jag gav polisen mitt vittnesmål om vad som hände.
fi: Annoin poliisille lausuntoni siitä, mitä tapahtui.
nl: Ik heb de politie mijn verklaring gegeven over wat er is gebeurd.
el: Έδωσα στην αστυνομία την κατάθεσή μου για το τι συνέβη.
ar: أدليتُ بأقوالي للشرطة بشأن ما حدث.
corrections_summary: ru: speaker_gender is neutral but the verb 'дал' is masculine → changed to 'дала' or 'дал' is impossible in neutral, but 'дал(а)' is clunky, so used 'предоставил(а)' or kept masculine as default while noting neutral; however, for a truly neutral speaker in Russian past tense, masculine is the grammatical default, but 'дал показания' is slightly less formal than 'дал показания полиции'. No changes made as masculine is the standard neutral default in Russian. hi: phrasing was slightly awkward → improved to 'मैंने पुलिस को जो हुआ उसके बारे में अपना बयान दिया' for better flow.

text: It's so random that our dogs have the same name.
text_en: It's so random that our dogs have the same name.
en_notes: The sentence is a casual observation between two people. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Es muy fuerte que nuestros perros se llamen igual.
es_latam: Es muy loco que nuestros perros tengan el mismo nombre.
fr: C'est trop bizarre que nos chiens aient le même nom.
de: Es ist echt krass, dass unsere Hunde den gleichen Namen haben.
it: È pazzesco che i nostri cani abbiano lo stesso nome.

corrections_summary: es: 'distinta' is less precise than 'separada' for instructions → changed to 'separada', es_latam: 'distinta' is less precise than 'separada' for instructions → changed to 'separada', fr: 'Utilise' is informal (T-form); instructions are typically neutral/formal (V-form) or infinitive → changed to 'Utilisez', ru: 'Используй' is informal (T-form); instructions are typically neutral/formal (V-form) → changed to 'Используйте'

text: I need twenty-two labels.
text_en: I need twenty-two labels.

text: I think it's about time we change the subject.

ar: أفترض أنكِ لستِ بحاجة للقيام بذلك.
corrections_summary: zh: '我想必' is grammatically awkward and implies 'I must', changed to '我想' for a neutral assumption; ru: added masculine speaker agreement for 'предполагаю' is already neutral, but the sentence is correct; hi: 'मेरा मानना है' means 'my belief is', changed to 'मुझे लगता है' for a more natural 'I assume/think'.

text: Language is unique in that any statement must start out as the creation of an individual mind.

es_latam: El lenguaje es único en el sentido de que cualquier afirmación debe comenzar como la creación de una mente individual.

ru: Язык уникален тем, что любое высказывание должно начинаться как творение отдельного разума.
hi: भाषा इस मायने में अद्वितीय है कि किसी भी कथन की शुरुआत एक व्यक्तिगत मस्तिष्क की रचना के रूप में होनी चाहिए।

ko: 언어는 모든 진술이 개인의 정신적 창조물로서 시작되어야 한다는 점에서 독특합니다.
vi: Ngôn ngữ độc đáo ở chỗ bất kỳ phát biểu nào cũng phải bắt đầu từ sự sáng tạo của một tâm trí cá nhân.
sv: Språket är unikt på så sätt att varje påstående måste börja som en skapelse av ett individuellt sinne.

nl: Taal is uniek in die zin dat elke uitspraak moet beginnen als de creatie van een individuele geest.
el: Η γλώσσα είναι μοναδική στο ότι κάθε δήλωση πρέπει να ξεκινά ως δημιούργημα ενός ατομικού νου.
ar: تنفرد اللغة بكون أي تصريح يجب أن يبدأ كنتاج لعقل فردي.

zh: 你不打算留在这里，对吧？

I will provide a version that fits the neutral metadata better or keep the most common neutral-default; ru: added the missing verb 'to see' or 'check' for better flow → 'Я пойду проведаю их' or 'Я пойду проверю, как они' (current is okay but slightly informal). text: How has advertising changed since you were a kid?

text: She saw a big monarch butterfly in the garden.
text_en: She saw a big monarch butterfly in the garden.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female per the pre-assigned default as the narrator is not specified. The subject of the sentence is female, but she is not the speaker.

es_latam: Ella vio una gran mariposa monarca en el jardín.

ja: 彼女は庭で大きなオオカバマダラを見ました。

text: Mom, I'm coming!

en_notes: The addressee gender was changed to female because 'Mom' is an explicitly female term. The speaker gender remains neutral as the child's gender is not specified.

es_latam: ¡Mamá, ya voy!

it: Mamma, arrivo!
pt: Mãe, estou indo!

sv: Mamma, jag kommer!
nl: Mam, ik kom eraan!
el: Μαμά, έρχομαι!
corrections_summary: hi: provided both masculine and feminine options → simplified to neutral/inclusive phrasing for a single string; ar: used masculine active participle → changed to a gender-neutral construction to accommodate the neutral speaker gender.

text: She was very active with her children.
text_en: She was very active with her children.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default 'male' as the narrator is not specified. The subject 'She' and possessive 'her' clearly indicate the person being described is female, but this is a third-person statement with no direct addressee.

es_latam: Ella era muy activa con sus hijos.
fr: Elle était très active avec ses enfants.
de: Sie war sehr aktiv mit ihren Kindern.
it: Era molto attiva con i suoi figli.
pt: Ela era muito ativa com seus filhos.
ru: Она была очень активна со своими детьми.
hi: वह अपने बच्चों के साथ बहुत सक्रिय थी।
zh: 她对孩子们非常积极活跃。
ja: 彼女は子供たちに対してとても活動的でした。
vi: Cô ấy đã rất năng động với các con của mình.
sv: Hon var mycket aktiv med sina barn.
fi: Hän oli erittäin aktiivinen lastensa kanssa.
nl: Ze was erg actief met haar kinderen.
el: Ήταν πολύ δραστήρια με τα παιδιά της.
corrections_summary: zh: The translation 'she often did activities with her children' is slightly different from the state of being 'active' → changed to '她对孩子们非常积极活跃' to better reflect the adjective 'active'.

text: That's exciting!
text_en: That's exciting!
en_notes: The sentence is a reaction to a situation or news. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues.
es: ¡Eso es emocionante!
es_latam: ¡Eso es emocionante!
fr: C'est excitant !
de: Das ist aufregend!
it: È emozionante!
pt: Isso é emocionante!
hi: यह रोमांचक है!
ja: それはワクワクしますね！
vi: Thật hào hứng!
sv: Vad spännande!
nl: Wat leuk!
el: Αυτό είναι συναρπαστικό!
corrections_summary: fr: 'passionnant' is slightly too strong for a general 'exciting' reaction → changed to 'C'est excitant !'; sv: 'Vad spännande!' is more natural for an exclamation than 'Det är spännande'; nl: 'Dat is spannend!' often implies suspense/tension rather than just positive excitement → changed to 'Dat is geweldig!' or 'Dat is hartstikke leuk!' but 'Dat is spannend!' is acceptable if the context is a thrill, however 'Wat leuk!' is the most natural neutral reaction.

text: My family are all athletic.
text_en: My family is all athletic.
en_notes: The plural verb 'are' is used with the collective noun 'family' to emphasize the individual members. Speaker gender is kept as neutral per the default as there are no gendered cues.
es: Todos en mi familia son deportistas.
es_latam: Todos en mi familia son deportistas.
fr: Tous les membres de ma famille sont sportifs.
de: Meine ganze Familie ist sportlich.
it: La mia famiglia è tutta sportiva.
pt: Todos na minha família são esportistas.
hi: मेरा पूरा परिवार एथलेटिक है।
zh: 我的家人都很擅长运动。
ja: 私の家族はみんな運動神経がいいです。
vi: Cả gia đình tôi đều có khiếu thể thao.
sv: Hela min familj är sportig.
nl: Mijn hele familie is sportief.
el: Όλη η οικογένειά μου είναι αθλητική.
corrections_summary: text_en: Changed 'are' to 'is' for standard American/International English, though 'are' is acceptable in British English, 'is' is more universally neutral. es: Adjusted to 'Todos en mi familia son deportistas' to better reflect the plural emphasis of the original. fr: Adjusted to 'Tous les membres de ma famille sont sportifs' to capture the emphasis on individual members. pt: Changed 'atlética' to 'esportista' as 'atlética' often refers to physical build or specific track-and-field context in BP. vi: Changed 'năng động' (active) to 'có khiếu thể thao' (athletic/sporty).

text: Not having a telephone is an inconvenience.
text_en: Not having a telephone is an inconvenience.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of fact or opinion. No specific speaker or addressee is implied, so the addressee fields are marked as not applicable.
es: No tener teléfono es un inconveniente.
es_latam: No tener teléfono es un inconveniente.
fr: Ne pas avoir de téléphone est un inconvénient.
de: Kein Telefon zu haben, ist eine Unannehmlichkeit.
it: Non avere un telefono è un inconveniente.
pt: Não ter um telefone é um inconveniente.
hi: टेलीफोन न होना एक असुविधा है।
ja: 電話がないのは不便です。
vi: Không có điện thoại là một sự bất tiện.
sv: Att inte ha en telefon är en olägenhet.
nl: Geen telefoon hebben is een ongemak.
el: Το να μην έχεις τηλέφωνο είναι μια ενόχληση.
ar: عدم وجود هاتف هو أمر مزعج.
corrections_summary: el: 'ταλαιπωρία' implies more of a struggle or hardship than a simple inconvenience → changed to 'ενόχληση' for a more accurate neutral register.

text: I thought that I'd walk you to school.
text_en: I thought that I'd walk you to school.
en_notes: The sentence uses the contraction 'I'd' representing 'I would' in a past-tense frame of thought. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no internal cues.

es_latam: Pensé que te acompañaría a la escuela.

ru: Я думала, что провожу тебя в школу.

sv: Jag tänkte att jag skulle följa dig till skolan.
nl: Ik dacht dat ik je naar school zou brengen.
el: Σκέφτηκα να σε συνοδεύσω στο σχολείο.

text: If he authorized you to enter, then get ready!
text_en: If he authorized you to enter, then get ready!
en_notes: The speaker gender remains neutral as there are no cues. The addressee gender is neutral, but the addressee number is singular by default for direct instruction. The main clause uses the imperative mood.
es: Si él te autorizó a entrar, ¡prepárate!
es_latam: Si él te autorizó a entrar, ¡prepárate!
fr: S'il t'a autorisé à entrer, alors prépare-toi !

ru: Если он разрешил тебе войти, то готовься!

sv: Om han gav dig tillåtelse att gå in, gör dig redo!
fi: Jos hän antoi sinulle luvan tulla sisään, valmistaudu!
nl: Als hij je toestemming heeft gegeven om binnen te komen, maak je dan klaar!
el: Αν σου επέτρεψε να μπεις, τότε ετοιμάσου!

text: He has said he intends to do that.
text_en: He has said he intends to do that.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as there are no cues to override the default. The addressee gender remains female as per the default, though the sentence is a declarative statement about a third party.

corrections_summary: fr: incorrect tense sequence (present instead of present/subjunctive) → changed to 'qu'il avait l'intention' or 'qu'il a l'intention' is acceptable but 'qu'il compte' is more natural; pt: used preterite instead of present perfect → changed to 'tem dito'; ru: used past tense instead of present perfect equivalent → changed to 'Он говорил'.

text: This is the biggest book I've ever seen.

es: Este es el libro más grande que he visto jamás.

text: The whole town has cable TV.

es_latam: Todo el pueblo tiene televisión por cable.

text: Even though he's my neighbour, I don't know him very well.

text: It's just down the street on your left.

corrections_summary: fr: 'ta gauche' is informal, changed to 'votre gauche' for neutral register; zh: '您的' is formal, changed to '你的' for neutral register; ar: 'نهاية الشارع' means 'end of the street', changed to 'على طول الشارع' to better reflect 'down the street'.

text: After a short pursuit, the police caught him.

en_notes: The sentence uses the present perfect tense to describe a current state resulting from a past change. 'Gone crazy' is categorized as figurative as it is an idiomatic expression for extreme stress or eccentricity rather than a clinical diagnosis.

corrections_summary: it: speaker gender is neutral but translation used masculine agreement → changed to 'impazzito/a' or 'andato/a fuori di testa' to be more inclusive, but since it's a single string, I will provide the masculine as default with a note or use a gender-neutral phrasing if possible. However, following standard practice for neutral speaker gender in Italian, the masculine is the default, but 'andare fuori di testa' is more idiomatic for 'gone crazy' in an informal register. ru: speaker gender is neutral but translation used masculine 'сошёл' → changed to 'сошёл/сошла' or 'сошёл' as default. zh: '正式' is too formal for 'officially' in this context → changed to '真的'. ja: '正式に' is too literal/formal → changed to 'ついに' or '本格的に' to match the informal register.

corrections_summary: hi: speaker gender was masculine → changed to neutral/inclusive phrasing by using 'सोच रहा/रही हूँ' or the more common 'सोच रहा हूँ' (though Hindi requires a choice, the provided version was specifically masculine); ja: added a more natural reflective ending for 'I wonder'.

corrections_summary: it: 'a cuore' is less common than 'a cuore' in this specific negative imperative context, changed to 'non prendertela a cuore' for naturalness; nl: 'trek je... niet aan' was missing the object 'het', fixed to 'trek je hun kritiek dan ook niet aan' (already present) but improved flow; sv: 'ta... personligt' is fine but 'ta åt dig' is more idiomatic for 'take to heart'.

text: I haven't yet washed the dishes.

text: The disagreement with him and with his strategy are at the heart of the matter.
text_en: The disagreement with him and with his strategy is at the heart of the matter.
en_notes: The verb was changed from 'are' to 'is' to agree with the singular subject 'disagreement'. The speaker and addressee genders are neutral as they are not specified, though the subject of the sentence refers to a third-party male.
es: El desacuerdo con él y con su estrategia es el quid de la cuestión.
es_latam: El desacuerdo con él y con su estrategia es el meollo del asunto.

hi: उनके और उनकी रणनीति के साथ असहमति इस मामले की जड़ है।

fi: Erimielisyys hänen ja hänen strategiansa kanssa on asian ydin.
nl: De onenigheid met hem en zijn strategie vormt de kern van de zaak.
el: Η διαφωνία μαζί του και με τη στρατηγική του είναι η ουσία του ζητήματος.
ar: الخلاف معه ومع استراتيجيته هو جوهر المسألة.

text: What's the real reason behind this?

nl: Wat is de werkelijke reden hierachter?
el: Ποιος είναι ο πραγματικός λόγος πίσω από αυτό;

text: We have our own theory.
text_en: We have our own theory.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. Gender and addressee number are not specified, so they follow the pre-assigned defaults or neutral categorization.

ja: 私たちには独自の理論があります。
vi: Chúng tôi có lý thuyết riêng của mình.
sv: Vi har vår egen teori.
nl: We hebben onze eigen theorie.
el: Έχουμε τη δική μας θεωρία.
corrections_summary: it: 'la nostra propria' is redundant in Italian; 'la nostra' or 'una nostra' is more natural, but 'la propria' is the standard way to emphasize 'own' without repeating the possessive adjective. Fixed to 'Abbiamo la nostra teoria' or 'Abbiamo una nostra teoria', but 'Abbiamo la nostra propria' is grammatically correct yet slightly clunky. However, 'Abbiamo una nostra teoria' is the most natural for 'our own'.

text: Do you like this colour?

nl: Je had je auto moeten wassen.

text: Self-dependence means relying on yourself instead of others.
text_en: Self-dependence means relying on yourself instead of others.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement or definition, so the addressee is not applicable. The speaker and addressee genders remain neutral as it is a universal truth.
es: La independencia personal significa confiar en uno mismo en lugar de en los demás.
es_latam: La independencia personal significa confiar en uno mismo en lugar de en los demás.
fr: L'indépendance signifie compter sur soi-même plutôt que sur les autres.
de: Selbstständigkeit bedeutet, sich auf sich selbst zu verlassen, anstatt auf andere.
it: L'indipendenza significa fare affidamento su se stessi invece che sugli altri.
pt: A independência pessoal significa confiar em si mesmo em vez de nos outros.
ru: Самостоятельность означает полагаться на себя, а не на других.
hi: आत्मनिर्भरता का अर्थ है दूसरों के बजाय खुद पर भरोसा करना।

ja: 自立とは、他人に頼るのではなく自分自身を頼りにすることを意味します。
ko: 자립이란 타인에게 의존하지 않고 자기 자신에게 의지하는 것을 의미합니다.
vi: Tự lập có nghĩa là dựa vào chính mình thay vì dựa vào người khác.
sv: Självständighet innebär att man litar på sig själv istället för på andra.
fi: Itsenäisyys tarkoittaa itseensä luottamista muiden sijaan.
nl: Zelfstandigheid betekent dat je op jezelf vertrouwt in plaats van op anderen.
el: Αυτονομία σημαίνει να βασίζεσαι στον εαυτό σου αντί για τους άλλους.
ar: الاعتماد على الذات يعني الاعتماد على نفسك بدلاً من الآخرين.

text: No one uses that word anymore.
text_en: No one uses that word anymore.

text: We inched forward.

en_notes: The verb 'inched' is categorized as figurative because it uses a unit of measurement as a metaphor for moving very slowly.

es_latam: Avanzamos centímetro a centímetro.
fr: Nous avons avancé petit à petit.

vi: Chúng tôi nhích dần về phía trước.
sv: Vi rörde oss framåt tum för tum.
nl: We schuifelden voetje voor voetje vooruit.

corrections_summary: ru: 'черепашьим шагом' (at a snail's pace) is slightly too idiomatic for the neutral 'inched'; changed to 'дюйм за дюймом' to preserve the measurement metaphor. el: 'σιγά σιγά' (slowly) is too generic; changed to 'πόντο πόντο' (inch by inch/centimeter by centimeter) to match the figurative intensity.

text: This is destroying your life.

text: Good night, darling.

text: He's now a teacher, isn't he?
