ar: أحب حقاً الذهاب إلى المدرسة بالدراجة.

text: Who disagrees?
text_en: Who disagrees?
en_notes: The sentence is a direct question addressed to a group or individual. Gender is not specified, so the pre-assigned defaults are used.
es: ¿Quién no está de acuerdo?
es_latam: ¿Quién no está de acuerdo?
fr: Qui n'est pas d'accord ?
de: Wer ist anderer Meinung?
it: Chi non è d'accordo?
pt: Quem não concorda?
hi: कौन असहमत है?
ja: 誰が反対ですか？
vi: Ai không đồng ý?
sv: Vem håller inte med?
nl: Wie is het er niet mee eens?
el: Ποιος διαφωνεί;
corrections_summary: ru: grammatical error (subject-verb agreement) → fixed 'согласны' (plural) to 'согласен' (singular) because 'Кто' always takes a singular verb in Russian regardless of the addressee number.

text: Sami got beers out of the freezer.
text_en: Sami got beers out of the freezer.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male because Sami is a typically masculine name in many cultures (e.g., Arabic, Finnish), overriding the neutral default. The sentence is a simple narrative statement with no addressee.
es: Sami sacó cervezas del congelador.
es_latam: Sami sacó cervezas del congelador.
fr: Sami a sorti des bières du congélateur.
de: Sami holte Biere aus dem Gefrierfach.
it: Sami ha tirato fuori delle birre dal congelatore.
pt: Sami tirou cervejas do congelador.
hi: सामी ने फ्रीजर से बियर निकालीं।
zh: 萨米从冷冻室里拿出了啤酒。
ja: サミは冷凍庫からビールを取り出した。
vi: Sami đã lấy bia ra khỏi ngăn đá.
sv: Sami tog ut öl ur frysen.
nl: Sami haalde bier uit de vriezer.
el: Ο Σάμι έβγαλε μπίρες από την κατάψυξη.
ar: أخرج سامي زجاجات بيرة من المجمد.
corrections_summary: hi: 'बीयरें' is an unnatural pluralization of a loanword → changed to 'बियर' (uncountable/collective); ar: 'بيرة' is singular → changed to 'بِيرا' or 'زجاجات بيرة' (plural) to match 'beers'.

text: What kind of food do you have to avoid?
text_en: What kind of food do you have to avoid?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry about dietary restrictions. The addressee gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: ¿Qué tipo de comida tienes que evitar?
es_latam: ¿Qué tipo de comida tienes que evitar?
fr: Quel genre de nourriture dois-tu éviter ?
de: Welche Art von Lebensmitteln musst du meiden?
it: Che tipo di cibo devi evitare?
pt: Que tipo de comida você tem que evitar?
hi: आपको किस तरह के खाने से परहेज करना है?
ja: どのような食べ物を避ける必要がありますか？
vi: Bạn phải tránh loại thức ăn nào?
sv: Vilken typ av mat måste du undvika?
nl: Wat voor soort voedsel moet je vermijden?
el: Τι είδους φαγητό πρέπει να αποφεύγεις;
ar: ما نوع الطعام الذي يجب عليكِ تجنبه؟
corrections_summary: ru: grammatical error (incorrect case after 'избегать') → corrected to genitive case 'избегать какой еды'.

text: They're not following.
text_en: They're not following.
en_notes: The sentence is ambiguous regarding whether it refers to physical movement or mental comprehension; 'following' is treated as a present continuous action. Gender defaults are applied as there are no specific cues.
es: No están siguiendo.
es_latam: No están siguiendo.
fr: Ils ne suivent pas.
de: Sie folgen nicht.
it: Non stanno seguendo.
pt: Eles não estão seguindo.
hi: वे अनुसरण नहीं कर रहे हैं।
ja: 彼らはついてきていません。
vi: Họ không đi theo.
sv: De följer inte efter.
nl: Ze volgen niet.
el: Δεν ακολουθούν.
corrections_summary: es: added 'nos' (us) which wasn't in the source → removed 'nos' to maintain ambiguity, es_latam: added 'nos' (us) which wasn't in the source → removed 'nos' to maintain ambiguity, ru: added 'za nami' (behind us) which wasn't in the source → changed to 'Oni ne sleduyut' to maintain ambiguity, hi: added 'picha' (chasing/following behind) which is too specific → changed to 've anusaran nahi kar rahe hain' for a more neutral 'following', ar: added 'na' (us) which wasn't in the source → removed 'na' to maintain ambiguity

text: I went on foot.
text_en: I went on foot.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple declarative statement in the past tense. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Fui a pie.
es_latam: Fui a pie.
fr: Je suis allé à pied.
de: Ich bin zu Fuß gegangen.
it: Sono andato a piedi.
pt: Eu fui a pé.
hi: मैं पैदल गया।
ja: 歩いて行きました。
vi: Tôi đã đi bộ.
sv: Jag gick till fots.
nl: Ik ben te voet gegaan.
el: Πήγα με τα πόδια.

text: Can Tom and Mary do that themselves?
text_en: Can Tom and Mary do that themselves?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard interrogative. The speaker gender defaults to the pre-assigned female as there are no internal cues to suggest otherwise.
es: ¿Pueden Tom y Mary hacerlo ellos mismos?
es_latam: ¿Pueden Tom y Mary hacerlo ellos mismos?
fr: Est-ce que Tom et Mary peuvent faire ça eux-mêmes ?
de: Können Tom und Mary das selbst machen?
it: Tom e Mary possono farlo da soli?
pt: O Tom e a Mary conseguem fazer isso sozinhos?
ru: Могут ли Том и Мэри сделать это сами?
hi: क्या टॉम और मैरी यह खुद कर सकते हैं?
zh: 汤姆和玛丽能自己做那件事吗？
ja: トムとメアリーは自分たちでそれをできますか？
ko: 톰과 메리 스스로 그것을 할 수 있나요?
vi: Tom và Mary có thể tự mình làm việc đó không?
sv: Kan Tom och Mary göra det där själva?
fi: Voivatko Tom ja Mary tehdä sen itse?
nl: Kunnen Tom en Mary dat zelf doen?
el: Μπορούν ο Τομ και η Μαίρη να το κάνουν μόνοι τους;
ar: هل يستطيع توم وماري فعل ذلك بأنفسهما؟

text: We need to find them right away.
text_en: We need to find them right away.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral declarative statement. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults as there are no contextual cues to indicate otherwise.
es: Tenemos que encontrarlos de inmediato.
es_latam: Tenemos que encontrarlos de inmediato.
fr: Nous devons les trouver tout de suite.
de: Wir müssen sie sofort finden.
it: Dobbiamo trovarli subito.
pt: Precisamos encontrá-los imediatamente.
ru: Нам нужно найти их прямо сейчас.
hi: हमें उन्हें तुरंत ढूंढने की ज़रूरत है।
zh: 我们需要立刻找到他们。
ja: すぐに彼らを見つける必要があります。
vi: Chúng tôi cần tìm họ ngay lập tức.
sv: Vi måste hitta dem genast.
nl: We moeten ze meteen vinden.
el: Πρέπει να τους βρούμε αμέσως.
ar: نحن بحاجة للعثور عليهم على الفور.

text: You wanted an economy car, didn't you?
text_en: You wanted an economy car, didn't you?
en_notes: The sentence is a tag question used for confirmation. Gender defaults are maintained as there are no specific cues to override them.
es: ¿Querías un coche económico, verdad?
es_latam: ¿Querías un auto económico, no?
fr: Tu voulais une voiture économique, n'est-ce pas ?
de: Du wolltest ein sparsames Auto, oder?
it: Volevi un'auto economica, vero?
pt: Você queria um carro econômico, não queria?
ru: Ты хотела экономичный автомобиль, не так ли?
hi: तुम एक किफ़ायती कार चाहती थीं, है ना?
zh: 你当时想要一辆经济型轿车，对吗？
ja: 経済的な車が欲しかったんでしょう？
vi: Bạn đã muốn một chiếc xe tiết kiệm nhiên liệu, phải không?
sv: Du ville ha en bränslesnål bil, eller hur?
nl: Je wilde een zuinige auto, nietwaar?
el: Ήθελες ένα οικονομικό αυτοκίνητο, έτσι δεν είναι;
ar: كنتِ تريدين سيارة اقتصادية، أليس كذلك؟
corrections_summary: zh: '想要' implies 'want' (present/future) rather than 'wanted' (past) → changed to '想买' or '想要过' to better reflect past intent in this context, though '你当时想要' is most precise for simple past.

text: Could you please repeat it once again?
text_en: Could you please repeat it once again?
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request, which aligns with a neutral to formal register. The addressee is assumed to be singular based on the default context of a direct conversation.
es: ¿Podrías repetirlo una vez más?
es_latam: ¿Podrías repetirlo una vez más?
fr: Pourrais-tu le répéter encore une fois ?
de: Könntest du es bitte noch einmal wiederholen?
it: Potresti ripeterlo ancora una volta?
pt: Você poderia repetir mais uma vez?
ru: Не мог бы ты повторить это ещё раз?
hi: क्या आप इसे एक बार फिर दोहरा सकते हैं?
zh: 请问你能再重复一遍吗？
ja: もう一度繰り返していただけますか？
ko: 한 번 더 반복해 줄 수 있어요?
vi: Anh có thể nhắc lại một lần nữa được không?
sv: Skulle du kunna upprepa det en gång till?
nl: Zou je het nog een keer kunnen herhalen?
el: Θα μπορούσες να το επαναλάβεις άλλη μια φορά;
ar: هل يمكنك تكرار ذلك مرة أخرى؟
corrections_summary: fr: register mismatch (used formal 'vous' for neutral/singular) → changed to 'tu' form; hi: register mismatch (used 'tum' which is informal) → changed to 'aap' for neutral/polite request; zh: added 'please' equivalent to match 'could you please' more naturally.

text: Yanni put the baby down.
text_en: Yanni put the baby down.
en_notes: The name Yanni is typically a masculine diminutive of Ioannis (John) in Greek culture, so the speaker gender was overridden to male. The verb 'put' is interpreted as simple past.
es: Yanni acostó al bebé.
es_latam: Yanni acostó al bebé.
fr: Yanni a posé le bébé.
de: Yanni legte das Baby hin.
it: Yanni ha messo giù il bambino.
pt: Yanni deitou o bebê.
hi: यान्नी ने बच्चे को नीचे लिटा दिया।
ja: ヤニは赤ちゃんを寝かせました。
vi: Yanni đã đặt em bé xuống.
sv: Yanni lade ner bebisen.
nl: Yanni legde de baby neer.
el: Ο Γιάννης άφησε το μωρό.
corrections_summary: it: 'posato' is less common for babies → changed to 'messo giù' for a more natural literal translation of putting a baby down (e.g., in a crib); el: 'άφησε κάτω' can imply leaving the baby on the floor → changed to 'κοίμισε' (put to bed/down) or 'άφησε' depending on context, but 'έβαλε το μωρό για ύπνο' or 'άφησε το μωρό' is better. Given the literal 'put down', 'άφησε το μωρό' is safer.

text: You aren't the only one who uses this computer, are you?
text_en: You aren't the only one who uses this computer, are you?
en_notes: The sentence is a tag question used for confirmation. The register is neutral to informal. Gender defaults were maintained as there are no specific cues in the text.
es: No eres la única que usa este ordenador, ¿verdad?
es_latam: No eres la única que usa esta computadora, ¿verdad?
fr: Tu n'es pas la seule à utiliser cet ordinateur, n'est-ce pas ?
de: Du bist nicht die Einzige, die diesen Computer benutzt, oder?
it: Non sei l'unica a usare questo computer, vero?
pt: Você não é a única que usa este computador, é?
ru: Ты ведь не единственная, кто пользуется этим компьютером?
hi: तुम इस कंप्यूटर का उपयोग करने वाली अकेली नहीं हो, है ना?
zh: 你不是唯一使用这台电脑的人，对吧？
ja: このコンピューターを使っているのは、あなただけじゃないよね？
ko: 이 컴퓨터를 사용하는 사람이 너뿐만은 아니지?
vi: Bạn không phải là người duy nhất sử dụng chiếc máy tính này, phải không?
sv: Du är inte den enda som använder den här datorn, eller hur?
fi: Et ole ainoa, joka käyttää tätä tietokonetta, vai mitä?
nl: Je bent niet de enige die deze computer gebruikt, toch?
el: Δεν είσαι η μόνη που χρησιμοποιεί αυτόν τον υπολογιστή, έτσι δεν είναι;
ar: لستِ الوحيدة التي تستخدم هذا الحاسوب، أليس كذلك؟
corrections_summary: it: missing feminine agreement for 'the only one' → changed 'l'unica' to match addressee_gender: female; hi: missing feminine agreement for 'the only one' → changed 'अकेली' to 'अकेली' (already correct, but ensured gender markers in surrounding context match feminine speaker/addressee if needed, though Hindi 'अकेली' is correct for female). No corrections needed for other languages.

text: I initially had trouble understanding what he was saying.
text_en: I initially had trouble understanding what he was saying.
en_notes: The speaker gender defaults to female as per instructions. The addressee gender is not applicable as this is a declarative statement about a third party.
es: Al principio tuve dificultades para entender lo que decía.
es_latam: Al principio tuve problemas para entender lo que él decía.
fr: Au début, j'ai eu du mal à comprendre ce qu'il disait.
de: Anfangs hatte ich Schwierigkeiten zu verstehen, was er sagte.
it: Inizialmente ho avuto difficoltà a capire cosa stesse dicendo.
pt: No início, tive dificuldade em entender o que ele estava dizendo.
ru: Сначала мне было трудно понять, что он говорил.
hi: शुरुआत में मुझे यह समझने में कठिनाई हुई कि वह क्या कह रहा था।
zh: 起初，我很难理解他在说什么。
ja: 最初は、彼が何を言っているのか理解するのに苦労しました。
ko: 처음에는 그가 하는 말을 이해하는 데 어려움이 있었어요.
vi: Ban đầu tôi đã gặp khó khăn khi hiểu những gì anh ấy nói.
sv: I början hade jag svårt att förstå vad han sade.
fi: Aluksi minun oli vaikea ymmärtää, mitä hän sanoi.
nl: Aanvankelijk had ik moeite om te begrijpen wat hij zei.
el: Αρχικά δυσκολεύτηκα να καταλάβω τι έλεγε.
ar: في البداية، واجهتُ صعوبة في فهم ما كان يقوله.

text: Off to bed, darling, it's late.
text_en: Off to bed, darling, it's late.
en_notes: The term 'darling' implies an informal, intimate register. The speaker and addressee genders are kept as neutral and male respectively as the sentence contains no specific gender markers.
es: A la cama, cariño, es tarde.
es_latam: A la cama, querido, es tarde.
fr: Au lit, chéri, il est tard.
de: Ab ins Bett, Schatz, es ist spät.
it: A letto, caro, è tardi.
pt: Para a cama, querido, está tarde.
hi: बिस्तर पर जाओ, प्रिय, देर हो गई है।
zh: 该睡觉了，亲爱的，很晚了。
ja: もう寝なさい、あなた。遅いよ。
vi: Đi ngủ đi anh yêu, muộn rồi.
sv: Gå och lägg dig, älskling, det är sent.
nl: Naar bed, schat, het is laat.
el: Στο κρεβάτι, αγάπη μου, είναι αργά.
ar: اذهب إلى السرير يا عزيزي، الوقت متأخر.
corrections_summary: ja: 'いい子' (good boy) is too specific and sounds like talking to a child; changed to 'あなた' or omitted for a more general 'darling' feel. ko: '얘야' (child) is too specific; changed to '자기야' to better reflect 'darling' in an informal/intimate context.

text: Tom ate all the ice cream that was in the freezer.
text_en: Tom ate all the ice cream that was in the freezer.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default. The subject 'Tom' is a male name, but he is the subject of the sentence, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Tom se comió todo el helado que había en el congelador.
es_latam: Tom se comió todo el helado que estaba en el congelador.
fr: Tom a mangé toute la glace qui était dans le congélateur.
de: Tom hat das ganze Eis gegessen, das im Gefrierfach war.
it: Tom ha mangiato tutto il gelato che c'era nel congelatore.
pt: Tom comeu todo o sorvete que estava no congelador.
ru: Том съел всё мороженое, которое было в морозилке.
hi: टॉम ने वह सारी आइसक्रीम खा ली जो फ्रीज़र में थी।
zh: 汤姆吃掉了冷冻柜里所有的冰淇淋。
ja: トムは冷凍庫にあったアイスクリームを全部食べました。
ko: 톰은 냉동실에 있던 아이스크림을 모두 먹었습니다.
vi: Tom đã ăn hết tất cả kem có trong ngăn đá.
sv: Tom åt upp all glass som fanns i frysen.
fi: Tom söi kaiken pakastimessa olleen jäätelön.
nl: Tom heeft al het ijs opgegeten dat in de vriezer stond.
el: Ο Τομ έφαγε όλο το παγωτό που υπήρχε στην κατάψυξη.
ar: أكل توم كل الآيس كريم الذي كان في المجمدة.

text: How long does it take to get to Berlin?
text_en: How long does it take to get to Berlin?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry about travel time. Gender defaults were applied as there are no specific markers in the text.
es: ¿Cuánto tiempo se tarda en llegar a Berlín?
es_latam: ¿Cuánto tiempo se tarda en llegar a Berlín?
fr: Combien de temps faut-il pour aller à Berlin ?
de: Wie lange dauert es, nach Berlin zu kommen?
it: Quanto tempo ci vuole per arrivare a Berlino?
pt: Quanto tempo leva para chegar a Berlim?
ru: Сколько времени занимает дорога до Берлина?
hi: बर्लिन पहुँचने में कितना समय लगता है?
ja: ベルリンまでどのくらい時間がかかりますか？
vi: Mất bao lâu để đến Berlin?
sv: Hur lång tid tar det att ta sig till Berlin?
nl: Hoe lang duurt het om in Berlijn te komen?
el: Πόση ώρα χρειάζεται για να φτάσει κανείς στο Βερολίνο;
ar: كم من الوقت يستغرق الوصول إلى برلين؟

text: It takes olympic strength to do this.
text_en: It takes Olympic strength to do this.
en_notes: The word 'Olympic' was capitalized to follow proper English orthography. The sentence is categorized as figurative because it uses 'Olympic strength' as a metaphor for extreme effort rather than a literal requirement for an athlete.
es: Hace falta una fuerza olímpica para hacer esto.
es_latam: Se requiere una fuerza olímpica para hacer esto.
fr: Il faut une force olympique pour faire ça.
de: Man braucht olympische Kraft, um das zu tun.
it: Ci vuole una forza olimpica per farlo.
pt: É preciso uma força olímpica para fazer isso.
hi: इसे करने के लिए ओलंपिक जैसी शक्ति चाहिए।
zh: 做这件事需要奥林匹克般的力量。
ja: これをするにはオリンピック級の力が必要です。
vi: Cần một sức mạnh Olympic để làm điều này.
sv: Det krävs olympisk styrka för att göra detta.
nl: Er is olympische kracht voor nodig om dit te doen.
el: Χρειάζεται ολυμπιακή δύναμη για να το κάνεις αυτό.
ar: يتطلب الأمر قوة أولمبية للقيام بذلك.

text: Yanni bought a few glass drill bits from a home improvement store.
text_en: Yanni bought a few glass drill bits from a home improvement store.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as the narrator is not identified. The subject 'Yanni' is a name often associated with males, but since he is the subject and not the speaker or addressee, it does not override the speaker/addressee gender fields.
es: Yanni compró unas cuantas brocas para vidrio en una tienda de bricolaje.
es_latam: Yanni compró unas cuantas brocas para vidrio en una tienda de artículos para el hogar.
fr: Yanni a acheté quelques forets à verre dans un magasin de bricolage.
de: Yanni kaufte einige Glasbohrer in einem Baumarkt.
it: Yanni ha comprato alcune punte per vetro in un negozio di bricolage.
pt: Yanni comprou algumas brocas para vidro em uma loja de materiais de construção.
ru: Янни купил несколько свёрл по стеклу в строительном магазине.
hi: यान्नी ने एक हार्डवेयर की दुकान से कांच के लिए कुछ ड्रिल बिट्स खरीदे।
zh: 雅尼在一家家居装饰店买了几支玻璃钻头。
ja: ヤニはホームセンターでガラス用ドリルビットを数本買いました。
ko: 야니는 주택 개조 용품점에서 유리용 드릴 비트 몇 개를 샀습니다.
vi: Yanni đã mua một vài mũi khoan kính từ một cửa hàng vật liệu xây dựng.
sv: Yanni köpte några glasborr i en byggvaruhandel.
nl: Yanni kocht een paar glasboren in een bouwmarkt.
el: Ο Γιάννης αγόρασε μερικά τρυπάνια γυαλιού από ένα κατάστημα ειδών σπιτιού.
ar: اشترى ياني بضع لقم ثقب للزجاج من متجر لمستلزمات تحسين المنازل.

text: He told me that he'd been forgiven.
text_en: He told me that he'd been forgiven.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as the pronoun 'me' is gender-neutral. The subject 'He' is the third-party actor, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Él me dijo que había sido perdonado.
es_latam: Él me dijo que había sido perdonado.
fr: Il m'a dit qu'il avait été pardonné.
de: Er sagte mir, dass ihm vergeben worden war.
it: Mi ha detto che era stato perdonato.
pt: Ele me disse que tinha sido perdoado.
ru: Он сказал мне, что его простили.

fr: À mesure que les jours s'étiraient, la nouveauté s'est estompée.
de: Als die Tage dahinzogen, verflog der Reiz des Neuen.
it: Con il passare dei giorni, la novità svanì.
pt: À medida que os dias se arrastavam, a novidade perdeu a graça.
ru: Дни тянулись, и эффект новизны испарился.
hi: जैसे-जैसे दिन बीतते गए, नयापन खत्म हो गया।
zh: 随着日子变得漫长，新鲜感消失了。
ja: 日が経つにつれて、新鮮味が薄れていった。
vi: Khi ngày tháng trôi qua, sự mới mẻ dần mất đi.
sv: Allteftersom dagarna gick försvann nyhetens behag.
nl: Naarmate de dagen verstreken, ging de nieuwigheid eraf.
el: Καθώς οι μέρες περνούσαν, η αίσθηση του καινούργιου χάθηκε.
ar: مع مرور الأيام، تلاشى بريق الحداثة.
corrections_summary: es: 'se hacían largos' is a bit literal; 'se hacían eternos' or 'se arrastraban' better captures 'dragged on'. es_latam: 'pasaban' is too neutral for 'dragged on'. fr: 'Au fil des jours' is neutral; 'À mesure que les jours s'étiraient' better captures the dragging sensation. pt: 'passavam' is neutral; 'se arrastavam' captures 'dragged on'. ru: 'исчез' is simple past; 'пропал' or 'испарился' fits the figurative 'wore off' better. zh: '过去' is neutral; '拖延' or '漫长' captures 'dragged on'. ja: '薄れていきました' is polite; changed to '薄れていった' for neutral register. ko: '사라졌습니다' is polite; changed to '사라졌다' for neutral register.

text: If you take this drug, side effects may result.
text_en: If you take this drug, side effects may result.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual warning, most naturally interpreted as neutral in register. The addressee is singular as it addresses an individual patient or reader.
es: Si tomas este medicamento, pueden producirse efectos secundarios.
es_latam: Si tomas este medicamento, pueden producirse efectos secundarios.
fr: Si vous prenez ce médicament, des effets secondaires peuvent survenir.
de: Wenn Sie dieses Medikament einnehmen, können Nebenwirkungen auftreten.
it: Se prendi questo farmaco, possono verificarsi effetti collaterali.
pt: Se você tomar este medicamento, podem ocorrer efeitos colaterais.
ru: Если вы примете это лекарство, могут возникнуть побочные эффекты.
hi: यदि आप यह दवा लेती हैं, तो दुष्प्रभाव हो सकते हैं।
zh: 如果你服用这种药物，可能会产生副作用。
ja: この薬を服用すると、副作用が生じることがあります。
ko: 이 약을 복용하면 부작용이 나타날 수 있습니다.
vi: Nếu bạn uống loại thuốc này, các tác dụng phụ có thể xảy ra.
sv: Om du tar detta läkemedel kan biverkningar uppstå.
fi: Jos otat tätä lääkettä, sivuvaikutuksia voi ilmetä.
nl: Als u dit medicijn gebruikt, kunnen er bijwerkingen optreden.
el: Εάν πάρετε αυτό το φάρμακο, μπορεί να προκύψουν παρενέργειες.
ar: إذا تناولتِ هذا الدواء، فقد تظهر آثار جانبية.
corrections_summary: fr: register was formal (vous) while metadata specified neutral/singular, but in medical contexts 'vous' is often preferred; however, to strictly match 'singular neutral' in a direct address, 'tu' is used, but 'vous' is safer for medical warnings. No changes made as 'vous' is the standard neutral for instructions. it: changed to 'possono' to match simple present tense metadata instead of conditional 'potrebbero'.

text: The cloud is grey.
text_en: The cloud is grey.
en_notes: No disambiguation needed. The sentence is a simple descriptive statement with no addressee or gendered pronouns.
es: La nube es gris.
es_latam: La nube es gris.
fr: Le nuage est gris.
de: Die Wolke ist grau.
it: La nuvola è grigia.
pt: A nuvem é cinza.
hi: बादल स्लेटी है।
ja: 雲は灰色です。
vi: Đám mây màu xám.
sv: Molnet är grått.
nl: De wolk is grijs.
el: Το σύννεφο είναι γκρι.

text: The debate heated up quickly.
text_en: The debate heated up quickly.
en_notes: The phrase 'heated up' is classified as figurative as it describes the intensity of the debate rather than physical temperature.
es: El debate se caldeó rápidamente.
es_latam: El debate se acaloró rápidamente.
fr: Le débat s'est rapidement animé.
de: Die Debatte heizte sich schnell auf.
it: Il dibattito si è acceso rapidamente.
pt: O debate esquentou rapidamente.
hi: बहस जल्दी ही गरमा गई।
zh: 辩论很快变得激烈起来。
ja: 討論はすぐに白熱した。
vi: Cuộc tranh luận đã nhanh chóng trở nên gay gắt.
sv: Debatten hettade snabbt till.
nl: Het debat liep al snel hoog op.
el: Η συζήτηση οξύνθηκε γρήγορα.

text: This word has got several meanings.
text_en: This word has several meanings.
en_notes: Normalized 'has got' to 'has' for a more standard neutral register. No gendered pronouns or addressees are present, so defaults were applied where applicable.
es: Esta palabra tiene varios significados.
es_latam: Esta palabra tiene varios significados.
fr: Ce mot a plusieurs significations.
de: Dieses Wort hat mehrere Bedeutungen.
it: Questa parola ha diversi significati.
pt: Esta palavra tem vários significados.
hi: इस शब्द के कई अर्थ हैं।
ja: この単語にはいくつかの意味があります。
ko: 이 단어는 여러 가지 의미가 있습니다.
vi: Từ này có nhiều nghĩa.
sv: Det här ordet har flera betydelser.
nl: Dit woord heeft verschillende betekenissen.
el: Αυτή η λέξη έχει πολλές σημασίες.

text: I'll pop into the post office on the way home.
text_en: I'll pop into the post office on the way home.
en_notes: The phrase 'pop into' is a common British/informal idiom meaning to visit briefly. The register is informal due to the use of this phrasal verb and the contraction.
es: Me pasaré un momento por correos de camino a casa.
es_latam: Pasaré rapidito por el correo de camino a casa.
fr: Je passerai vite fait à la poste en rentrant.
de: Ich springe auf dem Heimweg kurz bei der Post vorbei.
it: Farò un salto alla posta mentre torno a casa.
pt: Vou dar um pulinho no correio no caminho de casa.
ru: Я заскочу на почту по пути домой.
hi: मैं घर जाते समय डाकघर हो आऊँगा।
zh: 我会在回家的路上顺便去一趟邮局。
ja: 帰りに郵便局にちょっと寄るね。
ko: 집에 가는 길에 우체국에 잠깐 들를게.
vi: Tôi sẽ ghé qua bưu điện trên đường về nhà.
sv: Jag tittar in på posten på vägen hem.
nl: Ik wip op weg naar huis even binnen bij het postkantoor.
el: Θα πεταχτώ στο ταχυδρομείο στον δρόμο για το σπίτι.
ar: سأمر سريعا على مكتب البريد في طريقي للمنزل.

text: Sorry, can you repeat your name?
text_en: Sorry, can you repeat your name?
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request in a neutral register. The addressee is singular as it refers to a single person's name, and the default male gender for the addressee is maintained.
es: Perdona, ¿puedes repetir tu nombre?
es_latam: Disculpa, ¿puedes repetir tu nombre?
fr: Désolé, peux-tu répéter ton nom ?
de: Entschuldigung, kannst du deinen Namen wiederholen?
it: Scusa, puoi ripetere il tuo nome?
pt: Desculpe, você pode repetir o seu nome?
ru: Извини, ты можешь повторить своё имя?
hi: माफ़ कीजिए, क्या आप अपना नाम दोहरा सकते हैं?
zh: 抱歉，你能重复一下你的名字吗？
ja: すみません、お名前をもう一度言ってもらえますか？
vi: Xin lỗi, anh có thể nhắc lại tên mình được không?
sv: Ursäkta, kan du upprepa ditt namn?
nl: Sorry, kun je je naam herhalen?
el: Συγγνώμη, μπορείς να επαναλάβεις το όνομά σου;

text: I get back home the earliest time in the morning so that I can get the whole day ahead all for myself.
text_en: I get back home early in the morning so that I can have the whole day ahead all for myself.
en_notes: The sentence was slightly normalized for better flow ('the earliest time' to 'early' and 'get' to 'have'). The speaker gender remains neutral as there are no gendered cues.
es: Vuelvo a casa temprano por la mañana para poder tener todo el día por delante para mí.
es_latam: Regreso a casa temprano por la mañana para poder tener todo el día por delante para mí.
fr: Je rentre à la maison tôt le matin pour avoir toute la journée devant moi.
de: Ich komme früh am Morgen nach Hause, damit ich den ganzen Tag für mich allein habe.
it: Torno a casa la mattina presto per poter avere l'intera giornata tutta per me.
pt: Volto para casa de manhã cedo para poder ter o dia inteiro só para mim.
ru: Я возвращаюсь домой рано утром, чтобы весь предстоящий день был в моем распоряжении.
hi: मैं सुबह जल्दी घर वापस आता/आती हूँ ताकि मेरे पास पूरा दिन अपने लिए हो।
zh: 我清晨回到家，这样一整天的时间就都属于我自己了。
ja: 一日中を自分のために使えるように、私は早朝に帰宅します。
ko: 하루 종일 나만의 시간을 가질 수 있도록 아침 일찍 집에 돌아옵니다.
vi: Tôi về nhà sớm vào buổi sáng để có thể dành cả ngày cho riêng mình.
sv: Jag kommer hem tidigt på morgonen så att jag kan ha hela dagen framför mig helt för mig själv.
fi: Palaan kotiin aikaisin aamulla, jotta minulla on koko päivä aikaa itselleni.
nl: Ik kom 's ochtends vroeg thuis, zodat ik de hele dag voor mezelf heb.
el: Επιστρέφω στο σπίτι νωρίς το πρωί για να έχω όλη την ημέρα μπροστά μου μόνο για μένα.
ar: أعود إلى المنزل في الصباح الباكر لكي أحظى باليوم كله لنفسي.
corrections_summary: fr: 'pouvoir avoir' is redundant and unnatural → changed to 'pour avoir toute la journée devant moi'; sv: 'framför mig för mig själv' is repetitive → simplified to 'framför mig helt för mig själv' for better flow.

text: Green, yellow, and red peppers are all the same species. The color of the pepper depends on how long it is allowed to grow on the plant.
text_en: Green, yellow, and red peppers are all the same species. The color of the pepper depends on how long it is allowed to grow on the plant.
en_notes: This is a factual statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned. The tense is simple present as it describes a general scientific fact.
es: Los pimientos verdes, amarillos y rojos son todos de la misma especie. El color del pimiento depende de cuánto tiempo se deje crecer en la planta.
es_latam: Los pimientos verdes, amarillos y rojos son todos de la misma especie. El color del pimiento depende de cuánto tiempo se deje crecer en la planta.
fr: Les poivrons verts, jaunes et rouges sont tous de la même espèce. La couleur du poivron dépend du temps qu'on le laisse pousser sur la plante.
de: Grüne, gelbe und rote Paprika sind alle dieselbe Art. Die Farbe der Paprika hängt davon ab, wie lange sie an der Pflanze wachsen darf.
it: I peperoni verdi, gialli e rossi sono tutti della stessa specie. Il colore del peperone dipende da quanto tempo viene lasciato crescere sulla pianta.
pt: Pimentões verdes, amarelos e vermelhos são todos da mesma espécie. A cor do pimentão depende de quanto tempo ele é deixado crescer na planta.
ru: Зеленый, желтый и красный перцы — это один и тот же вид. Цвет перца зависит от того, как долго ему дают расти на кусте.
hi: हरी, पीली और लाल मिर्च सभी एक ही प्रजाति की हैं। मिर्च का रंग इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि उसे पौधे पर कितने समय तक बढ़ने दिया जाता है।
zh: 绿、黄、红辣椒都是同一种物种。辣椒的颜色取决于它在植株上生长的时间长短。
ja: 緑、黄、赤のピーマンはすべて同じ種です。ピーマンの色は、植物の上でどれくらいの期間成長させるかによって決まります。
ko: 초록색, 노란색, 빨간색 피망은 모두 같은 종입니다. 피망의 색깔은 식물에서 얼마나 오래 자라게 두느냐에 따라 달라집니다.
vi: Ớt chuông xanh, vàng và đỏ đều cùng một loài. Màu sắc của quả ớt phụ thuộc vào việc nó được để phát triển trên cây trong bao lâu.
sv: Grön, gul och röd paprika är alla samma art. Paprikans färg beror på hur länge den får växa på plantan.
fi: Vihreät, keltaiset ja punaiset paprikat ovat kaikki samaa lajia. Paprikan väri riippuu siitä, kuinka kauan sen annetaan kasvaa kasvissa.
nl: Groene, gele en rode paprika's zijn allemaal van dezelfde soort. De kleur van de paprika hangt af van hoe lang deze aan de plant mag groeien.
el: Οι πράσινες, οι κίτρινες και οι κόκκινες πιπεριές είναι όλες το ίδιο είδος. Το χρώμα της πιπεριάς εξαρτάται από το πόσο καιρό αφήνεται να αναπτυχθεί στο φυτό.
ar: الفلفل الأخضر والأصفر والأحمر كلها من نفس النوع. يعتمد لون الفلفل على المدة التي يُترك فيها لينمو على النبتة.

text: I have an important mission for all of you.
text_en: I have an important mission for all of you.
en_notes: The phrase 'all of you' indicates that the addressee number is plural. The speaker and addressee genders are kept as neutral and female respectively per the pre-assigned defaults as there are no specific cues in the text.
es: Tengo una misión importante para todas vosotras.
es_latam: Tengo una misión importante para todas ustedes.
fr: J'ai une mission importante pour vous toutes.
de: Ich habe eine wichtige Mission für euch alle.
it: Ho una missione importante per tutte voi.
pt: Eu tenho uma missão importante para todas vocês.
ru: У меня есть важная миссия для всех вас.
hi: मेरे पास आप सभी के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण मिशन है।
zh: 我有一项重要的任务要交给你们所有人。
ja: あなたたち全員に重要な任務があります。
vi: Tôi có một nhiệm vụ quan trọng dành cho tất cả các bạn.
sv: Jag har ett viktigt uppdrag åt er alla.
fi: Minulla on tärkeä tehtävä teille kaikille.
nl: Ik heb een belangrijke missie voor jullie allemaal.
el: Έχω μια σημαντική αποστολή για όλες σας.
corrections_summary: ar: grammar error in the feminine plural pronoun 'لكنّ' (should be 'لكنَّ' or 'لكُنَّ') and better phrasing for 'all of you' → fixed to 'لكُنَّ جميعاً'.

text: They promised me that they wouldn't cry.
text_en: They promised me that they wouldn't cry.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement about a past promise. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the pre-assigned defaults as the pronouns 'they' and 'me' are gender-neutral.
es: Me prometieron que no llorarían.
es_latam: Me prometieron que no llorarían.
fr: Ils m'ont promis qu'ils ne pleureraient pas.
de: Sie versprachen mir, dass sie nicht weinen würden.
it: Mi hanno promesso che non avrebbero pianto.
pt: Eles me prometeram que não chorariam.
ru: Они обещали мне, что не будут плакать.
hi: उन्होंने मुझसे वादा किया था कि वे नहीं रोएँगे।
zh: 他们向我保证过他们不会哭。
ja: 彼らは泣かないと私に約束しました。
vi: Họ đã hứa với tôi rằng họ sẽ không khóc.
sv: De lovade mig att de inte skulle gråta.
fi: He lupasivat minulle, etteivät he itkisi.
nl: Ze beloofden me dat ze niet zouden huilen.
el: Μου υποσχέθηκαν ότι δεν θα έκλαιγαν.

text: My views have evolved since then.
text_en: My views have evolved since then.
en_notes: The sentence uses the present perfect tense to describe a change that occurred over time. The speaker and addressee genders remain as the default since there are no specific markers.
es: Mis puntos de vista han evolucionado desde entonces.
es_latam: Mis puntos de vista han evolucionado desde entonces.
fr: Mes points de vue ont évolué depuis lors.
de: Meine Ansichten haben sich seither weiterentwickelt.
it: Le mie opinioni si sono evolute da allora.
pt: Meus pontos de vista evoluíram desde então.
ru: С тех пор мои взгляды изменились.
hi: तब से मेरे विचार विकसित हुए हैं।
zh: 从那时起，我的观点发生了演变。
ja: それ以来、私の考えは進化しました。
vi: Quan điểm của tôi đã thay đổi kể từ đó.
sv: Mina åsikter har utvecklats sedan dess.
nl: Mijn opvattingen zijn sindsdien geëvolueerd.
el: Οι απόψεις μου έχουν εξελιχθεί από τότε.
ar: لقد تطورت وجهات نظري منذ ذلك الحين.

text: Notifications seem to matter more than people.
text_en: Notifications seem to matter more than people.
en_notes: The sentence is a general observation about modern life. No specific speaker or addressee is identified, so the pre-assigned gender defaults are used.
es: Las notificaciones parecen importar más que las personas.
es_latam: Las notificaciones parecen importar más que las personas.
fr: Les notifications semblent compter plus que les gens.
de: Benachrichtigungen scheinen wichtiger zu sein als Menschen.
it: Le notifiche sembrano contare più delle persone.
pt: As notificações parecem importar mais do que as pessoas.
hi: सूचनाएं लोगों से अधिक महत्वपूर्ण लगती हैं।
ja: 通知は人よりも重要なようです。
ko: 알림이 사람보다 더 중요한 것 같아요.
vi: Thông báo dường như quan trọng hơn con người.
sv: Aviseringar verkar spela större roll än människor.
fi: Ilmoitukset tuntuvat olevan tärkeämpiä kuin ihmiset.
nl: Meldingen lijken belangrijker dan mensen.
el: Οι ειδοποιήσεις φαίνεται να έχουν μεγαλύτερη σημασία από τους ανθρώπους.
ar: تبدو الإشعارات أكثر أهمية من الناس.

text: The rules must be few and, more importantly, simple.
text_en: The rules must be few and, more importantly, simple.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement or observation without a specific speaker or addressee mentioned, so the pre-assigned gender defaults are used.
es: Las reglas deben ser pocas y, lo que es más importante, sencillas.
es_latam: Las reglas deben ser pocas y, más importante aún, simples.
fr: Les règles doivent être peu nombreuses et, plus important encore, simples.
de: Die Regeln müssen wenige sein und, was noch wichtiger ist, einfach.
it: Le regole devono essere poche e, cosa più importante, semplici.
pt: As regras devem ser poucas e, mais importante, simples.
ru: Правил должно быть немного и, что более важно, они должны быть простыми.
hi: नियम कम होने चाहिए और, इससे भी महत्वपूर्ण बात यह है कि वे सरल होने चाहिए।
zh: 规则必须少，而且更重要的是，要简单。
ja: 規則は少なく、そして何よりも単純でなければなりません。
ko: 규칙은 적어야 하며, 더 중요한 것은 단순해야 한다는 것입니다.
vi: Các quy tắc phải ít và quan trọng hơn là phải đơn giản.
sv: Reglerna måste vara få och, framför allt, enkla.
fi: Sääntöjä on oltava vähän ja mikä tärkeämpää, niiden on oltava yksinkertaisia.
nl: De regels moeten beperkt zijn en, wat belangrijker is, eenvoudig.
el: Οι κανόνες πρέπει να είναι λίγοι και, το κυριότερο, απλοί.
ar: يجب أن تكون القواعد قليلة، والأهم من ذلك، بسيطة.

text: Where has our optimism gone?
text_en: Where has our optimism gone?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard interrogative using the present perfect tense. No gendered cues are present, so the pre-assigned defaults for speaker and addressee were used.
es: ¿A dónde se ha ido nuestro optimismo?
es_latam: ¿A dónde se ha ido nuestro optimismo?
fr: Où est passé notre optimisme ?
de: Wo ist unser Optimismus geblieben?
it: Dov'è finito il nostro ottimismo?
pt: Para onde foi o nosso otimismo?
hi: हमारा आशावाद कहाँ चला गया है?
zh: 我们的乐观精神去哪儿了？
ja: 私たちの楽観主義はどこへ行ってしまったのでしょうか？
vi: Sự lạc quan của chúng ta đã đi đâu mất rồi?
sv: Vart har vår optimism tagit vägen?
nl: Waar is ons optimisme gebleven?
el: Πού πήγε η αισιοδοξία μας;

text: I went there on foot.
text_en: I went there on foot.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward statement of past action. No gender cues are present, so the pre-assigned speaker gender is used.
es: Fui allí a pie.
es_latam: Fui allí a pie.
fr: J'y suis allé à pied.
de: Ich bin zu Fuß dorthin gegangen.
it: Ci sono andato a piedi.
pt: Eu fui lá a pé.
hi: मैं वहाँ पैदल गया था।
ja: 私はそこへ歩いて行きました。

fr: Il est libre de le prendre ou de le laisser, et je respecte sa liberté.
de: Es steht ihm frei, es anzunehmen oder abzulehnen, und ich respektiere seine Freiheit.
it: È libero di accettarlo o meno, e io rispetto la sua libertà.
pt: Ele é livre para aceitar ou deixar, e eu respeito a liberdade dele.
ru: Он волен принимать это или нет, и я уважаю его свободу.
hi: वह इसे स्वीकार करने या छोड़ने के लिए स्वतंत्र है, और मैं उसकी स्वतंत्रता का सम्मान करता हूँ।
zh: 他可以自由选择接受或放弃，我尊重他的自由。
ja: 彼がそれを受け入れるか断るかは自由であり、私は彼の自由を尊重します。
ko: 그가 그것을 받아들이든 말든 그의 자유이며, 나는 그의 자유를 존중합니다.
vi: Anh ấy có quyền chấp nhận hoặc từ chối, và tôi tôn trọng sự tự do của anh ấy.
sv: Han är fri att välja eller låta bli, och jag respekterar hans frihet.
fi: Hän on vapaa hyväksymään tai hylkäämään sen, ja minä kunnioitan hänen vapauttaan.
nl: Het staat hem vrij om het aan te nemen of te laten, en ik respecteer zijn vrijheid.
el: Είναι ελεύθερος να το δεχτεί ή να το αρνηθεί, και σέβομαι την ελευθερία του.
ar: هو حر في قبوله أو رفضه، وأنا أحترم حريته.
corrections_summary: pt: grammatical inconsistency in object placement → Ele é livre para aceitar ou deixar, e eu respeito a liberdade dele.

text: She looked like she was suspicious.
text_en: She looked like she was suspicious.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male per the default as there are no cues to the contrary. The subject of the sentence is female, but there is no direct addressee.
es: Parecía que sospechaba algo.
es_latam: Parecía que sospechaba algo.
fr: Elle avait l'air méfiante.
de: Sie sah misstrauisch aus.
it: Sembrava sospettosa.
pt: Ela parecia estar desconfiada.
hi: वह संदिग्ध लग रही थी।
ja: 彼女は疑っているようだった。
vi: Cô ấy trông có vẻ nghi ngờ.
sv: Hon såg misstänksam ut.
nl: Ze zag er achterdochtig uit.
el: Φαινόταν καχύποπτη.

text: Don't forget to add basil.
text_en: Don't forget to add basil.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative instruction, typically used in a neutral or informal context. The addressee number defaults to singular as it is most common for direct kitchen instructions.
es: No olvides añadir albahaca.
es_latam: No olvides agregar albahaca.
fr: N'oublie pas d'ajouter du basilic.
de: Vergiss nicht, Basilikum hinzuzufügen.
it: Non dimenticare di aggiungere il basilico.
pt: Não se esqueça de adicionar manjericão.
hi: तुलसी डालना मत भूलना।
ja: バジルを入れるのを忘れないで。
vi: Đừng quên cho thêm húng quế.
sv: Glöm inte att tillsätta basilika.
nl: Vergeet niet om basilicum toe te voegen.
el: Μην ξεχάσεις να προσθέσεις βασιλικό.

text: What does this ivy look like in fall?
text_en: What does this ivy look like in fall?
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward inquiry about a plant's appearance. Fall is used as a synonym for autumn.
es: ¿Qué aspecto tiene esta hiedra en otoño?
es_latam: ¿Cómo se ve esta hiedra en otoño?
fr: À quoi ressemble ce lierre en automne ?
de: Wie sieht dieser Efeu im Herbst aus?
it: Che aspetto ha questa edera in autunno?
pt: Como fica esta hera no outono?
hi: पतझड़ में यह आइवी कैसी दिखती है?
zh: 这株常春藤在秋天是什么样子的？
ja: このアイビーは秋にはどのような姿になりますか？
vi: Cây thường xuân này trông như thế nào vào mùa thu?
sv: Hur ser den här murgrönan ut på hösten?
nl: Hoe ziet deze klimop eruit in de herfst?
el: Πώς μοιάζει αυτός ο κισσός το φθινόπωρο;
ar: كيف يبدو هذا اللبلاب في الخريف؟

text: In this kind of heat, I just don't feel like doing anything.
text_en: In this kind of heat, I just don't feel like doing anything.
en_notes: The sentence is a personal statement about a feeling, so there is no addressee. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: Con este calor, no tengo ganas de hacer nada.
es_latam: Con este calor, no tengo ganas de hacer nada.
fr: Avec une telle chaleur, je n'ai envie de rien faire.
de: Bei dieser Hitze habe ich einfach keine Lust, irgendetwas zu tun.
it: Con questo caldo, non ho proprio voglia di fare nulla.
pt: Com esse calor, eu simplesmente não tenho vontade de fazer nada.
ru: В такую жару мне просто не хочется ничего делать.
hi: इस तरह की गर्मी में, मेरा कुछ भी करने का मन नहीं है।
zh: 在这样的酷热下，我简直什么都不想做。
ja: この暑さでは、何もする気が起きません。
ko: 이런 더위 속에서는 정말 아무것도 하고 싶지 않아요.
vi: Trong cái nóng thế này, tôi chẳng muốn làm gì cả.
sv: I den här värmen har jag helt enkelt ingen lust att göra någonting.
fi: Tällaisella helteellä minua ei huvita tehdä yhtään mitään.
nl: Met deze hitte heb ik gewoon nergens zin in.
el: Με τέτοια ζέστη, απλά δεν έχω όρεξη να κάνω τίποτα.
ar: في مثل هذا الحر، لا أشعر برغبة في القيام بأي شيء.

text: They said the situation was only temporary.
text_en: They said the situation was only temporary.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement about a past event. The gender of 'they' is neutral as it refers to a group or an unspecified individual, and there is no specific addressee.
es: Dijeron que la situación era solo temporal.
es_latam: Dijeron que la situación era solo temporal.
fr: Ils ont dit que la situation n'était que temporaire.
de: Sie sagten, die Situation sei nur vorübergehend.
it: Hanno detto che la situazione era solo temporanea.
pt: Eles disseram que a situação era apenas temporária.
ru: Они сказали, что ситуация была лишь временной.
hi: उन्होंने कहा कि स्थिति केवल अस्थायी थी।
zh: 他们说情况只是暂时的。
ja: 彼らは状況は一時的なものに過ぎないと言いました。
vi: Họ nói rằng tình hình chỉ là tạm thời.
sv: De sa att situationen bara var tillfällig.
fi: He sanoivat, että tilanne oli vain väliaikainen.
nl: Ze zeiden dat de situatie slechts tijdelijk was.
el: Είπαν ότι η κατάσταση ήταν μόνο προσωρινή.
ar: قالوا إن الوضع كان مؤقتاً فقط.

text: His notion is that planes are safer than cars.
text_en: His notion is that planes are safer than cars.
en_notes: The speaker gender is female as per the default, while the subject of the sentence ('His') is male. There is no addressee in this declarative statement.
es: Su idea es que los aviones son más seguros que los coches.
es_latam: Su idea es que los aviones son más seguros que los autos.
fr: Son idée est que les avions sont plus sûrs que les voitures.
de: Seine Auffassung ist, dass Flugzeuge sicherer als Autos sind.
it: La sua idea è che gli aerei siano più sicuri delle auto.
pt: A ideia dele é que os aviões são mais seguros do que os carros.
ru: Его мнение заключается в том, что самолеты безопаснее автомобилей.
hi: उनकी धारणा है कि हवाई जहाज कारों की तुलना में अधिक सुरक्षित हैं।
zh: 他的观点是飞机比汽车更安全。
ja: 飛行機は車よりも安全だというのが彼の考えです。
ko: 비행기가 자동차보다 더 안전하다는 것이 그의 생각입니다.
vi: Quan điểm của anh ấy là máy bay an toàn hơn ô tô.
sv: Hans uppfattning är att flygplan är säkrare än bilar.
fi: Hänen käsityksensä on, että lentokoneet ovat turvallisempia kuin autot.
nl: Zijn opvatting is dat vliegtuigen veiliger zijn dan auto's.
el: Η άποψή του είναι ότι τα αεροπλάνα είναι ασφαλέστερα από τα αυτοκίνητα.
ar: فكرته هي أن الطائرات أكثر أماناً من السيارات.

text: Sami stumbled across a small village.
text_en: Sami stumbled across a small village.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the default. The name Sami is often male in Arabic contexts or female in others, but since the sentence is narrative, the speaker is an external narrator. 'Stumbled across' is categorized as figurative due to the phrasal verb meaning 'to find by chance'.
es: Sami se topó con una pequeña aldea.
es_latam: Sami se topó con un pequeño pueblo.
fr: Sami est tombé par hasard sur un petit village.
de: Sami stieß zufällig auf ein kleines Dorf.
it: Sami si è imbattuto in un piccolo villaggio.
pt: Sami deparou-se com uma pequena aldeia.
ru: Сами случайно наткнулся на маленькую деревню.
hi: सामी को अचानक एक छोटा सा गाँव मिला।
zh: 萨米偶然发现了一个小村庄。
ja: サミは小さな村を偶然見つけた。
vi: Sami tình cờ bắt gặp một ngôi làng nhỏ.
sv: Sami snubblade över en liten by.
nl: Sami stuitte op een klein dorpje.
el: Ο Σάμι έπεσε τυχαία πάνω σε ένα μικρό χωριό.
ar: عثر سامي صدفة على قرية صغيرة.
corrections_summary: pt: 'deparou com' is less natural than 'deparou-se com' for this context → fixed to 'Sami deparou-se com uma pequena aldeia.'

text: I wasn't having a good time.
text_en: I wasn't having a good time.
en_notes: The sentence is in the past continuous tense. The speaker gender defaults to female as per the pre-assigned instructions since no specific gender cues are present.
es: No me lo estaba pasando bien.
es_latam: No la estaba pasando bien.
fr: Je ne passais pas un bon moment.
de: Ich hatte keine gute Zeit.
it: Non mi stavo divertendo.
pt: Eu não estava me divertindo.
ru: Я не очень хорошо проводила время.
hi: मैं अच्छा समय नहीं बिता रही थी।
ja: 私は楽しい時間を過ごしていませんでした。
ko: 저는 즐거운 시간을 보내고 있지 않았어요.
vi: Tôi đã không có một khoảng thời gian vui vẻ.
sv: Jag hade inte särskilt roligt.
nl: Ik had geen leuke tijd.
el: Δεν περνούσα καλά.

text: Tom is at the library right now.
text_en: Tom is at the library right now.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple factual statement. 'Tom' is a masculine name, but he is the subject of the sentence, not the speaker or addressee. Therefore, the speaker and addressee genders remain as the default/neutral assignments.
es: Tom está en la biblioteca ahora mismo.
es_latam: Tom está en la biblioteca ahora mismo.
fr: Tom est à la bibliothèque en ce moment.
de: Tom ist gerade in der Bibliothek.
it: Tom è in biblioteca in questo momento.
pt: Tom está na biblioteca agora mesmo.
hi: टॉम अभी पुस्तकालय में है।
ja: トムは今、図書館にいます。
vi: Tom đang ở thư viện ngay lúc này.
sv: Tom är på biblioteket just nu.
nl: Tom is op dit moment in de bibliotheek.
el: Ο Τομ είναι στη βιβλιοθήκη αυτή τη στιγμή.

text: How did you learn that trick?
text_en: How did you learn that trick?
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward question. The register is neutral, and the addressee is assumed to be singular in a typical conversational context.
es: ¿Cómo aprendiste ese truco?
es_latam: ¿Cómo aprendiste ese truco?
fr: Comment as-tu appris ce tour ?
de: Wie hast du diesen Trick gelernt?
it: Come hai imparato quel trucco?
pt: Como você aprendeu esse truque?
hi: तुमने वह तरकीब कैसे सीखी?
zh: 你是怎么学会那个招数的？
ja: そのトリックはどうやって覚えたの？
vi: Làm thế nào bạn học được trò đó vậy?
sv: Hur lärde du dig det där tricket?
nl: Hoe heb je die truc geleerd?
el: Πώς έμαθες αυτό το κόλπο;
corrections_summary: ru: The translation 'Как тебе удалось' implies 'How did you manage to', which adds a nuance of difficulty not present in the literal 'learn'. Changed to a more direct translation. ar: The addressee gender is neutral in metadata, but the translation used a masculine suffix (ta). Added the feminine alternative (ti) to ensure neutrality/completeness.

text: He was as still as a statue.
text_en: He was as still as a statue.
en_notes: The sentence uses a simile to describe a third party ('he'), so the speaker and addressee genders remain at their default values as they are not specified. The tense is simple past.
es: Se quedó inmóvil como una estatua.
es_latam: Se quedó inmóvil como una estatua.
fr: Il était immobile comme une statue.
de: Er war starr wie eine Statue.
it: Era immobile come una statua.
pt: Ele ficou imóvel como uma estátua.
hi: वह मूर्ति की तरह स्थिर था।
ja: 彼は彫像のようにじっとしていた。
vi: Anh ấy đứng yên như một bức tượng.
sv: Han var orörlig som en staty.
nl: Hij stond zo stil als een standbeeld.
el: Ήταν ακίνητος σαν άγαλμα.

text: Potatoes are so versatile.
text_en: Potatoes are so versatile.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement about a vegetable, requiring no specific gender or addressee context.
es: Las patatas son muy versátiles.
es_latam: Las papas son muy versátiles.
fr: Les pommes de terre sont tellement polyvalentes.
de: Kartoffeln sind so vielseitig.
it: Le patate sono così versatili.
pt: As batatas são muito versáteis.
hi: आलू बहुत बहुमुखी होते हैं।
ja: ジャガイモはとても用途が広いです。
vi: Khoai tây rất đa năng.
sv: Potatis är så mångsidigt.
nl: Aardappelen zijn zo veelzijdig.
el: Οι πατάτες είναι τόσο πολυχρηστικές.
corrections_summary: el: 'πολυδιάστατες' (multidimensional) is less natural for food than 'πολυχρηστικές' (versatile/multipurpose) → changed to 'πολυχρηστικές'.

text: Did you have a good evening?
text_en: Did you have a good evening?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard polite inquiry. I used the pre-assigned genders as there are no specific cues to override them.
es: ¿Pasaste una buena velada?
es_latam: ¿Tuviste una buena noche?
fr: As-tu passé une bonne soirée ?
de: Hattest du einen schönen Abend?
it: Hai passato una bella serata?
pt: Você teve uma boa noite?
hi: क्या आपकी शाम अच्छी रही?
ja: 良い晩を過ごしましたか？
vi: Anh đã có một buổi tối tốt lành chứ?
sv: Hade du en bra kväll?
nl: Heb je een fijne avond gehad?
el: Πέρασες ένα όμορφο βράδυ;

text: He was often confused with his brother.
text_en: He was often confused with his brother.
en_notes: The sentence refers to a male subject ('he') and his brother, but the speaker's gender remains the pre-assigned default as there are no cues to override it. There is no addressee.
es: A menudo se le confundía con su hermano.
es_latam: A menudo se lo confundía con su hermano.
fr: Il était souvent confondu avec son frère.
de: Er wurde oft mit seinem Bruder verwechselt.
it: Veniva spesso scambiato per suo fratello.
pt: Ele era frequentemente confundido com o seu irmão.
ru: Его часто путали с его братом.
hi: अक्सर लोग उसे उसका भाई समझ लेते थे।
zh: 他经常被误认为是他的兄弟。
ja: 彼はよく兄弟と間違えられていました。
vi: Anh ấy thường bị nhầm lẫn với anh trai mình.
sv: Han förväxlades ofta med sin bror.
nl: Hij werd vaak verward met zijn broer.
el: Συχνά τον μπέρδευαν με τον αδελφό του.
ar: غالباً ما كان يتم الخلط بينه وبين أخيه.
corrections_summary: zh: '哥哥' (older brother) is too specific for 'brother' → changed to '兄弟' to remain neutral; ja: '兄弟' (brothers) is slightly ambiguous in this context → changed to '弟' or '兄' is usually avoided unless known, but '兄弟' is acceptable, however '彼自身の兄弟' or '彼の兄弟' is more precise for 'his brother'. No changes made to ja as it is acceptable, but zh was adjusted for better accuracy.

text: Did you buy potatoes, too?
text_en: Did you buy potatoes, too?
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward question. The genders are set to the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual clues to suggest otherwise.
es: ¿Compraste patatas también?
es_latam: ¿Compraste papas también?
fr: As-tu aussi acheté des pommes de terre ?
de: Hast du auch Kartoffeln gekauft?
it: Hai comprato anche le patate?
pt: Você também comprou batatas?
hi: क्या तुमने आलू भी खरीदे?
ja: あなたもジャガイモを買いましたか？
vi: Bạn cũng đã mua khoai tây phải không?
sv: Köpte du potatis också?
nl: Heb je ook aardappelen gekocht?
el: Αγόρασες και πατάτες;
corrections_summary: hi: incorrect gender agreement for 'potatoes' (masculine) and subject → corrected to masculine plural agreement for the object and neutral/feminine subject context.

text: I got rid of all my old textbooks.
text_en: I got rid of all my old textbooks.
en_notes: The phrasal verb 'got rid of' is treated as literal in the context of disposing of physical objects. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: Me deshice de todos mis libros de texto viejos.
es_latam: Me deshice de todos mis libros de texto viejos.
fr: Je me suis débarrassée de tous mes vieux manuels scolaires.
de: Ich bin alle meine alten Lehrbücher losgeworden.
it: Mi sono sbarazzata di tutti i miei vecchi libri di testo.
pt: Eu me livrei de todos os meus livros didáticos antigos.
ru: Я избавилась от всех своих старых учебников.
hi: मैंने अपनी सभी पुरानी पाठ्यपुस्तकें हटा दीं।
zh: 我处理掉了我所有的旧教科书。
ja: 古い教科書をすべて処分しました。
vi: Tôi đã bỏ hết tất cả sách giáo khoa cũ của mình.
sv: Jag gjorde mig av med alla mina gamla läroböcker.
nl: Ik heb al mijn oude studieboeken weggedaan.
el: Ξεφορτώθηκα όλα τα παλιά μου σχολικά βιβλία.
ar: تخلصتُ من جميع كتبي المدرسية القديمة.

text: I did that the way you showed me.
text_en: I did that the way you showed me.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. Following the pre-assigned defaults, the speaker is neutral and the addressee is male.
es: Lo hice de la manera que me enseñaste.
es_latam: Lo hice de la manera que me enseñaste.
fr: Je l'ai fait de la manière que tu m'as montrée.
de: Ich habe das so gemacht, wie du es mir gezeigt hast.
it: L'ho fatto nel modo in cui mi hai mostrato.
pt: Eu fiz isso do jeito que você me mostrou.
ru: Я сделал это так, как ты мне показал.
hi: मैंने उसे वैसे ही किया जैसे तुमने मुझे दिखाया था।
zh: 我是按照你教我的方式做的。
ja: あなたが教えてくれた通りにそれをしました。
vi: Tôi đã làm việc đó theo cách anh đã chỉ cho tôi.
sv: Jag gjorde det på det sättet som du visade mig.
fi: Tein sen niin kuin näytit minulle.
nl: Ik heb dat gedaan op de manier die je me hebt laten zien.
el: Το έκανα με τον τρόπο που μου έδειξες.
ar: لقد فعلتُ ذلك بالطريقة التي أريتني إياها.
corrections_summary: ru: speaker gender was masculine but metadata is neutral → changed to gender-neutral past tense (though Russian usually requires gender, the neutral metadata suggests the speaker's gender shouldn't be assumed if avoidable, but in simple past 'я сделал' is masculine; I have adjusted it to 'я это сделал(а)' or the standard masculine as default while ensuring the addressee remains male); hi: 'दिखाया' (showed/displayed) is less natural than 'सिखाया' (taught/showed how to do) for 'showed me' in this context, but grammatically correct; zh: '展示' is too formal/theatrical for 'showed me' in a neutral context → changed to '教' (taught/showed how to); ja: '見せてくれた' implies showing an object, '教えてくれた' is better for showing a method → updated for naturalness.

text: I should've been suspicious.
text_en: I should have been suspicious.
en_notes: The contraction 'should've' was expanded to 'should have' for clarity. The speaker and addressee genders are set to neutral and not applicable as there is no specific context or addressee mentioned.
es: Debería haber sospechado.
es_latam: Debí haber sospechado.
fr: J'aurais dû me méfier.
de: Ich hätte misstrauisch sein sollen.
it: Avrei dovuto essere sospettoso.
pt: Eu deveria ter desconfiado.
hi: मुझे संदेह होना चाहिए था।
ja: 疑うべきでした。
vi: Lẽ ra tôi nên nghi ngờ.
sv: Jag borde ha varit misstänksam.
nl: Ik had argwaan moeten hebben.
el: Θα έπρεπε να είχα υποψιαστεί.
corrections_summary: ru: added 'more' which was not in the source → removed 'более', ar: provided dual gender options in a single string → simplified to the masculine form as the standard neutral default for MSA when gender is unspecified.

text: This might be a trivial thing for you, but it's a very important thing for me.
text_en: This might be a trivial thing for you, but it's a very important thing for me.
en_notes: The sentence is a contrastive statement between the speaker and the addressee. No gendered cues are present, so the pre-assigned defaults were used.

text: The anticipation of the upcoming concert had William buzzing with excitement.

ar: أحب افتراض أن الجميع يبذلون قصارى جهدهم، وأنه يجب علينا جميعاً أن نكون طيبين مع بعضنا البعض.

it: Il mondo è un libro e ogni passo ne apre una pagina.
pt: O mundo é um livro e cada passo abre uma página.
ru: Мир — это книга, и каждый шаг открывает новую страницу.
hi: दुनिया एक किताब है और हर कदम एक पन्ना खोलता है।
zh: 世界是一本书，每一步都开启一页。
ja: 世界は一冊の本であり、一歩ごとに新たなページが開かれる。

sv: Världen är en bok och varje steg öppnar en sida.
fi: Maailma on kirja ja jokainen askel avaa uuden sivun.
nl: De wereld is een boek en elke stap opent een pagina.
el: Ο κόσμος είναι ένα βιβλίο και κάθε βήμα ανοίγει μια σελίδα.
ar: العالم كتاب وكل خطوة تفتح صفحة.

text: Their relationship really started gaining momentum.
text_en: Their relationship really started gaining momentum.
en_notes: The sentence is a figurative description of a relationship progressing quickly. The genders are kept as neutral/default as there are no specific indicators in the text.
es: Su relación realmente empezó a cobrar impulso.
es_latam: Su relación realmente empezó a cobrar impulso.
fr: Leur relation a vraiment commencé à prendre de l'ampleur.

it: La loro relazione ha iniziato davvero a prendere slancio.
pt: O relacionamento deles realmente começou a ganhar força.
ru: Их отношения действительно начали набирать обороты.
hi: उनके रिश्ते में वाकई रफ़्तार आने लगी थी।
zh: 他们的关系真的开始升温了。
ja: 二人の関係は本当に勢いづき始めた。
ko: 그들의 관계는 정말 탄력을 받기 시작했다.
vi: Mối quan hệ của họ thực sự bắt đầu tiến triển mạnh mẽ.

nl: Hun relatie begon echt op stoom te komen.
el: Η σχέση τους άρχισε πραγματικά να αποκτά δυναμική.
corrections_summary: zh: literal translation of 'momentum' sounds unnatural in this context → changed to a more idiomatic expression for relationships; el: 'παίρνει τα πάνω της' implies recovery from a bad state rather than gaining speed → changed to a more accurate figurative expression for momentum.

text: I'm begging you to reconsider.
text_en: I'm begging you to reconsider.
en_notes: The sentence is in the present continuous tense to emphasize the current state of the request. Register is neutral but emotionally charged.

es_latam: Te ruego que lo reconsideres.
fr: Je te supplie de reconsidérer.
de: Ich flehe dich an, es dir noch einmal zu überlegen.
it: Ti prego di riconsiderare.
pt: Eu te imploro que reconsidere.
hi: मैं तुमसे पुनर्विचार करने की विनती कर रहा हूँ।
ja: 考え直してくれるよう、あなたに懇願しています。
vi: Tôi đang cầu xin anh hãy xem xét lại.
sv: Jag bönfaller dig att tänka om.
nl: Ik smeek je om het te heroverwegen.
el: Σε ικετεύω να το ξανασκεφτείς.
ar: أنا أتوسل إليك أن تعيد النظر.
corrections_summary: pt: 'se reconsidere' is grammatically incorrect for 'reconsider' in this context → changed to 'reconsidere'; hi: gender agreement for male speaker was correct but phrasing can be more natural → adjusted slightly; ko: register was slightly polite for neutral → adjusted to a more standard neutral form.

text: He had a big box in his arms.

it: Sono una buona ascoltatrice.

text: He recognised me to be a more experienced driver.
text_en: He recognized me to be a more experienced driver.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as 'me' does not specify gender. The subject 'He' is the one performing the recognition, not the speaker or addressee. Normalized 'recognised' to 'recognized' for standard American English preference in many apps, though both are correct.

es_latam: Él me reconoció como alguien con más experiencia al volante.

zh: 他承认我是一个更有经验的司机。
ja: 彼は私がより経験豊富な運転手であると認めました。
ko: 그는 나를 더 숙련된 운전자로 인정했다.
vi: Anh ấy công nhận tôi là một tài xế có kinh nghiệm hơn.
sv: Han erkände mig som en mer erfaren förare.
nl: Hij erkende dat ik een meer ervaren chauffeur was.
el: Με αναγνώρισε ως πιο έμπειρο οδηγό.
ar: لقد اعترف بي كسائق أكثر خبرة.
corrections_summary: es: removed clunky 'un conductor o una conductora' for a neutral speaker → Él me reconoció como alguien con más experiencia al volante; es_latam: removed clunky gendered phrasing → Él me reconoció como alguien con más experiencia al volante; fr: removed clunky gendered phrasing → Il m'a reconnu comme un conducteur plus expérimenté; it: removed clunky gendered phrasing → Mi ha riconosciuto come un guidatore più esperto; pt: removed clunky gendered phrasing → Ele me reconheceu como um motorista mais experiente; el: removed clunky gendered phrasing → Με αναγνώρισε ως πιο έμπειρο οδηγό.

text: You took pictures at the wedding, didn't you?

es_latam: ¿Dónde compraron esta moto?

text: How many episodes do you watch in a row?

text: I recognised the name.

text: Anything you can tell us would be helpful.
text_en: Anything you can tell us would be helpful.

es_latam: Cualquier cosa que pudieras decirnos sería de ayuda.

de: Alles, was du uns sagen könntest, wäre hilfreich.
it: Qualsiasi cosa tu potresti dirci sarebbe utile.
pt: Qualquer coisa que você pudesse nos dizer seria útil.
ru: Всё, что ты могла бы нам сказать, было бы полезно.
hi: आप हमें जो कुछ भी बता सकती हैं, वह मददगार होगा।
zh: 你能告诉我们的任何事情都会有所帮助。
ja: あなたが話してくれることは何でも助けになります。
ko: 당신이 우리에게 말해줄 수 있는 것은 무엇이든 도움이 될 거예요.

corrections_summary: fr: 'tu' is informal, changed to 'vous' for neutral register; it: 'potessi' is subjunctive, changed to conditional 'potresti' to match the English 'can/could' conditional nuance; hi: 'सकें' is plural/formal, changed to 'सकती हैं' to reflect the specific female singular addressee metadata.

text: Children all over the world have been placing pictures of rainbows on their windows.
text_en: Children all over the world have been placing pictures of rainbows on their windows.

corrections_summary: fr: used passé composé instead of present perfect continuous nuance → changed to 'placent' or 'ont commencé à placer' to better reflect the ongoing nature, but 'ont affiché' is acceptable; however, 'dessins' is better as 'images' or 'dessins' but the tense was slightly off for 'have been placing'. Actually, the most natural French for this specific trend is 'ont mis' or 'collent'. I will adjust for better flow. ru: 'стали вешать' means 'started to hang', changed to 'размещают' or 'вешают' to match the continuous aspect. hi: added the continuous aspect 'आ रहे हैं' to match 'have been placing'.

vi: Tom nói anh ấy biết Mary có thể phải tự mình làm việc đó.
sv: Tom sa att han visste att Mary kanske skulle behöva göra det själv.
fi: Tom sanoi tietävänsä, että Mary saattaisi joutua tekemään sen yksin.
nl: Tom zei dat hij wist dat Mary dat misschien alleen zou moeten doen.
el: Ο Τομ είπε ότι ήξερε πως η Μαίρη μπορεί να χρειαζόταν να το κάνει αυτό μόνη της.
ar: قال توم إنه كان يعلم أن ماري قد تضطر إلى فعل ذلك بمفردها.

text: Tom isn't as young as Mary thinks he is.
text_en: Tom isn't as young as Mary thinks he is.
en_notes: The sentence describes a relationship between two named individuals (Tom and Mary). The speaker is neutral as there are no first-person indicators, and there is no specific addressee.
es: Tom no es tan joven como Mary cree que es.
es_latam: Tom no es tan joven como Mary cree que es.
fr: Tom n'est pas aussi jeune que Mary le pense.
de: Tom ist nicht so jung, wie Mary glaubt.
it: Tom non è così giovane come Mary pensa che sia.
pt: Tom não é tão jovem quanto Mary pensa que é.
ru: Том не так молод, как думает Мэри.
hi: टॉम उतना युवा नहीं है जितना मैरी को लगता है कि वह है।
zh: 汤姆并不像玛丽认为的那么年轻。
ja: トムはメアリーが思っているほど若くはない。
ko: 톰은 메리가 생각하는 것만큼 젊지 않다.
vi: Tom không trẻ như Mary nghĩ.
sv: Tom är inte så ung som Mary tror att han är.
fi: Tom ei ole niin nuori kuin Mary luulee.
nl: Tom is niet zo jong als Mary denkt dat hij is.
el: Ο Τομ δεν είναι τόσο νέος όσο νομίζει η Μαίρη.
ar: توم ليس شاباً كما تعتقد ماري.

text: She's an intense woman.
text_en: She's an intense woman.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the female default as the sentence does not provide clues about the speaker. The subject is female, but she is the topic of the sentence, not the addressee.
es: Es una mujer intensa.
es_latam: Es una mujer intensa.
fr: C'est une femme intense.
de: Sie ist eine energische Frau.
it: È una donna intensa.
pt: Ela é uma mulher intensa.
hi: वह एक प्रखर महिला है।
zh: 她是一个性格强烈的女人。
ja: 彼女は強烈な女性です。
vi: Cô ấy là một người phụ nữ mãnh liệt.
sv: Hon är en intensiv kvinna.
nl: Ze is een intense vrouw.
el: Είναι μια έντονη γυναίκα.
corrections_summary: fr: 'passionnée' (passionate) changes the meaning → changed to 'intense' to match the English literal meaning; ru: 'сильная личность' (strong personality) is a paraphrase → changed to 'интенсивная женщина' or more naturally 'эмоционально напряженная женщина', but 'интенсивная' is the direct equivalent for this context; hi: 'गंभीर' (serious) is not 'intense' → changed to 'तेज-तर्रार' or 'प्रखर' for intensity.

text: Many different things can be made from wood.
text_en: Many different things can be made from wood.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned, so the pre-assigned defaults are used for gender fields.
es: Se pueden fabricar muchas cosas diferentes con madera.
es_latam: Se pueden hacer muchas cosas diferentes de madera.
fr: On peut fabriquer beaucoup de choses différentes avec du bois.
de: Aus Holz können viele verschiedene Dinge hergestellt werden.
it: Si possono fare molte cose diverse con il legno.
pt: Muitas coisas diferentes podem ser feitas de madeira.
ru: Из дерева можно сделать много разных вещей.
hi: लकड़ी से कई अलग-अलग चीजें बनाई जा सकती हैं।
zh: 木头可以制成许多不同的东西。
ja: 木材から多くの異なるものを作ることができます。
ko: 나무로 많은 다양한 것들을 만들 수 있습니다.
vi: Nhiều thứ khác nhau có thể được làm từ gỗ.
sv: Många olika saker kan tillverkas av trä.
fi: Puusta voidaan valmistaa monia erilaisia asioita.
nl: Van hout kunnen veel verschillende dingen worden gemaakt.
el: Πολλά διαφορετικά πράγματα μπορούν να φτιαχτούν από ξύλο.
ar: يمكن صنع العديد من الأشياء المختلفة من الخشب.

text: It is time to reflect on your past.
text_en: It is time to reflect on your past.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral declarative statement. The addressee is assumed to be singular and the gender defaults to female as per instructions, as there are no specific markers to indicate otherwise.
es: Es hora de reflexionar sobre tu pasado.
es_latam: Es hora de reflexionar sobre tu pasado.
fr: Il est temps de réfléchir à ton passé.
de: Es ist Zeit, über deine Vergangenheit nachzudenken.
it: È tempo di riflettere sul tuo passato.
pt: É hora de refletir sobre o seu passado.
ru: Пришло время поразмышлять о твоём прошлом.
hi: यह आपके अतीत पर विचार करने का समय है।
zh: 是时候反思你的过去了。
ja: あなたの過去を振り返る時です。
vi: Đã đến lúc để bạn suy ngẫm về quá khứ của mình.
sv: Det är dags att reflektera över ditt förflutna.
nl: Het is tijd om over je verleden na te denken.
el: Είναι ώρα να αναλογιστείς το παρελθόν σου.

text: I am not rich, nor do I wish to be.
text_en: I am not rich, nor do I wish to be.
en_notes: The sentence uses a formal structure ('nor do I') which elevates the register. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: No soy rica, ni deseo serlo.
es_latam: No soy rica, ni deseo serlo.
fr: Je ne suis pas riche, et je ne souhaite pas l'être.
de: Ich bin nicht reich, noch wünsche ich es zu sein.
it: Non sono ricca, né desidero esserlo.
pt: Não sou rica, nem desejo ser.
ru: Я не богата и не желаю этого.
hi: मैं अमीर नहीं हूँ, और न ही मैं होना चाहती हूँ।
ja: 私は裕福ではありませんし、そうなりたいとも思いません。
ko: 저는 부유하지 않으며, 부유해지기를 바라지도 않습니다.
vi: Tôi không giàu, và tôi cũng không mong muốn được như vậy.
sv: Jag är inte rik, och jag önskar inte heller vara det.
fi: En ole rikas, enkä halua ollakaan.
nl: Ik ben niet rijk, noch wens ik dat te zijn.
el: Δεν είμαι πλούσια, ούτε επιθυμώ να είμαι.
ar: لستُ غنيةً، ولا أرغبُ في أن أكونَ كذلك.
corrections_summary: pt: spelling error in clitic pronoun → fixed 'serlo' to 'ser'.

text: Take the keys to your brother.
text_en: Take the keys to your brother.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative command. The speaker is female by default, and the addressee is neutral as there are no specific gender markers for the person being spoken to.
es: Llévale las llaves a tu hermano.
es_latam: Llévale las llaves a tu hermano.
fr: Apporte les clés à ton frère.
de: Bring deinem Bruder die Schlüssel.
it: Porta le chiavi a tuo fratello.
pt: Leve as chaves para o seu irmão.
hi: चाबियाँ अपने भाई के पास ले जाओ।
ja: お兄さんに鍵を届けて。
vi: Hãy mang chìa khóa cho anh trai của bạn.
sv: Ta med nycklarna till din bror.
nl: Breng de sleutels naar je broer.
el: Πήγαινε τα κλειδιά στον αδερφό σου.
corrections_summary: es: added indirect object pronoun 'le' for better naturalness in Castilian Spanish; zh: changed '兄弟' (general/formal) to '哥哥' or '弟弟' is usually preferred, but '哥哥' is the standard default for 'brother' in neutral imperatives; ja: changed '兄弟' (sibling) to 'お兄さん' or '弟さん' as '兄弟' is rarely used for a specific person in speech; ko: changed '남동생' (younger brother) to '오빠' or '남동생' depending on speaker, but '오빠' or '형' is more common; however, '동생' or '형/오빠' is better than the specific '남동생' unless specified. Adjusted to '오빠/형' for naturalness.

text: If you stack the dishes up by the sink, I'll do them later.
text_en: If you stack the dishes up by the sink, I'll do them later.
en_notes: The sentence is a conditional statement in a casual domestic setting, so an informal register is most appropriate. The genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no specific markers.
es: Si apilas los platos junto al fregadero, los lavaré luego.
es_latam: Si apilas los platos junto al fregadero, los lavaré luego.
fr: Si tu empiles la vaisselle près de l'évier, je la ferai plus tard.
de: Wenn du das Geschirr am Spülbecken stapelst, spüle ich es später ab.
it: Se impili i piatti vicino al lavandino, li laverò più tardi.
pt: Se você empilhar a louça ao lado da pia, eu a lavarei mais tarde.
ru: Если ты сложишь тарелки стопкой у раковины, я помою их позже.
hi: अगर तुम सिंक के पास बर्तन लगा दोगी, तो मैं उन्हें बाद में धो दूँगी।
zh: 如果你把盘子叠在水槽边，我等下再洗。
ja: シンクの横に皿を積み上げておいてくれたら、後で私が洗っておくね。
ko: 싱크대 옆에 그릇을 쌓아 두면 내가 나중에 설거지할게.
vi: Nếu cậu xếp chồng bát đĩa cạnh bồn rửa, tớ sẽ rửa chúng sau.
sv: Om du staplar disken vid diskhon så fixar jag den senare.
fi: Jos pinoat astiat tiskialtaan viereen, tiskaan ne myöhemmin.
nl: Als je de vaat bij de gootsteen opstapelt, doe ik die later wel.
el: Αν στοιβάξεις τα πιάτα δίπλα στον νεροχύτη, θα τα πλύνω αργότερα.
ar: إذا وضعتِ الأطباق فوق بعضها بجانب المغسلة، فسأغسلها لاحقاً.

text: He tends to isolate himself.
text_en: He tends to isolate himself.
en_notes: The speaker gender defaults to female as pre-assigned. The subject 'He' and reflexive pronoun 'himself' refer to a third party, not the addressee.
es: Él tiende a aislarse.
es_latam: Él tiende a aislarse.
fr: Il a tendance à s'isoler.
de: Er neigt dazu, sich zu isolieren.
it: Tende a isolarsi.
pt: Ele tende a se isolar.
hi: वह खुद को अलग-थलग रखने की प्रवृत्ति रखता है।
ja: 彼は自分を孤立させる傾向がある。
vi: Anh ấy có xu hướng tự cô lập mình.
sv: Han tenderar att isolera sig.
nl: Hij heeft de neiging zich te isoleren.
el: Τείνει να απομονώνεται.
corrections_summary: ru: 'изолировать себя' is grammatically correct but 'изолироваться' is more natural for personal habits → changed to 'Он склонен изолироваться'; hi: phrasing was slightly wordy → simplified to 'वह खुद को अलग-थलग रखने की प्रवृत्ति रखता है' (kept as is, but noted as acceptable); zh: '自我孤立' sounds like a psychological term → changed to '他倾向于孤立自己' for a more natural neutral register.

text: Please check all the items on this list.
text_en: Please check all the items on this list.
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request using 'please', which is categorized as an imperative sentence type. The register is neutral to formal, and there are no specific gender cues, so the defaults are maintained.
es: Por favor, comprueba todos los elementos de esta lista.
es_latam: Por favor, revisa todos los elementos de esta lista.
fr: Veuillez vérifier tous les éléments de cette liste.
de: Bitte überprüfe alle Punkte auf dieser Liste.
it: Per favore, controlla tutti gli elementi di questa lista.
pt: Por favor, verifique todos os itens desta lista.
ru: Пожалуйста, проверьте все пункты в этом списке.
hi: कृपया इस सूची की सभी वस्तुओं की जाँच करें।
zh: 请检查这份清单上的所有项目。
ja: このリストのすべての項目を確認してください。
ko: 이 목록의 모든 항목을 확인해 주세요.
vi: Vui lòng kiểm tra tất cả các mục trong danh sách này.
sv: Vänligen kontrollera alla punkter på den här listan.
nl: Controleer alstublieft alle items op deze lijst.
el: Παρακαλώ ελέγξτε όλα τα στοιχεία σε αυτή τη λίστα.
ar: يرجى التحقق من جميع العناصر الموجودة في هذه القائمة.

text: This is a wood table.
text_en: This is a wooden table.
en_notes: Normalized 'wood table' to 'wooden table' for better flow, though both are acceptable. The sentence is a simple statement of fact with no specific addressee or speaker cues.
es: Esta es una mesa de madera.
es_latam: Esta es una mesa de madera.
fr: C'est une table en bois.
de: Das ist ein Holztisch.
it: Questo è un tavolo di legno.
pt: Esta é uma mesa de madeira.
hi: यह लकड़ी की एक मेज़ है।
ja: これは木製のテーブルです。
vi: Đây là một cái bàn gỗ.
sv: Det här är ett träbord.
nl: Dit is een houten tafel.
el: Αυτό είναι ένα ξύλινο τραπέζι.

text: It would have been silly to do that.
text_en: It would have been silly to do that.
en_notes: The sentence uses a conditional perfect construction to express a hypothetical past situation. The genders are set to the defaults as there are no contextual clues to override them.
es: Habría sido una tontería hacer eso.
es_latam: Habría sido una tontería hacer eso.
fr: Il aurait été stupide de faire cela.
de: Es wäre albern gewesen, das zu tun.
it: Sarebbe stato sciocco fare una cosa del genere.
pt: Teria sido uma tolice fazer isso.
hi: ऐसा करना मूर्खतापूर्ण होता।
ja: そんなことをするのは愚かだったでしょう。
ko: 그렇게 하는 것은 어리석은 일이었을 것입니다.
vi: Làm như vậy thì đã thật là ngớ ngẩn.
sv: Det hade varit fånigt att göra så.
nl: Het zou dwaas zijn geweest om dat te doen.
el: Θα ήταν ανόητο να γίνει αυτό.
corrections_summary: el: The translation used a second-person singular verb ('to do it yourself') which was not implied by the source; changed to a neutral infinitive construction.

text: The soccer match was intense for Gustavo.
text_en: The soccer match was intense for Gustavo.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement about a third party. Gustavo is a typically male name, but he is the subject of the prepositional phrase, not the speaker or addressee.
es: El partido de fútbol fue intenso para Gustavo.
es_latam: El partido de fútbol fue intenso para Gustavo.
fr: Le match de football a été intense pour Gustavo.
de: Das Fußballspiel war für Gustavo intensiv.
it: La partita di calcio è stata intensa per Gustavo.
pt: A partida de futebol foi intensa para o Gustavo.
ru: Футбольный матч был напряженным для Густаво.
hi: गुस्तावो के लिए फुटबॉल मैच रोमांचक था।
zh: 这场足球赛对古斯塔沃来说非常激烈。
ja: そのサッカーの試合はグスタボにとって激しいものでした。
vi: Trận bóng đá đã diễn ra rất căng thẳng đối với Gustavo.
sv: Fotbollsmatchen var intensiv för Gustavo.
nl: De voetbalwedstrijd was intens voor Gustavo.
el: Ο ποδοσφαιρικός αγώνας ήταν έντονος για τον Γκουστάβο.
ar: كانت مباراة كرة القدم حماسية بالنسبة لغوستافو.

text: Diego put out the fire and went inside his tent.
text_en: Diego put out the fire and went inside his tent.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as the narrator is not specified. The speaker_gender default was ignored in favor of the name 'Diego' and the possessive pronoun 'his' identifying the subject as male.
es: Diego apagó el fuego y entró en su tienda.
es_latam: Diego apagó el fuego y entró en su carpa.
fr: Diego a éteint le feu et est entré dans sa tente.
de: Diego löschte das Feuer und ging in sein Zelt.
it: Diego ha spento il fuoco ed è entrato nella sua tenda.
pt: Diego apagou o fogo e entrou em sua barraca.
ru: Диего потушил огонь и вошел в свою палатку.
hi: डिएगो ने आग बुझाई और अपने तंबू के अंदर चला गया।
zh: 迭戈扑灭了火，走进了他的帐篷。
ja: ディエゴは火を消してテントの中に入った。
ko: 디에고는 불을 끄고 자신의 텐트 안으로 들어갔다.
vi: Diego đã dập tắt lửa và đi vào trong lều của mình.
sv: Diego släckte elden och gick in i sitt tält.
fi: Diego sammutti tulen ja meni sisään telttaansa.
nl: Diego doofde het vuur en ging zijn tent binnen.
el: Ο Ντιέγκο έσβησε τη φωτιά και μπήκε στη σκηνή του.

text: The early fences were designed to keep out animals, not people.
text_en: The early fences were designed to keep out animals, not people.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual historical statement. No disambiguation needed as there is no direct speaker or addressee mentioned.
es: Las primeras vallas fueron diseñadas para mantener fuera a los animales, no a las personas.
es_latam: Las primeras cercas fueron diseñadas para mantener fuera a los animales, no a las personas.
fr: Les premières clôtures ont été conçues pour empêcher les animaux d'entrer, pas les gens.
de: Die ersten Zäune wurden entworfen, um Tiere fernzuhalten, nicht Menschen.
it: Le prime recinzioni furono progettate per tenere fuori gli animali, non le persone.
pt: As primeiras cercas foram projetadas para manter os animais fora, não as pessoas.
ru: Первые заборы были предназначены для защиты от животных, а не от людей.
hi: शुरुआती बाड़ जानवरों को बाहर रखने के लिए बनाई गई थीं, लोगों को नहीं।
zh: 早期的围栏是设计用来阻挡动物的，而不是人。
ja: 初期の柵は、人ではなく動物を入れないように設計されていました。
ko: 초기의 울타리는 사람이 아니라 동물을 막기 위해 설계되었습니다.
vi: Những hàng rào đầu tiên được thiết kế để ngăn chặn động vật, không phải con người.
sv: De tidiga stängslen utformades för att hålla djur ute, inte människor.
fi: Ensimmäiset aidat suunniteltiin pitämään eläimet ulkona, ei ihmisiä.
nl: De eerste hekken waren ontworpen om dieren buiten te houden, niet mensen.
el: Οι πρώτοι φράχτες σχεδιάστηκαν για να κρατούν έξω τα ζώα, όχι τους ανθρώπους.
ar: صُممت الأسوار الأولى لإبعاد الحيوانات، لا البشر.

text: This story tells us an interesting fact.
text_en: This story tells us an interesting fact.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement with no specific addressee or gendered cues, so it follows the pre-assigned speaker gender and neutral addressee defaults.
es: Esta historia nos cuenta un dato interesante.
es_latam: Esta historia nos cuenta un dato interesante.
fr: Cette histoire nous raconte un fait intéressant.
de: Diese Geschichte erzählt uns eine interessante Tatsache.
it: Questa storia ci racconta un fatto interessante.
pt: Esta história nos conta um fato interessante.
ru: Эта история рассказывает нам интересный факт.
hi: यह कहानी हमें एक दिलचस्प तथ्य बताती है।
zh: 这个故事告诉了我们一个有趣的事实。
ja: この物語は私たちに興味深い事実を伝えています。
ko: 이 이야기는 우리에게 흥미로운 사실을 알려줍니다.
vi: Câu chuyện này kể cho chúng ta một sự thật thú vị.
sv: Den här berättelsen berättar ett intressant faktum för oss.
fi: Tämä tarina kertoo meille mielenkiintoisen tosiasian.
nl: Dit verhaal vertelt ons een interessant feit.
el: Αυτή η ιστορία μάς λέει ένα ενδιαφέρον γεγονός.
ar: تحكي لنا هذه القصة حقيقة مثيرة للاهتمام.

text: Natural gas is an important natural resource.
text_en: Natural gas is an important natural resource.
en_notes: The sentence is a general factual statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned.
es: El gas natural es un recurso natural importante.
es_latam: El gas natural es un recurso natural importante.
fr: Le gaz naturel est une ressource naturelle importante.
de: Erdgas ist eine wichtige natürliche Ressource.
it: Il gas naturale è un'importante risorsa naturale.
pt: O gás natural é um recurso natural importante.
ru: Природный газ — это важный природный ресурс.
hi: प्राकृतिक गैस एक महत्वपूर्ण प्राकृतिक संसाधन है।
zh: 天然气是一种重要的自然资源。
ja: 天然ガスは重要な天然資源です。
vi: Khí thiên nhiên là một nguồn tài nguyên thiên nhiên quan trọng.
sv: Naturgas är en viktig naturresurs.
nl: Aardgas is een belangrijke natuurlijke hulpbron.
el: Το φυσικό αέριο είναι ένας σημαντικός φυσικός πόρος.

text: I'd much rather not retire at all.

corrections_summary: sv: 'sondotter' (son's daughter) is too specific for 'granddaughter' → changed to 'barnbarn' (grandchild) with feminine context or 'dotterdotter/sondotter' generic; 'barnbarn' is the standard translation for granddaughter when the lineage isn't specified, but 'sondotter' is technically only 50% likely. However, in Swedish, 'enda barnbarn som är flicka' is clunky, so 'enda sondotter' or 'enda dotterdotter' are usually avoided unless known. Replaced with 'enda barnbarnsflicka' or the more natural 'enda sondotter' if we assume paternal, but 'enda barnbarn' is safest. Actually, 'enda sondotter' is acceptable if we assume one side, but 'enda kvinnliga barnbarn' is the literal. I will use 'enda barnbarn' as it is the most natural equivalent for a general statement. fi: 'pojantytär' (son's daughter) is too specific → changed to 'lapsenlapsi' (grandchild) or 'tyttärentytär/pojantytär'. Using 'ainoa lapsenlapsi' is the standard natural translation for 'only granddaughter' when the specific parent isn't known.

ja: エリート体操はこの地域では珍しく、サッカーやラグビー、クリケットといったスポーツの人気に影を潜めています。
ko: 엘리트 체조는 세계 이 지역에서 흔치 않으며, 축구, 럭비, 크리켓과 같은 스포츠의 인기에 밀려 빛을 보지 못하고 있습니다.

text: I know I don't have to do anything Tom tells me to do.
text_en: I know I don't have to do anything Tom tells me to do.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement. The speaker gender remains neutral as there are no specific cues, and there is no direct addressee.
