ko: 톰이 시키는 일은 무엇이든 할 필요가 없다는 걸 알아요.
vi: Tôi biết mình không phải làm bất cứ điều gì Tom bảo tôi làm.

text: Your life is shaped by the different people you meet in your life.

text: You can get all kinds of things to eat if you go to the free samples area in a department store.
text_en: You can get all kinds of things to eat if you go to the free samples area in a department store.
en_notes: The sentence uses the generic 'you' to describe a general possibility, but for translation purposes, it is treated as an informal address to a female as per the default. The tense is simple present describing a general truth.
es: Puedes conseguir todo tipo de cosas para comer si vas a la zona de muestras gratuitas de unos grandes almacenes.
es_latam: Puedes conseguir todo tipo de cosas para comer si vas a la zona de muestras gratis de una tienda departamental.
fr: Tu peux trouver toutes sortes de choses à manger si tu vas au rayon des échantillons gratuits dans un grand magasin.

pt: Você pode conseguir todo tipo de coisa para comer se for à área de amostras grátis em uma loja de departamentos.
ru: Ты можешь найти самую разную еду, если зайдёшь в отдел бесплатных дегустаций в универмаге.
hi: अगर तुम किसी डिपार्टमेंट स्टोर में मुफ्त नमूनों वाले हिस्से में जाओगी, तो तुम्हें खाने के लिए हर तरह की चीज़ें मिल सकती हैं।
zh: 如果你去百货公司的免费试吃区，你可以吃到各种各样的东西。
ja: デパートの無料試食コーナーに行けば、いろいろな食べ物がもらえるよ。
ko: 백화점 무료 시식 코너에 가면 온갖 종류의 먹을거리를 얻을 수 있어.
vi: Cậu có thể tìm thấy đủ loại đồ ăn nếu cậu đến khu vực dùng thử miễn phí trong một cửa hàng bách hóa.
sv: Du kan få alla möjliga sorters saker att äta om du går till avdelningen för gratisprover i ett varuhus.
fi: Voit saada kaikenlaista syötävää, jos menet tavaratalon ilmaisnäyteosastolle.
nl: Je kunt allerlei dingen te eten krijgen als je naar de gratis proeverijen in een warenhuis gaat.
el: Μπορείς να βρεις κάθε είδους φαγητό αν πας στην περιοχή με τα δωρεάν δείγματα σε ένα πολυκατάστημα.
ar: يمكنكِ الحصول على أنواع مختلفة من الطعام إذا ذهبتِ إلى قسم العينات المجانية في متجر كبير.
corrections_summary: ar: fixed verb conjugation to match female addressee (singular informal) → يمكنكِ and ذهبتِ.

text: He arrived with a trunk full of books.

zh: 后来，人们学会了制造铁制品。
ja: その後、人々は鉄製品の作り方を学びました。

text: He said that we weren't allowed to take photographs in this museum.
text_en: He said that we weren't allowed to take photographs in this museum.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default female as the sentence does not specify who is reporting the statement. The subject of the reported speech is male ('He').

es_latam: Dijo que no se nos permitía tomar fotografías en este museo.

de: Er sagte, dass wir in diesem Museum nicht fotografieren durften.
it: Ha detto che non ci era permesso scattare fotografie in questo museo.
pt: Ele disse que não nos era permitido tirar fotografias neste museu.
ru: Он сказал, что нам не разрешалось фотографировать в этом музее.
hi: उन्होंने कहा कि हमें इस संग्रहालय में तस्वीरें लेने की अनुमति नहीं थी।

sv: Han sade att vi inte fick ta fotografier i det här museet.
fi: Hän sanoi, ettei meillä ollut lupaa ottaa valokuvia tässä museossa.
nl: Hij zei dat we in dit museum geen foto's mochten maken.
el: Είπε ότι δεν μας επιτρεπόταν να βγάλουμε φωτογραφίες σε αυτό το μουσείο.
ar: قال إنّه لم يكن مسموحاً لنا بالتقاط الصور في هذا المتحف.
corrections_summary: fr: gender agreement mismatch → changed 'autorisés' to 'autorisées' because the speaker is female and 'we' includes her (assuming a female group or mixed, but 'autorisées' is required if the speaker is female and the group is female, however, in French 'nous' usually defaults to masculine unless specified otherwise; given the speaker_gender is female, 'autorisées' is a valid correction if the group is all-female, but 'autorisés' is standard for mixed. However, the most natural neutral phrasing is 'on n'avait pas le droit', so I will adjust for naturalness). ja: slightly formal for neutral → adjusted to a more natural reporting style.

corrections_summary: hi: 'लंगर' (ship anchor) is rarely used figuratively for emotional stability in Hindi, 'सहारा' is more natural; ko: '닻' (anchor) is not used figuratively for emotional support in Korean, '버팀목' (support/mainstay) is the correct equivalent.

text: If you would be a good reader, read; if a writer, write.

corrections_summary: zh: removed redundant 'female' adjectives as the gender is implied by the context of the address; ja: adjusted to a more natural formal register; sv: removed 'kvinnlig' (female) as it is unnatural in this context, the gender is handled by the addressee number/register; fi: removed 'naispuolinen' (female) as it is unnatural in Finnish to specify gender this way.

sv: Vad har du där under armen?
nl: Wat heb je daar onder je arm?
el: Τι είναι αυτό κάτω από τη μασχάλη σου;
corrections_summary: hi: incorrect word order and register → rephrased for naturalness and neutral register; vi: 'bạn' is slightly formal for a neutral context → changed to 'cậu' for a more natural neutral address.

text: He's a fly fisher.
text_en: He's a fly fisher.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no cues. The subject of the sentence is male ('He'), but the addressee is not applicable as this is a declarative statement about a third party.
es: Él es un pescador de mosca.
es_latam: Él es un pescador con mosca.
fr: C'est un pêcheur à la mouche.
de: Er ist ein Fliegenfischer.
it: È un pescatore a mosca.
pt: Ele é um pescador com mosca.
hi: वह एक फ्लाई फिशर है।
ja: 彼はフライフィッシャーです。
vi: Anh ấy là một người câu cá bay.
sv: Han är en flugfiskare.
nl: Hij is een vliegvisser.
el: Είναι ψαράς με μύγα.
corrections_summary: pt: 'pescador de mosca' is less common than 'pescador com mosca' → updated to 'com mosca'; vi: 'câu cá bằng ruồi' sounds like using actual flies as bait rather than the sport of fly fishing → updated to 'câu cá bằng ruồi nhân tạo' or more naturally 'người câu cá bay' (though 'câu cá bằng ruồi' is technically acceptable, 'người câu cá bay' is the specific term for the sport); zh: '飞钓者' is understandable but '飞钓玩家' or '飞钓爱好者' is more natural for the sport → updated to '飞钓爱好者'.

text: He rubbed his chin.
text_en: He rubbed his chin.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as the narrator is not identified, but the subject of the sentence is explicitly male due to the pronouns 'he' and 'his'.
es: Se frotó la barbilla.
es_latam: Se frotó la barbilla.
fr: Il s'est frotté le menton.
de: Er rieb sich das Kinn.
it: Si sfregò il mento.
pt: Ele esfregou o queixo.
hi: उसने अपनी ठुड्डी रगड़ी।
ja: 彼は顎をさすった。
vi: Anh ấy đã xoa cằm.
sv: Han gned sig om hakan.
nl: Hij wreef over zijn kin.
el: Έτριψε το πηγούνι του.

text: Do you have any more wine?
text_en: Do you have any more wine?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry in a neutral register. I have used the pre-assigned gender defaults as there are no contextual cues to suggest otherwise.
es: ¿Tienes algo más de vino?
es_latam: ¿Tienes más vino?
fr: Est-ce que tu as encore du vin ?
de: Hast du noch mehr Wein?
it: Hai altro vino?
pt: Você tem mais vinho?
hi: क्या तुम्हारे पास और वाइन है?
ja: ワインはまだありますか？
vi: Anh còn rượu không?
sv: Har du mer vin?
nl: Heb je nog meer wijn?
el: Έχεις κι άλλο κρασί;
corrections_summary: zh: '更多的' is slightly redundant/unnatural for a simple inquiry about wine → simplified to '还有酒吗'.

text: You look like you're having a lot of trouble setting up that web page. Want some help?
text_en: You look like you're having a lot of trouble setting up that web page. Want some help?
en_notes: The sentence is informal due to the ellipsis of 'Do you' in the second question. Addressee number is singular as it is directed at one person performing a task.
es: Parece que estás teniendo muchos problemas para configurar esa página web. ¿Quieres que te ayude?
es_latam: Parece que estás teniendo muchos problemas para configurar esa página web. ¿Quieres que te ayude?
fr: On dirait que tu as beaucoup de mal à configurer cette page web. Tu veux un coup de main ?
de: Es sieht so aus, als hättest du gerade große Schwierigkeiten beim Erstellen dieser Webseite. Brauchst du Hilfe?
it: Sembra che tu stia avendo molte difficoltà a configurare quella pagina web. Vuoi una mano?
pt: Parece que você está tendo muitos problemas para configurar essa página web. Quer ajuda?
ru: Похоже, у тебя возникло много проблем с настройкой этой веб-страницы. Тебе помочь?
hi: ऐसा लग रहा है कि तुम्हें उस वेब पेज को सेटअप करने में काफी परेशानी हो रही है। क्या तुम्हें मदद चाहिए?
zh: 看起来你在设置那个网页时遇到了很多麻烦。需要帮忙吗？
ja: そのウェブページの設定にかなり苦労しているみたいだね。手伝おうか？
ko: 그 웹페이지를 설정하는 데 꽤 애를 먹고 있는 것 같네. 좀 도와줄까?
vi: Có vẻ như cậu đang gặp rất nhiều khó khăn khi thiết lập trang web đó. Cậu có cần giúp không?
sv: Det ser ut som att du har stora problem med att ställa in den där webbsidan. Vill du ha hjälp?
fi: Näyttää siltä, että sinulla on paljon vaikeuksia tuon verkkosivun pystyttämisessä. Haluatko apua?
nl: Het lijkt erop dat je veel moeite hebt met het instellen van die webpagina. Wil je wat hulp?
el: Φαίνεται ότι δυσκολεύεσαι πολύ να στήσεις αυτή την ιστοσελίδα. Θέλεις βοήθεια;
ar: يبدو أنكِ تواجهين الكثير من المتاعب في إعداد صفحة الويب تلك. هل تريدين مساعدة؟
corrections_summary: hi: used masculine/neutral 'तुम्हें' which is okay, but the verb 'रहा है' is masculine; changed to feminine 'रही है' to match addressee_gender.

text: Apparently in this library are precious books that money can't buy.
text_en: Apparently, in this library there are precious books that money can't buy.
en_notes: Added a comma and 'there' for better flow and grammatical clarity. The phrase 'money can't buy' is classified as figurative as it implies being priceless or irreplaceable rather than a literal transaction failure.
es: Al parecer, en esta biblioteca hay libros valiosos que el dinero no puede comprar.
es_latam: Al parecer, en esta biblioteca hay libros valiosos que el dinero no puede comprar.
fr: Apparemment, il y a dans cette bibliothèque des livres précieux que l'argent ne peut acheter.
de: Anscheinend gibt es in dieser Bibliothek kostbare Bücher, die man für Geld nicht kaufen kann.
it: A quanto pare, in questa biblioteca ci sono libri preziosi che il denaro non può comprare.
pt: Pelo visto, nesta biblioteca há livros preciosos que o dinheiro não compra.
ru: Судя по всему, в этой библиотеке есть бесценные книги, которые не купишь ни за какие деньги.
hi: जाहिर है, इस पुस्तकालय में ऐसी कीमती किताबें हैं जिन्हें पैसे से नहीं खरीदा जा सकता।
zh: 显然，这家图书馆里有一些金钱买不到的珍贵书籍。
ja: どうやら、この図書館には金では買えない貴重な本があるようです。
ko: 듣자 하니 이 도서관에는 돈으로 살 수 없는 귀중한 책들이 있다고 합니다.
vi: Hình như trong thư viện này có những cuốn sách quý giá mà tiền bạc không thể mua được.
sv: Tydligen finns det värdefulla böcker i det här biblioteket som inte kan köpas för pengar.
fi: Ilmeisesti tässä kirjastossa on arvokkaita kirjoja, joita ei voi rahalla ostaa.
nl: Blijkbaar staan er in deze bibliotheek kostbare boeken die met geen goud te koop zijn.
el: Προφανώς, σε αυτή τη βιβλιοθήκη υπάρχουν πολύτιμα βιβλία που δεν αγοράζονται με χρήματα.
ar: على ما يبدو، توجد في هذه المكتبة كتب قيمة لا يمكن شراؤها بالمال.
corrections_summary: es: changed 'no tienen precio' to 'el dinero no puede comprar' to better reflect the source phrasing; fr: changed 'n'ont pas de prix' to 'l'argent ne peut acheter' for closer alignment with the source idiom; it: changed 'non hanno prezzo' to 'che il denaro non può comprare' for accuracy; ar: changed 'لا تُقدّر بثمن' (priceless) to 'لا يمكن شراؤها بالمال' to match the specific 'money can't buy' phrasing.

text: Do we have milk in the fridge?
text_en: Do we have milk in the fridge?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry about household supplies. No gender cues are present, so the pre-assigned defaults were used.
es: ¿Tenemos leche en la nevera?
es_latam: ¿Tenemos leche en el refrigerador?
fr: Est-ce qu'on a du lait dans le frigo ?
de: Haben wir Milch im Kühlschrank?
it: Abbiamo del latte in frigo?
pt: Temos leite na geladeira?
ru: У нас есть молоко в холодильнике?
hi: क्या हमारे पास फ्रिज में दूध है?
ja: 冷蔵庫に牛乳はある？
vi: Chúng ta có sữa trong tủ lạnh không?
sv: Har vi mjölk i kylskåpet?
nl: Hebben we melk in de koelkast?
el: Έχουμε γάλα στο ψυγείο;

text: In spite of all of his riches, he is not at all happy.
text_en: In spite of all of his riches, he is not at all happy.
en_notes: The gender of the subject is explicitly male due to the pronouns 'his' and 'he'. The speaker gender remains the pre-assigned default as there are no cues to override it.
es: A pesar de todas sus riquezas, no es nada feliz.
es_latam: A pesar de todas sus riquezas, no es para nada feliz.
fr: Malgré toutes ses richesses, il n'est pas du tout heureux.
de: Trotz all seines Reichtums ist er überhaupt nicht glücklich.
it: Nonostante tutte le sue ricchezze, non è affatto felice.
pt: Apesar de todas as suas riquezas, ele não é nem um pouco feliz.
ru: Несмотря на всё своё богатство, он совсем не счастлив.
hi: अपनी तमाम दौलत के बावजूद, वह बिल्कुल भी खुश नहीं है।
zh: 尽管他拥有所有的财富，但他一点也不快乐。
ja: あれほどの富がありながら、彼は少しも幸せではない。
ko: 그 모든 부유함에도 불구하고, 그는 전혀 행복하지 않다.
vi: Bất chấp tất cả sự giàu có của mình, anh ấy không hề hạnh phúc chút nào.
sv: Trots alla sina rikedomar är han inte alls lycklig.
fi: Kaikesta rikkaudestaan huolimatta hän ei ole lainkaan onnellinen.
nl: Ondanks al zijn rijkdom is hij helemaal niet gelukkig.
el: Παρά όλα τα πλούτη του, δεν είναι καθόλου ευτυχισμένος.
ar: على الرغم من كل ثرواته، إلا أنه ليس سعيداً على الإطلاق.

text: Pretend you're doing something.
text_en: Pretend you're doing something.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative command addressed to a second person. Register is neutral to informal, and the addressee number is singular by default in a general context.
es: Finge que estás haciendo algo.
es_latam: Finge que estás haciendo algo.
fr: Fais semblant de faire quelque chose.
de: Tu so, als würdest du etwas tun.
it: Fingi di fare qualcosa.
pt: Finja que está fazendo alguma coisa.
hi: दिखावा करो कि तुम कुछ कर रहे हो।
ja: 何かをしているふりをしてください。
vi: Hãy giả vờ như bạn đang làm gì đó.
sv: Låtsas att du gör något.
nl: Doe alsof je iets aan het doen bent.
el: Προσποιήσου ότι κάνεις κάτι.

text: Mother is preparing lunch.
text_en: Mother is preparing lunch.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as there are no cues in the text. The addressee gender and number are not applicable as this is a declarative statement about a third party.
es: Mamá está preparando el almuerzo.
es_latam: Mamá está preparando el almuerzo.
fr: Maman prépare le déjeuner.
de: Mutter bereitet gerade das Mittagessen zu.
it: La mamma sta preparando il pranzo.
pt: A mãe está preparando o almoço.
hi: माँ दोपहर का खाना बना रही हैं।
ja: 母は昼食を準備しています。
vi: Mẹ đang chuẩn bị bữa trưa.
sv: Mamma lagar lunch.
nl: Moeder is de lunch aan het bereiden.
el: Η μητέρα ετοιμάζει το μεσημεριανό.
corrections_summary: es: 'La madre' sounds like 'the mother' (referring to someone else's mother) rather than 'Mother' as a title/name; changed to 'Mamá' or 'Madre' to match the English nuance of a family member. zh: '母亲' (mǔqīn) is very formal; changed to '妈妈' (māma) for a more natural neutral register.

text: I am sorry for disappointing you.
text_en: I am sorry for disappointing you.
en_notes: The sentence is a direct apology. The speaker gender is set to the female default as there are no contrary indicators, and the addressee is neutral and singular by default.
es: Siento haberte decepcionado.
es_latam: Siento haberte decepcionado.
fr: Je suis désolée de t'avoir déçu.
de: Es tut mir leid, dich enttäuscht zu haben.
it: Mi dispiace di averti delusa.
pt: Sinto muito por ter decepcionado você.
ru: Мне жаль, что я тебя разочаровала.
hi: मुझे तुम्हें निराश करने का दुख है।
ja: あなたをがっかりさせてしまってごめんなさい。
vi: Tôi xin lỗi vì đã làm bạn thất vọng.
sv: Jag är ledsen att jag gjorde dig besviken.
fi: Olen pahoillani, että tuotin sinulle pettymyksen.
nl: Het spijt me dat ik je heb teleurgesteld.
el: Λυπάμαι που σε απογοήτευσα.
corrections_summary: it: speaker gender was masculine → changed to 'dispiaciuta' to match female speaker_gender; hi: phrasing was slightly unnatural → adjusted to a more common expression for 'I am sorry'.

text: Is the hatred we see walking, driving, on social media, in the media a normal state or a pathology of the mind?
text_en: Is the hatred we see walking, driving, on social media, or in the media a normal state or a pathology of the mind?
en_notes: Added 'or' before the final item in the list for better grammatical flow. The sentence is a philosophical inquiry, making the register neutral and the addressee not applicable as it is a general question.
es: ¿Es el odio que vemos al caminar, al conducir, en las redes sociales o en los medios un estado normal o una patología de la mente?
es_latam: ¿Es el odio que vemos al caminar, al conducir, en las redes sociales o en los medios un estado normal o una patología de la mente?
fr: La haine que nous voyons en marchant, en conduisant, sur les réseaux sociaux ou dans les médias est-elle un état normal ou une pathologie de l'esprit ?
de: Ist der Hass, den wir beim Gehen, beim Autofahren, in den sozialen Medien oder in den Medien sehen, ein normaler Zustand oder eine Pathologie des Geistes?
it: L'odio che vediamo camminando, guidando, sui social media o nei media è uno stato normale o una patologia della mente?
pt: O ódio que vemos ao caminhar, ao dirigir, nas redes sociais ou na mídia é um estado normal ou uma patologia da mente?
ru: Является ли ненависть, которую мы видим во время прогулок, вождения, в социальных сетях или в СМИ, нормальным состоянием или патологией разума?
hi: क्या वह नफरत जो हम चलते हुए, गाड़ी चलाते हुए, सोशल मीडिया पर या मीडिया में देखते हैं, एक सामान्य स्थिति है या मन की विकृति?
zh: 我们在走路时、开车时、社交媒体上或媒体中看到的仇恨，是一种正常状态还是心理病态？
ja: 歩いている時、運転している時、SNS、あるいはメディアで見かける憎しみは、正常な状態なのでしょうか、それとも精神の病理なのでしょうか。
ko: 우리가 걷거나 운전할 때, 소셜 미디어나 대중 매체에서 보는 증오는 정상적인 상태인가요, 아니면 정신적 병리인가요?
vi: Sự thù hận mà chúng ta thấy khi đi bộ, lái xe, trên mạng xã hội hay trên các phương tiện truyền thông là một trạng thái bình thường hay là một bệnh lý của tâm trí?
sv: Är det hat vi ser när vi går, kör bil, på sociala medier eller i media ett normalt tillstånd eller en patologi i sinnet?
fi: Onko viha, jota näemme kävellessämme, ajaessamme, sosiaalisessa mediassa tai mediassa, normaali tila vai mielen patologia?
nl: Is de haat die we zien tijdens het lopen, autorijden, op sociale media of in de media een normale toestand of een pathologie van de geest?
el: Είναι το μίσος που βλέπουμε περπατώντας, οδηγώντας, στα μέσα κοινωνικής δικτύωσης ή στα μέσα ενημέρωσης μια φυσιολογική κατάσταση ή μια παθολογία του μυαλού;
ar: هل الكراهية التي نراها أثناء المشي، أو القيادة، أو على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، أو في وسائل الإعلام حالة طبيعية أم اعتلال في العقل؟

text: This isn't quite it yet but I think that we're getting closer.
text_en: This isn't quite it yet, but I think that we're getting closer.
en_notes: Added a comma for better readability. The sentence is neutral in register and uses a figurative expression 'getting closer' to imply progress toward a goal.
es: Esto no es exactamente lo que buscamos todavía, pero creo que nos estamos acercando.
es_latam: Esto no es exactamente lo que buscamos todavía, pero creo que nos estamos acercando.
fr: Ce n'est pas encore tout à fait ça, mais je pense que nous nous en rapprochons.
de: Das ist es noch nicht ganz, aber ich glaube, wir kommen der Sache näher.
it: Non è ancora del tutto esatto, ma penso che ci stiamo avvicinando.
pt: Ainda não é bem isso, mas acho que estamos chegando perto.
ru: Это ещё не совсем то, но я думаю, что мы приближаемся.
hi: यह अभी पूरी तरह से वह नहीं है, लेकिन मुझे लगता है कि हम करीब आ रहे हैं।
zh: 这还不太对，但我觉得我们正越来越接近了。
ja: これはまだ完全ではありませんが、近づいてきていると思います。
ko: 아직은 이게 정답이 아니지만, 점점 가까워지고 있는 것 같아요.
vi: Đây vẫn chưa hoàn toàn là nó, nhưng tôi nghĩ chúng ta đang tiến gần hơn rồi.
sv: Det här är inte riktigt rätt än, men jag tror att vi närmar oss.
fi: Tämä ei ole vielä aivan se, mutta luulen, että olemme pääsemässä lähemmäksi.
nl: Dit is het nog niet helemaal, maar ik denk dat we dichterbij komen.
el: Δεν είναι ακόμα ακριβώς αυτό, αλλά νομίζω ότι πλησιάζουμε.
ar: ليس هذا هو الأمر تماماً بعد، ولكنني أعتقد أننا نقترب.
corrections_summary: ja: unnatural phrasing for 'getting closer' in a figurative sense → rephrased to be more natural; zh: 'not completely correct' is a bit literal → rephrased to better capture the figurative 'it'.

text: He shows great enthusiasm for his work.
text_en: He shows great enthusiasm for his work.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains the default (female) as the sentence is a third-person observation. The subject 'He' and possessive 'his' refer to the person being discussed, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Muestra un gran entusiasmo por su trabajo.
es_latam: Muestra un gran entusiasmo por su trabajo.
fr: Il fait preuve d'un grand enthousiasme pour son travail.
de: Er zeigt große Begeisterung für seine Arbeit.
it: Mostra un grande entusiasmo per il suo lavoro.
pt: Ele demonstra grande entusiasmo pelo seu trabalho.
ru: Он проявляет большой энтузиазм в своей работе.
hi: वह अपने काम के प्रति बहुत उत्साह दिखाता है।
zh: 他在工作中表现出极大的热情。
ja: 彼は仕事に対して大きな熱意を見せています。
ko: 그는 자신의 일에 큰 열의를 보입니다.
vi: Anh ấy thể hiện sự nhiệt huyết lớn đối với công việc của mình.
sv: Han visar stor entusiasm för sitt arbete.
fi: Hän osoittaa suurta intoa työtään kohtaan.
nl: Hij toont een groot enthousiasme voor zijn werk.
el: Δείχνει μεγάλο ενθουσιασμό για τη δουλειά του.

text: May I park my scooter here?
text_en: May I park my scooter here?
en_notes: The use of 'May I' indicates a formal or polite request for permission. The speaker and addressee genders remain as the default or neutral since no specific identifiers are present.
es: ¿Podría aparcar mi patinete aquí, señor?
es_latam: ¿Podría estacionar mi scooter aquí, señor?
fr: Puis-je garer ma trottinette ici, monsieur ?
de: Dürfte ich meinen Roller hier parken?
it: Potrei parcheggiare il mio monopattino qui, signore?
pt: Poderia estacionar meu patinete aqui, senhor?
ru: Могу ли я припарковать свой самокат здесь?
hi: क्या मैं अपना स्कूटर यहाँ खड़ा कर सकता हूँ, जी?
zh: 请问我可以把我的滑板车停在这里吗？
ja: ここにスクーターを停めてもよろしいでしょうか？
vi: Tôi có thể đỗ xe tay ga của mình ở đây không thưa ông?
sv: Får jag parkera min sparkcykel här?
nl: Mag ik mijn scooter hier parkeren?
el: Θα μπορούσα να παρκάρω το σκούτερ μου εδώ, κύριε;
ar: هل يمكنني ركن السكوتر الخاص بي هنا يا سيدي؟
corrections_summary: ru: 'господин' is overly formal/archaic for a simple parking request → removed to sound more natural while maintaining formal register through verb forms; hi: missing formal honorific for addressee → added 'जी' to align with formal register; sv: 'skoter' usually refers to a snowmobile or moped, 'sparkcykel' is the correct term for a scooter (kick scooter) → updated to 'sparkcykel'.

text: I like that description.
text_en: I like that description.

de: Gustavo hat sein Handy fallen lassen.
it: A Gustavo è caduto il telefono.

sv: Gustavo tappade sin telefon.

text: Shake my hand.
text_en: Shake my hand.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative command. Register is neutral to informal depending on context, but neutral is the safest default for a standard request.
es: Estrecha mi mano.
es_latam: Estrecha mi mano.
fr: Serre-moi la main.
de: Gib mir die Hand.
it: Stringimi la mano.
pt: Aperte a minha mão.
hi: मुझसे हाथ मिलाओ।
ja: 握手して。
vi: Hãy bắt tay tôi.
sv: Skaka hand med mig.
nl: Geef me een hand.
el: Σφίξε μου το χέρι.
corrections_summary: es: 'Dame la mano' means 'Give me your hand', changed to 'Estrecha mi mano' for 'Shake my hand'; es_latam: 'Dame la mano' means 'Give me your hand', changed to 'Estrecha mi mano' for 'Shake my hand'; it: 'Stringimi la mano' is 'Squeeze my hand', changed to 'Stringimi la mano' is acceptable but 'Dammi la mano' or 'Stringiamoci la mano' is better, however 'Dammi la mano' is the most natural for the physical act; sv: 'Skaka hand med mig' is slightly formal, 'Skaka hand' is more common but the original is fine; nl: 'Schud mijn hand' is a literal translation but 'Geef me een hand' is more natural.

text: Everyone will be glad if you stay here. We'll certainly be needing you.
text_en: Everyone will be glad if you stay here. We'll certainly be needing you.
en_notes: The sentence uses the future continuous 'will be needing' to emphasize a future state of necessity. The addressee gender remains male as per the pre-assigned default since no specific cues are present.
es: Todos se alegrarán si te quedas aquí. Sin duda te estaremos necesitando.
es_latam: Todos se alegrarán si te quedas aquí. Sin duda te estaremos necesitando.
fr: Tout le monde sera ravi si tu restes ici. Nous aurons certainement besoin de toi.
de: Alle werden froh sein, wenn du hier bleibst. Wir werden dich mit Sicherheit brauchen.
it: Tutti saranno felici se rimarrai qui. Avremo sicuramente bisogno di te.
pt: Todos ficarão felizes se você ficar aqui. Com certeza estaremos precisando de você.
ru: Все будут рады, если ты останешься здесь. Ты нам определённо будешь нужен.
hi: अगर तुम यहाँ रुकोगे तो सबको खुशी होगी। हमें निश्चित रूप से तुम्हारी ज़रूरत रहेगी।
zh: 如果你留在这里，大家都会很高兴的。我们肯定会一直需要你。
ja: あなたがここに残ってくれたら、みんな喜ぶでしょう。きっとあなたの力が必要になるはずです。
ko: 네가 여기 머문다면 모두가 기뻐할 거야. 우린 분명히 네가 계속 필요할 거야.
vi: Mọi người sẽ rất vui nếu cậu ở lại đây. Chúng tôi chắc chắn sẽ cần đến cậu.
sv: Alla kommer att bli glada om du stannar här. Vi kommer definitivt att behöva dig.
fi: Kaikki ovat iloisia, jos jäät tänne. Tulemme varmasti tarvitsemaan sinua.
nl: Iedereen zal blij zijn als je hier blijft. We zullen je zeker nodig hebben.
el: Όλοι θα χαρούν αν μείνεις εδώ. Σίγουρα θα σε χρειαζόμαστε.
ar: سيسعد الجميع إذا بقيت هنا. سنكون بالتأكيد بحاجة إليك.
corrections_summary: fr: register was formal (vous) → changed to neutral/informal (tu) to match the singular addressee and general tone; es: updated second sentence to better reflect the future continuous aspect; es_latam: updated second sentence to better reflect the future continuous aspect.

text: We took the shortest way to the station.
text_en: We took the shortest way to the station.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement in the past tense. No specific gender or addressee is implied, so defaults were used.
es: Tomamos el camino más corto a la estación.
es_latam: Tomamos el camino más corto a la estación.
fr: Nous avons pris le chemin le plus court pour aller à la gare.
de: Wir nahmen den kürzesten Weg zum Bahnhof.
it: Abbiamo preso la strada più breve per la stazione.
pt: Nós pegamos o caminho mais curto para a estação.
ru: Мы пошли самым коротким путём к вокзалу.
hi: हमने स्टेशन के लिए सबसे छोटा रास्ता लिया।
zh: 我们走的是去车站最近的路。
ja: 私たちは駅までの最短の道を行きました。
ko: 우리는 역으로 가는 가장 짧은 길로 갔습니다.
vi: Chúng tôi đã đi con đường ngắn nhất đến nhà ga.
sv: Vi tog den kortaste vägen till stationen.
nl: We namen de kortste weg naar het station.
el: Πήραμε τον συντομότερο δρόμο για τον σταθμό.

text: She's a better liar than I thought.
text_en: She's a better liar than I thought.
en_notes: The subject 'She' identifies the person being discussed as female, but the speaker's gender remains the pre-assigned default (female). The sentence is a declarative statement about a third party.
es: Es mejor mentirosa de lo que pensaba.
es_latam: Es mejor mentirosa de lo que pensaba.
fr: Elle ment mieux que je ne le pensais.
de: Sie ist eine bessere Lügnerin, als ich dachte.
it: È una bugiarda migliore di quanto pensassi.
pt: Ela é uma mentirosa melhor do que eu pensava.
ru: Она лжёт лучше, чем я думала.
hi: वह मेरी सोच से कहीं बेहतर झूठ बोलती है।
zh: 她比我想象中更会撒谎。
ja: 彼女は私が思っていたよりも嘘が上手だ。
ko: 그녀는 내가 생각했던 것보다 더 거짓말을 잘해요.
vi: Cô ấy nói dối giỏi hơn tôi tưởng.
sv: Hon är en bättre lögnare än jag trodde.
fi: Hän on parempi valehtelija kuin luulin.
nl: Ze is een betere leugenaar dan ik dacht.
el: Είναι καλύτερη ψεύτρα από ό,τι νόμιζα.
corrections_summary: hi: missing female speaker agreement → changed बोलता to बोलती to match speaker_gender; ru: missing female speaker agreement → changed думал to думала to match speaker_gender.

text: The mayor walked at the head of the procession.
text_en: The mayor walked at the head of the procession.
en_notes: The term 'mayor' is gender-neutral in English, so the speaker gender defaults to the pre-assigned male. 'At the head of' is a literal spatial description in this context.
es: El alcalde caminó a la cabeza de la procesión.
es_latam: El alcalde caminó a la cabeza de la procesión.
fr: Le maire marchait en tête du cortège.
de: Der Bürgermeister ging an der Spitze des Umzugs.
it: Il sindaco camminava alla testa del corteo.
pt: O prefeito caminhou à frente da procissão.
hi: मेयर जुलूस के सबसे आगे चले।
zh: 市长走在游行队伍的前头。
ja: 市長は行列の先頭を歩いた。
vi: Thị trưởng đã đi đầu đoàn diễu hành.
sv: Borgmästaren gick längst fram i processionen.
nl: De burgemeester liep aan het hoofd van de stoet.
el: Ο δήμαρχος βάδιζε στην κεφαλή της πομπής.

text: Is there an air pressure gauge here?
text_en: Is there an air pressure gauge here?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry. The addressee gender is set to the default female as there are no contextual cues to override it.
es: ¿Hay un manómetro aquí?
es_latam: ¿Hay un medidor de presión de aire aquí?
fr: Y a-t-il un manomètre ici ?
de: Gibt es hier einen Luftdruckmesser?
it: C'è un manometro qui?
pt: Tem um medidor de pressão de ar aqui?
hi: क्या यहाँ हवा का दबाव मापने वाला यंत्र है?
ja: ここに空気圧計はありますか？
vi: Ở đây có đồng hồ đo áp suất không khí không?
sv: Finns det en lufttrycksmätare här?
nl: Is hier een luchtdrukmeter?
el: Υπάρχει μετρητής πίεσης αέρα εδώ;
ar: هل يوجد مقياس لضغط الهواء هنا؟

text: She checks the office sanitation standards.
text_en: She checks the office sanitation standards.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as it is a third-person observation. The subject 'She' identifies the person performing the action, but does not dictate the speaker's gender. There is no addressee.
es: Ella comprueba los estándares de higiene de la oficina.
es_latam: Ella revisa los estándares de higiene de la oficina.
fr: Elle vérifie les normes sanitaires du bureau.
de: Sie überprüft die Hygienestandards des Büros.
it: Lei controlla gli standard igienico-sanitari dell'ufficio.
pt: Ela verifica os padrões de higiene do escritório.
ru: Она проверяет санитарные нормы в офисе.
hi: वह कार्यालय के स्वच्छता मानकों की जाँच करती है।
zh: 她检查办公室的卫生标准。
ja: 彼女はオフィスの衛生基準をチェックします。
vi: Cô ấy kiểm tra các tiêu chuẩn vệ sinh văn phòng.
sv: Hon kontrollerar kontorets sanitära standarder.
nl: Ze controleert de hygiënenormen van het kantoor.
el: Αυτή ελέγχει τα πρότυπα υγιεινής του γραφείου.
ar: هي تتحقق من معايير النظافة في المكتب.

text: Yanni is done milking his goat.
text_en: Yanni is done milking his goat.
en_notes: The name Yanni and the possessive pronoun 'his' indicate that the subject is male, but the speaker gender remains the pre-assigned default as the speaker is not identified in the text.
es: Yanni ha terminado de ordeñar a su cabra.
es_latam: Yanni terminó de ordeñar a su cabra.
fr: Yanni a fini de traire sa chèvre.
de: Yanni ist fertig mit dem Melken seiner Ziege.
it: Yanni ha finito di mungere la sua capra.
pt: Yanni terminou de ordenhar sua cabra.
hi: यान्नी ने अपनी बकरी का दूध दुहना समाप्त कर लिया है।
ja: ヤニは自分のヤギの乳搾りを終えました。
vi: Yanni đã vắt sữa con dê của mình xong.
sv: Yanni är klar med att mjölka sin get.
nl: Yanni is klaar met het melken van zijn geit.
el: Ο Γιάννης τελείωσε το άρμεγμα της κατσίκας του.
corrections_summary: zh: The translation implies milking the goat's milk rather than the goat itself → corrected to '挤完了山羊的奶' or more naturally '挤完羊奶了'.

text: She was promoted above her supervisors.
text_en: She was promoted above her supervisors.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the pre-assigned default (male) as there is no first-person pronoun. The subject is female based on the pronouns 'she' and 'her'.
es: Ella fue ascendida por encima de sus supervisores.
es_latam: Ella fue ascendida por encima de sus supervisores.
fr: Elle a été promue au-dessus de ses superviseurs.
de: Sie wurde über ihre Vorgesetzten befördert.
it: È stata promossa al di sopra dei suoi supervisori.
pt: Ela foi promovida acima de seus supervisores.
hi: उसे उसके पर्यवेक्षकों से ऊपर पदोन्नत किया गया था।
zh: 她被提拔到了她的主管之上。
ja: 彼女は上司たちを追い越して昇進しました。
ko: 그녀는 자신의 상사들보다 더 높은 직급으로 승진했습니다.
vi: Cô ấy đã được thăng chức cao hơn các cấp trên của mình.
sv: Hon befordrades över sina chefer.
nl: Ze werd gepromoveerd boven haar leidinggevenden.
el: Προήχθη πάνω από τους επόπτες της.
ar: تمت ترقيتها إلى منصب أعلى من مشرفيها.
corrections_summary: ru: incorrect reflexive pronoun usage → changed 'своих' to 'её' to clarify the supervisors belong to her, as 'своих' in this passive/impersonal construction can be ambiguous or grammatically awkward.

text: Have you seen the latest figures?
text_en: Have you seen the latest figures?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry about data or statistics. The addressee gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: ¿Has visto las últimas cifras?
es_latam: ¿Has visto las últimas cifras?
fr: As-tu vu les derniers chiffres ?
de: Hast du die neuesten Zahlen gesehen?
it: Hai visto le ultime cifre?
pt: Você viu os números mais recentes?
hi: क्या तुमने ताज़ा आंकड़े देखे हैं?
ja: 最新の数字を見ましたか？
vi: Anh đã xem những số liệu mới nhất chưa?
sv: Har du sett de senaste siffrorna?
nl: Heb je de nieuwste cijfers gezien?
el: Έχεις δει τα τελευταία νούμερα;

text: The lamb is gone now.
text_en: The lamb is gone now.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple declarative statement. 'Gone' is treated as an adjective describing the state of the subject. No specific gender cues are present, so the pre-assigned defaults are used.
es: El cordero ya no está.
es_latam: El cordero ya se fue.
fr: L'agneau est parti maintenant.
de: Das Lamm ist jetzt weg.
it: L'agnello non c'è più adesso.
pt: O cordeiro se foi agora.
hi: मेमना अब चला गया है।
ja: 子羊はもういなくなりました。
vi: Con cừu non đã đi rồi.
sv: Lammet är borta nu.
nl: Het lam is nu weg.
el: Το αρνί έχει φύγει τώρα.

text: She held up her skirts and picked her steps carefully so as to keep her shoes nice and clean.
text_en: She held up her skirts and picked her steps carefully so as to keep her shoes nice and clean.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as it is a third-person narrative description. The subject is female as indicated by the pronouns 'she' and 'her'.
es: Se levantó las faldas y eligió dónde pisar con cuidado para mantener sus zapatos bonitos y limpios.
es_latam: Se levantó las faldas y eligió dónde pisar con cuidado para mantener sus zapatos lindos y limpios.
fr: Elle releva ses jupes et choisit ses pas avec soin afin de garder ses chaussures belles et propres.
de: Sie hob ihre Röcke an und setzte ihre Schritte vorsichtig, um ihre Schuhe schön und sauber zu halten.
it: Si sollevò le gonne e scelse con cura dove mettere i piedi per mantenere le scarpe belle e pulite.
pt: Ela levantou as saias e escolheu seus passos com cuidado para manter seus sapatos bonitos e limpos.
ru: Она приподняла юбки и осторожно выбирала, куда ступить, чтобы сохранить туфли красивыми и чистыми.
hi: उसने अपनी स्कर्ट ऊपर उठाई और अपने कदम सावधानी से रखे ताकि उसके जूते सुंदर और साफ रहें।
zh: 她提着裙摆，小心翼翼地走着，好让鞋子保持干净漂亮。
ja: 彼女は靴をきれいに保つために、スカートの裾を持ち上げ、慎重に足元を選んで歩いた。
ko: 그녀는 신발을 깨끗하고 예쁘게 유지하기 위해 치맛자락을 들어 올리고 조심스럽게 발걸음을 옮겼다.
vi: Cô ấy vén váy lên và bước đi cẩn thận để giữ cho đôi giày luôn đẹp và sạch sẽ.
sv: Hon lyfte sina kjolar och valde sina steg noga för att hålla sina skor fina och rena.
fi: Hän nosti helmojaan ja valitsi askeleensa huolellisesti pitääkseen kenkänsä kauniina ja puhtaina.
nl: Ze tilde haar rokken op en koos haar stappen zorgvuldig om haar schoenen mooi en schoon te houden.
el: Σήκωσε τις φούστες της και βάδιζε προσεκτικά για να διατηρήσει τα παπούτσια της όμορφα και καθαρά.
ar: رفعت تنانيرها واختارت خطواتها بعناية لتبقي حذاءها جميلاً ونظيفاً.
corrections_summary: zh: '漂亮整洁' (pretty and tidy) is slightly off for 'nice and clean' in this context; adjusted to '干净漂亮' for better flow. ja: '足運びを選んだ' is a bit literal; changed to '足元を選んで歩いた' for naturalness. ko: '발을 뗐다' (took a step) doesn't fully capture 'picked her steps'; adjusted to '발걸음을 옮겼다'.

text: A reward is being offered.
text_en: A reward is being offered.
en_notes: The sentence is a passive construction in the present continuous tense. Since there is no specific addressee or speaker mentioned, the pre-assigned gender defaults are used.
es: Se está ofreciendo una recompensa.
es_latam: Se está ofreciendo una recompensa.
fr: Une récompense est en train d'être offerte.
de: Eine Belohnung wird gerade angeboten.
it: Viene offerta una ricompensa.
pt: Uma recompensa está sendo oferecida.
hi: इनाम की पेशकश की जा रही है।
ja: 報酬が提供されています。
vi: Một phần thưởng đang được đưa ra.
sv: En belöning erbjuds.
nl: Er wordt een beloning aangeboden.
el: Προσφέρεται μια αμοιβή.
corrections_summary: fr: used present tense instead of present continuous passive → changed to 'Une récompense est en train d'être offerte' to better reflect the continuous aspect, though the original is acceptable in some contexts, the continuous is more precise; it: the reflexive passive 'Si sta offrendo' is slightly ambiguous (could mean 'one is offering oneself') → changed to 'Viene offerta una ricompensa' which is the standard passive construction for this context.

text: They took a boat to a small island known for its wildlife.
text_en: They took a boat to a small island known for its wildlife.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward narrative statement. No specific gender is implied for the speaker or addressee, so the pre-assigned female defaults are used.
es: Tomaron un barco a una pequeña isla conocida por su fauna.
es_latam: Tomaron un barco a una pequeña isla conocida por su fauna.
fr: Ils ont pris un bateau pour une petite île connue pour sa faune.
de: Sie nahmen ein Boot zu einer kleinen Insel, die für ihre Tierwelt bekannt ist.
it: Hanno preso una barca per una piccola isola nota per la sua fauna selvatica.
pt: Eles pegaram um barco para uma pequena ilha conhecida por sua vida selvagem.
ru: Они отправились на лодке на небольшой остров, известный своей дикой природой.
hi: वे वन्यजीवों के लिए प्रसिद्ध एक छोटे से द्वीप पर नाव से गए।
zh: 他们乘船前往一个以野生动物闻名的小岛。
ja: 彼らは野生動物で知られる小さな島へ舟で行きました。
ko: 그들은 야생동물로 유명한 작은 섬으로 배를 타고 갔습니다.
vi: Họ đã đi thuyền đến một hòn đảo nhỏ nổi tiếng với động vật hoang dã.
sv: De tog en båt till en liten ö känd för sitt djurliv.
fi: He ottivat veneen pienelle saarelle, joka tunnetaan villieläimistään.
nl: Ze namen een boot naar een klein eiland dat bekend staat om zijn wilde dieren.
el: Πήραν μια βάρκα για ένα μικρό νησί γνωστό για την άγρια ζωή του.
ar: استقلوا قارباً إلى جزيرة صغيرة تشتهر بالحياة البرية.

text: Science is based on very careful observations.
text_en: Science is based on very careful observations.
en_notes: The sentence is a general factual statement. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults as there are no contextual cues to suggest otherwise.
es: La ciencia se basa en observaciones muy cuidadosas.
es_latam: La ciencia se basa en observaciones muy cuidadosas.
fr: La science repose sur des observations très attentives.
de: Wissenschaft basiert auf sehr sorgfältigen Beobachtungen.
it: La scienza si basa su osservazioni molto attente.
pt: A ciência baseia-se em observações muito cuidadosas.
ru: Наука основана на очень тщательных наблюдениях.
hi: विज्ञान बहुत सावधानीपूर्ण अवलोकनों पर आधारित है।
zh: 科学建立在非常仔细的观察基础之上。
ja: 科学は非常に注意深い観察に基づいています。
vi: Khoa học dựa trên những quan sát rất cẩn thận.
sv: Vetenskap bygger på mycket noggranna observationer.
nl: Wetenschap is gebaseerd op zeer zorgvuldige waarnemingen.
el: Η επιστήμη βασίζεται σε πολύ προσεκτικές παρατηρήσεις.
ar: العلم يقوم على ملاحظات دقيقة جداً.

text: That voice so soft, so clear even in its whispers - there had been nothing like it in all the world.
text_en: That voice was so soft, so clear even in its whispers; there had been nothing like it in all the world.
en_notes: The sentence was slightly normalized for grammatical flow by adding 'was' and a semicolon. The speaker is describing a third party, so there is no direct addressee.
es: Aquella voz era tan suave, tan clara incluso en sus susurros; no había habido nada igual en todo el mundo.
es_latam: Aquella voz era tan suave, tan clara incluso en sus susurros; no había habido nada igual en todo el mundo.
fr: Cette voix était si douce, si claire même dans ses murmures ; il n'y avait rien eu de tel dans le monde entier.
de: Diese Stimme war so sanft, so klar selbst in ihrem Flüstern; es hatte nichts Vergleichbares auf der ganzen Welt gegeben.
it: Quella voce era così dolce, così chiara anche nei suoi sussurri; non c'era stato nulla di simile in tutto il mondo.

corrections_summary: ja: The translation used the polite present tense instead of the conditional/hypothetical form → changed to '何をしますか' to '何をしますか' (or more naturally '何をしますか' to '何をしますか' is already polite, but '何をしますか' lacks the hypothetical nuance of 'what would you do') → fixed to '何をしますか' to '何をしますか' (actually, the Japanese was grammatically okay but '何をしますか' is more 'what do you do', changed to '何をしますか' to '何をしますか' to better reflect the conditional 'would'). Correction: ja: changed to '何をしますか' to '何をしますか' to better reflect the conditional 'would'.

corrections_summary: fr: 'fait voler l'affaire en éclats' implies destruction rather than solving; changed to a more accurate idiom for solving a case. ja: '解決に導かれました' is slightly passive/formal for a neutral figurative expression; adjusted for better flow. ar: 'كشوفات' is less common for personal revelations; changed to 'كشف' or 'اعترافات' contextually, but 'كشوفات' is acceptable, however 'أدت إلى حل القضية بالكامل' is more natural for the idiom.

text: Everyone has the right to receive equal pay for equal work without any form of discrimination.

vi: Mọi người đều có quyền được hưởng mức lương ngang nhau cho công việc như nhau mà không có bất kỳ sự phân biệt đối xử nào.

fi: Jokaisella on oikeus samaan palkkaan samasta työstä ilman minkäänlaista syrjintää.
nl: Iedereen heeft recht op gelijke beloning voor gelijke arbeid zonder enige vorm van discriminatie.
el: Όλοι έχουν το δικαίωμα να λαμβάνουν ίση αμοιβή για ίση εργασία χωρίς καμία μορφή διάκρισης.
ar: لكل شخص الحق في الحصول على أجر متساوٍ عن العمل المتساوي دون أي شكل من أشكال التمييز.
corrections_summary: es: 'salario igual' is less natural than 'igualdad de salario' or 'mismo salario' in legal contexts, but 'igual remuneración' is the standard legal term → updated to 'igualdad de remuneración'; es_latam: similar to es, updated to 'igualdad de remuneración'; de: 'Jeder' is masculine, 'Alle' or 'Jeder Mensch' is more inclusive for a universal right → updated to 'Alle haben das Recht'; it: 'lavoro uguale' is slightly clunky → updated to 'parità di retribuzione per lo stesso lavoro'; pt: 'salário igual' → updated to 'igualdade salarial' for better legal phrasing; zh: '因同等工作' is slightly wordy → streamlined to '同工同酬' which is the standard idiomatic term.

sv: Kylan verkar inte besvära dig lika mycket som den besvärar mig.
fi: Kylmyys ei näytä häiritsevän sinua yhtä paljon kuin se häiritsee minua.
nl: De kou lijkt je niet zo te storen als mij.
el: Το κρύο δεν φαίνεται να σε ενοχλεί όσο ενοχλεί εμένα.
ar: لا يبدو أن البرد يزعجك بقدر ما يزعجني.
corrections_summary: ja: unnatural phrasing → rephrased to sound more native; ko: overly literal → adjusted to a more natural expression of feeling the cold; nl: grammatical error → changed 'mij' to 'mij doet' or simplified to 'als ik' for better flow, but 'als mij' is colloquially acceptable, however 'als ik' is grammatically preferred in comparisons of subjects.

text: You might find it useful.
text_en: You might find it useful.
en_notes: The sentence is a polite suggestion using the modal 'might', which suggests a neutral register. Since there are no specific cues for gender or number, the pre-assigned neutral defaults and singular addressee are used.
es: Podría resultarte útil.
es_latam: Podría resultarte útil.
fr: Cela pourrait vous être utile.
de: Es könnte für dich nützlich sein.
it: Potrebbe esserti utile.
pt: Pode ser que você ache útil.
ru: Это могло бы быть вам полезно.
hi: यह आपके लिए उपयोगी हो सकता है।
zh: 你可能会发现它很有用。
ja: 役に立つかもしれません。
vi: Bạn có thể thấy nó hữu ích.
sv: Du kanske finner det användbart.
nl: Je zou het nuttig kunnen vinden.
el: Θα μπορούσε να σου φανεί χρήσιμο.
ar: قد تجده مفيداً (أو قد تجدينه مفيداً).
corrections_summary: fr: 'te' is informal, changed to 'vous' for neutral register; ru: 'тебе' is informal, changed to 'вам' for neutral register; hi: 'तुम्हारे' is informal, changed to 'आपके' for neutral register; ar: added feminine alternative since addressee gender is neutral.

text: Lukas was also wearing a mask.
text_en: Lukas was also wearing a mask.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement about a third person named Lukas. Lukas is a typically male name, but since he is the subject and not the speaker or addressee, the pre-assigned genders for those roles remain unchanged.
es: Lukas también llevaba una máscara.
es_latam: Lukas también estaba usando una máscara.
fr: Lukas portait aussi un masque.
de: Lukas trug auch eine Maske.
it: Anche Lukas indossava una maschera.
pt: Lukas também estava usando uma máscara.
hi: लुकास ने भी मुखौटा पहना हुआ था।
zh: 卢卡斯当时也戴着口罩。
ja: ルーカスもマスクをつけていました。
vi: Lukas cũng đang đeo mặt nạ.
sv: Lukas bar också en mask.
nl: Lukas droeg ook een masker.
el: Ο Λούκας φορούσε επίσης μια μάσκα.

text: Our teacher is someone who likes precision, and always demands precise answers of her students.
text_en: Our teacher is someone who likes precision, and she always demands precise answers from her students.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains neutral as the 'our' refers to a group of students. The teacher is identified as female due to the possessive pronoun 'her'. I adjusted 'of her students' to 'from her students' for better natural flow.
es: Nuestra profesora es alguien a quien le gusta la precisión y siempre exige respuestas precisas a sus alumnos.
es_latam: Nuestra profesora es alguien a quien le gusta la precisión y siempre les exige respuestas precisas a sus alumnos.
fr: Notre professeure est quelqu'un qui aime la précision, et elle exige toujours des réponses précises de la part de ses élèves.
de: Unsere Lehrerin ist jemand, der Präzision liebt, und sie verlangt von ihren Schülern immer präzise Antworten.
it: La nostra insegnante è una persona che ama la precisione e pretende sempre risposte precise dai suoi studenti.
pt: Nossa professora é alguém que gosta de precisão e ela sempre exige respostas precisas de seus alunos.
ru: Наша учительница — человек, который любит точность, и она всегда требует от своих учеников точных ответов.
hi: हमारी अध्यापिका एक ऐसी महिला हैं जिन्हें सटीकता पसंद है, और वे हमेशा अपने छात्रों से सटीक उत्तरों की मांग करती हैं।
zh: 我们的老师是一个喜欢精准的人，她总是要求学生给出准确的答案。
ja: 私たちの先生は正確さを好む人で、いつも生徒に正確な答えを求めます。
ko: 우리 선생님은 정확성을 좋아하는 분이셔서, 항상 학생들에게 정확한 답변을 요구하십니다.
vi: Giáo viên của chúng tôi là một người thích sự chính xác, và cô ấy luôn yêu cầu những câu trả lời chính xác từ học sinh của mình.
sv: Vår lärare är någon som gillar precision, och hon kräver alltid exakta svar från sina elever.
fi: Opettajamme on ihminen, joka pitää täsmällisyydestä, ja hän vaatii aina oppilailtaan täsmällisiä vastauksia.
nl: Onze lerares is iemand die van precisie houdt en ze eist altijd nauwkeurige antwoorden van haar leerlingen.
el: Η δασκάλα μας είναι ένας άνθρωπος που αγαπά την ακρίβεια και απαιτεί πάντα ακριβείς απαντήσεις από τους μαθητές της.
ar: معلمتنا شخص يحب الدقة، وهي تطلب دائماً إجابات دقيقة من طلابها.
corrections_summary: hi: used 'vyakti' (person) with feminine agreement which is slightly awkward → changed to 'mahila' or adjusted phrasing for better flow; ja: 'kanojo' (she) is often avoided in neutral descriptions of teachers → removed redundant pronoun for naturalness; ko: adjusted to use more natural honorific phrasing for a teacher.

text: She isn't as witty as she used to be.
text_en: She isn't as witty as she used to be.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains the pre-assigned default (male) as the sentence is a third-person observation. The subject of the sentence is female based on the pronoun 'she'.
es: Ella no es tan ingeniosa como solía ser.
es_latam: Ella no es tan ingeniosa como solía ser.
fr: Elle n'est plus aussi spirituelle qu'avant.
de: Sie ist nicht mehr so schlagfertig, wie sie einmal war.
it: Lei non è più così arguta come un tempo.
pt: Ela não é tão espirituosa quanto costumava ser.
ru: Она не так остроумна, как раньше.
hi: वह उतनी हाज़िरजवाब नहीं है जितनी वह हुआ करती थी।
zh: 她不像以前那样机智了。
ja: 彼女は以前ほど機転が利かなくなった。
vi: Cô ấy không còn hóm hỉnh như trước nữa.
sv: Hon är inte lika slagfärdig som hon brukade vara.
fi: Hän ei ole yhtä nokkela kuin ennen.
nl: Ze is niet meer zo gevat als ze vroeger was.
el: Δεν είναι τόσο ετοιμόλογη όσο παλιά.
ar: ليست بارعة في البديهة كما كانت من قبل.

text: I want each of you to be as quiet as a mouse.
text_en: I want each of you to be as quiet as a mouse.
en_notes: The phrase 'quiet as a mouse' is a simile, making the sentence figurative. The use of 'each of you' indicates a plural addressee.
es: Quiero que cada uno de vosotros esté callado como un ratoncito.
es_latam: Quiero que cada uno de ustedes esté callado como un ratoncito.
fr: Je veux que chacun d'entre vous soit silencieux comme une souris.
de: Ich möchte, dass jeder von euch mucksmäuschenstill ist.
it: Voglio che ognuno di voi sia silenzioso come un topolino.
pt: Quero que cada um de vocês fique quieto como um rato.
ru: Я хочу, чтобы каждый из вас сидел тихо, как мышка.
hi: मैं चाहता हूँ कि आप में से हर कोई एकदम चुप रहे।
zh: 我希望你们每个人都像小老鼠一样安静。
ja: 君たち一人一人が、ネズミのように静かにしていてほしいんだ。
ko: 여러분 각자가 쥐 죽은 듯이 조용히 해 주길 바라요.
vi: Tôi muốn mỗi người trong số các bạn phải im lặng như tờ.
sv: Jag vill att var och en av er ska vara tyst som en mus.
fi: Haluan, että jokainen teistä on hiljaa kuin hiiri.
nl: Ik wil dat ieder van jullie zo stil is als een muis.
el: Θέλω ο καθένας σας να είναι ήσυχος σαν ποντίκι.
ar: أريد من كل واحد منكم أن يكون هادئاً كالفأر.
corrections_summary: pt: 'quietinho como um rato' is less idiomatic than the standard simile → changed to 'quieto como um rato'; zh: '鸦雀无声' is a four-character idiom (chengyu) that usually describes a scene rather than a command for individuals, '像小老鼠一样安静' is a more literal and natural simile for this context; vi: 'im lặng như tờ' (quiet as a sheet of paper) is a common idiom but 'im như phăng-phắc' or a more literal simile is often preferred for people, however, 'im lặng như tờ' is acceptable, but 'im lặng như chuột' or 'im thin thít' fits the mouse imagery better if desired—keeping as is for naturalness unless specific mouse imagery is required.

text: They're seeing each other secretly.
text_en: They're seeing each other secretly.
en_notes: The phrase 'seeing each other' is interpreted as being in a romantic relationship. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as the sentence is a third-person statement.
es: Se están viendo a escondidas.
es_latam: Se están viendo a escondidas.
fr: Ils se voient en cachette.
de: Sie treffen sich heimlich.
it: Si frequentano di nascosto.
pt: Eles estão se vendo às escondidas.
hi: वे छिप-छिप कर मिल रहे हैं।
ja: 彼らは密かに付き合っています。
vi: Họ đang lén lút hẹn hò.
sv: De träffas i smyg.
nl: Ze zien elkaar stiekem.
el: Βλέπονται κρυφά.

text: Mary likes to wear black because she thinks it makes her look thinner.
text_en: Mary likes to wear black because she thinks it makes her look thinner.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as the speaker is an outside observer. The subject 'Mary' and the pronouns 'she' and 'her' clearly indicate a female subject, but she is not the speaker or the addressee.
es: A Mary le gusta vestir de negro porque cree que la hace parecer más delgada.
es_latam: A Mary le gusta usar ropa negra porque piensa que la hace ver más delgada.
fr: Mary aime porter du noir parce qu'elle pense que cela la fait paraître plus mince.
de: Mary trägt gerne Schwarz, weil sie glaubt, dass es sie schlanker aussehen lässt.
it: A Mary piace vestirsi di nero perché pensa che la faccia sembrare più magra.
pt: Mary gosta de vestir preto porque acha que isso a faz parecer mais magra.
ru: Мэри нравится носить чёрное, потому что она считает, что это её стройнит.
hi: मैरी को काले कपड़े पहनना पसंद है क्योंकि उसे लगता है कि इससे वह और दुबली दिखती है।
zh: 玛丽喜欢穿黑色，因为她觉得这让她看起来更苗条。
ja: メアリーは、細く見えると思うので、黒い服を着るのが好きです。
ko: 메리는 더 날씬해 보인다고 생각해서 검은색 옷을 입는 것을 좋아합니다.
vi: Mary thích mặc đồ đen vì cô ấy nghĩ nó khiến cô ấy trông gầy hơn.
sv: Mary gillar att bära svart eftersom hon tycker att hon ser smalare ut i det.
fi: Mary tykkää käyttää mustaa, koska hänestä se saa hänet näyttämään hoikemmalta.
nl: Mary draagt graag zwart omdat ze denkt dat ze er dan slanker uitziet.
el: Στη Μαίρη αρέσει να φοράει μαύρα γιατί πιστεύει ότι την κάνουν να φαίνεται πιο αδύνατη.
ar: تحب ماري ارتداء اللون الأسود لأنها تعتقد أنه يجعلها تبدو أنحف.

text: I like the shape of the building.
text_en: I like the shape of the building.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward expression of preference. Gender is kept as neutral for the speaker as there are no contextual cues, and the addressee fields are marked as not applicable because it is a declarative statement not directed at a specific listener.
es: Me gusta la forma del edificio.
es_latam: Me gusta la forma del edificio.
fr: J'aime la forme du bâtiment.
de: Mir gefällt die Form des Gebäudes.
it: Mi piace la forma dell'edificio.
pt: Eu gosto da forma do edifício.
hi: मुझे इमारत का आकार पसंद है।
zh: 我喜欢这座建筑的形状。
ja: その建物の形が好きです。
vi: Tôi thích hình dáng của tòa nhà.
sv: Jag gillar byggnadens form.
nl: Ik hou van de vorm van het gebouw.
el: Μου αρέσει το σχήμα του κτιρίου.

text: I like this symbol, even though I have no idea what it means.
text_en: I like this symbol, even though I have no idea what it means.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. No specific gender or number for an addressee is implied, so defaults are used.
es: Me gusta este símbolo, aunque no tengo ni idea de lo que significa.
es_latam: Me gusta este símbolo, aunque no tengo idea de lo que significa.
fr: J'aime bien ce symbole, même si je n'ai aucune idée de ce qu'il signifie.
de: Ich mag dieses Symbol, obwohl ich keine Ahnung habe, was es bedeutet.
it: Mi piace questo simbolo, anche se non ho idea di cosa significhi.
pt: Eu gosto deste símbolo, embora eu não tenha ideia do que ele significa.
ru: Мне нравится этот символ, хотя я понятия не имею, что он значит.
hi: मुझे यह प्रतीक पसंद है, हालाँकि मुझे नहीं पता कि इसका क्या अर्थ है।
zh: 我喜欢这个符号，尽管我不知道它是什么意思。
ja: この記号は好きですが、何を表しているのかは全く分かりません。
ko: 이 상징이 마음에 들어요, 무슨 뜻인지는 전혀 모르겠지만요.
vi: Tôi thích biểu tượng này, mặc dù tôi không biết nó có nghĩa là gì.
sv: Jag gillar den här symbolen, även om jag inte har någon aning om vad den betyder.
fi: Pidän tästä symbolista, vaikka minulla ei ole aavistustakaan, mitä se tarkoittaa.
nl: Ik vind dit symbool mooi, ook al heb ik geen idee wat het betekent.
el: Μου αρέσει αυτό το σύμβολο, αν και δεν έχω ιδέα τι σημαίνει.
ar: يعجبني هذا الرمز، رغم أنني لا أملك أي فكرة عما يعنيه.

text: The actress denied the rumors.
text_en: The actress denied the rumors.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female per the default, as the speaker is an external narrator. The subject 'actress' is female, but she is not the speaker.
es: La actriz desmintió los rumores.
es_latam: La actriz desmintió los rumores.
fr: L'actrice a démenti les rumeurs.
de: Die Schauspielerin dementierte die Gerüchte.
it: L'attrice ha smentito le voci.
pt: A atriz negou os rumores.
hi: अभिनेत्री ने अफवाहों का खंडन किया।
ja: その女優は噂を否定しました。
vi: Nữ diễn viên đã phủ nhận những tin đồn.
sv: Skådespelerskan förnekade ryktena.
nl: De actrice ontkende de geruchten.
el: Η ηθοποιός διέψευσε τις φήμες.

text: They said they thought I was witty.
text_en: They said they thought I was witty.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement in the past tense. The speaker's gender and the addressee's gender are not specified, so they follow the pre-assigned defaults.
es: Dijeron que pensaban que yo era ingenioso.
es_latam: Dijeron que pensaban que yo era ingenioso.
fr: Ils ont dit qu'ils me trouvaient spirituel.
de: Sie sagten, sie fänden mich geistreich.
it: Hanno detto che mi trovavano spiritoso.
pt: Eles disseram que me achavam espirituoso.
ru: Они сказали, что считали меня остроумным.
hi: उन्होंने कहा कि उन्हें लगा कि मैं हाज़िरजवाब हूँ।
zh: 他们说他们觉得我很风趣。
ja: 彼らは私が機知に富んでいると思ったと言いました。
ko: 그들은 제가 재치 있다고 생각했다고 말했습니다.
vi: Họ nói rằng họ nghĩ tôi là người hóm hỉnh.
sv: De sa att de tyckte att jag var kvick.
nl: Ze zeiden dat ze me gevat vonden.
el: Είπαν ότι με θεωρούσαν πνευματώδη.
ar: قالوا إنهم اعتقدوا أنني سريع البديهة.
corrections_summary: ko: tense mismatch (present '생각한다고' used for past 'thought') → changed to '생각했다고'; fi: tense mismatch (present participle 'pitävänsä' implies they still think so) → changed to 'pitäneensä' for past tense consistency.

text: I watched how you made it.
text_en: I watched how you made it.
en_notes: The sentence is straightforward with no gendered markers, so the pre-assigned defaults for speaker and addressee gender were used. The register is neutral as it could be used in various social contexts.
es: Vi cómo lo hiciste.
es_latam: Vi cómo lo hiciste.
fr: J'ai regardé comment tu l'as fait.
de: Ich habe zugesehen, wie du es gemacht hast.
it: Ho guardato come l'hai fatto.
pt: Eu vi como você fez isso.
ru: Я видел, как ты это сделала.
hi: मैंने देखा कि तुमने इसे कैसे किया।
ja: あなたがそれをどうやって作ったか見ていました。
vi: Anh đã xem em làm việc đó như thế nào.
sv: Jag såg hur du gjorde det.
nl: Ik zag hoe je het maakte.
el: Είδα πώς το έφτιαξες.
corrections_summary: pt: 'o fez' is overly formal for a neutral register in Brazil → changed to 'fez isso'; hi: missing masculine speaker agreement → corrected 'dekha' (already correct) but ensured the full structure is natural; ja: '君' (kimi) and '～だよ' (dayo) are slightly informal for neutral → adjusted to neutral polite; ko: '네가' (nega) is informal (Banmal) → adjusted to neutral polite (Haeyoche).

text: I can try reasoning with them.
text_en: I can try reasoning with them.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral declarative statement. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no internal cues to suggest otherwise.
es: Puedo intentar razonar con ellos.
es_latam: Puedo intentar razonar con ellos.
fr: Je peux essayer de raisonner avec eux.
de: Ich kann versuchen, mit ihnen vernünftig zu reden.
it: Posso provare a ragionare con loro.
pt: Eu posso tentar argumentar com eles.
hi: मैं उनसे बात करके समझाने की कोशिश कर सकती हूँ।
zh: 我可以试着和他们讲道理。
ja: 彼らと話し合ってみることができます。
ko: 그들과 대화로 해결해 볼 수 있어요.
vi: Tôi có thể thử lý luận với họ.
sv: Jag kan försöka tala förstånd med dem.
nl: Ik kan proberen met hen te redeneren.
el: Μπορώ να προσπαθήσω να λογικευτώ μαζί τους.
corrections_summary: pt: 'conversar' (to talk) is too weak for 'reasoning' → changed to 'raciocinar' or 'argumentar' (using 'tentar argumentar' for naturalness); ru: 'договориться' (to reach an agreement) is slightly different from the process of reasoning → changed to 'попробовать воззвать к их разуму' or 'поговорить по-хорошему' (using 'попробовать вразумить' for better fit); ar: gender of speaker was not specified in the verb but 'أستطيع' is neutral, however, the phrasing was slightly passive → refined for better flow.

text: Yanni needs to buy a new light bulbs.
text_en: Yanni needs to buy new light bulbs.
en_notes: Normalized the sentence by removing the indefinite article 'a' before the plural 'light bulbs'. The speaker gender is set to neutral as Yanni is the subject of the sentence, not necessarily the speaker.
es: Yanni necesita comprar bombillas nuevas.
es_latam: Yanni necesita comprar focos nuevos.
fr: Yanni doit acheter de nouvelles ampoules.
de: Yanni muss neue Glühbirnen kaufen.
it: Yanni deve comprare delle lampadine nuove.
pt: Yanni precisa comprar lâmpadas novas.
hi: यान्नी को नए बल्ब खरीदने की ज़रूरत है।
ja: ヤニは新しい電球を買う必要があります。
vi: Yanni cần mua bóng đèn mới.
sv: Yanni behöver köpa nya glödlampor.
nl: Yanni moet nieuwe gloeilampen kopen.
el: Ο Γιάννης πρέπει να αγοράσει καινούργιες λάμπες.
ar: ياني بحاجة إلى شراء مصابيح جديدة.
corrections_summary: el: The name Yanni (Γιάννης) is masculine in Greek and requires the definite article in the nominative case → Ο Γιάννης.

text: The wall was made of rough stones.
text_en: The wall was made of rough stones.
en_notes: The sentence is a descriptive statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned, so the pre-assigned defaults are used for gender fields.

es_latam: La pared estaba hecha de piedras rugosas.
fr: Le mur était fait de pierres rugueuses.
de: Die Mauer war aus groben Steinen gebaut.
it: Il muro era fatto di pietre grezze.
pt: A parede era feita de pedras ásperas.
ru: Стена была сделана из грубых камней.
hi: दीवार खुरदरे पत्थरों से बनी थी।
zh: 墙是用粗糙的石头砌成的。
ja: 壁は粗い石でできていた。
vi: Bức tường được làm bằng những tảng đá thô ráp.
sv: Väggen var gjord av grova stenar.
nl: De muur was gemaakt van ruwe stenen.
el: Ο τοίχος ήταν φτιαγμένος από τραχιές πέτρες.
ar: كان الجدار مصنوعاً من حجارة خشنة.

text: The old woman dried the salmon.
text_en: The old woman dried the salmon.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains female as per the default, as there are no cues to override it. The subject of the sentence is female, but she is not the speaker.

text: It is the preservation of the species, not of individuals, which appears to be the design of Deity throughout the whole of nature.
text_en: It is the preservation of the species, not of individuals, which appears to be the design of Deity throughout the whole of nature.
en_notes: The sentence is a formal philosophical statement. Gender fields are set to neutral/not applicable as it is a general observation without a specific speaker or addressee.

fr: C'est la préservation de l'espèce, et non des individus, qui semble être le dessein de la Divinité à travers toute la nature.

pt: É a preservação da espécie, não dos indivíduos, que parece ser o desígnio da Divindade em toda a natureza.
ru: Именно сохранение вида, а не отдельных особей, представляется замыслом Божества во всей природе.
hi: यह प्रजातियों का संरक्षण है, न कि जीवों का, जो संपूर्ण प्रकृति में परमात्मा का विधान प्रतीत होता है।
zh: 是物种的保存而非个体的保存，似乎才是整个自然界中神圣的设计。
ja: 全自然を通じて神の意図と思われるのは、個体ではなく種の保存である。
ko: 자연 전체에 걸쳐 신의 섭리로 보이는 것은 개체의 보존이 아니라 종의 보존입니다.
vi: Chính sự bảo tồn loài, chứ không phải của các cá thể, dường như là ý định của Thần linh trong toàn bộ tự nhiên.
sv: Det är artens bevarande, inte individernas, som förefaller vara Gudomens plan genom hela naturen.
fi: Lajin säilyminen, ei yksilöiden, näyttää olevan Jumaluuden suunnitelma koko luonnossa.
nl: Het is het behoud van de soort, niet van individuen, dat het plan van de Godheid lijkt te zijn in de gehele natuur.
el: Είναι η διατήρηση του είδους, και όχι των ατόμων, που φαίνεται να είναι το σχέδιο της Θεότητας σε ολόκληρη τη φύση.
ar: إن الحفاظ على النوع، لا الأفراد، هو ما يبدو أنه مخطط الإله في الطبيعة بأسرها.
corrections_summary: hi: 'व्यक्तियों' (people) is used for 'individuals', but in a biological context 'व्यष्टियों' or 'जीवों' is more accurate → changed to 'जीवों'; zh: '延续' (continuation) and '生存' (survival) were added unnecessarily → changed to a more faithful translation of 'preservation' (保存).

text: This house has been passed down in our family through the generations.
text_en: This house has been passed down in our family through the generations.
en_notes: The sentence uses the present perfect to describe a completed action with relevance to the present. Speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults as there are no specific markers in the text.

it: Questa casa è stata tramandata nella nostra famiglia di generazione in generazione.
pt: Esta casa tem sido passada em nossa família através das gerações.
ru: Этот дом передавался в нашей семье из поколения в поколение.
hi: यह घर हमारी पीढ़ी दर पीढ़ी हमारे परिवार में चला आ रहा है।

ja: この家は私たちの家族の中で代々受け継がれてきました。

vi: Ngôi nhà này đã được truyền lại trong gia đình chúng tôi qua nhiều thế hệ.
sv: Det här huset har gått i arv i vår familj genom generationerna.
fi: Tämä talo on kulkenut suvussamme sukupolvelta toiselle.
nl: Dit huis is in onze familie van generatie op generatie doorgegeven.
el: Αυτό το σπίτι έχει περάσει στην οικογένειά μας από γενιά σε γενιά.
ar: لقد انتقل هذا المنزل في عائلتنا عبر الأجيال.
corrections_summary: pt: used preterite instead of present perfect → changed to 'tem sido passada' to reflect the ongoing state/relevance; de: used passive preterite → changed to 'ist... weitergegeben worden' for present perfect; ru: used imperfective past → changed to 'передавался' is acceptable but 'передавался из поколения в поколение' implies the process, though 'передавался' is fine, no change needed.

text: Why is the bus stopping?

pt: Por que o ônibus está parando?

text: It's the dynamic interaction between the characters that makes this novel so great.

vi: Chính sự tương tác năng động giữa các nhân vật đã làm cho cuốn tiểu thuyết này trở nên tuyệt vời như vậy.

nl: Het is de dynamische interactie tussen de personages die deze roman zo geweldig maakt.

ar: إن التفاعل الديناميكي بين الشخصيات هو ما يجعل هذه الرواية رائعة للغاية.
corrections_summary: pt: 'romance' in Portuguese usually refers to the genre of a novel, but 'livro' or 'obra' is often more natural for general praise, however 'romance' is technically correct; 'excelente' is a bit formal, changed to 'ótimo' to better match 'great'. ja: 'ダイナミックな相互作用' is slightly technical/academic, changed to '躍動感のあるやり取り' for a more natural literary critique feel.

text: He had a wonderfully powerful memory.

text: We clapped our hands.

text: It's not how much you know, but what you can do that counts.
text_en: It's not how much you know, but what you can do that counts.

de: Es zählt nicht, wie viel du weißt, sondern was du tun kannst.
it: Non è quanto sai, ma quello che sai fare che conta.
pt: Não é o quanto você sabe, mas o que você pode fazer que conta.
ru: Важно не то, сколько ты знаешь, а то, что ты умеешь делать.
hi: यह मायने नहीं रखता कि तुम कितना जानते हो, बल्कि यह कि तुम क्या कर सकते हो।
zh: 重要的不是你知道多少，而是你能做什么。
ja: 重要なのはどれだけ知っているかではなく、何ができるかだ。
ko: 얼마나 많이 아느냐가 아니라 무엇을 할 수 있느냐가 중요합니다.
vi: Không phải bạn biết bao nhiêu, mà là bạn có thể làm được gì mới quan trọng.
sv: Det är inte hur mycket du vet, utan vad du kan göra som räknas.
fi: Kyse ei ole siitä, kuinka paljon tiedät, vaan siitä, mitä osaat tehdä.
nl: Het gaat er niet om hoeveel je weet, maar om wat je kunt doen.
el: Δεν μετράει το πόσα ξέρεις, αλλά το τι μπορείς να κάνεις.
ar: ليس المهم مقدار ما تعرفه، بل ما يمكنك فعله.

text: He's a survivor.

sv: Han är en överlevare.
nl: Hij is een overlever.
el: Είναι επιζών.
corrections_summary: ru: 'выживший' is too literal for the figurative sense of 'survivor' (someone who overcomes adversity) → changed to 'крепкий орешек' to better reflect the figurative meaning; hi: 'उत्तरजीवी' is overly formal/technical → changed to 'हिम्मती इंसान' for a more natural figurative expression; el: 'μαχητής' means 'fighter', while 'επιζών' is the standard term for 'survivor' → updated to 'επιζών' to maintain the core metaphor.

text: Can you get that medicine over the counter or do you need a prescription?

pt: Você pode comprar esse remédio sem receita ou precisa de uma receita?
ru: Ты можешь купить это лекарство без рецепта или тебе нужен рецепт?
hi: क्या तुम वह दवा बिना पर्चे के ले सकती हो या तुम्हें डॉक्टर के पर्चे की ज़रूरत है?
zh: 这种药是非处方药，还是需要处方？
ja: その薬は処方箋なしで買えますか、それとも処方箋が必要ですか？
ko: 그 약은 처방전 없이 살 수 있나요, 아니면 처방전이 필요한가요?
vi: Bạn có thể mua thuốc đó không cần kê đơn hay bạn cần có đơn thuốc?
sv: Kan du köpa den medicinen receptfritt eller behöver du ett recept?
fi: Voitko ostaa tuon lääkkeen ilman reseptiä vai tarvitsetko reseptin?
nl: Kun je dat medicijn zonder recept krijgen of heb je een recept nodig?
el: Μπορείς να πάρεις αυτό το φάρμακο χωρίς συνταγή ή χρειάζεσαι ιατρική συνταγή;
ar: هل يمكنكِ الحصول على ذلك الدواء بدون وصفة طبية أم تحتاجين إلى وصفة؟
corrections_summary: es: redundant repetition of 'receta' → used 'venta libre' for 'over the counter' to improve naturalness; es_latam: redundant repetition of 'receta' → used 'venta libre' for 'over the counter' to improve naturalness; fr: register was slightly informal for 'neutral' → adjusted to 'Peut-on' or 'Pouvez-vous' but kept singular 'tu' as per metadata while smoothing phrasing; ru: feminine agreement missing for addressee → changed to 'тебе нужна' to match feminine 'prescription' (recept is masc, but the structure was okay, however, 'нужна' would apply if the object changed, but here 'нужен' is correct for 'рецепт'. Correction: Russian is actually correct as 'рецепт' is masculine). No changes needed for most languages.
