ru: Потрясающие фотографии демонстрируют сложный и разнообразный рельеф на ледяной карликовой планете.
hi: शानदार तस्वीरें बर्फीले बौने ग्रह पर एक जटिल और विविध भूभाग को प्रकट करती हैं।
zh: 这些惊人的照片揭示了这颗冰冷矮行星上复杂多样的地形。
ja: その見事な写真は、氷に覆われた準惑星の複雑で多様な地形を明らかにしています。
ko: 이 멋진 사진들은 얼음으로 뒤덮인 왜소행성의 복잡하고 다양한 지형을 보여줍니다.
vi: Những bức ảnh tuyệt đẹp tiết lộ địa hình phức tạp và đa dạng trên hành tinh lùn băng giá.
sv: De fantastiska bilderna avslöjar en komplex och varierad terräng på den isiga dvärgplaneten.
fi: Upeat kuvat paljastavat monimutkaisen ja vaihtelevan maaston jäisellä kääpiöplaneetalla.
nl: De prachtige foto's onthullen een complex en gevarieerd terrein op de ijzige dwergplaneet.
el: Οι εντυπωσιακές φωτογραφίες αποκαλύπτουν ένα περίπλοκο και ποικίλο έδαφος στον παγωμένο νάνο πλανήτη.
ar: تكشف الصور المذهلة عن تضاريس معقدة ومتنوعة على الكوكب القزم الجليدي.

text: He acted as if he didn't know her.
text_en: He acted as if he didn't know her.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the female default as the sentence is a third-person narrative. The addressee gender is not applicable as there is no direct addressee.
es: Él actuó como si no la conociera.
es_latam: Él actuó como si no la conociera.
fr: Il a agi comme s'il ne la connaissait pas.
de: Er tat so, als ob er sie nicht kennte.
it: Si è comportato come se non la conoscesse.
pt: Ele agiu como se não a conhecesse.
ru: Он вёл себя так, будто не знал её.
hi: उसने ऐसा व्यवहार किया जैसे वह उसे नहीं जानता हो।
zh: 他表现得好像不认识她一样。
ja: 彼は彼女を知らないかのように振る舞った。
vi: Anh ấy đã hành động như thể không quen biết cô ấy.
sv: Han agerade som om han inte kände henne.
fi: Hän käyttäytyi ikään kuin ei olisi tuntenut häntä.
nl: Hij deed alsof hij haar niet kende.
el: Φέρθηκε σαν να μην την ήξερε.
corrections_summary: de: incorrect mood for hypothetical comparison → changed 'kannte' to 'kennte' (Konjunktiv II); ar: literal past tense used instead of the more natural continuous/state aspect for 'knowing' in a hypothetical context → adjusted to 'وكأنه لا يعرفها'

text: They know they'll be punished.
text_en: They know they'll be punished.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement about a third party. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults as there are no contextual cues to override them.
es: Saben que serán castigados.
es_latam: Saben que serán castigados.
fr: Ils savent qu'ils seront punis.
de: Sie wissen, dass sie bestraft werden.
it: Sanno che saranno puniti.
pt: Eles sabem que serão punidos.
hi: वे जानते हैं कि उन्हें सजा दी जाएगी।
zh: 他们知道自己会受到惩罚。
ja: 彼らは罰せられることを知っています。
ko: 그들은 자신들이 처벌받을 것을 알고 있습니다.
vi: Họ biết rằng họ sẽ bị trừng phạt.
sv: De vet att de kommer att bli straffade.
nl: Ze weten dat ze gestraft zullen worden.
el: Ξέρουν ότι θα τιμωρηθούν.

text: I admire his work ethic.
text_en: I admire his work ethic.
en_notes: The speaker gender is kept as neutral per the default. The addressee gender is set to not_applicable as this is a declarative statement about a third party ('his').
es: Admiro su ética de trabajo.
es_latam: Admiro su ética de trabajo.
fr: J'admire sa conscience professionnelle.
de: Ich bewundere seine Arbeitsmoral.
it: Ammiro la sua etica del lavoro.
pt: Eu admiro a ética de trabalho dele.
hi: मैं उनकी कार्य नैतिकता की प्रशंसा करता/करती हूँ।
ja: 私は彼の仕事ぶりを尊敬しています。
vi: Tôi ngưỡng mộ đạo đức làm việc của anh ấy.
sv: Jag beundrar hans arbetsmoral.
nl: Ik bewonder zijn arbeidsethos.
el: Θαυμάζω την εργασιακή του ηθική.
corrections_summary: fr: 'éthique de travail' is a calque from English → changed to 'conscience professionnelle' which is the natural idiomatic term in France; ja: '労働倫理' is technical/sociological → changed to '仕事ぶり' (work style/ethic) or '職業倫理' for a more natural expression of personal admiration; ar: 'أعجب' usually means 'I like' or 'I am impressed by' → changed to 'أقدر' (I appreciate/value) or 'أعجب بـ' with correct preposition for 'admire'.

text: It's feeding time.
text_en: It's feeding time.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral declarative statement. No specific gender or addressee cues are present, so the pre-assigned defaults were used.
es: Es la hora de comer.
es_latam: Es la hora de comer.
fr: C'est l'heure de manger.
de: Es ist Essenszeit.
it: È l'ora del pasto.
pt: É hora de comer.
hi: खाने का समय हो गया है।
ja: 食事の時間です。
vi: Đến giờ ăn rồi.
sv: Det är dags för mat.
nl: Het is tijd om te eten.
el: Είναι η ώρα του φαγητού.
corrections_summary: de: 'Fütterungszeit' is specifically for animals; changed to 'Essenszeit' for a neutral context. ru: 'Пора кормить' implies feeding someone else (like a baby or pet); changed to 'Пора есть' for a general 'feeding time'. zh: '喂食' is specifically for animals; changed to '用餐' for a neutral/human context.

text: She wished she hadn't looked.
text_en: She wished she hadn't looked.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female because the subject 'she' is describing her own internal state. There is no addressee in this narrative statement.
es: Deseó no haber mirado.
es_latam: Deseó no haber mirado.
fr: Elle regrettait d'avoir regardé.
de: Sie wünschte, sie hätte nicht hingesehen.
it: Avrebbe voluto non aver guardato.
pt: Ela desejou não ter olhado.
hi: उसने चाहा कि उसने न देखा होता।
ja: 彼女は見なければよかったと思った。
vi: Cô ấy ước gì mình đã không nhìn.
sv: Hon önskade att hon inte hade tittat.
nl: Ze wenste dat ze niet had gekeken.
el: Ευχήθηκε να μην είχε κοιτάξει.
corrections_summary: fr: The translation used a conditional past which implies a current regret about a past action, but the English 'wished' is simple past; changed to 'Elle a regretté d'avoir regardé' or 'Elle souhaitait' to better match the narrative past. it: 'Desiderò' is grammatically correct but 'Avrebbe voluto non aver guardato' or 'Si pentì di aver guardato' is more natural for this sentiment; adjusted to 'Avrebbe voluto non aver guardato' to maintain the 'wish' nuance. ru: 'Пожалела' (regretted) is the most natural way to translate this specific English idiom, so it is kept as is.

text: Could you wipe down the kitchen counters, please?
text_en: Could you wipe down the kitchen counters, please?
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request, which is categorized as interrogative in form but functions as a directive. The addressee is singular by default for a direct request unless context suggests a group.
es: ¿Podrías limpiar las encimeras de la cocina, por favor?
es_latam: ¿Podrías limpiar las encimeras de la cocina, por favor?
fr: Pourrais-tu essuyer les plans de travail de la cuisine, s'il te plaît ?
de: Könntest du bitte die Küchenarbeitsplatten abwischen?
it: Potresti pulire i piani della cucina, per favore?
pt: Você poderia limpar as bancadas da cozinha, por favor?
ru: Не мог бы ты протереть кухонные столешницы, пожалуйста?
hi: क्या आप रसोई के काउंटर साफ कर सकते हैं, कृपया?
zh: 请问你能擦一下厨房台面吗？
ja: 台所のカウンターを拭いてくれますか？
ko: 주방 조리대 좀 닦아줄 수 있어요?
vi: Anh có thể lau sạch mặt bàn bếp được không?
sv: Skulle du kunna torka av köksbänkarna, tack?
nl: Zou je de aanrechten in de keuken willen afnemen, alsjeblieft?
el: Θα μπορούσες να σκουπίσεις τους πάγκους της κουζίνας, παρακαλώ;
ar: هل يمكنك مسح أسطح المطبخ، من فضلك؟
corrections_summary: es_latam: 'mostradores' is more common for commercial counters; 'mesones' or 'encimeras' is better for kitchens. ru: added masculine agreement for 'could' to match addressee_gender. hi: adjusted to neutral register (tum -> aap) to better reflect the polite 'Could you' request. nl: 'afvegen' is more like sweeping away; 'afnemen' is the standard term for wiping down surfaces.

text: What's this vaccine for?
text_en: What is this vaccine for?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry about the purpose of a medical treatment. The register is neutral, and the addressee is singular as it typically addresses a single healthcare provider.
es: ¿Para qué sirve esta vacuna?
es_latam: ¿Para qué es esta vacuna?
fr: À quoi sert ce vaccin ?
de: Wofür ist dieser Impfstoff?
it: A cosa serve questo vaccino?
pt: Para que serve esta vacina?
hi: यह टीका किस लिए है?
zh: 这种疫苗是用来预防什么的？
ja: このワクチンは何のためのものですか？
vi: Vắc-xin này dùng để làm gì?
sv: Vad är det här vaccinet till för?
nl: Waar is dit vaccin voor?
el: Για τι είναι αυτό το εμβόλιο;

text: The kettle is whistling on the stove.
text_en: The kettle is whistling on the stove.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward observation in the present continuous tense. No addressee is present, and the speaker gender defaults to the pre-assigned value as there are no gendered cues.
es: La tetera está silbando en el fuego.
es_latam: La tetera está silbando en la estufa.
fr: La bouilloire siffle sur la cuisinière.
de: Der Wasserkessel pfeift auf dem Herd.
it: Il bollitore sta fischiando sul fornello.
pt: A chaleira está apitando no fogão.
hi: केतली चूल्हे पर सीटी बजा रही है।
ja: やかんがコンロの上で鳴っています。
vi: Ấm nước đang reo trên bếp.
sv: Vattenkitteln visslar på spisen.
nl: De waterkoker fluit op het fornuis.
el: Η τσαγιέρα σφυρίζει στο μάτι της κουζίνας.
corrections_summary: zh: '鸣响' is too formal/mechanical for a kettle → changed to '鸣叫' or '开了' (using '在响' for naturalness); ko: '소리를 내며 끓고 있어요' is overly descriptive → simplified to '주전자가 가스레인지 위에서 울리고 있어요' to match 'whistling'.

text: Donald wore a small key on a chain around his neck.
text_en: Donald wore a small key on a chain around his neck.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as the speaker is a narrator. The subject 'Donald' and the possessive pronoun 'his' confirm the subject of the sentence is male.
es: Donald llevaba una pequeña llave en una cadena alrededor del cuello.
es_latam: Donald llevaba una pequeña llave en una cadena alrededor del cuello.
fr: Donald portait une petite clé à une chaîne autour du cou.
de: Donald trug einen kleinen Schlüssel an einer Kette um seinen Hals.
it: Donald portava una piccola chiave appesa a una catenina intorno al collo.
pt: Donald usava uma pequena chave em uma corrente em volta do pescoço.
ru: Дональд носил на шее маленький ключ на цепочке.
hi: डोनाल्ड ने अपने गले में एक चेन पर एक छोटी सी चाबी पहनी हुई थी।
zh: 唐纳德的脖子上戴着一根挂着小钥匙的链子。
ja: ドナルドは首にかけたチェーンに小さな鍵をつけていた。
ko: 도널드는 목에 건 체인에 작은 열쇠를 매달고 있었다.
vi: Donald đeo một chiếc chìa khóa nhỏ trên một sợi dây chuyền quanh cổ.
sv: Donald bar en liten nyckel i en kedja runt halsen.
fi: Donaldilla oli pieni avain ketjussa kaulansa ympärillä.
nl: Donald droeg een kleine sleutel aan een ketting om zijn nek.
el: Ο Ντόναλντ φορούσε ένα μικρό κλειδί σε μια αλυσίδα γύρω από το λαιμό του.
ar: كان دونالد يرتدي مفتاحاً صغيراً في سلسلة حول عنقه.
corrections_summary: fr: 'sur une chaîne' is less natural than 'à une chaîne' for jewelry/accessories; it: 'su una catenina' is less natural than 'appesa a una catenina'; zh: rephrased for better flow to match the English structure more closely.

text: Sami still doesn't know what to call his puppy.
text_en: Sami still doesn't know what to call his puppy.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the default. The subject 'Sami' is male as indicated by the possessive pronoun 'his'.
es: Sami todavía no sabe cómo llamar a su cachorro.
es_latam: Sami todavía no sabe cómo llamar a su perrito.
fr: Sami ne sait toujours pas comment appeler son chiot.
de: Sami weiß immer noch nicht, wie er seinen Welpen nennen soll.
it: Sami non sa ancora come chiamare il suo cucciolo.
pt: Sami ainda não sabe como chamar seu filhote.
ru: Сами всё ещё не знает, как назвать своего щенка.
hi: सामी को अभी भी नहीं पता कि वह अपने पिल्ले का क्या नाम रखे।
zh: 萨米还不知道该给他的小狗起什么名字。
ja: サミは自分の子犬を何と呼べばいいか、まだ決めていません。
ko: 사미는 아직 자신의 강아지 이름을 무엇으로 지을지 모릅니다.
vi: Sami vẫn chưa biết nên gọi chú chó con của mình là gì.
sv: Sami vet fortfarande inte vad han ska döpa sin valp till.
fi: Sami ei vieläkään tiedä, miksi kutsuisi pentuaan.
nl: Sami weet nog steeds niet hoe hij zijn puppy moet noemen.
el: Ο Σάμι δεν ξέρει ακόμα πώς να ονομάσει το κουτάβι του.
ar: سامي لا يعرف حتى الآن ماذا يسمي جروه.

text: You can indulge yourself without spending a fortune.
text_en: You can indulge yourself without spending a fortune.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of advice. The register is neutral, and the addressee is interpreted as singular. The phrase 'spending a fortune' is classified as figurative due to the idiomatic use of 'fortune' to mean a large sum of money.
es: Puedes darte un capricho sin gastar una fortuna.
es_latam: Puedes darte un gusto sin gastar una fortuna.
fr: Tu peux te faire plaisir sans dépenser une fortune.
de: Du kannst dir etwas gönnen, ohne ein Vermögen auszugeben.
it: Puoi concederti un vizio senza spendere una fortuna.
pt: Você pode se dar um luxo sem gastar uma fortuna.
ru: Ты можешь побаловать себя, не тратя целое состояние.
hi: तुम बिना बड़ी रकम खर्च किए खुद को खुश कर सकती हो।
zh: 你可以犒劳一下自己，而不需要挥金如土。
ja: 大金を使わなくても、自分にご褒美をあげられますよ。
ko: 큰돈을 들이지 않고도 자신에게 선물을 줄 수 있어요.
vi: Bạn có thể nuông chiều bản thân mà không cần tốn một gia tài.
sv: Du kan unna dig något utan att spendera en förmögenhet.
nl: Je kunt jezelf verwennen zonder een fortuin uit te geven.
el: Μπορείς να κακομάθεις τον εαυτό σου χωρίς να ξοδέψεις μια περιουσία.
ar: يمكنكِ تدليل نفسكِ دون إنفاق ثروة.
corrections_summary: el: used masculine article/pronoun for 'yourself' → changed to feminine 'την εαυτό σου' to 'τον εαυτό σου' is grammatically masculine but since the metadata specifies a female addressee, the phrasing 'τον εαυτό σου' is standard, however 'την' was a grammatical error; corrected to 'τον εαυτό σου' as 'εαυτός' is a masculine noun regardless of the person's gender, but ensured the surrounding context fits.

text: His parents acted to calm him down.
text_en: His parents acted to calm him down.
en_notes: The sentence uses the masculine pronouns 'his' and 'him', but these refer to the subject's son/child, not the speaker. The speaker gender remains neutral as there are no cues to override the default.
es: Sus padres actuaron para calmarlo.
es_latam: Sus padres actuaron para calmarlo.
fr: Ses parents ont agi pour le calmer.
de: Seine Eltern handelten, um ihn zu beruhigen.
it: I suoi genitori hanno agito per calmarlo.
pt: Os pais dele agiram para acalmá-lo.
ru: Его родители действовали, чтобы его успокоить.
hi: उसके माता-पिता ने उसे शांत करने के लिए कदम उठाया।
zh: 他的父母采取行动让他平静下来。
ja: 彼の両親は彼を落ち着かせるために行動した。
ko: 그의 부모님은 그를 진정시키기 위해 행동했다.
vi: Cha mẹ anh ấy đã hành động để trấn an anh ấy.
sv: Hans föräldrar agerade för att lugna honom.
nl: Zijn ouders ondernamen actie om hem te kalmeren.
el: Οι γονείς του έδρασαν για να τον ηρεμήσουν.

text: Do you know who invented the telegraph?
text_en: Do you know who invented the telegraph?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard interrogative. The addressee gender is set to female based on the provided default as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: ¿Sabes quién inventó el telégrafo?
es_latam: ¿Sabes quién inventó el telégrafo?
fr: Sais-tu qui a inventé le télégraphe ?
de: Weißt du, wer den Telegrafen erfunden hat?
it: Sai chi ha inventato il telegrafo?
pt: Você sabe quem inventou o telégrafo?
hi: क्या तुम जानती हो कि टेलीग्राफ का आविष्कार किसने किया था?
zh: 你知道是谁发明了电报吗？
ja: 誰が電信機を発明したか知っていますか？
vi: Bạn có biết ai đã phát minh ra máy điện báo không?
sv: Vet du vem som uppfann telegrafen?
nl: Weet je wie de telegraaf heeft uitgevonden?
el: Ξέρεις ποιος εφηύρε τον τηλέγραφο;

text: We're talking about laptops.
text_en: We're talking about laptops.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement in the present continuous tense. Speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues to override them.
es: Estamos hablando de portátiles.
es_latam: Estamos hablando de laptops.
fr: Nous parlons d'ordinateurs portables.
de: Wir sprechen über Laptops.
it: Stiamo parlando di computer portatili.
pt: Estamos falando de laptops.
hi: हम लैपटॉप के बारे में बात कर रही हैं।
zh: 我们正在谈论笔记本电脑。
ja: 私たちはノートパソコンについて話しています。
vi: Chúng tôi đang nói về máy tính xách tay.
sv: Vi pratar om bärbara datorer.
nl: We hebben het over laptops.
el: Μιλάμε για φορητούς υπολογιστές.
ar: نحن نتحدث عن أجهزة الكمبيوتر المحمولة.

text: Why didn't the alarm clock ring, even though I set it? Now I'm definitely going to be late.
text_en: Why didn't the alarm clock ring, even though I set it? Now I'm definitely going to be late.
en_notes: The sentence is a rhetorical question followed by a declarative statement. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: ¿Por qué no ha sonado el despertador, aunque lo puse? Ahora seguro que voy a llegar tarde.
es_latam: ¿Por qué no sonó el despertador, aunque lo puse? Ahora seguro que voy a llegar tarde.
fr: Pourquoi le réveil n'a-t-il pas sonné, alors que je l'avais réglé ? Maintenant, je vais certainement être en retard.
de: Warum hat der Wecker nicht geklingelt, obwohl ich ihn gestellt habe? Jetzt werde ich auf jeden Fall zu spät kommen.
it: Perché la sveglia non ha suonato, anche se l'avevo impostata? Ora arriverò sicuramente in ritardo.
pt: Por que o despertador não tocou, embora eu o tenha ajustado? Agora, com certeza vou me atrasar.
ru: Почему будильник не прозвенел, хотя я его завела? Теперь я точно опоздаю.
hi: अलार्म घड़ी क्यों नहीं बजी, जबकि मैंने इसे सेट किया था? अब मैं निश्चित रूप से देर से पहुँचूँगी।
zh: 闹钟为什么没响？我明明定好了。现在我肯定要迟到了。
ja: セットしたのに、どうして目覚まし時計が鳴らなかったの？これじゃ絶対に遅刻しちゃう。
ko: 알람을 맞춰놨는데 왜 안 울렸지? 이제 분명히 늦겠어.
vi: Tại sao đồng hồ báo thức không kêu, mặc dù tôi đã đặt nó? Bây giờ chắc chắn tôi sẽ bị trễ.
sv: Varför ringde inte väckarklockan, trots att jag ställde den? Nu kommer jag definitivt att bli sen.
fi: Miksi herätyskello ei soinut, vaikka asetin sen? Nyt myöhästyn aivan varmasti.

sv: Jag har experimenterat med det där.

el: Έχω πειραματιστεί με αυτό.
corrections_summary: ru: missing gender-specific ending for neutral speaker → used masculine as default but provided both options; hi: gender-neutral speaker requires masculine default in Hindi grammar → corrected to masculine; ja: 'experimenting' in a general sense is better expressed with 'shite-iru' → refined for naturalness; ar: added diacritics for clarity and ensured the continuous aspect is captured.

text: I came across my pal.
text_en: I came across my pal.
en_notes: The phrasal verb 'came across' is interpreted as 'met by chance'. 'Pal' is an informal term for a friend, which sets the register to informal.

es_latam: Me encontré con mi cuate.
fr: Je suis tombé sur mon pote.
de: Ich bin meinem Kumpel über den Weg gelaufen.
it: Mi sono imbattuto nel mio socio.
pt: Eu trombei com o meu parça.
hi: मैं अपने यार से टकरा गया।
zh: 我碰巧遇到了我的哥们儿。
ja: 相棒にばったり会ったよ。
vi: Tôi tình cờ gặp lại thằng bạn.
sv: Jag sprang på min polare.
nl: Ik kwam mijn maatje tegen.
el: Έπεσα πάνω στον κολλητό μου.
corrections_summary: it: 'amico' is neutral/standard → changed to 'amico' to 'socio' or 'compagno' for informal 'pal' (using 'socio' as a common informal equivalent); ru: 'приятеля' is slightly formal/neutral → changed to 'кореша' to better reflect the informal 'pal' and male speaker; hi: 'मिल गया' is slightly passive → changed to 'टकरा गया' to better capture 'came across' (met by chance); ar: 'صديقي' is standard → changed to 'رفيقي' to better suit the informal 'pal' context.

text: Yanni found cigarette butts on the porch.
text_en: Yanni found cigarette butts on the porch.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male per the default. Yanni is a name typically associated with males in Greek and other cultures, so the subject is treated as male, though the speaker is a third-party narrator.

es_latam: Yanni encontró colillas de cigarrillo en el porche.

vi: Yanni đã tìm thấy những mẩu thuốc lá trên hiên nhà.

text: Although I learned to parallel park, it was never really necessary in my small town.
text_en: Although I learned to parallel park, it was never really necessary in my small town.
en_notes: The sentence is a personal reflection on a past experience. The speaker and addressee genders are set to neutral as there are no specific markers or names indicating otherwise.
es: Aunque aprendí a aparcar en línea, nunca fue realmente necesario en mi pueblo pequeño.
es_latam: Aunque aprendí a estacionar en paralelo, nunca fue realmente necesario en mi pueblo pequeño.
fr: Bien que j'aie appris à faire un créneau, ce n'a jamais vraiment été nécessaire dans ma petite ville.
de: Obwohl ich das Längsparken gelernt habe, war es in meiner kleinen Stadt nie wirklich nötig.
it: Sebbene avessi imparato a parcheggiare in parallelo, non è mai stato veramente necessario nella mia piccola città.
pt: Embora eu tenha aprendido a estacionar em paralelo, nunca foi realmente necessário na minha cidade pequena.
ru: Хотя я и научился параллельной парковке, в моем маленьком городке это никогда не было по-настоящему нужно.
hi: हालाँकि मैंने समानांतर पार्किंग सीखी थी, लेकिन मेरे छोटे से शहर में इसकी कभी ज़रूरत नहीं पड़ी।
zh: 虽然我学会了侧方位停车，但在我的小镇上这从来都不是必需的。
ja: 縦列駐車を習いましたが、私の小さな町では全く必要ありませんでした。
ko: 평행 주차를 배웠지만, 제가 사는 작은 마을에서는 전혀 필요하지 않았습니다.
vi: Mặc dù tôi đã học cách đỗ xe song song, nhưng điều đó chưa bao giờ thực sự cần thiết ở thị trấn nhỏ của tôi.
sv: Även om jag lärde mig att fickparkera var det aldrig riktigt nödvändigt i min lilla stad.
fi: Vaikka opinkin taskupysäköinnin, se ei ollut koskaan todella tarpeellista pienessä kotikaupungissani.
nl: Hoewel ik leerde fileparkeren, was het nooit echt nodig in mijn kleine stadje.
el: Αν και έμαθα να παρκάρω παράλληλα, δεν ήταν ποτέ πραγματικά απαραίτητο στη μικρή μου πόλη.
ar: على الرغم من أنني تعلمت الركن المتوازي، إلا أنه لم يكن ضرورياً حقاً في بلدتي الصغيرة.
corrections_summary: fr: 'ce n'était jamais' implies a habitual state in the past, 'ce n'a jamais été' is more accurate for a completed reflection; ru: removed gendered slashes to provide a neutral/natural phrasing for a general statement.

text: We seek beauty not in perfection, but in truth.
text_en: We seek beauty not in perfection, but in truth.
en_notes: The sentence is a philosophical statement using the first-person plural 'we'. The speaker gender defaults to male as per instructions, and there is no specific addressee.
es: Buscamos la belleza no en la perfección, sino en la verdad.
es_latam: Buscamos la belleza no en la perfección, sino en la verdad.
fr: Nous ne cherchons pas la beauté dans la perfection, mais dans la vérité.
de: Wir suchen die Schönheit nicht in der Vollkommenheit, sondern in der Wahrheit.
it: Cerchiamo la bellezza non nella perfezione, ma nella verità.
pt: Buscamos a beleza não na perfeição, mas na verdade.
ru: Мы ищем красоту не в совершенстве, а в истине.
hi: हम सुंदरता पूर्णता में नहीं, बल्कि सत्य में खोजते हैं।
zh: 我们寻找美，不在于完美，而在于真实。
ja: 私たちは完璧さの中にではなく、真実の中に美を求めます。
ko: 우리는 완벽함이 아니라 진실함 속에서 아름다움을 찾습니다.
vi: Chúng tôi tìm kiếm vẻ đẹp không phải ở sự hoàn hảo, mà ở sự thật.
sv: Vi söker skönheten inte i det perfekta, utan i sanningen.
fi: Emme etsi kauneutta täydellisyydestä, vaan totuudesta.
nl: Wij zoeken schoonheid niet in perfectie, maar in waarheid.
el: Αναζητούμε την ομορφιά όχι στην τελειότητα, αλλά στην αλήθεια.
ar: نحن لا نبحث عن الجمال في الكمال، بل في الحقيقة.

text: Did you have a marvelous time?
text_en: Did you have a marvelous time?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard question. The speaker gender is set to the female default, and the addressee is treated as singular and neutral as per instructions.
es: ¿Lo pasaste de maravilla?
es_latam: ¿La pasaste de maravilla?
fr: As-tu passé un moment merveilleux ?
de: Hattest du eine wunderbare Zeit?
it: Hai passato un momento meraviglioso?
pt: Você passou um tempo maravilhoso?
hi: क्या तुम्हारा समय शानदार रहा?
ja: 素晴らしい時間を過ごせましたか？
vi: Bạn đã có một thời gian tuyệt vời chứ?
sv: Hade du det trevligt?
nl: Heb je een geweldige tijd gehad?
el: Πέρασες υπέροχα;
corrections_summary: pt: pluralized 'momentos' unnecessarily → changed to singular 'um tempo maravilhoso' for better accuracy; ru: used masculine agreement for neutral addressee → changed to gender-neutral phrasing; sv: 'en underbar tid' is slightly less natural for a specific event → changed to 'trevligt'; nl: 'had je' is grammatically correct but 'heb je ... gehad' is more natural for this context.

text: Could you teach me how to parallel park?
text_en: Could you teach me how to parallel park?
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request, which typically falls under a neutral register. No specific gender cues are present, so the pre-assigned neutral defaults are maintained.
es: ¿Podrías enseñarme a aparcar en línea?
es_latam: ¿Podrías enseñarme a estacionar en paralelo?
fr: Pourrais-tu m'apprendre à faire un créneau ?
de: Könntest du mir beibringen, wie man seitwärts einparkt?
it: Potresti insegnarmi a parcheggiare a S?
pt: Você poderia me ensinar a estacionar em paralelo?
hi: क्या आप मुझे पैरेलल पार्किंग करना सिखा सकते हैं?
zh: 你能教我如何侧方停车吗？
ja: 縦列駐車のやり方を教えてくれますか？
ko: 평행 주차하는 법을 가르쳐 줄 수 있어요?
vi: Bạn có thể dạy tôi cách đỗ xe song song không?
sv: Skulle du kunna lära mig hur man fickparkerar?
nl: Zou je me kunnen leren hoe ik moet fileparkeren?
el: Θα μπορούσες να μου μάθεις πώς να παρκάρω παράλληλα;
ar: هل يمكنك تعليمي كيفية ركن السيارة بشكل موازٍ؟
corrections_summary: it: 'parcheggiare a S' is common but 'parcheggio in parallelo' or 'parcheggio in linea' is more precise for the technical term, though 'a S' is acceptable; ru: 'Можешь ли ты' is slightly formal/stiff for a neutral request, changed to 'Можешь' for better flow; hi: added a more natural phrasing for 'parallel park'.

text: The factory produces robots for people.
text_en: The factory produces robots for people.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of fact. No disambiguation needed.

es_latam: La fábrica produce robots para personas.

it: La fabbrica produce robot per le persone.
pt: A fábrica produz robôs para pessoas.

ja: その工場は人々のためにロボットを製造しています。

text: The condition looks favourable.
text_en: The condition looks favorable.

es_latam: La condición parece favorable.

pt: A condição parece favorável.

el: Η κατάσταση φαίνεται ευνοϊκή.

text: The rock projected over us like a roof.
text_en: The rock projected over us like a roof.
en_notes: The sentence is a literal description of a physical formation, though it uses a simile ('like a roof'). The speaker gender is set to the female default as there are no gendered cues.
es: La roca sobresalía por encima de nosotros como un techo.
es_latam: La roca sobresalía por encima de nosotros como un techo.
fr: Le rocher surplombait nos têtes comme un toit.
de: Der Fels ragte wie ein Dach über uns.

pt: A rocha se projetava sobre nós como um telhado.
ru: Скала нависала над нами, словно крыша.
hi: चट्टान हमारे ऊपर एक छत की तरह बाहर निकली हुई थी।
zh: 岩石像屋顶一样伸出在我们的上方。
ja: 岩が屋根のように私たちの頭上に張り出していました。
ko: 바위가 지붕처럼 우리 위로 돌출되어 있었습니다.
vi: Tảng đá nhô ra phía trên chúng tôi như một mái nhà.

el: Ο βράχος προεξείχε από πάνω μας σαν στέγη.

es_latam: La cantidad de dinero que recaudamos fue insignificante.

es_latam: Mejorarás si sigues practicando.

ko: 계속 연습하면 더 잘하게 될 거예요.

fi: Tulet siinä paremmaksi, jos jatkat harjoittelua.

es_latam: El plato se me resbaló de las manos y se cayó al piso.

es_latam: El clima está interfiriendo con nuestros planes.

text: She's praying.
text_en: She's praying.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains neutral as the speaker is an observer. The subject 'She' identifies the person performing the action, but does not dictate the gender of the addressee.
es: Ella está rezando.
es_latam: Ella está orando.
fr: Elle est en train de prier.
de: Sie betet gerade.
it: Lei sta pregando.
pt: Ela está rezando.
hi: वह प्रार्थना कर रही है।
ja: 彼女は祈っています。
vi: Cô ấy đang cầu nguyện.
sv: Hon ber.
nl: Ze is aan het bidden.
el: Προσεύχεται.

text: For someone you see more often, it is customary to ask, "How are you?" or "How is your family"
text_en: For someone you see more often, it is customary to ask, "How are you?" or "How is your family?"
en_notes: Added a closing question mark to the internal quote for grammatical correctness. The sentence describes a general social custom, so the register is neutral and the addressee is singular.
es: Para alguien a quien ves más a menudo, es habitual preguntar: «¿Cómo estás?» o «¿Cómo está tu familia?»
es_latam: Para alguien a quien ves más seguido, es habitual preguntar: «¿Cómo estás?» o «¿Cómo está tu familia?»
fr: Pour quelqu'un que l'on voit plus souvent, il est d'usage de demander : « Comment vas-tu ? » ou « Comment va ta famille ? ».
de: Bei jemandem, den man öfter sieht, ist es üblich zu fragen: „Wie geht es dir?“ oder „Wie geht es deiner Familie?“
it: Per qualcuno che vedi più spesso, è consuetudine chiedere: «Come stai?» o «Come sta la tua famiglia?»
pt: Para alguém que você vê com mais frequência, é costume perguntar: "Como você está?" ou "Como está sua família?".
ru: Если вы видитесь с кем-то часто, принято спрашивать: «Как дела?» или «Как твоя семья?»
hi: किसी ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए जिससे आप अक्सर मिलते हैं, यह पूछना आम है, "आप कैसे हैं?" या "आपका परिवार कैसा है?"
zh: 对于经常见面的人，通常会问：“你好吗？”或者“你的家人好吗？”
ja: よく会う人に対しては、「元気ですか？」や「家族はどうですか？」と尋ねるのが習慣です。
ko: 더 자주 보는 사람에게는 "잘 지내요?" 또는 "가족들은 어때요?"라고 묻는 것이 관례입니다.
vi: Đối với người mà bạn gặp thường xuyên hơn, theo thói quen thường hỏi: "Bạn khỏe không?" hoặc "Gia đình bạn thế nào?"
sv: För någon man träffar oftare är det vanligt att fråga: "Hur mår du?" eller "Hur är det med din familj?"
fi: Henkilöltä, jota tapaat useammin, on tapana kysyä: ”Mitä kuuluu?” tai ”Mitä perheellesi kuuluu?”
nl: Bij iemand die je vaker ziet, is het gebruikelijk om te vragen: "Hoe gaat het met je?" of "Hoe is het met je familie?"
el: Για κάποιον που βλέπετε πιο συχνά, συνηθίζεται να ρωτάτε: «Πώς είσαι;» ή «Πώς είναι η οικογένειά σου;»
ar: بالنسبة لشخص تراه بشكل متكرر، فمن المعتاد أن تسأل: "كيف حالك؟" أو "كيف حال عائلتك؟"
corrections_summary: es: removed redundant period after closing quote, es_latam: removed redundant period after closing quote, it: removed redundant period after closing quote, hi: corrected phrasing to sound more natural for social customs, ja: adjusted to neutral register as requested (original was too casual), ko: adjusted to neutral register (original was formal/honorific)

text: The trains are running behind time.
text_en: The trains are running behind schedule.
en_notes: Normalized 'behind time' to the more common idiomatic expression 'behind schedule'. The sentence is a general statement with no specific addressee.
es: Los trenes circulan con retraso.
es_latam: Los trenes están circulando con retraso.
fr: Les trains circulent avec du retard.
de: Die Züge verkehren mit Verspätung.
it: I treni viaggiano in ritardo.
pt: Os trens estão circulando com atraso.
hi: ट्रेनें देरी से चल रही हैं।
ja: 電車が遅れています。
vi: Các chuyến tàu đang chạy trễ lịch trình.
sv: Tågen är försenade.
nl: De treinen rijden met vertraging.
el: Τα τρένα εκτελούν δρομολόγια με καθυστέρηση.
corrections_summary: zh: '正晚点' is a contradictory phrasing in Chinese (meaning both on time and late) → corrected to '正晚点运行' which is technically used in railway jargon but '正延迟运行' or simply '晚点' is more natural for a general statement. Fixed to '列车运行晚点' for better flow.

text: The nights are getting longer because autumn is coming.
text_en: The nights are getting longer because autumn is coming.
en_notes: The sentence is a general observation with no specific addressee. The present continuous is used to describe a current trend.
es: Las noches se están haciendo más largas porque está llegando el otoño.
es_latam: Las noches se están haciendo más largas porque está llegando el otoño.
fr: Les nuits rallongent car l'automne arrive.
de: Die Nächte werden länger, weil der Herbst kommt.
it: Le notti si stanno allungando perché sta arrivando l'autunno.
pt: As noites estão ficando mais longas porque o outono está chegando.
ru: Ночи становятся длиннее, потому что наступает осень.
hi: रातें लंबी होती जा रही हैं क्योंकि शरद ऋतु आ रही है।
zh: 夜晚正变得越来越长，因为秋天快到了。
ja: 秋が近づいているので、夜が長くなってきています。
ko: 가을이 오고 있어서 밤이 점점 길어지고 있어요.
vi: Đêm đang dài dần ra vì mùa thu đang đến.
sv: Nätterna blir längre eftersom hösten är på väg.
fi: Yöt pitenevät, koska syksy on tulossa.
nl: De nachten worden langer omdat de herfst eraan komt.
el: Οι νύχτες μεγαλώνουν επειδή έρχεται το φθινόπωρο.
ar: الليالي تزداد طولاً لأن الخريف قادم.

text: Sami promised his mom he would not sneak out again.
text_en: Sami promised his mom he would not sneak out again.
en_notes: The speaker gender was changed to male because 'Sami' is typically a male name and the pronoun 'his' refers back to him as the subject. There is no addressee as this is a third-person narrative statement.
es: Sami le prometió a su madre que no volvería a escaparse de casa.
es_latam: Sami le prometió a su mamá que no volvería a escaparse.
fr: Sami a promis à sa mère qu'il ne ferait plus le mur.
de: Sami versprach seiner Mutter, dass er sich nicht wieder herausschleichen würde.
it: Sami ha promesso a sua madre che non sarebbe più uscito di nascosto.
pt: Sami prometeu à sua mãe que não sairia escondido de novo.
ru: Сами пообещал маме, что больше не будет сбегать из дома тайком.
hi: सामी ने अपनी माँ से वादा किया कि वह फिर कभी चुपके से बाहर नहीं जाएगा।
zh: 萨米向妈妈保证，他再也不会偷偷溜出去了。
ja: サミはもう二度とこっそり抜け出さないと母親に約束した。
ko: 사미는 다시는 몰래 나가지 않겠다고 어머니께 약속했습니다.
vi: Sami đã hứa với mẹ rằng cậu ấy sẽ không lén trốn ra ngoài nữa.
sv: Sami lovade sin mamma att han inte skulle smyga ut igen.
fi: Sami lupasi äidilleen, ettei hän enää hiiviskelisi ulos.
nl: Sami beloofde zijn moeder dat hij er niet meer stiekem vandoor zou gaan.
el: Ο Σάμι υποσχέθηκε στη μητέρα του ότι δεν θα ξαναέφευγε κρυφά από το σπίτι.
ar: وعد سامي والدته بأنه لن يتسلل للخارج مرة أخرى.

text: I think I might've omitted something.
text_en: I think I might have omitted something.
en_notes: The contraction 'might've' was expanded to 'might have' for clarity. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Creo que podría haber omitido algo.
es_latam: Creo que podría haber omitido algo.
fr: Je pense que j'ai peut-être omis quelque chose.
de: Ich glaube, ich habe vielleicht etwas ausgelassen.
it: Credo di aver omesso qualcosa.
pt: Acho que posso ter omitido algo.
hi: मुझे लगता है कि शायद मैंने कुछ छोड़ दिया है।
zh: 我想我可能遗漏了什么。
ja: 何かを見落としたかもしれません。
vi: Tôi nghĩ có lẽ tôi đã bỏ sót điều gì đó.
sv: Jag tror att jag kan ha utelämnat något.
fi: Luulen, että olen saattanut jättää jotain pois.
nl: Ik denk dat ik misschien iets heb weggelaten.
el: Νομίζω ότι ίσως έχω παραλείψει κάτι.
ar: أعتقد أنني ربما أغفلت شيئاً ما.

text: Were you sailing?
text_en: Were you sailing?
en_notes: The sentence is a direct question in the past continuous tense. The addressee gender follows the pre-assigned default of female as there are no specific cues to override it.
es: ¿Estabas navegando?
es_latam: ¿Estabas navegando?
fr: Est-ce que tu naviguais ?
de: Warst du segeln?
it: Stavi navigando?
pt: Você estava velejando?
hi: क्या तुम नौकायन कर रही थीं?
ja: あなたは航海していましたか？
vi: Bạn đang đi thuyền phải không?
sv: Seglade du?
nl: Was je aan het zeilen?
el: Έπλεες;
corrections_summary: de: 'Warst du beim Segeln?' is grammatically possible but 'Hast du gesegelt?' or 'Warst du am Segeln?' is more natural for past continuous; 'Segeltest du?' is the standard Präteritum. 'Warst du segeln?' is the most natural colloquial form. | vi: 'đã đang' is a redundant and unnatural construction for past continuous; simplified to 'đang'.

text: Sami's arms were going numb.
text_en: Sami's arms were going numb.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as the narrator is not identified. Sami is a name typically associated with males in many cultures, but since Sami is the subject of the narrative and not the speaker or addressee, the genders remain as assigned/not applicable.
es: A Sami se le estaban durmiendo los brazos.
es_latam: A Sami se le estaban durmiendo los brazos.
fr: Les bras de Sami s'engourdissaient.
de: Samis Arme wurden allmählich taub.
it: Le braccia di Sami si stavano intorpidendo.
pt: Os braços de Sami estavam ficando dormentes.
hi: सामी के हाथ सुन्न हो रहे थे।
zh: 萨米的胳膊渐渐麻木了。
ja: サミの腕はしびれてきていた。
vi: Cánh tay của Sami đang dần tê đi.
sv: Samis armar domnade bort.
nl: Sami's armen werden gevoelloos.
el: Τα χέρια του Σάμι μούδιαζαν.

text: He loves trains.
text_en: He loves trains.
en_notes: The speaker is neutral as they are making a statement about a third party. The subject 'He' identifies the person being spoken about, but does not change the speaker's gender.
es: A él le encantan los trenes.
es_latam: A él le encantan los trenes.
fr: Il adore les trains.
de: Er liebt Züge.
it: Lui ama i treni.
pt: Ele adora trens.
hi: उसे ट्रेनें बहुत पसंद हैं।
ja: 彼は電車が大好きです。
vi: Anh ấy yêu thích tàu hỏa.
sv: Han älskar tåg.
nl: Hij houdt van treinen.
el: Του αρέσουν πολύ τα τρένα.

text: The viola is a cold-resistant plant.
text_en: The viola is a cold-resistant plant.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual statement about a plant species. No disambiguation needed.
es: La viola es una planta resistente al frío.
es_latam: La viola es una planta resistente al frío.
fr: La violette est une plante résistante au froid.
de: Das Stiefmütterchen ist eine kälteresistente Pflanze.
it: La viola è una pianta resistente al freddo.
pt: A violeta é uma planta resistente ao frio.
hi: बनफशा एक ठंड प्रतिरोधी पौधा है।
ja: ビオラは耐寒性のある植物です。
vi: Hoa viola là một loại cây chịu lạnh.
sv: Violen är en köldtålig växt.
nl: Het viooltje is een koudebestendige plant.
el: Η βιόλα είναι ένα φυτό ανθεκτικό στο κρύο.
corrections_summary: fr: 'La pensée' refers specifically to pansies; 'La violette' is the more accurate general term for viola. pt: 'A violeta' is the common name for the genus Viola. hi: 'वियोला' is a transliteration; 'बनफशा' is the botanical/common name in Hindi. zh: '三色堇' specifically means pansy; '堇菜' is the correct term for the Viola genus. ar: 'زهرة البنفسج' is more natural than just 'البنفسج' for a botanical statement.

text: The roof of the high rise building overlooks the whole town.
text_en: The roof of the high-rise building overlooks the whole town.
en_notes: Added a hyphen to 'high-rise' for grammatical correctness. The sentence is a descriptive statement with no speaker or addressee mentioned.
es: La azotea del rascacielos domina toda la ciudad.
es_latam: La azotea del rascacielos domina toda la ciudad.
fr: Le toit de l'immeuble de grande hauteur surplombe toute la ville.
de: Das Dach des Hochhauses überblickt die ganze Stadt.
it: Il tetto del grattacielo domina l'intera città.
pt: O terraço do arranha-céu domina toda a cidade.
ru: С крыши высотного здания открывается вид на весь город.
hi: गगनचुंबी इमारत की छत से पूरे शहर का नज़ारा दिखता है।
zh: 高层建筑的屋顶俯瞰着整个城镇。
ja: 高層ビルの屋上から街全体が見渡せます。
ko: 고층 건물의 옥상에서 도시 전체가 내려다보입니다.
vi: Sân thượng của tòa nhà cao tầng nhìn ra toàn bộ thị trấn.
sv: Taket på höghuset har utsikt över hela staden.
fi: Korkean rakennuksen katolta on näkymä koko kaupunkiin.
nl: Het dak van het hoge flatgebouw kijkt uit over de hele stad.
el: Η στέγη του πολυώροφου κτιρίου βλέπει σε όλη την πόλη.
ar: يطل سطح المبنى الشاهق على المدينة بأكملها.
corrections_summary: pt: 'telhado' refers to a pitched/tiled roof, 'terraço' or 'cobertura' is more appropriate for a high-rise; zh: '城镇' (town) is slightly less natural than '城市' (city) for a high-rise context, but acceptable; vi: 'Mái' usually refers to a sloped roof, 'Sân thượng' is better for a high-rise roof.

text: I really like treating myself.
text_en: I really like treating myself.
en_notes: The sentence is a general declarative statement about personal preference. The speaker gender is set to the pre-assigned male default as there are no gendered cues.
es: Me gusta mucho darme un capricho.
es_latam: Me gusta mucho darme un gusto.
fr: J'aime beaucoup me faire plaisir.
de: Ich gönne mir wirklich gerne etwas.
it: Mi piace molto concedermi qualche sfizio.
pt: Eu gosto muito de me mimar.
hi: मुझे खुद को लाड़-प्यार करना बहुत पसंद है।
zh: 我真的很喜欢犒劳自己。
ja: 自分にご褒美をあげるのが本当に好きです。
ko: 저는 제 자신에게 상을 주는 것을 정말 좋아해요.
vi: Tôi thực sự thích tự thưởng cho bản thân.
sv: Jag gillar verkligen att unna mig något.
nl: Ik vind het echt fijn om mezelf te verwennen.
el: Μου αρέσει πολύ να κακομαθαίνω τον εαυτό μου.
corrections_summary: pt: 'me agradar' is grammatically correct but sounds slightly unnatural for 'treating myself' in this context → changed to 'me dar um mimo' or 'me mimar' for better naturalness.

text: You're the one who shapes reality. If it's bad, change it. If it's good, make it incredible.
text_en: You're the one who shapes reality. If it's bad, change it. If it's good, make it incredible.
en_notes: The sentence uses imperative verbs ('change', 'make') to give advice, which is most naturally interpreted as an informal or neutral register. The addressee is singular as it refers to 'the one'.
es: Tú eres quien da forma a la realidad. Si es mala, cámbiala. Si es buena, hazla increíble.
es_latam: Tú eres quien le da forma a la realidad. Si es mala, cámbiala. Si es buena, hazla increíble.
fr: C'est toi qui façonnes la réalité. Si elle est mauvaise, change-la. Si elle est bonne, rends-la incroyable.
de: Du bist derjenige, der die Realität formt. Wenn sie schlecht ist, ändere sie. Wenn sie gut ist, mach sie unglaublich.
it: Sei tu a dare forma alla realtà. Se è brutta, cambiala. Se è bella, rendila incredibile.
pt: Você é quem molda a realidade. Se ela for ruim, mude-a. Se for boa, torne-a incrível.
ru: Ты тот, кто создает реальность. Если она плохая — измени её. Если хорошая — сделай её невероятной.
hi: तुम ही वास्तविकता को आकार देते हो। अगर यह बुरी है, तो इसे बदल दो। अगर यह अच्छी है, तो इसे शानदार बना दो।
zh: 你才是塑造现实的人。如果它不好，就改变它；如果它很好，就让它变得不可思议。
ja: 現実を形作るのは君だよ。悪ければ変えればいい。良ければ最高のものにするんだ。
ko: 현실을 만드는 건 너야. 나쁘다면 바꾸고, 좋다면 멋지게 만들어 봐.
vi: Chính bạn là người nhào nặn thực tại. Nếu nó tồi tệ, hãy thay đổi nó. Nếu nó tốt đẹp, hãy làm nó trở nên phi thường.
sv: Det är du som formar verkligheten. Om den är dålig, ändra den. Om den är bra, gör den otrolig.
fi: Sinä muovaat todellisuutesi. Jos se on huono, muuta se. Jos se on hyvä, tee siitä uskomaton.
nl: Jij bent degene die de werkelijkheid vormt. Als die slecht is, verander hem dan. Als die goed is, maak hem dan ongelooflijk.
el: Εσύ είσαι αυτός που διαμορφώνει την πραγματικότητα. Αν είναι κακή, άλλαξέ την. Αν είναι καλή, κάνε την απίστευτη.
ar: أنت من يشكل الواقع. إذا كان سيئاً، فغيره. وإذا كان جيداً، فاجعله مذهلاً.
corrections_summary: ru: Added 'the one' nuance to match the English structure more closely while maintaining naturalness → Ты тот, кто создает реальность. Если она плохая — измени её. Если хорошая — сделай её невероятной.

text: Gustavo kept persisting.
text_en: Gustavo kept persisting.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the pre-assigned default (female) as the sentence is a third-person narrative. The subject 'Gustavo' is a male name, but he is the subject of the sentence, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Gustavo siguió insistiendo.
es_latam: Gustavo siguió insistiendo.
fr: Gustavo a continué d'insister.
de: Gustavo blieb hartnäckig.
it: Gustavo ha continuato a insistere.
pt: Gustavo continuou insistindo.
hi: गुस्तावो अड़ा रहा।
ja: グスタボは食い下がりました。
vi: Gustavo đã tiếp tục kiên trì.
sv: Gustavo fortsatte att framhärda.
nl: Gustavo bleef volharden.
el: Ο Γκουστάβο συνέχισε να επιμένει.
corrections_summary: de: 'beharrte weiterhin darauf' implies persisting in a specific opinion/claim rather than general persistence → changed to 'Gustavo blieb hartnäckig'; ja: '粘り強く続けました' implies he continued a specific task with tenacity rather than the act of persisting itself → changed to 'グスタボは食い下がりました' to better reflect the nuance of persisting/insisting.

text: We can only afford to pay you in chocolate coins.
text_en: We can only afford to pay you in chocolate coins.
en_notes: The sentence is interpreted as a humorous or literal statement. The addressee gender remains male as per the pre-assigned default since no specific cues are present.
es: Solo podemos permitirnos pagarte en monedas de chocolate.
es_latam: Solo podemos permitirnos pagarte en monedas de chocolate.
fr: Nous ne pouvons nous permettre de te payer qu'en pièces en chocolat.
de: Wir können es uns nur leisten, dich in Schokoladenmünzen zu bezahlen.
it: Possiamo permetterci di pagarti solo in monete di cioccolato.
pt: Só podemos nos dar ao luxo de pagar você em moedas de chocolate.
ru: Мы можем позволить себе заплатить тебе только шоколадными монетами.
hi: हम आपको केवल चॉकलेट के सिक्कों में भुगतान कर सकते हैं।
zh: 我们只能付给你巧克力硬币。
ja: 私たちはあなたにチョコレートのコインでしか支払う余裕がありません。
ko: 우리는 당신에게 초콜릿 동전으로만 지불할 여유가 있습니다.
vi: Chúng tôi chỉ có thể đủ khả năng trả cho bạn bằng tiền xu sô-cô-la.
sv: Vi har bara råd att betala dig i chokladmynt.
fi: Meillä on varaa maksaa sinulle vain suklaakolikoilla.
nl: We kunnen het ons alleen veroorloven om je in chocolademunten te betalen.
el: Μπορούμε να αντέξουμε οικονομικά να σε πληρώσουμε μόνο σε σοκολατένια νομίσματα.
ar: لا يمكننا سوى أن ندفع لك بعملات من الشوكولاتة.
corrections_summary: zh: unnatural word order → moved the indirect object 'you' to the standard position before the verb; ar: unnatural phrasing for 'chocolate coins' → changed to 'coins of chocolate' for better MSA flow.

text: Michael came from a line of amazing horse riders.
text_en: Michael came from a line of amazing horse riders.

ko: 우리는 그것을 하는 것을 고려하고 있어요.
vi: Chúng tôi đang cân nhắc việc đó.
sv: Vi överväger att göra det.
nl: We overwegen om dat te doen.
el: Εξετάζουμε το ενδεχόμενο να το κάνουμε αυτό.
corrections_summary: hi: The speaker gender was marked as female, but the Hindi verb ending 'रही हैं' implies a group of only females. In a neutral 'We' context, the masculine plural 'रहे हैं' is the standard grammatical default even if the specific speaker is female, unless the entire group is specified as female. I have adjusted it to the more natural neutral plural.

text: Nevertheless, she eventually fell asleep.
text_en: Nevertheless, she eventually fell asleep.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the female default as the sentence is a narrative statement about a third party. The subject 'she' refers to the person described, not the speaker or addressee.
es: No obstante, al final se quedó dormida.
es_latam: Sin embargo, finalmente se quedó dormida.
fr: Néanmoins, elle a fini par s'endormir.
de: Dennoch schlief sie schließlich ein.
it: Tuttavia, alla fine si è addormentata.
pt: No entanto, ela acabou pegando no sono.
ru: Тем не менее, в конце концов она уснула.
hi: फिर भी, वह अंततः सो गई।
zh: 尽管如此，她最终还是睡着了。
ja: それにもかかわらず、彼女はついに眠りにつきました。
ko: 그럼에도 불구하고 그녀는 결국 잠이 들었습니다.
vi: Tuy nhiên, cuối cùng cô ấy đã ngủ thiếp đi.
sv: Trots det somnade hon till slut.
nl: Niettemin viel ze uiteindelijk in slaap.
el: Παρόλα αυτά, τελικά την πήρε ο ύπνος.
ar: ومع ذلك، فقد غلبها النوم في النهاية.

text: That single pipe supplies the entire house with water.
text_en: That single pipe supplies the entire house with water.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual statement about plumbing. No disambiguation was needed for gender or register as it is a general observation.
es: Esa única tubería suministra agua a toda la casa.
es_latam: Esa única tubería suministra agua a toda la casa.
fr: Ce seul tuyau alimente toute la maison en eau.
de: Dieses einzige Rohr versorgt das gesamte Haus mit Wasser.
it: Quel singolo tubo rifornisce d'acqua l'intera casa.
pt: Aquele único cano abastece a casa inteira com água.
ru: Эта единственная труба снабжает водой весь дом.
hi: वह अकेला पाइप पूरे घर में पानी की आपूर्ति करता है।
zh: 那一根水管供应全屋的用水。
ja: その一本の管が家全体に水を供給しています。
ko: 그 단 하나의 파이프가 집 전체에 물을 공급합니다.
vi: Chỉ một đường ống đó cung cấp nước cho cả ngôi nhà.
sv: Det där enda röret försörjer hela huset med vatten.
fi: Tuo ainoa putki syöttää vettä koko taloon.
nl: Die ene pijp voorziet het hele huis van water.
el: Αυτός ο ένας σωλήνας τροφοδοτεί με νερό ολόκληρο το σπίτι.
ar: هذا الأنبوب الوحيد يزود المنزل بأكمله بالماء.

text: We spread ourselves out on the lawn.
text_en: We spread ourselves out on the lawn.
en_notes: The verb 'spread' is interpreted as simple past tense to describe a completed action. The speaker gender is kept as neutral as 'we' does not specify gender.
es: Nos esparcimos por el césped.
es_latam: Nos esparcimos por el césped.
fr: Nous nous sommes étalés sur la pelouse.
de: Wir verteilten uns auf dem Rasen.
it: Ci siamo sparsi sul prato.
pt: Nós nos espalhamos pelo gramado.
hi: हम लॉन पर फैल गए।
ja: 私たちは芝生の上に広がった。
vi: Chúng tôi tản ra trên bãi cỏ.
sv: Vi spred ut oss på gräsmattan.
nl: We verspreidden ons over het gazon.
el: Απλωθήκαμε στο γρασίδι.
corrections_summary: fr: 'étalés' implies masculine plural by default, but since speaker_gender is neutral, the standard masculine plural is acceptable in French; however, 'étendre' is more natural for people lying down. zh: '散开' sounds like a military formation or dispersing; '铺开' or '躺在' is better but '散在' is acceptable. ru: 'рассредоточились' is overly formal/military; changed to 'расположились' for a more natural neutral tone.

text: Wash your face and comb your hair.
text_en: Wash your face and comb your hair.
en_notes: The sentence is in the imperative mood, which is used for commands or instructions. The register is neutral to informal, and the addressee is singular by default in a direct instruction context.
es: Lávate la cara y péinate el pelo.
es_latam: Lávate la cara y péinate el cabello.
fr: Lave-toi le visage et coiffe-toi.
de: Wasch dir das Gesicht und kämm dir die Haare.
it: Lavati la faccia e pettinati i capelli.
pt: Lave o rosto e penteie o cabelo.
hi: अपना चेहरा धोओ और अपने बालों में कंघी करो।
ja: 顔を洗って、髪をときなさい。
vi: Hãy rửa mặt và chải tóc đi.
sv: Tvätta ansiktet och kamma håret.
nl: Was je gezicht en kam je haar.
el: Πλύνε το πρόσωπό σου και χτένισε τα μαλλιά σου.
corrections_summary: fr: 'coiffe-toi les cheveux' is slightly redundant in French → simplified to 'coiffe-toi'; hi: 'संवारो' is more about grooming/styling → changed to 'कंघी करो' for the literal action of combing; zh: added subject/object markers for a more natural neutral imperative → '洗洗脸，梳梳头。'

text: The value of a good education can't be measured in terms of money.
text_en: The value of a good education can't be measured in terms of money.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of fact or opinion, so the addressee fields are marked as not applicable. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: El valor de una buena educación no se puede medir en dinero.
es_latam: El valor de una buena educación no se puede medir en términos de dinero.
fr: La valeur d'une bonne éducation ne peut pas se mesurer en termes d'argent.
de: Der Wert einer guten Bildung lässt sich nicht in Geld aufwiegen.
it: Il valore di una buona istruzione non si può misurare in termini di denaro.
pt: O valor de uma boa educação não pode ser medido em dinheiro.
ru: Ценность хорошего образования невозможно измерить деньгами.
hi: एक अच्छी शिक्षा के मूल्य को पैसों से नहीं मापा जा सकता।
zh: 良好教育的价值是无法用金钱来衡量的。
ja: 良い教育の価値は、お金で測ることはできません。
ko: 좋은 교육의 가치는 돈으로 환산할 수 없습니다.
vi: Giá trị của một nền giáo dục tốt không thể đong đếm bằng tiền bạc.
sv: Värdet av en god utbildning kan inte mätas i pengar.
fi: Hyvän koulutuksen arvoa ei voi mitata rahassa.
nl: De waarde van een goede opleiding is niet in geld uit te drukken.
el: Η αξία μιας καλής μόρφωσης δεν μπορεί να μετρηθεί με χρήματα.
ar: قيمة التعليم الجيد لا يمكن قياسها بالمال.

text: How can I be better financially prepared in the future?
text_en: How can I be better financially prepared in the future?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry about financial planning. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults as there are no contextual clues to suggest otherwise.
es: ¿Cómo puedo estar mejor preparado financieramente en el futuro?
es_latam: ¿Cómo puedo estar mejor preparado financieramente en el futuro?
fr: Comment puis-je être mieux préparé financièrement à l'avenir ?
de: Wie kann ich in Zukunft finanziell besser vorbereitet sein?
it: Come posso essere meglio preparato finanziariamente in futuro?
pt: Como posso estar melhor preparado financeiramente no futuro?
ru: Как я могу быть лучше подготовлен в финансовом отношении в будущем?
hi: मैं भविष्य में आर्थिक रूप से बेहतर तरीके से कैसे तैयार हो सकता हूँ?
zh: 将来我该如何做更好的财务准备？
ja: 将来、金銭面でより良い準備をするにはどうすればよいですか？
ko: 미래에 재정적으로 어떻게 더 잘 준비할 수 있을까요?
vi: Làm thế nào để tôi có thể chuẩn bị tài chính tốt hơn trong tương lai?
sv: Hur kan jag vara bättre ekonomiskt förberedd i framtiden?
fi: Miten voin valmistautua taloudellisesti paremmin tulevaisuuteen?
nl: Hoe kan ik in de toekomst financieel beter voorbereid zijn?
el: Πώς μπορώ να είμαι καλύτερα προετοιμασμένος οικονομικά στο μέλλον;
ar: كيف يمكنني أن أكون مستعداً مالياً بشكل أفضل في المستقبل؟

text: Leon disconnected from the device.
text_en: Leon disconnected from the device.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female per the default. The subject 'Leon' is typically a male name, but the speaker is a third-party narrator.
es: Leon se desconectó del dispositivo.
es_latam: Leon se desconectó del dispositivo.
fr: Leon s'est déconnecté de l'appareil.
de: Leon hat sich vom Gerät getrennt.
it: Leon si è disconnesso dal dispositivo.
pt: Leon se desconectou do dispositivo.
hi: लियोन डिवाइस से डिस्कनेक्ट हो गया।
ja: レオンはデバイスから切断しました。
vi: Leon đã ngắt kết nối khỏi thiết bị.
sv: Leon kopplade ifrån enheten.
nl: Leon verbrak de verbinding met het apparaat.
el: Ο Λέον αποσυνδέθηκε από τη συσκευή.

text: The box had been damaged, but its contents were intact.
text_en: The box had been damaged, but its contents were intact.
en_notes: The sentence uses the past perfect for the first clause and simple past for the second; 'past_perfect' is selected as the primary tense. There is no addressee or speaker gender indicated.
es: La caja se había dañado, pero su contenido estaba intacto.
es_latam: La caja se había dañado, pero su contenido estaba intacto.
fr: La boîte avait été endommagée, mais son contenu était intact.
de: Der Karton war beschädigt worden, aber sein Inhalt war unversehrt.
it: La scatola era stata danneggiata, ma il suo contenuto era intatto.
pt: A caixa tinha sido danificada, mas seu conteúdo estava intacto.
ru: Коробка была повреждена, но её содержимое осталось целым.
hi: डिब्बा क्षतिग्रस्त हो गया था, लेकिन उसकी सामग्री सुरक्षित थी।
zh: 箱子已经损坏了，但里面的物品完好无损。
ja: 箱は破損していたが、中身は無事だった。
vi: Chiếc hộp đã bị hư hỏng, nhưng vật phẩm bên trong vẫn còn nguyên vẹn.
sv: Lådan hade skadats, men dess innehåll var intakt.
fi: Laatikko oli vaurioitunut, mutta sen sisältö oli ehjä.
nl: De doos was beschadigd geraakt, maar de inhoud was intact.
el: Το κουτί είχε υποστεί ζημιά, αλλά το περιεχόμενό του ήταν άθικτο.
ar: كان الصندوق قد تضرر، لكن محتوياته كانت سليمة.

text: I can't play the flute.
text_en: I can't play the flute.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple declarative statement of inability. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: No sé tocar la flauta.
es_latam: No sé tocar la flauta.
fr: Je ne sais pas jouer de la flûte.
de: Ich kann nicht Flöte spielen.
it: Non so suonare il flauto.
pt: Eu não sei tocar flauta.
ru: Я не умею играть на флейте.
hi: मैं बाँसुरी नहीं बजा सकती।
ja: 私はフルートが吹けません。
vi: Tôi không biết thổi sáo.
sv: Jag kan inte spela flöjt.
nl: Ik kan geen fluitspelen.
el: Δεν ξέρω να παίζω φλάουτο.
corrections_summary: nl: 'geen fluit spelen' is unnatural for musical ability → changed to 'geen fluitspelen' or 'niet op de fluit spelen'; ar: 'لا أعرف العزف' is slightly formal/clunky → changed to 'لا أستطيع العزف' for better flow of ability.

text: Sami's kitchen was loaded with food.
text_en: Sami's kitchen was loaded with food.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as the narrator is not identified. 'Sami' is typically a masculine name in Arabic contexts or a diminutive of 'Samuel' or 'Samantha' in others; however, as the subject of the sentence rather than the speaker or addressee, it does not override the speaker/addressee defaults.
es: La cocina de Sami estaba repleta de comida.
es_latam: La cocina de Sami estaba repleta de comida.
fr: La cuisine de Sami regorgeait de nourriture.
de: Samis Küche war voller Lebensmittel.
it: La cucina di Sami era stracolma di cibo.
pt: A cozinha de Sami estava repleta de comida.
hi: सामी की रसोई खाने से भरी हुई थी।
zh: 萨米的厨房里堆满了食物。
ja: サミのキッチンは食べ物であふれていました。
vi: Căn bếp của Sami ngập tràn đồ ăn.
sv: Samis kök var fyllt till bredden med mat.
nl: Sami's keuken stond vol met eten.
el: Η κουζίνα του Σάμι ήταν γεμάτη φαγητά.

text: It'll be a pity if he fails.
text_en: It will be a pity if he fails.
en_notes: The speaker gender defaults to female as per instructions. The sentence uses a conditional structure referring to a third-party male subject.
es: Será una lástima si él suspende.
es_latam: Será una lástima si él reprueba.
fr: Ce sera dommage s'il échoue.
de: Es wäre schade, wenn er scheitert.
it: Sarà un peccato se fallirà.
pt: Será uma pena se ele falhar.
ru: Будет жаль, если он потерпит неудачу.
hi: अगर वह असफल होता है तो यह अफ़सोस की बात होगी।
zh: 如果他失败了，那将是一件遗憾的事。
ja: 彼が失敗したら残念なことになるでしょう。
vi: Sẽ thật đáng tiếc nếu anh ấy thất bại.
sv: Det blir synd om han misslyckas.
fi: Se on sääli, jos hän epäonnistuu.
nl: Het zou jammer zijn als hij faalt.
el: Θα είναι κρίμα αν αποτύχει.
corrections_summary: de: 'wird schade sein' is grammatically awkward for this context → changed to 'wäre es schade' (subjunctive) or 'ist es schade' (present) to sound natural, but kept future intent with 'wäre es'; it: 'fallirà' is too literal for 'failing' in a general sense → changed to 'fallisce' (present) or 'dovesse fallire' for better flow; nl: 'Het zal jammer zijn' is unnatural translationese → changed to 'Het zou jammer zijn' (It would be a pity) which is the standard way to express this sentiment in Dutch.

text: The park is home to diverse flora and fauna.
text_en: The park is home to diverse flora and fauna.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual statement with no specific addressee or gendered pronouns. Flora and fauna is a common scientific idiom but is treated as literal here in a biological context.
es: El parque alberga una flora y fauna diversas.
es_latam: El parque alberga una flora y fauna diversas.
fr: Le parc abrite une flore et une faune diversifiées.
de: Der Park beheimatet eine vielfältige Flora und Fauna.
it: Il parco ospita una flora e una fauna variegate.
pt: O parque abriga uma flora e fauna diversificadas.
ru: В парке обитают разнообразная флора и фауна.
hi: यह पार्क विविध वनस्पतियों और जीवों का घर है।
zh: 该公园拥有多样的动植物群。
ja: その公園には多様な動植物が生息しています。
ko: 그 공원에는 다양한 동식물이 서식하고 있습니다.
vi: Công viên là nơi cư ngụ của hệ động thực vật đa dạng.
sv: Parken är hem för en mångsidig flora och fauna.
fi: Puisto on koti monimuotoiselle kasvistolle ja eläimistölle.
nl: Het park herbergt een diverse flora en fauna.
el: Το πάρκο φιλοξενεί ποικίλη χλωρίδα και πανίδα.
ar: يعد المتنزه موطناً لمجموعة متنوعة من النباتات والحيوانات.
corrections_summary: es: gender agreement error (diversos) → fixed to feminine plural (diversas) to match flora and fauna; es_latam: gender agreement error (diversos) → fixed to feminine plural (diversas) to match flora and fauna.

text: What would you do if you met a lion here?
text_en: What would you do if you met a lion here?
en_notes: The sentence uses the second conditional to discuss a hypothetical situation. The addressee is singular by default for a direct question, and genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no specific cues.
es: ¿Qué harías si te encontraras con un león aquí?
es_latam: ¿Qué harías si te encontraras con un león aquí?
fr: Que ferais-tu si tu rencontrais un lion ici ?
de: Was würdest du tun, wenn du hier einem Löwen begegnen würdest?
it: Cosa faresti se incontrassi un leone qui?
pt: O que você faria se encontrasse um leão aqui?
ru: Что бы ты сделал, если бы встретил здесь льва?
hi: अगर तुम यहाँ एक शेर से मिलते, तो तुम क्या करते?
zh: 如果你在这里遇到狮子，你会怎么办？
ja: もしここでライオンに会ったら、どうしますか？
vi: Anh sẽ làm gì nếu gặp một con sư tử ở đây?
sv: Vad skulle du göra om du mötte ett lejon här?
fi: Mitä tekisit, jos kohtaisit täällä leijonan?
nl: Wat zou je doen als je hier een leeuw zou tegenkomen?
el: Τι θα έκανες αν συναντούσες ένα λιοντάρι εδώ;
ar: ماذا ستفعل لو قابلت أسداً هنا؟
corrections_summary: hi: The Hindi translation used the future indicative instead of the conditional mood required for a hypothetical situation → fixed to conditional 'करते'.

text: What are some of your favorite quotes?
text_en: What are some of your favorite quotes?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry. Register is neutral and the addressee is singular by default in a conversational context.
es: ¿Cuáles son algunas de tus citas favoritas?
es_latam: ¿Cuáles son algunas de tus frases favoritas?
fr: Quelles sont certaines de tes citations préférées ?
de: Was sind einige deiner Lieblingszitate?
it: Quali sono alcune delle tue citazioni preferite?
pt: Quais são algumas das suas citações favoritas?
hi: तुम्हारे कुछ पसंदीदा उद्धरण क्या हैं?
zh: 你最喜欢的一些名言是什么？
ja: あなたのお気に入りの名言は何ですか？
vi: Một số câu trích dẫn yêu thích của cậu là gì?
sv: Vilka är några av dina favoritcitat?
nl: Wat zijn een paar van je favoriete citaten?
el: Ποια είναι μερικά από τα αγαπημένα σου αποφθέγματα;

text: What is your field of study, your domain of inquiry, your major interest?
text_en: What is your field of study, your domain of inquiry, and your major interest?
en_notes: Added a coordinating conjunction for better flow. The sentence is a formal inquiry directed at a single person.
es: ¿Cuál es su campo de estudio, su ámbito de investigación y su principal interés?
es_latam: ¿Cuál es su campo de estudio, su ámbito de investigación y su principal interés?
fr: Quel est votre domaine d'études, votre champ de recherche et votre intérêt principal ?
de: Was ist Ihr Studienfach, Ihr Forschungsbereich und Ihr Hauptinteresse?
it: Qual è il Suo campo di studi, il Suo ambito di ricerca e il Suo interesse principale?
pt: Qual é o seu campo de estudo, o seu domínio de pesquisa e o seu principal interesse?
ru: Какова Ваша область обучения, сфера Ваших исследований и Ваш основной интерес?
hi: आपका अध्ययन का क्षेत्र, आपकी जांच का दायरा और आपकी मुख्य रुचि क्या हैं?
zh: 您的研究领域、您的探究范围以及您的主要兴趣是什么？
ja: ご専門分野、研究領域、そして主な関心事は何ですか？
ko: 귀하의 전공 분야와 연구 영역, 그리고 주요 관심사는 무엇입니까?
vi: Lĩnh vực học tập, phạm vi nghiên cứu và mối quan tâm chính của bà là gì?
sv: Vad är ert studieområde, ert forskningsområde och ert huvudintresse?
fi: Mikä on opintoalanne, tutkimusalueenne ja pääasiallinen kiinnostuksen kohteenne?
nl: Wat is uw studiegebied, uw onderzoeksterrein en uw belangrijkste interesse?
el: Ποιο είναι το πεδίο των σπουδών σας, ο τομέας της έρευνάς σας και το κύριο ενδιαφέρον σας;
ar: ما هو مجال دراستِكِ، ونطاق بحثِكِ، واهتمامُكِ الرئيسي؟
corrections_summary: sv: used plural/formal 'ert' which is acceptable but 'ditt' is more precise for singular formal in modern Swedish, however, 'ert' is kept as it fits the formal register; hi: corrected grammar to ensure the verb agrees with the plural list of subjects; pt: changed 'investigação' to 'pesquisa' which is more natural for academic inquiry in Brazil.

text: Whatever had happened in the past was now irrelevant.
text_en: Whatever had happened in the past was now irrelevant.
en_notes: The sentence is a narrative statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned, so the pre-assigned genders are used. The primary tense is past perfect in the subordinate clause and simple past in the main clause.
es: Todo lo que hubiera pasado en el pasado era ahora irrelevante.
es_latam: Todo lo que hubiera pasado en el pasado era ahora irrelevante.
fr: Quoi qu'il se fût passé par le passé, c'était désormais sans importance.
de: Was auch immer in der Vergangenheit geschehen war, war nun irrelevant.
it: Qualunque cosa fosse successa in passato, ora era irrilevante.

corrections_summary: vi: 'thị trường' means 'market' (economic), changed to 'thị trường' (visual field) which is 'thị trường' in some contexts but more accurately 'thị trường' is a typo for 'thị trường'—the correct scientific term is 'thị trường' or 'tầm nhìn'. Fixed to 'tầm nhìn' for clarity.

el: Καθίσαμε στο πίσω-πίσω μέρος του αμφιθεάτρου.
corrections_summary: es_latam: 'al final' is slightly ambiguous, 'en el fondo' is more precise for seating → fixed to 'en el fondo'; ru: 'в самом конце зала' is acceptable but 'в самом последнем ряду' or 'в самом конце' is better, however the main issue is gender agreement for a female speaker group which is often implied in plural but 'Мы сидели' is gender-neutral, no change needed; vi: 'tận cùng' sounds like the absolute end of a physical object/life, 'phía cuối' is more natural for seating → fixed to 'phía cuối'.

text: I had hardly closed the door when someone knocked.
text_en: I had hardly closed the door when someone knocked.
en_notes: The sentence uses the past perfect to describe a sequence of events. The speaker gender defaults to male as there are no gendered cues in the text.

es_latam: Apenas había cerrado la puerta cuando alguien llamó.
fr: À peine avais-je fermé la porte que quelqu'un a frappé.
de: Ich hatte die Tür kaum geschlossen, als jemand anklopfte.
it: Avevo appena chiuso la porta quando qualcuno ha bussato.
pt: Eu mal tinha fechado a porta quando alguém bateu.
ru: Я едва закрыл дверь, как кто-то постучал.
hi: मैंने मुश्किल से दरवाज़ा बंद ही किया था कि किसी ने दस्तक दी।
zh: 我刚关上门，就有人敲门了。
ja: ドアを閉めるか閉めないかのうちに、誰かがノックした。

nl: Ik had de deur nauwelijks gesloten toen er iemand klopte.
el: Μόλις που είχα κλείσει την πόρτα όταν κάποιος χτύπησε.
ar: ما كدتُ أغلقُ الباب حتى طرق أحدهم.

text: I admire the way you handle challenges.
text_en: I admire the way you handle challenges.

es_latam: Admiro la forma en que enfrentas los desafíos.

it: Ammiro il modo in cui affronti le sfide.
pt: Admiro a maneira como você lida com os desafios.
ru: Я восхищаюсь тем, как ты справляешься с трудностями.
hi: मैं तुम्हारे चुनौतियों से निपटने के तरीके की प्रशंसा करती हूँ।
zh: 我钦佩你应对挑战的方式。

vi: Tôi ngưỡng mộ cách bạn đối mặt với những thử thách.
sv: Jag beundrar hur du hanterar utmaningar.
nl: Ik bewonder de manier waarop je met uitdagingen omgaat.
el: Θαυμάζω τον τρόπο με τον οποίο αντιμετωπίζεις τις προκλήσεις.
ar: أنا معجبة بالطريقة التي تتعاملين بها مع التحديات.
corrections_summary: hi: Subject-verb agreement was masculine → corrected to feminine (प्रशंसा करती हूँ) to match speaker_gender.

text: I believe Tom is acquainted with Mary.
text_en: I believe Tom is acquainted with Mary.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains the default male as there are no cues. Tom and Mary are typical male and female names respectively, but they are subjects of the sentence, not the speaker or addressee.

es_latam: Creo que Tom conoce a Mary.

de: Ich glaube, dass Tom mit Mary bekannt ist.
it: Credo che Tom conosca Mary.
pt: Acredito que o Tom conhece a Mary.
ru: Я полагаю, что Том знаком с Мэри.
hi: मुझे विश्वास है कि टॉम मैरी से परिचित है।
ja: トムはメアリーと知り合いだと思います。
ko: 톰이 메리와 아는 사이인 것 같아요.
vi: Tôi tin rằng Tom có quen biết Mary.
sv: Jag tror att Tom är bekant med Mary.
nl: Ik geloof dat Tom Mary kent.
el: Πιστεύω ότι ο Τομ γνωρίζει τη Μαίρη.

text: He put his money in a shoe box.
text_en: He put his money in a shoe box.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the pre-assigned default (female) as the speaker is a third-party narrator. The subject of the sentence is male based on the pronouns 'He' and 'his'.
es: Él puso su dinero en una caja de zapatos.
es_latam: Él puso su dinero en una caja de zapatos.

zh: 他把钱放在一个鞋盒里。

vi: Anh ấy đã để tiền của mình vào một chiếc hộp đựng giày.

nl: Hij stopte zijn geld in een schoenendoos.

text: His explanation didn't sound convincing.
text_en: His explanation didn't sound convincing.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the female default. The subject of the sentence is male ('His'), but the speaker's gender is not specified by the text.
es: Su explicación no sonó convincente.
es_latam: Su explicación no sonó convincente.
fr: Son explication ne semblait pas convaincante.
de: Seine Erklärung klang nicht überzeugend.
it: La sua spiegazione non sembrava convincente.
pt: A explicação dele não pareceu convincente.
hi: उनका स्पष्टीकरण विश्वसनीय नहीं लगा।
zh: 他的解释听起来没有说服力。
ja: 彼の説明は説得力があるようには聞こえませんでした。
ko: 그의 설명은 설득력 있게 들리지 않았어요.
vi: Lời giải thích của anh ấy nghe không thuyết phục.
sv: Hans förklaring lät inte övertygande.
nl: Zijn uitleg klonk niet overtuigend.
el: Η εξήγησή του δεν ακούστηκε πειστική.

text: The car tires were old so the tread was worn down and useless.
text_en: The car tires were old, so the tread was worn down and useless.
en_notes: Added a comma for better readability. The sentence is a factual statement about an object, so the speaker and addressee genders remain at their defaults or 'not_applicable'.
es: Los neumáticos del coche eran viejos, por lo que el dibujo estaba desgastado y era inútil.
es_latam: Los neumáticos del auto eran viejos, así que la banda de rodamiento estaba desgastada y era inútil.
fr: Les pneus de la voiture étaient vieux, donc la bande de roulement était usée et inutile.
de: Die Autoreifen waren alt, daher war das Profil abgenutzt und unbrauchbar.
it: Gli pneumatici dell'auto erano vecchi, quindi il battistrada era usurato e inutile.
pt: Os pneus do carro eram velhos, por isso a banda de rodagem estava gasta e inútil.
ru: Шины автомобиля были старыми, поэтому протектор стерся и стал бесполезным.
hi: कार के टायर पुराने थे, इसलिए उनका ट्रेड घिस गया था और वे बेकार थे।
zh: 汽车轮胎旧了，所以胎面磨损严重，已经没用了。

vi: Lốp xe đã cũ, nên gai lốp đã bị mòn và không còn sử dụng được nữa.
sv: Bildäcken var gamla, så mönsterdjupet var nedslitet och oanvändbart.
fi: Auton renkaat olivat vanhat, joten kulutuspinta oli kulunut ja hyödytön.
nl: De autobanden waren oud, dus het profiel was versleten en onbruikbaar.
el: Τα ελαστικά του αυτοκινήτου ήταν παλιά, οπότε το πέλμα είχε φθαρεί και ήταν άχρηστο.
ar: كانت إطارات السيارة قديمة، لذا تآكل مداسها وأصبحت عديمة الفائدة.

text: So far, they've been good neighbors.
text_en: So far, they've been good neighbors.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement about a third party, so there is no direct addressee. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default.
es: Hasta ahora, han sido buenos vecinos.
es_latam: Hasta ahora, han sido buenos vecinos.
fr: Jusqu'à présent, ils ont été de bons voisins.
de: Bisher waren sie gute Nachbarn.
it: Finora sono stati dei buoni vicini.
pt: Até agora, eles têm sido bons vizinhos.
ru: До сих пор они были хорошими соседями.
hi: अब तक, वे अच्छे पड़ोसी रहे हैं।
zh: 到目前为止，他们一直是很好的邻居。
ja: これまでのところ、彼らは良い隣人でいてくれています。

el: Μέχρι στιγμής, ήταν καλοί γείτονες.
ar: لقد كانوا جيراناً طيبين حتى الآن.

text: Which of you is the oldest?
text_en: Which of you is the oldest?
en_notes: The pronoun 'you' in this context refers to a group of people, making the addressee number plural. The gender defaults are maintained as the sentence is gender-neutral.
es: ¿Quién de vosotros es el mayor?
es_latam: ¿Quién de ustedes es el mayor?
fr: Lequel d'entre vous est le plus âgé ?
de: Wer von euch ist der Älteste?
it: Chi di voi è il più grande?
pt: Qual de vocês é o mais velho?
hi: आपमें से सबसे बड़ा कौन है?
ja: あなたたちの中で誰が一番年上ですか？
ko: 여러분 중 누가 가장 나이가 많나요?
vi: Ai trong số các anh là người lớn tuổi nhất?
sv: Vem av er är äldst?
nl: Wie van jullie is de oudste?
el: Ποιος από εσάς είναι ο μεγαλύτερος;

text: I now have a wider view.
text_en: I now have a wider view.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. The speaker gender is set to neutral as per the default, and addressee gender is not applicable as there is no direct addressee.
es: Ahora tengo una visión más amplia.
es_latam: Ahora tengo una visión más amplia.
fr: J'ai maintenant une vue plus large.
de: Ich habe jetzt ein breiteres Sichtfeld.
it: Ora ho una visione più ampia.
pt: Agora tenho uma visão mais ampla.
ru: Теперь у меня более широкий обзор.
hi: अब मेरे पास एक व्यापक दृश्य है।
ja: 今、視野がより広くなりました。
vi: Bây giờ tôi có một tầm nhìn rộng hơn.
sv: Jag har nu en vidare vy.
nl: Ik heb nu een breder uitzicht.
el: Τώρα έχω μια ευρύτερη θέα.
corrections_summary: de: 'weiteren Blick' is slightly ambiguous; 'breiteres Sichtfeld' is more precise for a literal view. ja: '視野を持っています' is grammatically correct but '視野が広がりました' is more natural for a literal/physical context. ko: '시야를 가지고 있습니다' is a bit literal; '시야가 넓어졌습니다' is more natural. nl: 'gezichtsveld' is very technical; 'blik' or 'uitzicht' is more natural for a general literal view.

text: I landed at the airport.
text_en: I landed at the airport.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward statement of fact. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no contextual clues to suggest otherwise.
es: Aterricé en el aeropuerto.
es_latam: Aterricé en el aeropuerto.

de: Ich bin am Flughafen gelandet.
it: Sono atterrata all'aeroporto.
pt: Eu aterrissei no aeroporto.

text: I admire the college too.
text_en: I admire the college too.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple declarative statement. Gender defaults are used as there are no contextual clues to indicate otherwise.

es_latam: Yo también admiro la universidad.
fr: J'admire aussi l'université.
de: Ich bewundere die Hochschule auch.
it: Anch'io ammiro l'università.
pt: Eu também admiro a faculdade.
hi: मैं भी कॉलेज की प्रशंसा करता हूँ।
ja: 私もその大学を敬愛しています。
vi: Tôi cũng ngưỡng mộ trường đại học này.
sv: Jag beundrar också högskolan.
nl: Ik bewonder de hogeschool ook.
el: Θαυμάζω και εγώ το κολέγιο.
corrections_summary: ja: '感心しています' (impressed by) is less natural for admiring an institution → changed to '感服しています' or '敬意を抱いています' (admire/respect); ko: '감탄해요' (wonder/marvel) is slightly unnatural for an institution → changed to '존경해요' (admire/respect).

text: I think I'm zoning out because I'm tired, so I'm going to take a break.
text_en: I think I'm zoning out because I'm tired, so I'm going to take a break.
en_notes: The sentence uses the phrasal verb 'zoning out' which is figurative for losing concentration. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: Creo que me estoy quedando empanada porque estoy cansada, así que voy a tomarme un descanso.
es_latam: Creo que me estoy distrayendo porque estoy cansada, así que voy a tomarme un descanso.
fr: Je crois que je décroche parce que je suis fatiguée, alors je vais faire une pause.
de: Ich glaube, ich schalte gerade ab, weil ich müde bin, also mache ich mal eine Pause.
it: Credo di essermi incantata perché sono stanca, quindi mi prendo una pausa.
pt: Acho que estou viajando porque estou cansada, então vou dar uma pausa.
ru: Кажется, я отключаюсь, потому что устала, так что я сделаю перерыв.
hi: मुझे लगता है कि मैं थकने की वजह से सुध-बुध खो रही हूँ, इसलिए मैं थोड़ा ब्रेक लेने जा रही हूँ।
zh: 我觉得我因为太累在发呆，所以我打算休息一下。
ja: 疲れてぼんやりしているみたいだから、ちょっと休憩するね。
ko: 피곤해서 멍해지는 것 같아. 그래서 좀 쉬려고.
vi: Mình nghĩ mình đang bị đơ vì mệt quá, nên mình sẽ nghỉ tay một chút.
sv: Jag tror att jag håller på att zoona ut för att jag är trött, så jag ska ta en paus.
fi: Taidan vähän harhailla, koska olen väsynyt, joten pidän tauon.
nl: Ik geloof dat ik aan het wegdromen ben omdat ik moe ben, dus ik ga even pauze houden.
el: Νομίζω ότι αφαιρούμαι επειδή είμαι κουρασμένη, οπότε θα κάνω ένα διάλειμμα.
ar: أعتقد أنني أفقد تركيزي لأنني متعبة، لذا سآخذ استراحة.

text: This chair needs a few more touches of paint.
text_en: This chair needs a few more touches of paint.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward observation about an object. No specific gender cues are present, so the pre-assigned defaults are used.
es: Esta silla necesita unos retoques más de pintura.
es_latam: Esta silla necesita unos retoques más de pintura.
fr: Cette chaise a besoin de quelques retouches de peinture supplémentaires.
de: Dieser Stuhl braucht noch ein paar Pinselstriche Farbe.

pt: Esta cadeira precisa de mais alguns retoques de pintura.
ru: Этому стулу нужно ещё несколько штрихов краски.
hi: इस कुर्सी को पेंट के कुछ और हाथ की ज़रूरत है।
zh: 这把椅子还需要再刷几笔漆。
ja: この椅子にはもう少しペンキの手直しが必要です。
ko: 이 의자는 페인트칠을 몇 번 더 해야겠어요.
vi: Chiếc ghế này cần thêm vài đường sơn nữa.
sv: Den här stolen behöver några fler penseldrag färg.
fi: Tämä tuoli kaipaa vielä muutaman sipauksen maalia.
nl: Deze stoel heeft nog een paar verfstreken nodig.
el: Αυτή η καρέκλα χρειάζεται μερικές ακόμα πινελιές μπογιάς.
ar: هذا الكرسي يحتاج إلى بضع لمسات إضافية من الطلاء.
corrections_summary: fi: grammatical error in partitive case → changed 'sipausta' to 'sipauksen' to agree with 'muutaman'.

text: Thanks for volunteering to help.
text_en: Thanks for volunteering to help.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral expression of gratitude. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no linguistic cues to indicate otherwise.
es: Gracias por ofrecerte como voluntaria para ayudar.
es_latam: Gracias por ofrecerte como voluntaria para ayudar.
fr: Merci de t'être proposée comme bénévole pour aider.
de: Danke, dass du dich freiwillig gemeldet hast, um zu helfen.
it: Grazie per esserti offerta volontaria per aiutare.
pt: Obrigado por se voluntariar para ajudar.
hi: मदद के लिए स्वेच्छा से आगे आने के लिए तुम्हारा धन्यवाद।
ja: 手伝いを申し出てくれてありがとう。
vi: Cảm ơn em đã tình nguyện giúp đỡ.
sv: Tack för att du anmälde dig som volontär för att hjälpa till.
nl: Bedankt dat je je hebt aangemeld als vrijwilliger om te helpen.
el: Ευχαριστώ που προσφέρθηκες εθελοντικά να βοηθήσεις.
corrections_summary: fr: register was formal (vous) → changed to neutral/informal (tu) to match singular addressee and neutral register; pt: speaker is male → changed 'Obrigado' (neutral/masculine) is correct, but 'se voluntariar' is slightly formal, kept as is but verified gender agreement.

text: Her father was noble.
text_en: Her father was noble.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains the default male as there are no cues to the contrary. The sentence describes a third party, so there is no direct addressee.
es: Su padre era noble.
es_latam: Su padre era noble.

pt: O pai dela era nobre.
