ja: 彼女の父親は貴族でした。
vi: Cha của cô ấy là người quý tộc.
sv: Hennes far var adlig.
nl: Haar vader was van adel.
el: Ο πατέρας της ήταν ευγενής.

text: There are always exceptions.
text_en: There are always exceptions.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of fact. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the default female as there are no contextual cues to suggest otherwise.
es: Siempre hay excepciones.
es_latam: Siempre hay excepciones.
fr: Il y a toujours des exceptions.
de: Es gibt immer Ausnahmen.
it: Ci sono sempre delle eccezioni.
pt: Sempre há exceções.
hi: हमेशा अपवाद होते हैं।
ja: 常に例外はあります。
vi: Luôn luôn có những ngoại lệ.
sv: Det finns alltid undantag.
nl: Er zijn altijd uitzonderingen.
el: Πάντα υπάρχουν εξαιρέσεις.

text: I am acquainted with the author.
text_en: I am acquainted with the author.
en_notes: The sentence is a formal way of saying one knows someone. No gender cues are present, so the pre-assigned speaker gender is used.
es: Conozco al autor.
es_latam: Conozco al autor.
fr: Je connais l'auteur.
de: Ich bin mit dem Autor bekannt.
it: Ho una conoscenza con l'autore.
pt: Sou conhecido do autor.
hi: मैं लेखक से परिचित हूँ।
ja: 私はその著者と面識がございます。
vi: Tôi có quen biết tác giả.
sv: Jag är bekant med författaren.
nl: Ik ben bekend met de auteur.
el: Γνωρίζω τον συγγραφέα.
corrections_summary: es: 'Tengo el gusto de' is too idiomatic/polite for a literal 'acquainted' → changed to 'Conozco al autor'; es_latam: same as es → changed to 'Conozco al autor'; fr: 'personnellement' adds meaning not in the source → changed to 'Je connais l'auteur'; it: 'Conosco' is neutral, 'Sono in rapporti di conoscenza' is more formal → changed to 'Ho una conoscenza con l'autore'; pt: 'Eu conheço' is neutral → changed to 'Sou conhecido do autor' for formal register; zh: '认识' is neutral → changed to '我与这位作者相识' for formal register; fi: 'Tunnen' is neutral → changed to 'Olen tutustunut kirjailijaan' for formal register; ar: 'أنا على معرفة' is slightly informal → changed to 'أنا على دراية بالمؤلف' or 'أنا أعرف المؤلف' (using 'أنا على معرفة' is acceptable but 'إنني على معرفة' is more formal).

text: Sami was escorted out.

en_notes: The name Sami is typically a male name (Arabic origin) or a nickname for Samuel/Samantha; in this context, it refers to the subject of the passive voice. The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no cues, and addressee_gender is not applicable as this is a declarative statement without a direct addressee.
es: Sami fue acompañado a la salida.

sv: Sami blev eskorterad ut.
nl: Sami werd naar buiten begeleid.
el: Ο Σάμι συνοδεύτηκε έξω.
corrections_summary: es: 'escoltado fuera' is a literal translation of 'escorted out' but sounds unnatural in Spanish; changed to 'fue acompañado a la salida' for better flow. es_latam: 'escoltado hacia afuera' is slightly clunky; adjusted to 'fue escoltado a la salida'. ru: The original translation used a plural 'they' construction; changed to a more direct passive 'был выведен' to match the English structure and the male gender of Sami.

text: They corrected themselves.

en_notes: The pronoun 'they' is used as the subject, and 'themselves' is the reflexive pronoun. The speaker and addressee genders are neutral as there is no specific context or name provided.

corrections_summary: fr: 'Ils' is masculine, changed to gender-neutral 'Ils ou elles' or the more common plural 'Ils' but noted as masculine; however, for a truly neutral 'They' in French, 'Ils' is the default. No changes made as 'Ils' is the standard neutral plural. ru: 'исправились' can mean improved behaviorally, 'поправились' is better for correcting a mistake. fi: 'korjasivat itsensä' sounds like they physically fixed themselves, 'korjasivat puheensa' or 'korjasivat virheensä' is more natural, but 'korjasivat sanomisiaan' is best for speech. Actually, 'korjasivat itseään' is the standard reflexive. ja: '自分たちを' is slightly redundant, '訂正した' is for text/facts, '言い直した' is for speech. Keeping it general.

es_latam: Él cumplió con su parte del trato.

corrections_summary: zh: phrasing was slightly formal/stiff → adjusted to a more natural idiomatic expression for 'holding up one's end'; fi: missing the 'end/part' nuance → added 'oman osansa' to better reflect the original idiom.

text: I feel like people that are better-off have a moral obligation to help those in need, whether it be out of compassion or otherwise.
text_en: I feel like people who are better off have a moral obligation to help those in need, whether it be out of compassion or otherwise.
en_notes: The relative pronoun was changed from 'that' to 'who' for better flow when referring to people. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Siento que las personas que están en una mejor posición tienen la obligación moral de ayudar a los necesitados, ya sea por compasión o por cualquier otro motivo.
es_latam: Siento que las personas que tienen una mejor posición económica tienen la obligación moral de ayudar a los necesitados, ya sea por compasión o por otra razón.
fr: J'ai le sentiment que les personnes les plus aisées ont l'obligation morale d'aider ceux qui sont dans le besoin, que ce soit par compassion ou autrement.
de: Ich habe das Gefühl, dass besser gestellte Menschen eine moralische Verpflichtung haben, Bedürftigen zu helfen, sei es aus Mitgefühl oder aus anderen Gründen.
it: Sento che le persone che stanno meglio hanno l'obbligo morale di aiutare chi ha bisogno, che sia per compassione o per altro.
pt: Sinto que as pessoas que têm melhores condições têm a obrigação moral de ajudar os necessitados, seja por compaixão ou por outro motivo.
ru: Я считаю, что у более обеспеченных людей есть моральное обязательство помогать нуждающимся, будь то из сострадания или по другим причинам.
hi: मुझे लगता है कि जो लोग बेहतर स्थिति में हैं, उनका यह नैतिक दायित्व है कि वे ज़रूरतमंदों की मदद करें, चाहे वह करुणा के कारण हो या किसी और कारण से।
zh: 我觉得经济条件较好的人有道德义务去帮助那些有需要的人，无论是出于同情心还是其他原因。
ja: 裕福な人々には、慈悲の心からであれその他の理由であれ、困っている人々を助ける道徳的義務があると感じています。
ko: 형편이 더 나은 사람들이 동정심에서든 아니든 어려운 사람들을 도와야 할 도덕적 의무가 있다고 생각합니다.
vi: Tôi cảm thấy rằng những người có điều kiện tốt hơn có nghĩa vụ đạo đức phải giúp đỡ những người khó khăn, cho dù đó là vì lòng trắc ẩn hay vì lý do nào khác.
sv: Jag känner att människor som har det bättre ställt har en moralisk skyldighet att hjälpa de behövande, oavsett om det är av medkänsla eller av andra skäl.
fi: Minusta tuntuu, että parempiosaisilla on moraalinen velvollisuus auttaa puutteessa olevia, olipa kyse sitten myötätunnosta tai muusta syystä.
nl: Ik heb het gevoel dat mensen die het beter hebben een morele verplichting hebben om mensen in nood te helpen, of dat nu uit medeleven is of om een andere reden.
el: Αισθάνομαι ότι οι άνθρωποι που είναι πιο ευκατάστατοι έχουν την ηθική υποχρέωση να βοηθούν όσους έχουν ανάγκη, είτε από συμπόνια είτε για άλλο λόγο.
ar: أشعر أن الأشخاص الميسورين لديهم التزام أخلاقي بمساعدة المحتاجين، سواء كان ذلك بدافع الرحمة أو غير ذلك.
corrections_summary: ru: 'чувствую' is slightly literal for an opinion → changed to 'считаю' for better naturalness; hi: gender agreement was neutral/masculine → adjusted to feminine 'लगता है' (though 'लगता' is standard for 'it feels', the speaker gender is female, but Hindi 'mujhe lagta hai' is generally invariant for gender in this context, however, the phrasing was slightly improved for flow).

el: Μην κατεβάζεις αρχεία από άγνωστες πηγές· μπορεί να είναι κακόβουλο λογισμικό.
ar: لا تُحَمِّل ملفات من مصادر غير معروفة؛ فقد تكون برمجيات خبيثة.
corrections_summary: hi: incorrect gender agreement for 'files' (masculine plural) → corrected to 'हो सकती हैं' as 'फ़ाइलें' is feminine plural; nl: meaning shift from 'be malware' to 'contain malware' → corrected to 'kunnen malware zijn' for accuracy.

text: Do you worry about pesticides?

text: He recovered his sanity.

es_latam: Recobró la cordura.

vi: Với quá nhiều thông tin mâu thuẫn, người ta không còn biết loại dầu nào nên được sử dụng để nấu ăn.
sv: Med så mycket motsägelsefull information vet man inte längre vilken typ av oljor som bör användas vid matlagning.
fi: Ristiriitaisen tiedon paljouden vuoksi ei enää tiedetä, minkä tyyppisiä öljyjä ruoanlaitossa tulisi käyttää.
nl: Met zoveel tegenstrijdige informatie weet men niet meer welk type olie men moet gebruiken voor het koken.
el: Με τόσες αντικρουόμενες πληροφορίες, δεν γνωρίζει πλέον κανείς τι είδους λάδια πρέπει να χρησιμοποιούνται για το μαγείρεμα.
ar: مع وجود الكثير من المعلومات المتناقضة، لم يعد المرء يعرف أي نوع من الزيوت يجب استخدامه للطهي.
corrections_summary: fr: 'on' is often considered informal, 'on ne sait plus' changed to 'on ne sait plus' is acceptable but 'on' can be replaced by 'on ne sait plus' or 'l'on ne sait plus' for higher register, however, the main issue is 'huile' (singular) vs 'oils' (plural) → changed to 'huiles' to match the source plural; ru: 'не знаешь' is informal/colloquial → changed to 'неизвестно' or 'человек уже не знает' for formal register; hi: 'समझ नहीं आता' is slightly informal → changed to 'ज्ञात नहीं रहता' for a more formal tone.

text: I want to buy an automobile.
text_en: I want to buy an automobile.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual clues to suggest otherwise.

es_latam: Quiero comprar un automóvil.
fr: Je veux acheter une automobile.
de: Ich möchte ein Auto kaufen.
it: Voglio comprare un'automobile.
pt: Eu quero comprar um automóvel.
hi: मैं एक मोटरगाड़ी खरीदना चाहता हूँ।
ja: 自動車を買いたいです。
vi: Tôi muốn mua một chiếc ô tô.
sv: Jag vill köpa en bil.
nl: Ik wil een auto kopen.
el: Θέλω να αγοράσω ένα αυτοκίνητο.

text: I can't run away from the fascination of music.
text_en: I can't run away from the fascination of music.
en_notes: The sentence is literal in its expression of an inability to resist an attraction, though 'run away' is used in a common metaphorical sense for avoidance. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: No puedo escapar de la fascinación de la música.
es_latam: No puedo escapar de la fascinación de la música.
fr: Je ne peux pas échapper à la fascination de la musique.
de: Ich kann der Faszination der Musik nicht entkommen.
it: Non posso sfuggire al fascino della musica.
pt: Não consigo escapar do fascínio da música.
ru: Я не могу убежать от очарования музыки.
hi: मैं संगीत के आकर्षण से भाग नहीं सकता।
zh: 我无法逃避音乐的魅力。
ja: 音楽の魅力から逃れることはできません。
ko: 저는 음악의 매력에서 도망칠 수 없습니다.
vi: Tôi không thể chạy trốn khỏi sự mê hoặc của âm nhạc.
sv: Jag kan inte fly från fascinationen för musik.
nl: Ik kan niet ontsnappen aan de fascinatie van muziek.
el: Δεν μπορώ να ξεφύγω από τη γοητεία της μουσικής.
ar: لا أستطيع الهروب من سحر الموسيقى.

text: We often play chess.
text_en: We often play chess.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of habit. No specific gender or addressee is implied, so defaults are used.
es: Jugamos al ajedrez a menudo.
es_latam: Jugamos al ajedrez a menudo.
fr: Nous jouons souvent aux échecs.
de: Wir spielen oft Schach.
it: Giochiamo spesso a scacchi.
pt: Nós jogamos xadrez com frequência.
hi: हम अक्सर शतरंज खेलते हैं।
ja: 私たちはよくチェスをします。
vi: Chúng tôi thường chơi cờ vua.
sv: Vi spelar ofta schack.
nl: We schaken vaak.
el: Παίζουμε συχνά σκάκι.

text: I am a foreigner.
text_en: I am a foreigner.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple declarative statement. Gender is set to neutral as there are no contextual cues to override the pre-assigned default.
es: Soy extranjero.
es_latam: Soy extranjero.
fr: Je suis étranger.

it: Sono straniero.
pt: Eu sou estrangeiro.
hi: मैं एक विदेशी हूँ।
ja: 私は外国人です。
vi: Tôi là người nước ngoài.
sv: Jag är utlänning.
nl: Ik ben een buitenlander.
el: Είμαι ξένος.

text: I'm the adviser.
text_en: I'm the adviser.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues in the text.

es_latam: Soy la asesora.

pt: Eu sou a assessora.

ja: 私は顧問です。

text: The number of people capable of conversing in the language is declining.
text_en: The number of people capable of conversing in the language is declining.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual statement without a direct addressee. The speaker gender is set to the default female as there are no gendered cues.
es: El número de personas capaces de conversar en el idioma está disminuyendo.
es_latam: La cantidad de personas capaces de conversar en el idioma está disminuyendo.
fr: Le nombre de personnes capables de converser dans la langue est en train de diminuer.
de: Die Anzahl der Personen, die in der Sprache konversieren können, nimmt ab.
it: Il numero di persone in grado di conversare nella lingua sta diminuendo.
pt: O número de pessoas capazes de conversar no idioma está diminuindo.
ru: Число людей, способных поддерживать беседу на этом языке, сокращается.
hi: इस भाषा में बातचीत करने में सक्षम लोगों की संख्या घट रही है।
zh: 能够使用该语言进行交流的人数正在减少。
ja: その言語で会話ができる人の数は減少しています。
ko: 해당 언어로 대화할 수 있는 사람들의 수가 줄어들고 있습니다.
vi: Số lượng người có khả năng giao tiếp bằng ngôn ngữ này đang giảm dần.
sv: Antalet personer som kan konversera på språket minskar.
fi: Kieltä puhumaan kykenevien ihmisten määrä on vähenemässä.
nl: Het aantal mensen dat in de taal kan converseren, neemt af.
el: Ο αριθμός των ατόμων που είναι σε θέση να συνομιλούν στη γλώσσα μειώνεται.
ar: إن عدد الأشخاص القادرين على التحدث بهذه اللغة في تناقص.

text: This ghost photo is well made, but it's just a composite.
text_en: This ghost photo is well made, but it's just a composite.
en_notes: The sentence is a neutral observation. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults as there are no linguistic cues to indicate otherwise.
es: Esta foto de fantasmas está bien hecha, pero es solo un montaje.
es_latam: Esta foto de fantasmas está bien hecha, pero es solo un montaje.
fr: Cette photo de fantôme est bien faite, mais ce n'est qu'un montage.
de: Dieses Geisterfoto ist gut gemacht, aber es ist nur eine Montage.
it: Questa foto di fantasmi è ben fatta, ma è solo un fotomontaggio.
pt: Esta foto de fantasma está bem feita, mas é apenas uma montagem.
ru: Это фото с привидением сделано хорошо, но это просто фотомонтаж.
hi: यह भूत वाली तस्वीर अच्छी तरह से बनाई गई है, लेकिन यह केवल एक मिश्रित चित्र है।
zh: 这张鬼照片制作得很好，但它只是张合成照。
ja: この心霊写真はよくできていますが、ただの合成です。
ko: 이 심령사진은 잘 만들어졌지만, 그냥 합성일 뿐이에요.
vi: Bức ảnh ma này được làm rất tốt, nhưng nó chỉ là ảnh ghép thôi.
sv: Den här spökbilden är väl gjord, men det är bara ett montage.
fi: Tämä kummituskuva on hyvin tehty, mutta se on vain kuvamanipulaatio.
nl: Deze spookfoto is goed gemaakt, maar het is gewoon een montage.
el: Αυτή η φωτογραφία με το φάντασμα είναι καλοφτιαγμένη, αλλά είναι απλώς ένα φωτομοντάζ.
ar: هذه الصورة للشبح متقنة الصنع، لكنها مجرد صورة مركبة.
corrections_summary: hi: 'कंपोजिट' is a transliteration; replaced with 'मिश्रित चित्र' for better naturalness. zh: '合成的' (adjective) changed to '合成照' (noun) to match the English noun 'composite'.

text: Cooks are dicing onions, stirring sausage, slicing tuna in slender chunks, their work spare and clean.
text_en: Cooks are dicing onions, stirring sausage, and slicing tuna in slender chunks, their work spare and clean.
en_notes: Added a coordinating conjunction for better flow. The speaker gender remains female as per the default since the subject is plural and gender-neutral.
es: Los cocineros están picando cebollas, removiendo las salchichas y cortando atún en trozos delgados; su trabajo es sobrio y limpio.
es_latam: Los cocineros están picando cebollas, revolviendo las salchichas y cortando atún en trozos delgados; su trabajo es sobrio y limpio.
fr: Les cuisiniers coupent des oignons en dés, remuent de la chair à saucisse et tranchent du thon en morceaux fins, leur travail étant sobre et net.
de: Die Köche würfeln Zwiebeln, rühren Würste um und schneiden Thunfisch in schmale Stücke, ihre Arbeit ist schlicht und sauber.
it: I cuochi stanno tagliando cipolle a dadini, mescolando salsicce e affettando tonno in pezzi sottili, con un lavoro essenziale e pulito.
pt: Os cozinheiros estão picando cebolas, mexendo linguiças e fatiando atum em pedaços finos, com um trabalho contido e limpo.
ru: Повара режут лук кубиками, помешивают колбаски и нарезают тунец тонкими ломтиками; их работа сдержанна и аккуратна.
hi: रसोइए प्याज काट रहे हैं, सॉसेज चला रहे हैं, और ट्यूना को पतले टुकड़ों में काट रहे हैं, उनका काम सधा हुआ और साफ-सुथरा है।
zh: 厨师们正在将洋葱切丁，搅拌香肠，并将金枪鱼切成薄片，他们的动作简练而利落。
ja: 料理人たちが玉ねぎをみじん切りにし、ソーセージをかき混ぜ、マグロを細長く切っています。その手つきは無駄がなく、鮮やかです。
ko: 요리사들이 양파를 다지고 소시지를 저으며 참치를 얇게 썰고 있는데, 그들의 작업은 군더더기 없이 깔끔합니다.
vi: Các đầu bếp đang thái hành tây, đảo xúc xích và thái cá ngừ thành những miếng mỏng, công việc của họ thật gọn gàng và sạch sẽ.
sv: Kockarna tärnar lök, rör om korv och skivar tonfisk i tunna bitar, deras arbete är återhållsamt och rent.
fi: Kokit kuutioivat sipulia, hämmentävät makkaraa ja viipaloivat tonnikalaa ohuiksi paloiksi; heidän työnsä on vähäeleistä ja puhdasta.
nl: De koks snijden uien in blokjes, roeren in de worst en snijden tonijn in dunne plakken, hun werk is sober en netjes.
el: Οι μάγειρες ψιλοκόβουν κρεμμύδια, ανακατεύουν λουκάνικα και κόβουν τον τόνο σε λεπτά κομμάτια, με την εργασία τους να είναι λιτή και καθαρή.
ar: الطهاة يقطعون البصل، ويحركون السجق، ويقطعون التونة إلى قطع رفيعة، وعملهم يتسم بالبساطة والنظافة.
corrections_summary: es: 'removiendo' is less natural for cooking than 'removiendo' or 'salteando' but 'removiendo' is acceptable; however, 'con un trabajo' is slightly clunky → changed to 'su trabajo es sobrio y limpio' for better flow. es_latam: 'revolviendo' is good, but improved flow of the final clause. fr: 'remuent des saucisses' sounds like stirring whole sausages → changed to 'la chair à saucisse' or 'des morceaux de saucisse' to imply the meat being cooked. ja: '手つき' (handwork/technique) is a more natural translation for 'work' in this culinary context than '仕事'. zh: '动作' (movements) is more natural than '工作' for describing the physical act of dicing/slicing.

text: Damiano was dreaming about the planet.
text_en: Damiano was dreaming about the planet.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as there is no indication of who is speaking. The subject 'Damiano' is a typically male name, but he is the subject of the narrative, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Damiano estaba soñando con el planeta.
es_latam: Damiano estaba soñando con el planeta.
fr: Damiano était en train de rêver de la planète.
de: Damiano träumte gerade von dem Planeten.
it: Damiano stava sognando il pianeta.
pt: Damiano estava sonhando com o planeta.
hi: दामियानो ग्रह के बारे में सपना देख रहा था।
zh: 达米亚诺当时正梦见那个星球。
ja: ダミアーノはその惑星について夢を見ていました。
ko: 다미아노는 그 행성에 대한 꿈을 꾸고 있었습니다.
vi: Damiano đang mơ về hành tinh này.
sv: Damiano drömde om planeten.
nl: Damiano was aan het dromen over de planeet.
el: Ο Νταμιάνο ονειρευόταν τον πλανήτη.
corrections_summary: ru: The original translation 'Дамиано снилась планета' implies the planet appeared in his dream passively; 'Дамиано мечтал о планете' or 'Дамиано видел во сне планету' is better, but 'Дамиано видел сон о планете' or 'Дамиано грезил о планете' are options. However, for a literal past continuous 'was dreaming', 'Дамиано видел сон о планете' is more accurate to the English structure, but 'Дамиано грезил о планете' is often used for 'dreaming about'. To maintain the literal sense of sleeping/dreaming: 'Дамиано видел во сне планету'.

text: He is so mild in disposition that I have never heard him speak in a loud voice.
text_en: He is so mild in disposition that I have never heard him speak in a loud voice.
en_notes: The speaker gender defaults to female as per instructions since the text does not specify it. The subject 'He' is the person being described, not the addressee.
es: Es de un carácter tan apacible que nunca le he oído hablar en voz alta.
es_latam: Es de un carácter tan apacible que nunca lo he oído hablar en voz alta.
fr: Il est d'un tempérament si doux que je ne l'ai jamais entendu parler d'une voix forte.
de: Er ist von so sanftem Wesen, dass ich ihn noch nie mit lauter Stimme habe sprechen hören.
it: È di indole così mite che non l'ho mai sentito parlare a voce alta.
pt: Ele é de uma índole tão branda que eu nunca o ouvi falar em voz alta.
ru: У него такой мягкий характер, что я никогда не слышала, чтобы он говорил на повышенных тонах.
hi: उनका स्वभाव इतना कोमल है कि मैंने उन्हें कभी ऊँची आवाज़ में बात करते नहीं सुना है।
zh: 他的性格如此温和，以至于我从未听过他大声说话。
ja: 彼はとても穏やかな気性の持ち主なので、私は彼が大声で話すのを聞いたことがありません。
ko: 그분은 성품이 매우 온화하셔서 저는 그분이 큰 소리로 말씀하시는 것을 들어본 적이 없습니다.
vi: Anh ấy có tính cách ôn hòa đến mức tôi chưa bao giờ nghe thấy anh ấy nói lớn tiếng.
sv: Han har ett så milt sinnelag att jag aldrig har hört honom tala med hög röst.
fi: Hän on luonteeltaan niin lempeä, etten ole koskaan kuullut hänen puhuvan kovalla äänellä.
nl: Hij is zo zachtaardig van karakter dat ik hem nog nooit met verheven stem heb horen spreken.
el: Είναι τόσο πράος στον χαρακτήρα που δεν τον έχω ακούσει ποτέ να μιλάει με δυνατή φωνή.
ar: إنه دمث الأخلاق لدرجة أنني لم أسمعه قط يتحدث بصوت عالٍ.

text: I'm fairly old-fashioned.
text_en: I'm fairly old-fashioned.
en_notes: The speaker's gender is set to female based on the pre-assigned default as the sentence is gender-neutral. 'Old-fashioned' is treated as literal in the sense of adhering to traditional values.
es: Soy bastante anticuada.
es_latam: Soy bastante anticuada.
fr: Je suis assez vieux jeu.
de: Ich bin ziemlich altmodisch.
it: Sono piuttosto all'antica.
pt: Eu sou bastante antiquada.
hi: मैं काफी पुराने खयालों की हूँ।
ja: 私はかなり古風です。
vi: Tôi khá cổ hủ.
sv: Jag är ganska gammaldags.
nl: Ik ben nogal ouderwets.
el: Είμαι αρκετά παλιομοδίτισσα.
corrections_summary: ar: The adjective was masculine → changed to feminine 'قديمة' to match speaker_gender.

text: He's not a charismatic leader.
text_en: He's not a charismatic leader.
en_notes: The speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults as the sentence is a third-person statement about a male subject. The register is neutral as it is a standard descriptive statement.
es: Él no es un líder carismático.
es_latam: Él no es un líder carismático.
fr: Ce n'est pas un leader charismatique.
de: Er ist keine charismatische Führungspersönlichkeit.
it: Lui non è un leader carismatico.
pt: Ele não é um líder carismático.
hi: वह एक करिश्माई नेता नहीं है।
zh: 他不是一位有魅力的领导者。
ja: 彼はカリスマ的なリーダーではありません。
vi: Ông ấy không phải là một nhà lãnh đạo có sức hút.
sv: Han är inte en karismatisk ledare.
nl: Hij is geen charismatisch leider.
el: Δεν είναι χαρισματικός ηγέτης.

text: This is chess.
text_en: This is chess.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple declarative statement. Gender defaults were applied as there are no contextual cues to suggest otherwise.
es: Esto es ajedrez.
es_latam: Esto es ajedrez.
fr: Ce sont des échecs.
de: Das ist Schach.
it: Questi sono scacchi.
pt: Isso é xadrez.
hi: यह शतरंज है।
ja: これはチェスです。
vi: Đây là cờ vua.
sv: Det här är schack.
nl: Dit is schaken.
el: Αυτό είναι σκάκι.
corrections_summary: fr: 'C'est des échecs' is grammatically colloquial; changed to 'C'est le jeu d'échecs' or 'Ce sont des échecs' for better neutral register, but 'C'est du jeu d'échecs' is too heavy, so 'C'est le jeu d'échecs' is preferred. However, 'C'est du jeu d'échecs' is not standard; 'C'est le jeu d'échecs' is better. Actually, 'C'est des échecs' is common but 'Ce sont des échecs' is grammatically correct for plural. nl: 'Dit is schaak' means 'This is check' (the move); changed to 'Dit is schaken' for the game.

text: He eats beans only if he has no pending social engagements.
text_en: He eats beans only if he has no pending social engagements.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement about a third party ('he'), so there is no direct addressee. The speaker gender remains neutral as it is not specified.
es: Él solo come alubias si no tiene compromisos sociales pendientes.
es_latam: Él solo come frijoles si no tiene compromisos sociales pendientes.
fr: Il ne mange des haricots que s'il n'a pas d'engagements sociaux à venir.
de: Er isst Bohnen nur, wenn er keine ausstehenden sozialen Verpflichtungen hat.
it: Mangia fagioli solo se non ha impegni sociali in sospeso.
pt: Ele só come feijão se não tiver compromissos sociais pendentes.
ru: Он ест фасоль только в том случае, если у него нет предстоящих социальных обязательств.
hi: वह फलियाँ तभी खाता है जब उसकी कोई सामाजिक प्रतिबद्धता लंबित न हो।
zh: 只有在没有待处理的社交约会时，他才会吃豆子。
ja: 彼は社交的な予定がない場合にのみ豆を食べます。
ko: 그는 남은 사교 모임이 없을 때만 콩을 먹습니다.
vi: Anh ấy chỉ ăn đậu nếu không có các cuộc hẹn xã giao chưa giải quyết.
sv: Han äter bönor endast om han inte har några utestående sociala åtaganden.
fi: Hän syö papuja vain, jos hänellä ei ole rästissä olevia sosiaalisia sitoumuksia.
nl: Hij eet alleen bonen als hij geen openstaande sociale verplichtingen heeft.
el: Τρώει φασόλια μόνο αν δεν έχει εκκρεμείς κοινωνικές υποχρεώσεις.
ar: يأكل الفاصوليا فقط إذا لم يكن لديه أي التزامات اجتماعية معلقة.

text: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.

text: The proposal has not been fully agreed upon. I propose to simplify it.
text_en: The proposal has not been fully agreed upon. I propose to simplify it.
en_notes: The sentence is formal in tone due to the professional context of a proposal. The speaker gender is neutral as per the default, and the addressee gender is female as per the default, as there are no specific gender markers in the text.
es: La propuesta no ha sido acordada plenamente. Le propongo simplificarla.
es_latam: La propuesta no ha sido acordada plenamente. Le propongo simplificarla.
fr: La proposition n'a pas été pleinement acceptée. Je vous propose de la simplifier.
de: Der Vorschlag wurde noch nicht vollständig angenommen. Ich schlage Ihnen vor, ihn zu vereinfachen.
it: La proposta non è stata pienamente concordata. Le propongo di semplificarla.
pt: A proposta não foi totalmente acordada. Eu lhe proponho simplificá-la.
ru: Предложение не было полностью согласовано. Я предлагаю Вам его упростить.
hi: प्रस्ताव पर पूरी तरह से सहमति नहीं बनी है। मैं इसे सरल बनाने का प्रस्ताव देता/देती हूँ।
zh: 该提案尚未达成完全一致。我建议您将其简化。
ja: 提案はまだ完全には合意されていません。簡素化することを提案いたします。
ko: 제안서에 대한 합의가 완전히 이루어지지 않았습니다. 이를 단순화할 것을 제안합니다.
vi: Đề xuất vẫn chưa được thống nhất hoàn toàn. Tôi đề nghị bà nên đơn giản hóa nó.
sv: Förslaget har inte godtagits helt och hållet. Jag föreslår att du förenklar det.
fi: Ehdotuksesta ei ole päästy täyteen yhteisymmärrykseen. Ehdotan teille sen yksinkertaistamista.
nl: Over het voorstel is nog geen volledige overeenstemming bereikt. Ik stel u voor om het te vereenvoudigen.
el: Η πρόταση δεν έχει συμφωνηθεί πλήρως. Σας προτείνω να την απλοποιήσετε.
ar: لم يتم الاتفاق بالكامل على المقترح. أقترح عليكِ تبسيطه.
corrections_summary: hi: speaker gender was masculine → changed to neutral/formal plural 'hum' or standard neutral 'main' with neutral verb ending; sv: used plural 'ni' for singular addressee → changed to 'dig' (or 'Ni' if archaic formal, but 'du' is standard even in formal Swedish now, however 'ni' is often used as a formal singular in business contexts, but 'dig' is safer for singular); ja: added formal 'watashi' or kept polite structure to ensure the 'I' is clear in a formal context.

text: She draws beautifully.
text_en: She draws beautifully.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains neutral as it is not specified. The addressee gender is set to not_applicable because this is a declarative statement about a third party, not a direct address.
es: Ella dibuja de maravilla.
es_latam: Ella dibuja muy hermoso.
fr: Elle dessine magnifiquement.
de: Sie zeichnet wunderschön.
it: Lei disegna magnificamente.
pt: Ela desenha lindamente.
hi: वह बहुत सुंदर चित्र बनाती है।
ja: 彼女は絵をとても上手に描きます。
vi: Cô ấy vẽ rất đẹp.
sv: Hon tecknar vackert.
nl: Ze tekent prachtig.
el: Σχεδιάζει υπέροχα.
corrections_summary: es_latam: 'hermosamente' is grammatically correct but less natural than 'muy bien' or 'hermoso' in this context → changed to 'dibuja muy hermoso' for better flow; ar: the absolute object construction 'رسمًا جميلاً' is slightly formal/literary → changed to 'ترسم بجمال' for a more neutral, direct translation of the adverbial phrase.

text: Can you spare me a few liters of petrol?
text_en: Can you spare me a few liters of petrol?
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request using the modal 'can'. The speaker and addressee genders are set to defaults as there are no contextual clues.
es: ¿Me puedes dar unos litros de gasolina?
es_latam: ¿Me puedes dar unos litros de gasolina?
fr: Peux-tu me donner quelques litres d'essence ?
de: Kannst du mir ein paar Liter Benzin geben?
it: Puoi darmi qualche litro di benzina?
pt: Você pode me dar alguns litros de gasolina?
ru: Ты можешь дать мне несколько литров бензина?
hi: क्या तुम मुझे कुछ लीटर पेट्रोल दे सकते हो?
ja: ガソリンを数リットル分けてもらえますか？
ko: 휘발유 몇 리터만 빌려줄 수 있나요?
vi: Bạn có thể cho tôi vài lít xăng được không?
sv: Kan du avvara några liter bensin?
fi: Voitko antaa minulle muutaman litran bensiiniä?
nl: Kun je me een paar liter benzine geven?
el: Μπορείς να μου δώσεις λίγα λίτρα βενζίνη;
ar: هل يمكنك إعطائي بضعة لترات من البنزين؟
corrections_summary: hi: speaker gender was incorrectly marked as female in the verb ending → changed 'सकती' to 'सकते' to reflect neutral/masculine default for the addressee and general request form.

text: I'm not excluding them.
text_en: I'm not excluding them.
en_notes: The sentence is in the present continuous tense. Speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues to override them.
es: No los estoy excluyendo.
es_latam: No los estoy excluyendo.
fr: Je ne les exclus pas.
de: Ich schließe sie nicht aus.
it: Non li sto escludendo.
pt: Eu não os estou excluindo.
hi: मैं उन्हें बाहर नहीं कर रही हूँ।
ja: 彼らを排除しているわけではありません。
vi: Tôi không loại trừ họ.
sv: Jag utesluter dem inte.
nl: Ik sluit hen niet uit.
el: Δεν τους αποκλείω.

text: Petals are flying in the wind.
text_en: Petals are flying in the wind.
en_notes: The sentence is a descriptive statement about a natural occurrence. No specific gender or addressee is implied, so defaults were used.
es: Los pétalos vuelan al viento.
es_latam: Los pétalos vuelan al viento.
fr: Des pétales volent au vent.
de: Blütenblätter fliegen im Wind.
it: I petali volano nel vento.
pt: Pétalas estão voando ao vento.
hi: पंखुड़ियाँ हवा में उड़ रही हैं।
ja: 花びらが風に舞っています。
vi: Những cánh hoa đang bay trong gió.
sv: Kronblad flyger i vinden.
nl: Bloemblaadjes vliegen in de wind.
el: Πέταλα πετούν στον άνεμο.
corrections_summary: ru: 'летают' implies multidirectional/aimless movement, 'летят' is more natural for being carried by the wind → Лепестки летят по ветру.

text: I grew up on a farm and living in the city never made me stop loving the countryside.
text_en: I grew up on a farm and living in the city never made me stop loving the countryside.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement about the speaker's past and feelings; the pre-assigned male gender for the speaker is maintained as there are no gender-specific cues.
es: Crecí en una granja y vivir en la ciudad nunca hizo que dejara de amar el campo.
es_latam: Crecí en una granja y vivir en la ciudad nunca hizo que dejara de amar el campo.
fr: J'ai grandi dans une ferme et vivre en ville ne m'a jamais fait cesser d'aimer la campagne.
de: Ich bin auf einem Bauernhof aufgewachsen, und das Leben in der Stadt hat mich nie dazu gebracht, das Landleben weniger zu lieben.
it: Sono cresciuto in una fattoria e vivere in città non mi ha mai fatto smettere di amare la campagna.
pt: Eu cresci em uma fazenda e morar na cidade nunca me fez deixar de amar o campo.
ru: Я вырос на ферме, и жизнь в городе никогда не заставляла меня разлюбить деревню.
hi: मैं एक खेत में पला-बढ़ा हूँ और शहर में रहने से ग्रामीण इलाकों के प्रति मेरा प्यार कभी कम नहीं हुआ।
zh: 我在农场长大，在城市生活从未让我停止对乡村的热爱。
ja: 私は農場で育ちました。都会に住んでいても、田舎を愛する気持ちは変わりませんでした。
ko: 저는 농장에서 자랐고, 도시에 사는 것이 시골을 사랑하는 마음을 멈추게 하지는 못했습니다.
vi: Tôi lớn lên ở một trang trại và việc sống ở thành phố chưa bao giờ làm tôi ngừng yêu vùng nông thôn.
sv: Jag växte upp på en bondgård och att bo i staden fick mig aldrig att sluta älska landsbygden.
fi: Kasvoin maatilalla, eikä kaupungissa asuminen koskaan saanut minua lakkaamaan rakastamasta maaseutua.
nl: Ik ben opgegroeid op een boerderij en het leven in de stad heeft me er nooit toe gebracht om minder van het platteland te houden.
el: Μεγάλωσα σε μια φάρμα και η ζωή στην πόλη δεν με έκανε ποτέ να σταματήσω να αγαπώ την ύπαιθρο.
ar: لقد نشأتُ في مزرعة، ولم يجعلني العيش في المدينة أتوقف أبدًا عن حب الريف.
corrections_summary: it: corrected past participle to masculine 'cresciuto' to match speaker_gender (male); ru: corrected past tense verb to masculine 'вырос' to match speaker_gender (male).

text: Strive to simplify everything.
text_en: Strive to simplify everything.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative, which implies a direct address to another person. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues to override them.
es: Esfuérzate por simplificarlo todo.
es_latam: Esfuérzate por simplificar todo.
fr: Efforce-toi de tout simplifier.
de: Bemühe dich, alles zu vereinfachen.
it: Impegnati a semplificare tutto.
pt: Esforce-se para simplificar tudo.
hi: सब कुछ सरल करने का प्रयास करो।
ja: すべてを簡素化するように努めてください。
vi: Hãy cố gắng đơn giản hóa mọi thứ.
sv: Sträva efter att förenkla allt.
nl: Streef ernaar om alles te vereenvoudigen.
el: Προσπάθησε να απλοποιήσεις τα πάντα.

text: We're hooked on TV.
text_en: We're hooked on TV.
en_notes: The phrase 'hooked on' is figurative, meaning addicted to or very interested in. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no specific cues.
es: Estamos enganchadas a la tele.
es_latam: Estamos enganchadas a la tele.
fr: On est accros à la télé.
de: Wir sind total süchtig nach Fernsehen.
it: Siamo fissate con la TV.
pt: A gente está viciada na TV.
hi: हमें टीवी की लत लग गई है।
ja: 私たちはテレビに夢中なの。
vi: Chúng mình bị nghiện TV rồi.
sv: Vi är fast för TV:n.
nl: We zijn verslingerd aan de tv.
el: Έχουμε κολλήσει με την τηλεόραση.
corrections_summary: pt: 'viciada' is singular but 'A gente' represents 'we', while grammatically correct, 'viciadas' (plural) or 'viciados' is more common in some contexts, however, 'viciada' matches the feminine speaker gender correctly for the collective noun; no change needed. sv: 'fast vid' is more literal (stuck to), 'fast för' or 'hookade på' is better for addiction/interest → changed to 'Vi är fast för TV:n'.

text: Around the corner was a field full of golden stalks of wheat.
text_en: Around the corner was a field full of golden stalks of wheat.
en_notes: The sentence is a descriptive narrative statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned, so addressee fields are marked as not applicable.
es: A la vuelta de la esquina había un campo lleno de espigas de trigo doradas.
es_latam: A la vuelta de la esquina había un campo lleno de espigas de trigo doradas.
fr: Au détour du chemin se trouvait un champ rempli de tiges de blé dorées.
de: Um die Ecke lag ein Feld voller goldener Weizenhalme.
it: Dietro l'angolo c'era un campo pieno di spighe di grano dorate.
pt: Ao virar a esquina, havia um campo cheio de hastes de trigo douradas.
ru: За углом было поле, полное золотых колосьев пшеницы.
hi: कोने के पास सुनहरी गेहूं की बालियों से भरा एक खेत था।
zh: 拐角处有一片长满金色麦穗的田地。
ja: 角を曲がったところに、黄金色の小麦の穂でいっぱいの畑がありました。
ko: 모퉁이를 돌자 황금빛 밀 이삭으로 가득 찬 들판이 있었습니다.
vi: Quanh góc đường là một cánh đồng đầy những bông lúa mì vàng óng.
sv: Runt hörnet fanns ett fält fullt av gyllene veteax.
fi: Kulman takana oli pelto täynnä kultaisia vehnänkorsia.
nl: Om de hoek lag een veld vol gouden tarwehalmen.
el: Στη γωνία υπήρχε ένα χωράφι γεμάτο με χρυσά στάχυα σιταριού.
ar: كان خلف المنعطف حقل مليء بسنابل القمح الذهبية.

text: Tom and Mary are extremely competent.
text_en: Tom and Mary are extremely competent.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement about two third parties (Tom and Mary). No addressee is present.
es: Tom y Mary son extremadamente competentes.
es_latam: Tom y Mary son extremadamente competentes.
fr: Tom et Mary sont extrêmement compétents.
de: Tom und Mary sind äußerst kompetent.
it: Tom e Mary sono estremamente competenti.
pt: Tom e Mary são extremamente competentes.
hi: टॉम और मैरी बेहद सक्षम हैं।
zh: 汤姆和玛丽非常有能力。
ja: トムとメアリーは非常に有能です。
vi: Tom và Mary cực kỳ có năng lực.
sv: Tom och Mary är extremt kompetenta.
fi: Tom ja Mary ovat erittäin päteviä.
nl: Tom en Mary zijn uiterst bekwaam.
el: Ο Τομ και η Μαίρη είναι εξαιρετικά ικανοί.
corrections_summary: ar: Dual masculine form is required for a mixed-gender pair (Tom and Mary) in MSA → corrected to 'كفؤان' (dual masculine) from the generic plural/singular form.

text: No spoilers, please!
text_en: No spoilers, please!
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative request. The register is informal due to the clipped phrasing, and the addressee number is set to plural as this is commonly addressed to a group or general audience.
es: ¡Sin spoilers, por favor!
es_latam: ¡Sin spoilers, por favor!
fr: Pas de spoilers, s'il vous plaît !
de: Keine Spoiler, bitte!
it: Niente spoiler, per favore!
pt: Sem spoilers, por favor!
hi: कृपया स्पॉइलर न दें!
ja: ネタバレ禁止でお願いします！
vi: Đừng tiết lộ nội dung nhé, làm ơn!
sv: Inga spoilers, tack!
nl: Geen spoilers, alsjeblieft!
el: Όχι spoilers, παρακαλώ!
corrections_summary: fr: register was formal (s'il vous plaît) → changed to informal plural (s'il vous te plaît is singular, so s'il vous plaît is often used, but for informal plural 's'il vous plaît' is standard, however 'pas de spoilers' is already informal; no change needed for register but checked for plural consistency), ko: register was polite/neutral → changed to informal plural (말아 줘요 to 말아 줘), ar: gender/number was correct but phrasing could be more natural for a general request → refined.

text: He's never moving to the countryside again.
text_en: He's never moving to the countryside again.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no cues to the contrary. The subject of the sentence is male ('He'), but the speaker is a third party.
es: Él no volverá a mudarse al campo nunca más.
es_latam: Él no va a mudarse al campo nunca más.
fr: Il ne déménagera plus jamais à la campagne.
de: Er zieht nie wieder aufs Land.
it: Non si trasferirà mai più in campagna.
pt: Ele nunca mais vai se mudar para o campo.
ru: Он больше никогда не переедет в сельскую местность.
hi: वह फिर कभी गाँव नहीं जा रहा है।
zh: 他再也不会搬到农村去了。
ja: 彼は二度と田舎に引っ越すことはありません。
ko: 그는 다시는 시골로 이사하지 않을 거예요.
vi: Anh ấy sẽ không bao giờ chuyển về quê nữa.
sv: Han kommer aldrig att flytta till landsbygden igen.
fi: Hän ei muuta enää koskaan maaseudulle.
nl: Hij verhuist nooit meer naar het platteland.
el: Δεν πρόκειται να μετακομίσει ποτέ ξανά στην επαρχία.
ar: إنه لن ينتقل إلى الريف مرة أخرى أبداً.

text: All she left of the apple was the stalk.
text_en: All she left of the apple was the stalk.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no cues to the contrary. The subject 'she' refers to a third party, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Todo lo que dejó de la manzana fue el rabo.
es_latam: Todo lo que dejó de la manzana fue el cabo.
fr: Tout ce qu'elle a laissé de la pomme était la queue.
de: Alles, was sie von dem Apfel übrig ließ, war der Stiel.
it: Tutto ciò che ha lasciato della mela è stato il picciolo.
pt: Tudo o que ela deixou da maçã foi o talo.
ru: Всё, что она оставила от яблока, — это плодоножка.
hi: उसने सेब का केवल डंठल ही छोड़ा।
zh: 她吃剩的苹果只剩下一个梗。
ja: 彼女がリンゴで残したのは芯だけだった。
vi: Tất cả những gì cô ấy để lại của quả táo là cái cuống.
sv: Allt hon lämnade kvar av äpplet var stjälken.
fi: Ainoa mitä hän jätti omenasta jäljelle, oli kanta.
nl: Het enige wat ze van de appel overliet, was het steeltje.
el: Το μόνο που άφησε από το μήλο ήταν το κοτσάνι.
ar: كل ما تركته من التفاحة كان العنق.
corrections_summary: zh: phrasing was slightly unnatural/wordy → simplified to a more native structure; ja: '茎' (kuki) refers to plant stems, '芯' (shin) or 'ヘタ' (heta) is used for fruit cores/stalks → corrected to '芯' (core/stalk).

text: I don't like to impose on others.
text_en: I don't like to impose on others.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of preference. No specific gender or addressee is implied, so pre-assigned defaults are used.
es: No me gusta molestar a los demás.
es_latam: No me gusta incomodar a los demás.
fr: Je n'aime pas m'imposer aux autres.
de: Ich mag es nicht, mich anderen aufzudrängen.
it: Non mi piace impormi agli altri.
pt: Não gosto de me impor aos outros.
hi: मुझे दूसरों पर अपनी बात थोपना पसंद नहीं है।
ja: 他人に迷惑をかけるのは好きではありません。
ko: 저는 남에게 폐를 끼치는 것을 좋아하지 않습니다.
vi: Tôi không thích làm phiền người khác.
sv: Jag gillar inte att tränga mig på andra.
nl: Ik hou er niet van om mezelf aan anderen op te dringen.
el: Δεν μου αρέσει να επιβάλλομαι στους άλλους.
ar: لا أحب أن أفرض نفسي على الآخرين.
corrections_summary: hi: The translation 'bozh banna' (becoming a burden) is slightly more specific than 'impose' → changed to 'thopna' (impose) to better match the literal meaning; zh: 'dǎrǎo' (disturb) is a bit weak for 'impose' → changed to 'qiángjiā' (impose/force upon) to better reflect the English verb.

text: The birds pecked grains.
text_en: The birds pecked grains.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple narrative statement with no specific addressee or speaker cues, so default genders and neutral register are used.
es: Los pájaros picotearon granos.
es_latam: Los pájaros picotearon granos.
fr: Les oiseaux ont picoté des graines.
de: Die Vögel pickten Körner.
it: Gli uccelli hanno beccato dei chicchi.
pt: Os pássaros bicaram grãos.
hi: पक्षियों ने दाने चुगे।
ja: 鳥たちは穀物をついばんだ。
vi: Những con chim đã mổ những hạt ngũ cốc.
sv: Fåglarna pickade sädeskorn.
nl: De vogels pikten korrels.
el: Τα πουλιά τσίμπησαν σπόρους.
corrections_summary: pt: used imperfect past instead of simple past → changed 'bicavam' to 'bicaram'; ru: used imperfective aspect → changed 'клевали' to 'поклевали' to better reflect the simple past/completed action; sv: 'korn' refers to the specific crop barley → changed to 'frön' (seeds) or 'sädeskorn' (grains) for accuracy.

text: I'm not a big fan of this show, but I know I'm not the target demographic.
text_en: I'm not a big fan of this show, but I know I'm not the target demographic.
en_notes: The sentence uses the idiom 'big fan' to express a lack of interest, which is categorized as figurative. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: No soy una gran fan de esta serie, pero sé que no soy el público objetivo.
es_latam: No soy una gran fan de este programa, pero sé que no soy el público objetivo.
fr: Je ne suis pas une grande fan de cette émission, mais je sais que je ne suis pas le public cible.
de: Ich bin kein großer Fan dieser Serie, aber ich weiß, dass ich nicht zur Zielgruppe gehöre.
it: Non sono una grande fan di questo show, ma so di non essere il pubblico di riferimento.
pt: Não sou muito fã deste programa, mas sei que não sou o público-alvo.
ru: Я не большая поклонница этого шоу, но я знаю, что не являюсь целевой аудиторией.
hi: मैं इस शो की बहुत बड़ी प्रशंसिका नहीं हूँ, लेकिन मुझे पता है कि मैं इसकी लक्षित दर्शिका नहीं हूँ।
zh: 我不太喜欢这个节目，但我知道我不是它的目标受众。

corrections_summary: hi: Grammar error in gender agreement. Since the speaker is female and the object 'पांडुलिपि' (manuscript) is feminine, the verb 'पढ़ी' is correct, but the ergative construction 'मैंने' requires the verb to agree with the object. However, the original translation used 'पढ़ी' correctly for a feminine object, but the phrasing was slightly unnatural; 'पढ़ी' is correct, but 'को' is often omitted in this context for better flow. More importantly, 'reread... again' is redundant in English and the Hindi 'फिर से' covers 'again', while 'पढ़ी' covers 'read'.

ar: ما يمثله النحت لكتلة الرخام، تمثله التربية للروح البشرية.

text: Mary got out of the bathtub and dried herself with the new towel that Tom had given her.

corrections_summary: ru: speaker_gender is neutral but translation used masculine 'съел' → changed to past tense 'съела' or 'съел' is impossible to avoid in past tense, so used a gender-neutral construction 'если я съем'; hi: register was slightly too informal for 'Would you mind' → adjusted to a more polite neutral form; ar: 'donuts' is better translated as 'الدونات' as 'الكعكات' means cakes/cookies.

corrections_summary: it: 'rintracciare' implies finding a lost object/person, 'tracciare' or 'seguire le tracce' is better for wildlife tracking → changed to 'seguire le tracce di'; hi: the translation used present tense 'can I' instead of the conditional/past-narrative 'could I' → adjusted to 'क्या मैं कभी पानी के नीचे जानवरों का पता लगा पाऊँगा?' to reflect the speculative nature.

corrections_summary: hi: The pronoun 'वह' (vah) is used for both 'that' and 'it', but the second sentence sounds more natural with 'यह' (yah) or omitting the pronoun; however, the main issue is the gender of 'bird' (पक्षी - pakshi) which is masculine, making the current translation acceptable but slightly repetitive. ja: 'コウカンチョウ' is the technical name, but 'ショウジョウゼン' or simply 'カーディナル' is more common in casual contexts; however, the current is correct. vi: 'hồng tước' usually refers to a redstart or scarlet minivet; 'hồng tước bắc mỹ' or simply 'chim hồng quan' is more accurate for a Cardinal.

en_notes: The 'you' is interpreted as a generic or impersonal pronoun common in descriptive narratives, but is categorized as singular for translation purposes. The simile comparing the sky to a glass dome is marked as figurative.
es: Se podía ver a kilómetros a la redonda, y el cielo sobre ti era como una gran cúpula de cristal.
es_latam: Se podía ver a kilómetros a la redonda, y el cielo sobre ti era como una gran cúpula de cristal.
fr: On pouvait voir à des kilomètres à la ronde, et le ciel au-dessus était comme un immense dôme de verre.
de: Man konnte meilenweit um sich herum sehen, und der Himmel darüber war wie eine riesige Glaskuppel.
it: Si poteva vedere per chilometri e chilometri tutto intorno, e il cielo sopra era come una grande cupola di vetro.
pt: Dava para ver por quilômetros ao redor, e o céu acima era como uma grande cúpula de vidro.
ru: Вокруг можно было видеть на многие мили, а небо над головой было словно огромный стеклянный купол.
hi: तुम अपने चारों ओर मीलों दूर तक देख सकती थीं, और ऊपर का आकाश एक विशाल काँच के गुंबद जैसा था।

ko: 사방 몇 마일 앞까지 내다볼 수 있었고, 머리 위의 하늘은 거대한 유리 돔 같았어요.
vi: Bạn có thể nhìn xa hàng dặm xung quanh, và bầu trời phía trên giống như một mái vòm bằng thủy tinh khổng lồ.
sv: Man kunde se miltals omkring sig, och himlen ovanför var som en stor glaskupa.
fi: Ympärilleen näki kilometrien päähän, ja yllä oleva taivas oli kuin suuri lasikupu.
nl: Je kon mijlenver om je heen kijken, en de hemel boven je was als een grote glazen koepel.
el: Μπορούσες να δεις σε απόσταση χιλιομέτρων γύρω σου, και ο ουρανός από πάνω ήταν σαν ένας μεγάλος γυάλινος θόλος.
ar: كان بإمكانك رؤية أميال وأميال من حولك، وكانت السماء فوقك كأنها قبة زجاجية عظيمة.
corrections_summary: hi: gender agreement → changed to feminine 'सकती' to match speaker_gender; zh: register/naturalness → adjusted to a more literary '尽收眼底' and '宛如' to better reflect the figurative tone.

text: The dancers look delicate in their white dresses, but they are really as strong as horses.

es_latam: Las bailarinas se ven delicadas en sus vestidos blancos, pero en realidad son tan fuertes como caballos.

nl: De danseressen zien er tenger uit in hun witte jurken, maar eigenlijk zijn ze zo sterk als paarden.

ar: تبدو الراقصات رقيقات بفساتينهن البيضاء، لكنهن في الحقيقة قويات كالأحصنة.
corrections_summary: es: changed 'robles' to 'caballos' to match the source simile; es_latam: changed 'robles' to 'caballos' to match the source simile; fr: changed 'chênes' to 'chevaux' to match the source simile; it: changed 'querce' to 'cavalli' to match the source simile; pt: changed 'leoas' to 'cavalos' to match the source simile; zh: changed '力大如牛' (strong as an ox) to '像马一样强壮' to match the source simile; sv: changed 'oxar' to 'hästar' to match the source simile; fi: changed 'härät' to 'hevoset' to match the source simile; nl: changed 'beren' to 'paarden' to match the source simile; el: changed 'ταύροι' to 'άλογα' to match the source simile.

sv: Vet du hur man löser den här gåtan?
nl: Weet je hoe je dit raadsel moet oplossen?
el: Ξέρεις πώς να λύσεις αυτό το αίνιγμα;
ar: هل تعرف كيف تحل هذا اللغز؟

text: Are the ducks flying?
text_en: Are the ducks flying?
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward question in the present continuous tense. No gender or number for the addressee is implied, so defaults are used.
es: ¿Están volando los patos?
es_latam: ¿Están volando los patos?
fr: Est-ce que les canards volent ?
de: Fliegen die Enten?
it: Le anatre stanno volando?
pt: Os patos estão voando?
hi: क्या बत्तखें उड़ रही हैं?
ja: アヒルは飛んでいますか？
vi: Những con vịt đang bay phải không?
sv: Flyger ankorna?
nl: Zijn de eenden aan het vliegen?
el: Πετάνε οι πάπιες;
corrections_summary: ar: used the specific plural for small numbers/feminine group 'بطات' which is less common for general ducks → changed to the more natural collective plural 'البط'.

text: What would be preferable?
text_en: What would be preferable?
en_notes: The sentence uses a conditional modal verb to ask for a preference. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues.
es: ¿Qué sería preferible?
es_latam: ¿Qué sería preferible?
fr: Qu'est-ce qui serait préférable ?
de: Was wäre vorzuziehen?
it: Cosa sarebbe preferibile?
pt: O que seria preferível?
hi: क्या बेहतर होगा?
ja: 何が好ましいでしょうか？
vi: Điều gì sẽ được ưu tiên hơn?
sv: Vad skulle vara att föredra?
nl: Wat zou de voorkeur hebben?
el: Τι θα ήταν προτιμότερο;
corrections_summary: zh: unnatural phrasing → changed to a more natural expression of preference; ar: used 'the best' instead of 'preferable' → corrected to match the conditional preference meaning.

text: When did the fog lift?
text_en: When did the fog lift?
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward inquiry about weather conditions. No gender-specific markers are present, so the pre-assigned defaults are used.
es: ¿Cuándo se disipó la niebla?
es_latam: ¿Cuándo se despejó la neblina?
fr: Quand le brouillard s'est-il dissipé ?
de: Wann hat sich der Nebel gelichtet?
it: Quando si è diradata la nebbia?
pt: Quando a neblina se dissipou?
hi: कोहरा कब हटा?
ja: 霧はいつ晴れましたか？
vi: Sương mù tan khi nào?
sv: När lättade dimman?
nl: Wanneer trok de mist op?
el: Πότε διαλύθηκε η ομίχλη;

text: Are you sniffing?
text_en: Are you sniffing?
en_notes: The sentence is a direct question in the present continuous tense. Gender defaults are applied as there are no contextual cues to override them.
es: ¿Estás olfateando?
es_latam: ¿Estás olfateando?
fr: Tu renifles ?
de: Schnupperst du gerade?
it: Stai annusando?
pt: Você está fungando?
hi: क्या तुम सूंघ रहे हो?
ja: クンクンしてるの？
vi: Anh đang ngửi à?
sv: Sniffar du?
nl: Ben je aan het snuffelen?
el: Μυρίζεις;
corrections_summary: fr: 'renifler' is more natural than 'être en train de' for this short query → 'Tu renifles ?', ru: 'принюхиваешься' implies searching for a scent, 'шмыгаешь носом' is more common for the physical act of sniffing → 'Ты шмыгаешь носом?', zh: '闻' (smell) is less specific than '闻来闻去' or '嗅' for the action of sniffing → '你在嗅吗？', ar: 'تشم' (smell) corrected to 'تستنشق' for the physical act of sniffing → 'هل تستنشق؟'

text: I explored the cave by myself.
text_en: I explored the cave by myself.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement in the past tense. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default of female as there are no gender-specific cues.
es: Exploré la cueva yo sola.
es_latam: Exploré la cueva yo sola.
fr: J'ai exploré la grotte toute seule.
de: Ich habe die Höhle alleine erkundet.
it: Ho esplorato la grotta da sola.
pt: Eu explorei a caverna sozinha.
hi: मैंने अकेली ही गुफा की खोज की।
zh: 我独自探索了那个洞穴。
ja: 私は一人でその洞窟を探索しました。
vi: Tôi đã tự mình khám phá hang động.
sv: Jag utforskade grottan själv.
nl: Ik heb de grot in mijn eentje verkend.
el: Εξερεύνησα τη σπηλιά μόνη μου.

text: Unless it's absolutely necessary, I don't use taxis.
text_en: Unless it's absolutely necessary, I don't use taxis.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement of habit. The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: A menos que sea absolutamente necesario, no uso taxis.
es_latam: A menos que sea absolutamente necesario, no uso taxis.
fr: À moins que ce ne soit absolument nécessaire, je ne prends pas de taxi.
de: Sofern es nicht absolut notwendig ist, benutze ich keine Taxis.
it: A meno che non sia assolutamente necessario, non prendo i taxi.
pt: A menos que seja absolutamente necessário, não uso táxis.
ru: Если в этом нет крайней необходимости, я не пользуюсь такси.
hi: जब तक बिल्कुल ज़रूरी न हो, मैं टैक्सी का इस्तेमाल नहीं करता हूँ।
zh: 除非绝对必要，否则我不坐出租车。
ja: どうしても必要な場合を除き、私はタクシーを使いません。
ko: 절대적으로 필요하지 않은 한, 저는 택시를 타지 않아요.
vi: Trừ khi thực sự cần thiết, tôi không đi taxi.
sv: Om det inte är absolut nödvändigt använder jag inte taxi.
fi: En käytä taksia, ellei se ole täysin välttämätöntä.
nl: Tenzij het absoluut noodzakelijk is, gebruik ik geen taxi's.
el: Εκτός αν είναι απολύτως απαραίτητο, δεν χρησιμοποιώ ταξί.
ar: لا أستخدم سيارات الأجرة إلا إذا كان ذلك ضرورياً للغاية.

text: The rain was almost horizontal. We had to move elsewhere to stay dry.
text_en: The rain was almost horizontal. We had to move elsewhere to stay dry.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual narrative statement. The speaker gender remains neutral as 'we' does not specify gender, and there is no direct addressee.
es: La lluvia caía casi horizontalmente. Tuvimos que movernos a otro lugar para no mojarnos.
es_latam: La lluvia caía casi horizontalmente. Tuvimos que movernos a otro lugar para mantenernos secos.
fr: La pluie tombait presque à l'horizontale. Nous avons dû nous déplacer ailleurs pour rester au sec.
de: Der Regen fiel fast waagerecht. Wir mussten uns woandershin begeben, um trocken zu bleiben.
it: La pioggia cadeva quasi orizzontalmente. Abbiamo dovuto spostarci altrove per rimanere asciutti.
pt: A chuva caía quase na horizontal. Tivemos que nos deslocar para outro lugar para ficarmos secos.
ru: Дождь шел почти горизонтально. Нам пришлось перейти в другое место, чтобы не промокнуть.
hi: बारिश लगभग आड़ी पड़ रही थी। सूखा रहने के लिए हमें कहीं और जाना पड़ा।
zh: 雨几乎是横着下的。为了不被淋湿，我们不得不换个地方。
ja: 雨はほとんど横殴りでした。濡れないように別の場所に移動しなければなりませんでした。
ko: 비가 거의 가로로 내렸습니다. 우리는 젖지 않기 위해 다른 곳으로 이동해야 했습니다.
vi: Mưa rơi gần như nằm ngang. Chúng tôi đã phải di chuyển đi nơi khác để giữ cho người khô ráo.
sv: Regnet föll nästan horisontellt. Vi var tvungna att flytta oss någon annanstans för att hålla oss torra.
fi: Sade piiskasi melkein vaakasuoraan. Meidän oli siirryttävä muualle pysyäksemme kuivina.
nl: De regen viel bijna horizontaal. We moesten ergens anders heen gaan om droog te blijven.
el: Η βροχή έπεφτε σχεδόν οριζόντια. Έπρεπε να μετακινηθούμε αλλού για να παραμείνουμε στεγνοί.
ar: كان المطر يهطل بشكل أفقي تقريباً. اضطررنا للانتقال إلى مكان آخر لنبقى جافين.
corrections_summary: hi: 'क्षैतिज' (horizontal) is too technical for weather; used a more natural expression for driving rain. ja: '横殴り' (driving/sideways rain) is the perfect idiomatic fit for horizontal rain. fi: Added 'piiskasi' (lashed) which is more natural for this context.

text: If he had any friends or any credit, we undertook that he should lose them.
text_en: If he had any friends or any credit, we undertook that he should lose them.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to female per the default as 'we' is gender-neutral. The addressee gender and number are set to not_applicable as this is a narrative statement about a third party.
es: Si tenía amigos o crédito alguno, nos comprometimos a que los perdiera.
es_latam: Si tenía amigos o crédito alguno, nos comprometimos a que los perdiera.
fr: S'il avait des amis ou du crédit, nous nous sommes engagés à ce qu'il les perde.
de: Sollte er Freunde oder Kredit gehabt haben, so verpflichteten wir uns dazu, dass er diese verlieren würde.
it: Se avesse avuto amici o credito, ci impegnammo affinché li perdesse.
pt: Se ele tivesse amigos ou qualquer crédito, nós nos comprometemos a fazer com que ele os perdesse.
ru: Если у него были друзья или какое-либо доверие, мы обязались сделать так, чтобы он их лишился.
hi: यदि उसके पास कोई मित्र या कोई साख थी, तो हमने वचन दिया कि वह उन्हें खो देगा।
zh: 如果他有任何朋友或任何信誉，我们承诺让他失去这些。
ja: 彼に友人や信用があったとしても、私たちは彼がそれらを失うように取り計らいました。
ko: 그에게 친구나 신용이 있었다면, 우리는 그가 그것들을 잃게 하겠다고 약속했습니다.
vi: Nếu ông ta có bất kỳ người bạn hay uy tín nào, chúng tôi đã cam kết rằng ông ta sẽ mất hết chúng.
sv: Om han hade några vänner eller någon kredit, åtog vi oss att se till att han förlorade dem.
fi: Jos hänellä oli ystäviä tai luottoa, me sitouduimme siihen, että hän menettäisi ne.
nl: Als hij vrienden of krediet had, verbonden wij ons ertoe dat hij deze zou verliezen.
el: Αν είχε φίλους ή οποιαδήποτε πίστωση, αναλάβαμε να τα χάσει.
ar: إذا كان لديه أي أصدقاء أو أي ائتمان، فقد تعهدنا بأن يفقدهم.
corrections_summary: fr: used simple past (engageâmes) which is very literary, but 'perde' should be in the imperfect subjunctive 'perdît' for formal consistency, or use present subjunctive for modern formal; however, 'nous nous sommes engagés' is more natural for formal speech → adjusted to 'nous nous sommes engagés à ce qu'il les perde'; it: adjusted to 'ci impegnammo affinché li perdesse' for better formal flow; zh: '失去他们' is slightly unnatural for credit, changed to '失去这一切' or '失去这些' → '失去这些'; ar: 'صيت' means reputation/fame, 'ائتمان' is better for financial/social credit → 'ائتمان'

text: The fog began to disappear around ten o'clock.
text_en: The fog began to disappear around ten o'clock.
en_notes: No disambiguation needed. The sentence is a factual narrative statement with no specific speaker or addressee cues.
es: La niebla empezó a desaparecer alrededor de las diez.
es_latam: La niebla comenzó a desaparecer alrededor de las diez.
fr: Le brouillard a commencé à disparaître vers dix heures.
de: Der Nebel begann sich gegen zehn Uhr aufzulösen.
it: La nebbia ha cominciato a sparire verso le dieci.
pt: A neblina começou a desaparecer por volta das dez horas.
ru: Туман начал рассеиваться около десяти часов.
hi: कोहरा दस बजे के आसपास गायब होने लगा।
zh: 雾在十点左右开始消散。
ja: 霧は10時ごろに消え始めました。
vi: Sương mù bắt đầu tan vào khoảng mười giờ.
sv: Dimman började försvinna vid tiotiden.
nl: De mist begon rond tien uur te verdwijnen.
el: Η ομίχλη άρχισε να εξαφανίζεται γύρω στις δέκα.
ar: بدأ الضباب في الاختفاء في حدود الساعة العاشرة.

text: All the royalties went to charity.
text_en: All the royalties went to charity.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward factual statement. The speaker and addressee genders are set to the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual clues to suggest otherwise.
es: Toda la recaudación de derechos de autor se destinó a la beneficencia.
es_latam: Todas las regalías se destinaron a obras de caridad.
fr: Toutes les redevances ont été versées à des œuvres de bienfaisance.
de: Sämtliche Tantiemen gingen an wohltätige Zwecke.
it: Tutte le royalty sono andate in beneficenza.
pt: Todos os royalties foram para a caridade.
ru: Все авторские отчисления пошли на благотворительность.
hi: सभी रॉयल्टी दान में दे दी गई।
zh: 所有的版税都捐给了慈善机构。
ja: 印税はすべて慈善団体に寄付されました。
vi: Tất cả tiền bản quyền đã được chuyển cho tổ chức từ thiện.
sv: Alla royaltyintäkter gick till välgörenhet.
nl: Alle royalty's gingen naar het goede doel.
el: Όλα τα πνευματικά δικαιώματα δόθηκαν σε φιλανθρωπικούς σκοπούς.
ar: ذهبت جميع العائدات إلى الأعمال الخيرية.

text: He says he was framed.
text_en: He says he was framed.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default. The subject 'He' refers to a third party, not the speaker or addressee. 'Framed' is categorized as figurative as it is an idiom meaning to be falsely accused.
es: Él dice que le tendieron una trampa.
es_latam: Él dice que le tendieron una trampa.
fr: Il dit qu'on lui a tendu un piège.
de: Er sagt, ihm wurde eine Falle gestellt.
it: Dice di essere stato incastrato.
pt: Ele diz que foi vítima de uma armação.
hi: वह कहता है कि उसे फँसाया गया है।
ja: 彼は、自分ははめられたと言っています。
vi: Anh ấy nói rằng anh ấy đã bị gài bẫy.
sv: Han säger att han blev ditsatt.
nl: Hij zegt dat hij erin is geluisd.
el: Λέει ότι τον παγίδευσαν.
ar: يقول إنه قد تم الإيقاع به.

text: The tanker has a small crew.
text_en: The tanker has a small crew.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward factual statement. No disambiguation was needed for gender or register, so defaults were applied.
es: El petrolero tiene una tripulación pequeña.
es_latam: El buque tanque tiene una tripulación pequeña.
fr: Le pétrolier a un petit équipage.
de: Der Tanker hat eine kleine Besatzung.
it: La nave cisterna ha un piccolo equipaggio.
pt: O navio-tanque tem uma tripulação pequena.
hi: टैंकर में चालक दल के सदस्यों की संख्या कम है।
ja: そのタンカーの乗組員は少ないです。
vi: Tàu chở dầu có thủy thủ đoàn ít người.
sv: Tankfartyget har en liten besättning.
nl: De tanker heeft een kleine bemanning.
el: Το δεξαμενόπλοιο έχει μικρό πλήρωμα.

text: Enjoy this weather while it lasts.
text_en: Enjoy this weather while it lasts.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative addressed to a single person or group; I have kept the pre-assigned female gender for the addressee and set the number to singular as the most common default for direct advice.
es: Disfruta de este tiempo mientras dure.
es_latam: Disfruta de este clima mientras dure.
fr: Profite de ce temps tant qu'il dure.
de: Genieße dieses Wetter, solange es anhält.
it: Goditi questo tempo finché dura.
pt: Aproveite este tempo enquanto ele dura.
ru: Наслаждайся этой погодой, пока она держится.
hi: इस मौसम का आनंद लो जब तक यह रहता है।
zh: 趁着这种天气还在，尽情享受吧。
ja: この天気が続くうちに楽しんでください。
vi: Hãy tận hưởng thời tiết này khi nó còn kéo dài.
sv: Njut av det här vädret så länge det varar.
fi: Nauti tästä säästä niin kauan kuin sitä kestää.
nl: Geniet van dit weer zolang het duurt.
el: Απόλαυσε αυτόν τον καιρό όσο διαρκεί.
ar: استمتعي بهذا الطقس ما دام مستمراً.
corrections_summary: ko: grammatical error in the connective particle → fixed to '날씨가 지속되는 동안'; ar: improved naturalness for the temporal clause → changed to 'ما دام مستمراً'

text: Keep your collection of toys in the designated storage bins.
text_en: Keep your collection of toys in the designated storage bins.
en_notes: The sentence is an instruction or command, which classifies it as imperative. The addressee is singular by default in a typical instructional context, though it could be plural; singular is chosen as the most common direct address.
es: Guarda tu colección de juguetes en los contenedores de almacenamiento designados.
es_latam: Guarda tu colección de juguetes en los contenedores de almacenamiento designados.
fr: Garde ta collection de jouets dans les bacs de rangement désignés.
de: Bewahre deine Spielzeugsammlung in den dafür vorgesehenen Aufbewahrungsbehältern auf.
it: Conserva la tua collezione di giocattoli negli appositi contenitori.
pt: Guarde sua coleção de brinquedos nos recipientes de armazenamento designados.
ru: Храни свою коллекцию игрушек в предназначенных для этого контейнерах.
hi: खिलौनों के अपने संग्रह को निर्धारित भंडारण डिब्बों में रखें।
zh: 请将你收藏的玩具放在指定的储物箱中。
ja: おもちゃのコレクションは、指定された収納ボックスに保管してください。
vi: Hãy cất bộ sưu tập đồ chơi của bạn vào các thùng lưu trữ được chỉ định.
sv: Förvara din leksakssamling i de avsedda förvaringslådorna.
nl: Bewaar je verzameling speelgoed in de daarvoor bestemde opbergbakken.
el: Φύλαξε τη συλλογή παιχνιδιών σου στα καθορισμένα κουτιά αποθήκευσης.
ar: احتفظ بمجموعتك من الألعاب في صناديق التخزين المخصصة.

text: Send them a thank-you note for their hospitality.
text_en: Send them a thank-you note for their hospitality.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative, which implies a direct command or request to an addressee. The addressee number is singular by default in a neutral context.
es: Envíales una nota de agradecimiento por su hospitalidad.
es_latam: Envíales una nota de agradecimiento por su hospitalidad.
fr: Envoie-leur un mot de remerciement pour leur hospitalité.
de: Schicke ihnen eine Dankeskarte für ihre Gastfreundschaft.
it: Manda loro un biglietto di ringraziamento per la loro ospitalità.
pt: Mande-lhes um cartão de agradecimento pela hospitalidade.
ru: Отправь им благодарственную записку за их гостеприимство.
hi: उनकी मेहमाननवाज़ी के लिए उन्हें धन्यवाद पत्र भेजें।
zh: 给他们的热情款待寄一封感谢信。
ja: 彼らのおもてなしに対して感謝状を送ってください。
ko: 그들의 환대에 대해 감사 편지를 보내세요.
vi: Hãy gửi cho họ một lá thư cảm ơn vì sự hiếu khách của họ.
sv: Skicka dem ett tackkort för deras gästfrihet.
nl: Stuur hen een bedankje voor hun gastvrijheid.
el: Στείλε τους ένα ευχαριστήριο σημείωμα για τη φιλοξενία τους.
ar: أرسل لهم رسالة شكر على حسن ضيافتهم.
corrections_summary: de: 'Dankeschön' is slightly informal/abstract; 'Dankesschreiben' or 'Dankeskarte' is more accurate for 'note' → changed to 'Dankeskarte'. pt: 'Envie-lhes' is formal/imperative; 'Mande' is more natural for neutral Brazilian Portuguese → changed to 'Mande-lhes'.

text: The bearer of this letter is my friend Suzuki.
text_en: The bearer of this letter is my friend Suzuki.
en_notes: The register is formal due to the use of 'bearer'. Suzuki is a common Japanese surname, which is gender-neutral, so the speaker and addressee genders remain neutral as per defaults.
es: El portador de esta carta es mi amigo Suzuki.
es_latam: El portador de esta carta es mi amigo Suzuki.
fr: Le porteur de cette lettre est mon ami Suzuki.
de: Der Überbringer dieses Briefes ist mein Freund Suzuki.
it: Il portatore di questa lettera è il mio amico Suzuki.
pt: O portador desta carta é o meu amigo Suzuki.
ru: Предъявитель этого письма — мой друг Судзуки.
hi: इस पत्र के वाहक मेरे मित्र सुजुकी हैं।
zh: 这封信的递信人是我的朋友铃木。
ja: この手紙の持参人は、私の友人である鈴木です。
ko: 이 편지를 가져온 사람은 제 친구 스즈키입니다.
vi: Người mang bức thư này là người bạn Suzuki của tôi.
sv: Bäraren av detta brev är min vän Suzuki.
fi: Tämän kirjeen tuoja on ystäväni Suzuki.
nl: De brenger van deze brief is mijn vriend Suzuki.

text: She struggled with a persistent leak under her kitchen sink, causing damage to the cabinet.
text_en: She struggled with a persistent leak under her kitchen sink, causing damage to the cabinet.
en_notes: The speaker_gender is set to neutral as the speaker is an outside narrator. The subject of the sentence is female based on the pronouns 'she' and 'her'.
es: Ella tuvo problemas con una fuga persistente bajo el fregadero de su cocina, lo que causó daños en el mueble.
es_latam: Ella tuvo problemas con una fuga persistente debajo del fregadero de su cocina, lo que causó daños en el gabinete.
fr: Elle a dû faire face à une fuite persistante sous l'évier de sa cuisine, ce qui a endommagé le meuble.
de: Sie hatte mit einem hartnäckigen Leck unter ihrer Küchenspüle zu kämpfen, das den Schrank beschädigte.
it: Ha lottato con una perdita persistente sotto il lavello della sua cucina, che ha causato danni al mobile.
pt: Ela teve problemas com um vazamento persistente sob a pia da cozinha, o que causou danos ao armário.
ru: Она боролась с постоянной протечкой под кухонной мойкой, которая повредила шкаф.
hi: वह अपनी रसोई के सिंक के नीचे एक लगातार होने वाले रिसाव से परेशान थी, जिससे कैबिनेट को नुकसान पहुँचा।
zh: 她一直在处理厨房水槽下持续的漏水问题，这导致了橱柜受损。
ja: 彼女はキッチンの流しの下のしつこい水漏れに悩まされ、キャビネットが損傷しました。
ko: 그녀는 주방 싱크대 아래의 지속적인 누수로 고생했고, 그로 인해 수납장이 손상되었습니다.
vi: Cô ấy đã phải vật lộn với một vết rò rỉ dai dẳng dưới bồn rửa bát, gây hư hỏng cho tủ bếp.
sv: Hon kämpade med en ihållande läcka under diskbänken, vilket orsakade skador på skåpet.
fi: Hän kamppaili keittiön tiskialtaan alla olevan jatkuvan vuodon kanssa, mikä vaurioitti kaappia.
nl: Ze worstelde met een aanhoudend lek onder haar gootsteen, wat schade aan het kastje veroorzaakte.
el: Πάλευε με μια επίμονη διαρροή κάτω από τον νεροχύτη της κουζίνας της, η οποία προκάλεσε ζημιά στο ντουλάπι.
ar: عانت من تسرب مستمر تحت مغسلة مطبخها، مما تسبب في تلف الخزانة.

text: The workers hammered spikes into the wooden beams to secure the structure.
text_en: The workers hammered spikes into the wooden beams to secure the structure.
en_notes: The sentence is a factual description of a past event. No specific gender is implied for the workers or the speaker, so the pre-assigned speaker gender is used.
es: Los trabajadores clavaron clavos en las vigas de madera para asegurar la estructura.
es_latam: Los trabajadores clavaron clavos en las vigas de madera para asegurar la estructura.
fr: Les ouvriers ont enfoncé des pointes dans les poutres en bois pour fixer la structure.
de: Die Arbeiter schlugen Nägel in die Holzbalken, um die Struktur zu sichern.
it: Gli operai hanno conficcato dei grossi chiodi nelle travi di legno per fissare la struttura.
pt: Os trabalhadores martelaram grandes pregos nas vigas de madeira para fixar a estrutura.
ru: Рабочие вбили костыли в деревянные балки, чтобы закрепить конструкцию.
hi: मज़दूरों ने संरचना को सुरक्षित करने के लिए लकड़ी के शहतीरों में कीलें ठोंकीं।
zh: 工人们将大钉钉入木梁以加固结构。
ja: 作業員たちは構造を固定するために、木製の梁に犬釘を打ち込んだ。
ko: 인부들은 구조물을 고정하기 위해 나무 보에 대못을 박았습니다.
vi: Các công nhân đã đóng những chiếc đinh lớn vào các dầm gỗ để cố định cấu trúc.
sv: Arbetarna slog in spikar i träbalkarna för att säkra konstruktionen.
fi: Työntekijät löivät nauloja puupalkkeihin rakenteen kiinnittämiseksi.
nl: De arbeiders sloegen spijkers in de houten balken om de constructie vast te zetten.
el: Οι εργάτες κάρφωσαν μεγάλα καρφιά στα ξύλινα δοκάρια για να στερεώσουν την κατασκευή.
ar: دَقَّ العُمَّالُ مَساميرَ في العَوارِضِ الخَشَبِيَّةِ لِتَثبيتِ الهَيْكَل.
corrections_summary: es: 'pernos' means bolts, changed to 'clavos' for spikes; es_latam: 'pernos' means bolts, changed to 'clavos' for spikes; de: 'Bolzen' means bolts, changed to 'Nägel' for spikes; fi: 'piikkejä' is too literal/sharp, changed to 'nauloja' (nails) for construction context.

text: But she had not expected to cross an ocean, enter a new and romantic-sounding country, and find herself in exactly the same position.
text_en: But she had not expected to cross an ocean, enter a new and romantic-sounding country, and find herself in exactly the same position.
en_notes: The speaker gender is neutral as it is a third-person narrative. The subject 'she' and the reflexive pronoun 'herself' indicate the protagonist is female, but she is not the speaker.
es: Pero ella no había esperado cruzar un océano, entrar en un país nuevo que sonaba romántico y encontrarse exactamente en la misma situación.
es_latam: Pero ella no había esperado cruzar un océano, entrar en un país nuevo con nombre romántico y encontrarse exactamente en la misma situación.
fr: Mais elle ne s'était pas attendue à traverser un océan, à entrer dans un nouveau pays au nom romantique et à se retrouver exactement dans la même situation.
de: Aber sie hatte nicht erwartet, einen Ozean zu überqueren, in ein neues und romantisch klingendes Land einzureisen und sich in genau der gleichen Lage wiederzufinden.
it: Ma non si era aspettata di attraversare un oceano, entrare in un nuovo paese dal nome romantico e trovarsi esattamente nella stessa situazione.
pt: Mas ela não tinha esperado atravessar um oceano, entrar em um país novo e de nome romântico, e se encontrar exatamente na mesma situação.
ru: Но она не ожидала, что пересечет океан, попадет в новую страну с романтичным названием и окажется в точно таком же положении.
hi: लेकिन उसने एक महासागर पार करने, एक नए और सुनने में रोमांटिक लगने वाले देश में प्रवेश करने और खुद को बिल्कुल उसी स्थिति में पाने की उम्मीद नहीं की थी।
zh: 但她没料到自己会跨越重洋，进入一个听起来很浪漫的新国家，却发现自己处于完全相同的境地。
ja: しかし、彼女は海を渡り、ロマンチックな響きの新しい国に入りながらも、結局は自分が全く同じ立場に置かれることになるとは予想していなかった。
ko: 하지만 그녀는 대양을 건너 낭만적으로 들리는 새로운 나라에 들어와서 자신이 정확히 똑같은 상황에 처하게 될 줄은 예상하지 못했다.
vi: Nhưng cô đã không ngờ rằng mình sẽ băng qua một đại dương, đặt chân đến một đất nước mới nghe có vẻ lãng mạn, để rồi lại thấy mình ở chính xác vị trí cũ.
sv: Men hon hade inte väntat sig att korsa en ocean, komma till ett nytt och romantiskt klingande land, och befinna sig i exakt samma situation.
fi: Mutta hän ei ollut odottanut ylittävänsä valtamerta, saapuvansa uuteen ja romanttiselta kuulostavaan maahan ja huomaavansa olevansa täsmälleen samassa tilanteessa.
nl: Maar ze had niet verwacht een oceaan over te steken, een nieuw en romantisch klinkend land binnen te gaan en zich in precies dezelfde positie te bevinden.
el: Αλλά δεν είχε περιμένει να διασχίσει έναν ωκεανό, να μπει σε μια νέα και ρομαντική στο άκουσμα χώρα και να βρεθεί ακριβώς στην ίδια θέση.
ar: لكنها لم تكن تتوقع أن تعبر محيطاً، وتدخل بلداً جديداً ذا اسم رومانسي، وتجد نفسها في نفس الموقف تماماً.
corrections_summary: es: 'posición' is a literal translation of 'position' but 'situación' is more natural for a life circumstance → changed to 'situación'; es_latam: 'posición' changed to 'situación' for naturalness; fr: 'position' changed to 'situation' to better reflect the figurative meaning of life circumstances; it: 'posizione' changed to 'situazione' for naturalness; pt: 'posição' changed to 'situação' for naturalness.

pt: Aqui estão alguns truques que podem ajudá-lo a fazer somas de cabeça.
ru: Вот несколько приемов, которые помогут тебе складывать числа в уме.
hi: यहाँ कुछ तरकीबें दी गई हैं जो आपको मन में जोड़ करने में मदद कर सकती हैं।
zh: 这里有一些可以帮助你进行心算的技巧。
ja: 暗算に役立ついくつかのコツを紹介します。

sv: Här är några knep som kan hjälpa dig med huvudräkning.
fi: Tässä on muutamia niksejä, jotka voivat auttaa sinua laskemaan yhteen päässäsi.
nl: Hier zijn enkele trucs die je kunnen helpen om uit het hoofd op te tellen.

ar: إليك بعض الحيل التي يمكن أن تساعدك في إجراء عمليات الجمع ذهنياً.
corrections_summary: fr: register was informal (t'aider) → changed to neutral/formal (vous aider) to better match the neutral register and general instruction style; de: 'Summen' is technically correct but 'Rechnungen' or 'Kopfrechnen' is more natural for mental arithmetic → adjusted to 'im Kopf zu rechnen'; hi: 'मन ही मन' is more for thoughts → changed to 'जुबानी' or 'मन में' for mental math; sv: 'räkna i huvudet' is fine but 'huvudräkning' is the standard term → adjusted for naturalness.

text: When I was a child, I didn't like tomatoes.
text_en: When I was a child, I didn't like tomatoes.

pt: Quando eu era criança, não gostava de tomates.
ru: В детстве я не любил(а) помидоры.
hi: बचपन में मुझे टमाटर पसंद नहीं थे।

pt: Eles disseram a todos que estavam desempregados.
ru: Они сказали всем, что они были безработными.

zh: 他们告诉所有人他们失业了。
ja: 彼らは失業中であることを皆に話しました。
ko: 그들은 모두에게 자신들이 실직 상태라고 말했습니다.
vi: Họ đã nói với mọi người rằng họ đang thất nghiệp.
sv: De berättade för alla att de var arbetslösa.
nl: Ze vertelden iedereen dat ze werkloos waren.

ar: أخبروا الجميع بأنهم عاطلون عن العمل.

text: Gerda was obliged to rest again, and just opposite the place where she sat, she saw a great crow come hopping across the snow toward her.
text_en: Gerda was obliged to rest again, and just opposite the place where she sat, she saw a great crow come hopping across the snow toward her.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male as per the default, but the subject 'Gerda' and the pronouns 'she' and 'her' clearly identify the protagonist as female. There is no addressee as this is a narrative statement.
es: Gerda se vio obligada a descansar de nuevo y, justo frente al lugar donde estaba sentada, vio a un gran cuervo que venía saltando por la nieve hacia ella.
es_latam: Gerda se vio obligada a descansar de nuevo y, justo frente al lugar donde estaba sentada, vio a un gran cuervo que venía saltando por la nieve hacia ella.
fr: Gerda fut obligée de se reposer à nouveau et, juste en face de l'endroit où elle était assise, elle vit un grand corbeau s'avancer vers elle en sautillant sur la neige.
de: Gerda war gezwungen, sich erneut auszuruhen, und genau gegenüber dem Platz, an dem sie saß, sah sie eine große Krähe über den Schnee auf sich zuhüpfen.
it: Gerda fu costretta a riposarsi di nuovo e, proprio di fronte al luogo in cui sedeva, vide una grande cornacchia venire verso di lei saltellando sulla neve.
pt: Gerda foi obrigada a descansar novamente e, bem em frente ao lugar onde estava sentada, viu um grande corvo vir saltitando pela neve em sua direção.
ru: Герда была вынуждена снова отдохнуть, и как раз напротив того места, где она сидела, она увидела большого ворона, который прыгал по снегу ей навстречу.
hi: गेर्डा को फिर से आराम करने के लिए मजबूर होना पड़ा, और जहाँ वह बैठी थी ठीक उसके सामने, उसने एक बड़े कौवे को बर्फ पर फुदकते हुए अपनी ओर आते देखा।
zh: 格尔达不得不再次休息，就在她坐的地方对面，她看见一只大乌鸦正从雪地上向她跳过来。
ja: ゲルダは再び休まざるを得ませんでした。彼女が座っていた場所のちょうど向かい側で、大きなカラスが雪の上を彼女の方へ跳ねてくるのが見えました。
ko: 게르다는 다시 쉬어야만 했고, 그녀가 앉아 있는 곳 바로 맞은편에서 큰 까마귀 한 마리가 눈 위를 깡충깡충 뛰어 그녀를 향해 오는 것을 보았습니다.
vi: Gerda buộc phải nghỉ ngơi một lần nữa, và ngay đối diện nơi cô ngồi, cô thấy một con quạ lớn đang nhảy lò cò trên tuyết tiến về phía mình.
sv: Gerda var tvungen att vila igen, och precis mittemot platsen där hon satt såg hon en stor kråka komma hoppande över snön mot henne.
fi: Gerda joutui lepäämään uudelleen, ja aivan vastapäätä paikkaa, jossa hän istui, hän näki suuren variksen hyppivän lumella häntä kohti.
nl: Gerda was genoodzaakt opnieuw te rusten, en precies tegenover de plek waar ze zat, zag ze een grote kraai over de sneeuw naar haar toe komen huppelen.
el: Η Γκέρντα αναγκάστηκε να ξεκουραστεί ξανά και, ακριβώς απέναντι από το μέρος όπου καθόταν, είδε ένα μεγάλο κοράκι να έρχεται χοροπηδώντας πάνω στο χιόνι προς το μέρος της.
ar: اضطرت جيردا للراحة مرة أخرى، وفي المقابل تماماً من المكان الذي كانت تجلس فيه، رأت غراباً كبيراً يأتي قافزاً عبر الثلج نحوها.

Given the English 'saloon', the translations should reflect the specific 'Wild West' or 'public house' meaning where applicable. fi: 'saluunaan' is correct for a Western saloon. es: 'salón' is a general room; 'saloon' is used for Westerns. zh: '沙龙' is a literary/artistic salon; '酒吧' or '酒馆' fits a Western saloon. ja: 'サロン' is a beauty/artistic salon; '酒場' fits a Western saloon. ko: '살롱' is a social salon; '술집' fits a Western saloon. vi: 'phòng khách' means living room, which contradicts 'saloon'.

es_latam: «Yo», «ella» y «nosotros» son todos pronombres personales.

pt: “Eu”, “ela” e “nós” são todos pronomes pessoais.
hi: “मैं”, “वह” और “हम” सभी पुरुषवाचक सर्वनाम हैं।
ja: 「私」、「彼女」、「私たち」はすべて人称代名詞です。

el: Το «εγώ», το «αυτή» και το «εμείς» είναι όλα προσωπικές αντωνυμίες.

text: He says he sings bass.
text_en: He says he sings bass.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as the sentence is a third-person report. The subject of the sentence is male based on the pronoun 'he'.
es: Él dice que canta bajo.
es_latam: Él dice que canta bajo.
