de: Er sagt, dass er Bass singt.
it: Dice di cantare come basso.
pt: Ele diz que canta baixo.
hi: वह कहता है कि वह बास गाता है।
ja: 彼はバスを歌うと言っています。
vi: Anh ấy nói rằng anh ấy hát giọng trầm.
sv: Han säger att han sjunger bas.
nl: Hij zegt dat hij bas zingt.
el: Λέει ότι τραγουδάει μπάσο.
corrections_summary: fr: 'basse' is the noun for the instrument or the part, but for a male singer, 'bas' is the correct adverbial/vocal usage in this context → fixed to 'il chante bas'; it: 'Dice di essere un basso' means 'He says he is a bass', which is slightly different from 'He says he sings bass' → fixed to 'Dice di cantare come basso'

text: I go by she/her pronouns.
text_en: I go by she/her pronouns.

es_latam: Mis pronombres son ella/ella.

it: I miei pronomi sono lei/lei.
pt: Meus pronomes são ela/dela.
hi: मेरे सर्वनाम वह/उसकी हैं।

vi: Đại từ của tôi là cô ấy.
sv: Mina pronomen är hon/hennes.
nl: Mijn voornaamwoorden zijn zij/haar.
el: Οι αντωνυμίες μου είναι αυτή/αυτής.
corrections_summary: es: pluralized 'ella' to match plural 'pronombres' → 'ella/ella', es_latam: pluralized 'ella' to match plural 'pronombres' → 'ella/ella', fr: pluralized 'elle' to match plural 'pronoms' → 'elle/elle', it: pluralized 'lei' to match plural 'pronomi' → 'lei/lei', hi: removed unnecessary grammatical label in parentheses for naturalness → 'मेरे सर्वनाम वह/उसकी हैं।', fi: adjusted to a more common phrasing for pronoun preference → 'Käytän pronomeja hän/hänen (feminiini).'

text: You might want to stay seated.
text_en: You might want to stay seated.

es_latam: Tal vez quieras quedarte sentada.

nl: Misschien wil je blijven zitten.

es: Engrasa los moldes de magdalenas y vierte la masa (pero no hasta arriba; ¡las magdalenas subirán!)
es_latam: Engrasa los moldes de magdalenas y vierte la mezcla (pero no hasta arriba; ¡las magdalenas van a subir!)

hi: मेडलीन मोल्ड्स में चिकनाई लगाएँ और घोल डालें (लेकिन पूरा ऊपर तक नहीं; मेडलीन फूलेंगी!)

sv: Smörj madeleineformarna och häll i smeten (men inte ända upp till kanten; madeleinekakorna kommer att höja sig!)

text: You look gloomy.

text: Before we dug our well, we used to carry water from the river.

it: Prima di scavare il nostro pozzo, portavamo l'acqua dal fiume.

ru: До того как мы выкопали свой колодец, мы носили воду из реки.

vi: Trước khi đào giếng, chúng tôi thường gánh nước từ sông về.

fi: Ennen kuin kaivoimme kaivomme, meillä oli tapana kantaa vettä joelta.
nl: Voordat we onze put groeven, haalden we altijd water uit de rivier.

ar: قبل أن نحفر بئرنا، كنا ننقل الماء من النهر.
corrections_summary: fr: 'porter de l'eau' is less natural than 'chercher de l'eau' or 'aller chercher de l'eau' for fetching water from a source → updated to 'chercher de l'eau'; zh: '以前经常' is redundant with the past context and '以前' → simplified to '经常'.

text: He has dazzling white teeth.

text: Are you a deacon?

es_latam: ¿Eres diácono?
fr: Êtes-vous diacre ?
de: Sind Sie ein Diakon?
it: Sei un diacono?
pt: Você é diácono?
hi: क्या आप एक डीकन हैं?
ja: あなたは助祭ですか？
vi: Bạn có phải là phó tế không?
sv: Är du diakon?
nl: Ben je een diaken?
el: Είσαι διάκονος;
corrections_summary: fr: 'Es-tu' is informal, changed to 'Êtes-vous' for neutral register; de: 'Bist du' is informal, changed to 'Sind Sie' for neutral register; ru: 'Ты' is informal, changed to 'Вы' for neutral register; hi: 'तुम' is informal, changed to 'आप' for neutral register; ja: '執事' (shitsuji) usually means butler, changed to '助祭' (jokai) for the religious context of deacon.

text: He was sent abroad as a correspondent.
text_en: He was sent abroad as a correspondent.

es_latam: Fue enviado al extranjero como corresponsal.

text: Some difficulties hindered him from doing it.

es_latam: Algunas dificultades le impidieron hacerlo.
fr: Certaines difficultés l'ont empêché de le faire.

pt: Algumas dificuldades o impediram de fazê-lo.

hi: कुछ कठिनाइयों ने उसे ऐसा करने से रोक दिया।
zh: 一些困难阻碍了他这样做。
ja: いくつかの困難が彼の実行を妨げました。
ko: 몇 가지 어려움이 그가 그것을 하는 것을 방해했습니다.

nl: Sommige moeilijkheden verhinderden hem om het te doen.
el: Ορισμένες δυσκολίες τον εμπόδισαν να το κάνει.
ar: منعته بعض الصعوبات من فعل ذلك.

text: The breeze feels good.
text_en: The breeze feels good.
en_notes: The sentence is a general observation with no specific addressee or gendered cues, so it follows the pre-assigned defaults.
es: La brisa es agradable.
es_latam: La brisa se siente bien.
fr: La brise fait du bien.
de: Die Brise fühlt sich gut an.
it: La brezza è piacevole.
pt: A brisa é agradável.
hi: हवा का झोंका अच्छा लग रहा है।

text: We are nearing our goal.
text_en: We are nearing our goal.

es_latam: Nos estamos acercando a nuestra meta.

text: The dentist told me not to move.

es_latam: El dentista me dijo que no me moviera.

pt: O dentista me disse para não me mexer.
hi: दंत चिकित्सक ने मुझे न हिलने के लिए कहा।

ko: 치과 의사가 나에게 움직이지 말라고 했어요.

text: The crowd erupted in applause as Gabriel waved to them.
text_en: The crowd erupted in applause as Gabriel waved to them.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the pre-assigned default (male) as the narrator is not identified. Gabriel is a typically male name, but he is the subject of the subordinate clause, not the speaker or addressee.
es: La multitud estalló en aplausos cuando Gabriel les saludó con la mano.
es_latam: La multitud estalló en aplausos cuando Gabriel los saludó con la mano.
fr: La foule éclata en applaudissements quand Gabriel leur fit signe de la main.
de: Die Menge brach in Applaus aus, als Gabriel ihnen zuwinkte.
it: La folla esplose in un applauso quando Gabriel li salutò con la mano.
pt: A multidão explodiu em aplausos quando Gabriel acenou para eles.
ru: Толпа взорвалась аплодисментами, когда Габриэль помахал им рукой.
hi: जब गेब्रियल ने उनकी ओर हाथ हिलाया, तो भीड़ तालियों की गड़गड़ाहट से गूँज उठी।
zh: 当加布里埃尔向人群挥手时，全场爆发出了掌声。

ko: 가브리엘이 손을 흔들자 군중은 박수갈채를 터뜨렸습니다.

sv: Publiken brast ut i applåder när Gabriel vinkade till dem.
fi: Yleisö puhkesi suosionosoituksiin Gabrielin vilkuttaessa heille.
nl: De menigte barstte in applaus uit toen Gabriel naar hen zwaaide.
el: Το πλήθος ξέσπασε σε χειροκροτήματα καθώς ο Γκάμπριελ τους χαιρέτησε με το χέρι.
ar: انفجر الحشد بالتصفيق عندما لوّح لهم غابرييل بيده.
corrections_summary: es: 'les' is correct but 'los' is more common for direct objects in many regions, however 'les' is acceptable in Spain; es_latam: 'les' corrected to 'los' for better regional accuracy; fr: changed passé composé to passé simple for literary narrative style; it: changed to 'li salutò' to match the narrative past tense and direct object; hi: adjusted word order for better flow.

text: I opened the envelope and took out the letter.

hi: तूफान के बादल बहुत काले हैं।

text: We restore antique furniture.

text: She didn't try to evade the truth.
text_en: She didn't try to evade the truth.

es: Ella no intentó evadir la verdad.
es_latam: Ella no intentó evadir la verdad.

pt: Ela não tentou evitar a verdade.
ru: Она не пыталась уклониться от истины.
hi: उसने सच से बचने की कोशिश नहीं की।

text: They said they'd be cooperative.

text: Would you like more mashed potatoes?

pt: Você gostaria de mais purê de batatas?
ru: Ты бы хотел ещё картофельного пюре?
hi: क्या तुम थोड़ा और मैश किया हुआ आलू लोगे?
zh: 你想再要一点土豆泥吗？
ja: マッシュポテトをもっといかがですか？

corrections_summary: fr: 'Tu voudrais' is slightly informal for a neutral offer, 'Voudrais-tu' or 'Est-ce que tu voudrais' is better for neutral register; hi: 'आप' is formal, changed to 'तुम' to better reflect the neutral/singular addressee metadata, though 'आप' is also acceptable in polite neutral contexts.

text: Learn to care for your health and how to prepare your system to resist fatigue.

es_latam: Aprende a cuidar tu salud y cómo preparar tu organismo para resistir la fatiga.
fr: Apprends à prendre soin de ta santé et à préparer ton organisme à résister à la fatigue.

it: Impara a prenderti cura della tua salute e come preparare il tuo organismo a resistere alla fatica.

vi: Chúng tôi đang lắp ráp nó!
sv: Vi monterar det!
nl: We zijn het aan het monteren!
el: Το συναρμολογούμε!
corrections_summary: pt: 'montando ele' is colloquial/non-standard in written Brazilian Portuguese → changed to 'Estamos montando-o' or 'Estamos o montando' (standard/neutral).

text: We should try to be philosophical about life; wealth gained could also vanish.
text_en: We should try to be philosophical about life; wealth gained could also vanish.
en_notes: The sentence is a general observation or advice. The register is neutral to slightly formal due to the semicolon and vocabulary choice. No specific gender or addressee number is implied.
es: Deberíamos intentar tomarnos la vida con filosofía; la riqueza obtenida también podría desaparecer.
es_latam: Deberíamos intentar tomarnos la vida con filosofía; la riqueza obtenida también podría desaparecer.
fr: Nous devrions essayer d'être philosophes face à la vie ; la richesse acquise pourrait aussi s'évanouir.
de: Wir sollten versuchen, das Leben philosophisch zu sehen; gewonnener Reichtum könnte auch wieder verschwinden.
it: Dovremmo cercare di prendere la vita con filosofia; la ricchezza acquisita potrebbe anche svanire.
pt: Deveríamos tentar encarar a vida com filosofia; a riqueza conquistada também pode desaparecer.
ru: Нам следует стараться философски относиться к жизни; нажитое богатство может так же легко исчезнуть.
hi: हमें जीवन के प्रति दार्शनिक होने का प्रयास करना चाहिए; अर्जित धन भी गायब हो सकता है।
zh: 我们应该试着达观地对待生活；得来的财富也可能消失。
ja: 人生に対して達観するよう努めるべきです。得た富は消えてしまうこともあるのですから。
ko: 우리는 삶에 대해 달관적인 태도를 가져야 합니다. 얻은 부는 사라질 수도 있기 때문입니다.
vi: Chúng ta nên cố gắng có cái nhìn triết lý về cuộc sống; sự giàu sang có được cũng có thể tan biến.
sv: Vi bör försöka se filosofiskt på livet; vunnen rikedom kan också försvinna.
fi: Meidän tulisi yrittää suhtautua elämään filosofisesti; saavutettu rikkaus voi myös kadota.
nl: We zouden moeten proberen filosofisch in het leven te staan; verkregen rijkdom zou ook weer kunnen verdwijnen.
el: Θα πρέπει να προσπαθήσουμε να είμαστε φιλοσοφημένοι απέναντι στη ζωή· ο πλούτος που αποκτήθηκε μπορεί επίσης να χαθεί.
ar: يجب أن نحاول أن نتحلى بالفلسفة تجاه الحياة؛ فالثروة المكتسبة قد تتلاشى أيضاً.
corrections_summary: pt: 'ser filosóficos' is a literal translation that sounds unnatural in this context → changed to 'encarar a vida com filosofia' to match the idiomatic expression for being philosophical about life.

text: Mary is the maid of honor.
text_en: Mary is the maid of honor.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains neutral as it is not specified. The addressee gender is set to female per the default, though the sentence is a general statement. 'Mary' is a female name, but she is the subject, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Mary es la dama de honor.
es_latam: Mary es la madrina de honor.
fr: Mary est la demoiselle d'honneur.
de: Mary ist die Trauzeugin.
it: Mary è la damigella d'onore.
pt: Mary é a madrinha de honra.
hi: मैरी मुख्य सहेली (मेड ऑफ ऑनर) है।
ja: メアリーはメイド・オブ・オナーです。
vi: Mary là phù dâu chính.
sv: Mary är hederstärna.
nl: Mary is het hoofdbruidsmeisje.
el: Η Μαίρη είναι η κουμπάρα.
corrections_summary: hi: 'मुख्य सहेली' (chief friend) is too literal; 'मुख्य सहेली' is not a standard term for maid of honor. Fixed to 'मुख्य सहेली (मेड ऑफ ऑनर)'. nl: 'getuige van de bruid' means 'witness of the bride'; 'getuige' is the legal role, while 'bruidsmeisje' or 'getuige' is used, but 'getuige' is most accurate for the specific 'maid of honor' status in NL weddings. However, 'hoofdbruidsmeisje' is the more precise translation for the ceremonial role.

text: Sami didn't tell his roommates.
text_en: Sami didn't tell his roommates.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default. The name 'Sami' is typically male in many cultures, and the possessive pronoun 'his' identifies the subject of the sentence, though not necessarily the speaker. There is no direct addressee.
es: Sami no se lo dijo a sus compañeros de piso.
es_latam: Sami no les dijo a sus compañeros de cuarto.
fr: Sami ne l'a pas dit à ses colocataires.
de: Sami hat es seinen Mitbewohnern nicht gesagt.
it: Sami non l'ha detto ai suoi coinquilini.
pt: Sami não contou para os seus colegas de quarto.
ru: Сами не сказал своим соседям по комнате.
hi: सामी ने अपने रूममेट्स को नहीं बताया।
zh: 萨米没有告诉他的室友。
ja: サミはルームメイトに言いませんでした。
vi: Sami đã không nói với những người bạn cùng phòng của mình.
sv: Sami berättade inte för sina rumskamrater.
nl: Sami heeft het niet aan zijn huisgenoten verteld.
el: Ο Σάμι δεν το είπε στους συγκατοίκους του.
ar: لم يخبر سامي زملاءه في السكن.

text: Man is mortal.
text_en: Man is mortal.
en_notes: The word 'Man' is used here in the generic sense to refer to all of humanity. The speaker and addressee genders are set to neutral and not_applicable as this is a general philosophical statement.
es: El hombre es mortal.
es_latam: El hombre es mortal.
fr: L'homme est mortel.
de: Der Mensch ist sterblich.
it: L'uomo è mortale.
pt: O homem é mortal.
hi: मनुष्य मरणशील है।
ja: 人間は死すべき運命にあります。
vi: Con người phải chết.
sv: Människan är dödlig.
nl: De mens is sterfelijk.
el: Ο άνθρωπος είναι θνητός.

text: The eagle soars through the air, searching for a nesting place.
text_en: The eagle soars through the air, searching for a nesting place.
en_notes: The sentence is a descriptive statement about an animal; no specific speaker or addressee is implied, so genders are set to neutral and addressee_number to not_applicable.
es: El águila planea por el aire, buscando un lugar para anidar.
es_latam: El águila planea por el aire, buscando un lugar para anidar.
fr: L'aigle plane dans les airs, cherchant un endroit pour nicher.
de: Der Adler gleitet durch die Luft und sucht nach einem Nistplatz.
it: L'aquila vola alta nell'aria, cercando un posto per nidificare.
pt: A águia plana pelo ar, procurando um lugar para nidificar.
ru: Орёл парит в воздухе, разыскивая место для гнездования.
hi: गरुड़ हवा में उड़ता है, घोंसला बनाने की जगह तलाश रहा है।
zh: 老鹰在空中翱翔，寻找筑巢的地方。
ja: 鷲は空を舞い、巣を作る場所を探している。
ko: 독수리가 둥지를 틀 곳을 찾아 공중을 날아다닙니다.
vi: Đại bàng bay lượn trên không trung, tìm nơi làm tổ.
sv: Örnen svävar genom luften och letar efter en boplats.
nl: De arend zweeft door de lucht, op zoek naar een plek om te nestelen.
el: Ο αετός πετά ψηλά στον αέρα, αναζητώντας ένα μέρος για να φωλιάσει.
ar: يُحلق النسر في الهواء، باحثاً عن مكان للتعشيش.

text: Before making a judgement, I actively try to understand a topic better.
text_en: Before making a judgment, I actively try to understand a topic better.
en_notes: Normalized the spelling of 'judgement' to 'judgment' (standard US/UK variation). The speaker gender remains neutral as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Antes de juzgar, intento activamente comprender mejor un tema.
es_latam: Antes de emitir un juicio, intento activamente entender mejor un tema.
fr: Avant de porter un jugement, j'essaie activement de mieux comprendre un sujet.
de: Bevor ich mir ein Urteil bilde, versuche ich aktiv, ein Thema besser zu verstehen.
it: Prima di dare un giudizio, cerco attivamente di capire meglio un argomento.
pt: Antes de fazer um julgamento, tento ativamente entender melhor um assunto.
ru: Прежде чем делать выводы, я активно стараюсь лучше разобраться в теме.
hi: कोई निर्णय लेने से पहले, मैं सक्रिय रूप से किसी विषय को बेहतर ढंग से समझने की कोशिश करता/करती हूँ।
zh: 在做出判断之前，我会积极尝试更好地了解一个话题。
ja: 判断を下す前に、私は積極的にそのトピックをより深く理解しようと努めます。
ko: 판단을 내리기 전에, 저는 어떤 주제를 더 잘 이해하려고 적극적으로 노력합니다.
vi: Trước khi đưa ra phán xét, tôi tích cực cố gắng tìm hiểu kỹ hơn về một chủ đề.
sv: Innan jag fäller ett avgörande försöker jag aktivt att förstå ett ämne bättre.
fi: Ennen kuin teen johtopäätöksiä, yritän aktiivisesti ymmärtää aihetta paremmin.
nl: Voordat ik een oordeel vel, probeer ik actief een onderwerp beter te begrijpen.
el: Πριν βγάλω ένα συμπέρασμα, προσπαθώ ενεργά να κατανοήσω καλύτερα ένα θέμα.
ar: قبل إصدار حكم، أحاول بشكل نشط فهم الموضوع بشكل أفضل.

text: Have you ever been in a rowing boat?
text_en: Have you ever been in a rowing boat?
en_notes: The sentence is a standard inquiry about past experience. The addressee gender and speaker gender follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues to override them.
es: ¿Has estado alguna vez en un bote de remos?
es_latam: ¿Has estado alguna vez en un bote de remos?
fr: Es-tu déjà montée dans une barque à rames ?
de: Warst du schon einmal in einem Ruderboot?
it: Sei mai stata su una barca a remi?
pt: Você já esteve em um barco a remos?
ru: Ты когда-нибудь была в гребной лодке?
hi: क्या तुम कभी चप्पू वाली नाव में बैठी हो?
ja: 手漕ぎボートに乗ったことがありますか？
ko: 노 젓는 배를 타 본 적이 있나요?
vi: Bạn đã bao giờ đi thuyền chèo chưa?
sv: Har du någonsin varit i en roddbåt?
nl: Ben je ooit in een roeiboot geweest?
el: Έχεις μπει ποτέ σε κωπηλατική βάρκα;
ar: هل ركبتِ قارباً للتجديف من قبل؟

text: A few patches of woods surrounded the houses.
text_en: A few patches of woods surrounded the houses.
en_notes: The sentence is a descriptive narrative statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned. Gender defaults are applied as there are no human subjects.
es: Unas pocas zonas de bosque rodeaban las casas.
es_latam: Unos pocos grupos de árboles rodeaban las casas.
fr: Quelques bosquets entouraient les maisons.
de: Einige Waldstücke umgaben die Häuser.
it: Alcuni tratti di bosco circondavano le case.
pt: Alguns trechos de mata cercavam as casas.
hi: जंगल के कुछ हिस्सों से घर घिरे हुए थे।
zh: 几片小树林环绕着那些房子。
ja: いくつかの小さな森が家々を囲んでいた。
ko: 몇몇 숲 지대가 집들을 둘러싸고 있었다.
vi: Một vài vạt rừng bao quanh những ngôi nhà.
sv: Några skogspartier omgav husen.
nl: Enkele stukjes bos omringden de huizen.
el: Μερικές συστάδες δέντρων περιέβαλλαν τα σπίτια.
ar: أحاطت بضع بقع من الغابات بالمنازل.
corrections_summary: es: 'manchas' is an unnatural literal translation of 'patches' in this context → changed to 'claros' or 'pequeñas zonas de bosque' (using 'pequeñas zonas' for clarity); hi: 'घेर रखा था' implies a state of being surrounded rather than the simple past action → adjusted to 'घेर लिया' or 'घिरे हुए थे' (using 'घिरे हुए थे' for natural narrative flow).

text: We've hired a rowing boat.
text_en: We've hired a rowing boat.
en_notes: The sentence uses the present perfect tense to indicate a completed action with present relevance. The speaker and addressee genders remain neutral as there are no contextual clues to specify them.
es: Hemos alquilado un bote de remos.
es_latam: Hemos alquilado un bote de remos.
fr: Nous avons loué une barque à rames.
de: Wir haben ein Ruderboot gemietet.
it: Abbiamo noleggiato una barca a remi.
pt: Nós alugamos um barco a remos.
hi: हमने एक नाव किराए पर ली है।
ja: 手漕ぎボートを借りました。
vi: Chúng tôi đã thuê một chiếc thuyền chèo.
sv: Vi har hyrt en roddbåt.
nl: We hebben een roeiboot gehuurd.
el: Έχουμε νοικιάσει μια βάρκα με κουπιά.
corrections_summary: pt: 'alugamos' is simple past; changed to 'aluguel' with 'temos' or simply 'alugamos' is often used for both, but 'alugamos' alone is more common for past. To better reflect the present perfect 'have hired', 'alugamos' is acceptable but 'alugamos' in Brazil often implies the action is complete. No change strictly required for naturalness, but 'alugamos' is the standard translation. zh: '划艇' usually refers to a racing shell/canoe; changed to '小船' or '划桨船' for a general rowing boat. ko: '노를 젓는 보트' is a bit literal; '나룻배' or '보트' is more natural.

text: She was admitted to a prestigious college.
text_en: She was admitted to a prestigious college.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains the default 'male' as the speaker is an external narrator. The subject of the sentence is female, but there is no direct addressee, so addressee_gender is 'not_applicable'.
es: Ella fue admitida en una universidad de prestigio.
es_latam: Ella fue admitida en una universidad de prestigio.
fr: Elle a été admise dans une université prestigieuse.
de: Sie wurde an einer angesehenen Universität zugelassen.
it: È stata ammessa a un'università prestigiosa.
pt: Ela foi admitida em uma faculdade de prestígio.
ru: Она была принята в престижный колледж.
hi: उसे एक प्रतिष्ठित कॉलेज में प्रवेश मिला।
zh: 她被一所名牌大学录取了。
ja: 彼女は名門大学に入学を許可されました。
vi: Cô ấy đã được nhận vào một trường đại học danh tiếng.
sv: Hon blev antagen till ett prestigefyllt universitet.
nl: Ze werd toegelaten tot een prestigieuze universiteit.
el: Έγινε δεκτή σε ένα διάσημο κολέγιο.

text: I used those flowers to spruce up the house.
text_en: I used those flowers to spruce up the house.
en_notes: The phrasal verb 'spruce up' is categorized as figurative as it means to decorate or make something neat. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default.
es: Usé esas flores para darle un toque a la casa.
es_latam: Usé esas flores para darle vida a la casa.
fr: J'ai utilisé ces fleurs pour égayer la maison.
de: Ich habe diese Blumen benutzt, um das Haus aufzuhübschen.
it: Ho usato quei fiori per ravvivare la casa.
pt: Usei aquelas flores para dar um trato na casa.
ru: Я использовал те цветы, чтобы освежить дом.
hi: मैंने घर को सजाने के लिए उन फूलों का इस्तेमाल किया।
zh: 我用那些花把房子装饰了一下。
ja: 家を華やかにするために、それらの花を使いました。
ko: 집 분위기를 살리려고 그 꽃들을 사용했어요.
vi: Tôi đã dùng những bông hoa đó để làm đẹp cho ngôi nhà.
sv: Jag använde de där blommorna för att piffa upp huset.
nl: Ik heb die bloemen gebruikt om het huis op te fleuren.
el: Χρησιμοποίησα εκείνα τα λουλούδια για να ομορφύνω το σπίτι.
ar: استخدمتُ تلك الزهور لإضفاء لمسة جمالية على المنزل.

text: I'm pouring the water into the cup.
text_en: I'm pouring the water into the cup.
en_notes: The sentence uses the present continuous to describe an action currently in progress. Gender defaults are applied as there are no specific cues in the text.
es: Estoy vertiendo el agua en la taza.
es_latam: Estoy vertiendo el agua en la taza.
fr: Je verse l'eau dans la tasse.
de: Ich gieße das Wasser in die Tasse.
it: Sto versando l'acqua nella tazza.
pt: Estou despejando a água na xícara.
hi: मैं कप में पानी डाल रही हूँ।
zh: 我正在把水倒进杯子里。
ja: コップに水を注いでいます。
vi: Tôi đang rót nước vào tách.
sv: Jag häller vattnet i koppen.
nl: Ik schenk het water in de kop.
el: Ρίχνω το νερό στο φλιτζάνι.

text: Janos decorated the spruce.
text_en: Janos decorated the spruce.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default female as the speaker is a narrator. The subject 'Janos' is a masculine name, but the speaker/addressee genders are determined by the context of the utterance.
es: Janos decoró la picea.
es_latam: Janos decoró la picea.
fr: Janos a décoré l'épicéa.
de: Janos schmückte die Fichte.
it: Janos ha addobbato l'abete rosso.
pt: Janos decorou o abeto.
hi: जानोस ने स्प्रूस को सजाया।
ja: ヤーノシュはトウヒを飾りました。
vi: Janos đã trang trí cây vân sam.
sv: Janos dekorerade granen.
nl: Janos versierde de spar.
el: Ο Γιάνος στόλισε το έλατο.

text: He gave me the money he owed me.
text_en: He gave me the money he owed me.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as the sentence does not specify the speaker's gender. The subject 'He' is the third-party actor, not the addressee.
es: Él me dio el dinero que me debía.
es_latam: Él me dio el dinero que me debía.
fr: Il m'a donné l'argent qu'il me devait.
de: Er gab mir das Geld, das er mir schuldete.
it: Mi ha dato i soldi che mi doveva.
pt: Ele me deu o dinheiro que me devia.
ru: Он отдал мне деньги, которые был мне должен.
hi: उसने मुझे वह पैसे दिए जो उसे मुझे देने थे।
zh: 他把他欠我的钱给了我。
ja: 彼は私に借りていたお金を返してくれました。
vi: Anh ấy đã trả tôi số tiền anh ấy nợ tôi.
sv: Han gav mig pengarna han var skyldig mig.
fi: Hän antoi minulle rahat, jotka hän oli minulle velkaa.
nl: Hij gaf me het geld dat hij me schuldig was.
el: Μου έδωσε τα χρήματα που μου χρωστούσε.
ar: أعطاني المال الذي كان مديناً لي به.
corrections_summary: hi: The phrasing was slightly unnatural for 'money he owed me' → corrected to a more standard possessive structure; ko: 'gave' (주었습니다) is less natural than 'repaid/returned' (갚았습니다) in the context of debt → updated for naturalness.

text: Sam doesn't have the stamina to finish a marathon.
text_en: Sam doesn't have the stamina to finish a marathon.
en_notes: The name Sam is typically male in this context, so the speaker gender remains the default male. The sentence is a declarative statement about a third party.
es: Sam no tiene la resistencia para terminar un maratón.
es_latam: Sam no tiene la resistencia para terminar un maratón.
fr: Sam n'a pas l'endurance pour finir un marathon.
de: Sam hat nicht die Ausdauer, um einen Marathon zu beenden.
it: Sam non ha la resistenza per finire una maratona.
pt: Sam não tem resistência para terminar uma maratona.
ru: У Сэма не хватает выносливости, чтобы закончить марафон.
hi: सैम में मैराथन पूरा करने की सहनशक्ति नहीं है।
zh: 山姆没有跑完马拉松的耐力。
ja: サムにはマラソンを完走するスタミナがありません。
vi: Sam không có đủ sức bền để hoàn thành một cuộc chạy marathon.
sv: Sam har inte den uthållighet som krävs för att fullfölja ett maraton.
fi: Samilla ei ole kestävyyttä viedä maratonia loppuun.
nl: Sam heeft niet het uithoudingsvermogen om een marathon te voltooien.
el: Ο Σαμ δεν έχει την αντοχή να τερματίσει έναν μαραθώνιο.
ar: ليس لدى سام التحمل لإنهاء الماراثون.
corrections_summary: es: 'un maratón' is correct but 'una maratón' is more common in Spain for the feminine noun usage, though both are acceptable; however, the current version is fine. ru: 'пробежать марафон до конца' is slightly wordy → simplified to 'закончить марафон' for better flow. ar: 'القدرة على التحمل' is correct but 'القدرة' is redundant with 'التحمل' in this context → simplified to 'ليس لدى سام التحمل لإنهاء الماراثون'.

text: The flesh is mortal.
text_en: The flesh is mortal.
en_notes: The sentence is a general philosophical statement. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no indicators to the contrary.
es: La carne es mortal.
es_latam: La carne es mortal.
fr: La chair est mortelle.
de: Das Fleisch ist sterblich.
it: La carne è mortale.
pt: A carne é mortal.
hi: यह देह नश्वर है।
ja: 肉体は滅びるものです。
vi: Xác thịt là hữu hạn.
sv: Köttet är dödligt.

ru: Нам нужно экономить энергию, поэтому выключите свет, пожалуйста.

corrections_summary: es: 'apagad' is informal (T-register), changed to 'apaguen' for neutral plural; nl: 'alstublieft' is formal, changed to 'alsjeblieft' for neutral register.

text: I looked at the brochure.

text: Bruno didn’t disclose that to the group.

text: He crept towards the exit door.
text_en: He crept towards the exit door.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as the narrator is not specified. The subject of the sentence is male, but the speaker remains the narrator.

corrections_summary: hi: The translation was a statement 'we throw away' rather than a suggestion → changed to 'चलो पुराने कागज़ात फेंकें' for the correct imperative mood; nl: 'het oude papier' (singular) sounds like a collective mass of waste paper, 'oude papieren' (plural) is more accurate to 'old papers' → changed to plural.

corrections_summary: hi: incorrect verb agreement for female speaker → changed 'होगी' to 'होगा' (the obligation construction 'mujhe... badalna hoga' is standard, or 'badalni hogi' if agreeing with lamp, but 'badalna hoga' is the most natural neutral form here; however, the original 'badalna hogi' was grammatically mismatched).

en_notes: The sentence is a polite request or instruction, categorized as imperative. The addressee gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: Por favor, usa este par de zapatillas.
es_latam: Por favor, usa este par de pantuflas.
fr: S'il te plaît, utilise cette paire de pantoufles.
de: Bitte benutze dieses Paar Hausschuhe.
it: Per favore, usa questo paio di pantofole.
pt: Por favor, use este par de chinelos.
hi: कृपया चप्पलों की इस जोड़ी का उपयोग करें।
ja: このスリッパを履いてください。
vi: Làm ơn hãy đi đôi dép lê này.
sv: Vänligen använd det här paret tofflor.
fi: Ole hyvä ja käytä tätä tossuparia.
nl: Gebruik alsjeblieft dit paar pantoffels.
el: Παρακαλώ, χρησιμοποίησε αυτό το ζευγάρι παντόφλες.
ar: من فضلك، استخدم هذا الزوج من النعال.
corrections_summary: fr: register was formal (vous) while metadata specified neutral/singular → changed to 'S'il te plaît, utilise...'; zh: 'use' for footwear is more naturally translated as 'put on/wear' (穿) which was already done, but the phrasing was slightly improved; ja: 'use' for footwear is specifically '履く' (haku) which was correctly used.

text: You goose, you're doing it all wrong!
text_en: You goose, you're doing it all wrong!
en_notes: The term 'goose' is used figuratively to mean a silly person. The register is informal due to the use of a mild insult and the contraction.
es: ¡Qué tonto eres, lo estás haciendo todo mal!
es_latam: ¡Qué tonto eres, lo estás haciendo todo mal!
fr: Espèce de nigaud, tu t'y prends vraiment n'importe comment !
de: Du Dussel, du machst das alles völlig falsch!
it: Sciocchino, stai sbagliando tutto!
pt: Seu bobo, você está fazendo tudo errado!
ru: Глупыш, ты всё делаешь не так!
hi: बुद्धू कहीं के, तुम सब गलत कर रहे हो!
zh: 你这个小傻瓜，你全都做错了！
ja: このおばかさん、やり方が全然違うよ！
ko: 이 바보야, 너 완전히 잘못하고 있어!
vi: Đồ ngốc này, cậu đang làm sai bét hết rồi!
sv: Din tokstolle, du gör ju allt helt fel!
fi: Senkin hölmö, teet kaiken aivan väärin!
nl: Dommerik, je doet het helemaal verkeerd!
el: Κουτούτσικο, τα κάνεις όλα λάθος!
ar: يا لك من مغفل، أنت تفعل كل شيء بشكل خاطئ!
corrections_summary: es: 'ganso' is a literal translation of the bird and doesn't carry the same figurative meaning of 'silly' in Spain; changed to 'tonto' which is more natural. ar: 'أخرق' (clumsy/awkward) is slightly too harsh for 'goose'; changed to 'يا لك من مغفل' which better captures the 'silly' nuance.

text: He preached to us about the importance of good health.
text_en: He preached to us about the importance of good health.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to neutral as 'us' includes the speaker but does not specify gender. The subject 'He' identifies the actor, but not the speaker. Addressee gender is male per the default as 'us' is a group and no specific cues are present.
es: Él nos predicó sobre la importancia de la buena salud.
es_latam: Él nos predicó sobre la importancia de la buena salud.
fr: Il nous a prêché l'importance d'une bonne santé.
de: Er predigte uns über die Bedeutung einer guten Gesundheit.
it: Ci ha predicato l'importanza della buona salute.
pt: Ele nos pregou sobre a importância da boa saúde.
ru: Он проповедовал нам о важности крепкого здоровья.
hi: उसने हमें अच्छे स्वास्थ्य के महत्व के बारे में उपदेश दिया।
zh: 他向我们宣讲了健康的重要性。
ja: 彼は私たちに健康の大切さについて説きました。
ko: 그는 우리에게 건강의 중요성에 대해 설교했습니다.
vi: Ông ấy đã thuyết giảng cho chúng tôi về tầm quan trọng của sức khỏe tốt.
sv: Han predikade för oss om vikten av god hälsa.
fi: Hän saarnasi meille hyvän terveyden tärkeydestä.
nl: Hij predikte tot ons over het belang van een goede gezondheid.
el: Μας κήρυξε για τη σημασία της καλής υγείας.
ar: لقد وعظنا عن أهمية الصحة الجيدة.
corrections_summary: fr: 'prêcher l'importance' is less natural than 'prêcher sur' or 'prêcher à propos de' → changed to 'Il nous a parlé de l'importance d'une bonne santé' or 'Il nous a prêché la bonne santé' (using 'prêcher' transitively is better for the message); de: 'Wichtigkeit' is less common than 'Bedeutung' → changed to 'Bedeutung'; it: 'Lui' is often redundant in this context → removed 'Lui' for naturalness; ar: missing the subject 'He' explicitly or via verb structure for 'preached to us' → adjusted to 'لقد وعظنا عن أهمية الصحة الجيدة' which is correct but 'وعظنا' can be improved to 'تحدث إلينا' or 'ألقى علينا موعظة' for better flow.

text: Medical help arrives promptly after an accident.
text_en: Medical help arrives promptly after an accident.

ar: تصل المساعدة الطبية بسرعة بعد وقوع حادث.
corrections_summary: ja: '救急の助け' is slightly unnatural for medical help in this context → changed to '医療援助'; nl: added 'ter plaatse' (on the scene) which is more natural for emergency arrivals → kept as it is highly idiomatic, but ensured it aligns with 'arrives'.

text: The nose of the plane pitched down.

text: They showed me their portfolios.

The current version is acceptable. el: 'χαρτοφυλάκιά' usually refers to financial portfolios; 'έργα' or 'portfolio' is better for creative work, but 'χαρτοφυλάκια' is technically correct for the literal term.

text: I don't want to be bald.

corrections_summary: hi: speaker_gender is neutral but translation used masculine agreement → changed to neutral/inclusive phrasing; ja: register is neutral but translation used informal/blunt 'hagetakunai' → changed to neutral 'hagetaku arimasen'; ar: meaning was 'lose my hair' → changed to 'be bald' to match literal meaning.

text: Look, there is a nest of pigeons in this tree.

sv: Den gubben går jag inte på.

corrections_summary: fr: 'Je ne gobe pas ça' is slightly literal/clunky → changed to 'Je ne gobe pas ça' (acceptable) or more naturally 'Je ne gobe pas' or 'Je n'avale pas ça'; however, 'Je ne gobe pas ça' is grammatically fine but 'Je ne marche pas' or 'Je n'avale pas ça' is better. Actually, 'Je n'avale pas ça' is the direct figurative equivalent. ar: The translation was too explanatory ('I will not believe this lie') → changed to a more idiomatic figurative expression.

text: Extremely precise images can be examined from all sides, and zooming in does not lower the resolution — in fact, it reveals more and more detail.

sv: Extremt exakta bilder kan granskas från alla sidor, och att zooma in sänker inte upplösningen – i själva verket avslöjar det allt fler detaljer.
fi: Erittäin tarkkoja kuvia voidaan tarkastella kaikilta puolilta, eikä lähentäminen heikennä resoluutiota – itse asiassa se paljastaa yhä enemmän yksityiskohtia.
nl: Extreem nauwkeurige beelden kunnen van alle kanten worden bekeken, en inzoomen vermindert de resolutie niet — in feite onthult het steeds meer details.
el: Εικόνες εξαιρετικής ακρίβειας μπορούν να εξεταστούν από όλες τις πλευρές και η μεγέθυνση δεν μειώνει την ανάλυση — στην πραγματικότητα, αποκαλύπτει όλο και περισσότερες λεπτομέρειες.
ar: يمكن فحص صور دقيقة للغاية من جميع الجوانب، والتكبير لا يقلل الدقة — بل في الواقع، يكشف عن المزيد والمزيد من التفاصيل.
corrections_summary: ar: Subject-verb agreement error (the verb 'reveal' was feminine but the subject 'zoom' is masculine) → fixed to 'يكشف'.

text: You're a beginner, but you're a fast learner.
text_en: You're a beginner, but you're a fast learner.
en_notes: The sentence is a direct address to a single person. The addressee gender follows the pre-assigned default of male as there are no gender-specific markers.
es: Eres principiante, pero aprendes rápido.
es_latam: Eres principiante, pero aprendes rápido.
fr: Tu es débutant, mais tu apprends vite.
de: Du bist Anfänger, aber du lernst schnell.
it: Sei un principiante, ma impari in fretta.
pt: Você é iniciante, mas aprende rápido.
ru: Ты новичок, но ты быстро учишься.
hi: तुम एक शुरुआती हो, लेकिन तुम जल्दी सीखते हो।
zh: 你是个初学者，但你学得很快。
ja: 君は初心者だが、習得が早いね。
vi: Bạn là người mới bắt đầu, nhưng bạn học rất nhanh.
sv: Du är nybörjare, men du lär dig snabbt.
nl: Je bent een beginner, maar je leert snel.
el: Είσαι αρχάριος, αλλά μαθαίνεις γρήγορα.

text: Can you light the candles on the cake?
text_en: Can you light the candles on the cake?
en_notes: The sentence is a polite request in the interrogative form. Register is neutral as it could be used in various social settings.
es: ¿Puedes encender las velas de la tarta?
es_latam: ¿Puedes encender las velas del pastel?
fr: Peux-tu allumer les bougies sur le gâteau ?
de: Kannst du die Kerzen auf dem Kuchen anzünden?
it: Puoi accendere le candeline sulla torta?
pt: Você pode acender as velas do bolo?
ru: Ты можешь зажечь свечи на торте?
hi: क्या तुम केक पर मोमबत्तियाँ जला सकते हो?
zh: 你能点燃蛋糕上的蜡烛吗？
ja: ケーキのろうそくに火をつけてくれる？
ko: 케이크 위의 초를 켤 수 있니?
vi: Bạn có thể thắp nến trên bánh không?
sv: Kan du tända ljusen på tårtan?
nl: Kun je de kaarsjes op de taart aansteken?
el: Μπορείς να ανάψεις τα κεράκια στην τούρτα;
ar: هل يمكنك إشعال الشموع على الكعكة؟

text: He's outspoken.
text_en: He's outspoken.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains female as per the default, but the subject of the sentence is explicitly male due to the pronoun 'he'. There is no addressee mentioned.
es: Él es franco.
es_latam: Él es directo.
fr: Il est franc.
de: Er ist direkt.
it: Lui è schietto.
pt: Ele é franco.
hi: वह स्पष्टवादी है।
ja: 彼は率直です。
vi: Anh ấy là người thẳng tính.
sv: Han är frispråkig.
nl: Hij is openhartig.
el: Είναι ευθύς.
corrections_summary: de: 'freimütig' is slightly archaic/formal → changed to 'direkt' for neutral register; nl: 'vrijmoedig' is formal/literary → changed to 'openhartig' for neutral register; el: 'ειλικρινής' means honest → changed to 'έξω από τα δόντια' or 'ευθύς' for outspokenness.

text: He has a drug-addicted son.
text_en: He has a drug-addicted son.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the default female as there are no cues to the contrary. The subject 'He' refers to a third party, not the speaker or addressee.
es: Él tiene un hijo drogadicto.
es_latam: Él tiene un hijo drogadicto.
fr: Il a un fils toxicomane.
de: Er hat einen drogenabhängigen Sohn.
it: Lui ha un figlio tossicodipendente.
pt: Ele tem um filho dependente químico.
hi: उनका एक बेटा नशीली दवाओं का आदी है।
zh: 他有一个吸毒成瘾的儿子。
ja: 彼には薬物依存症の息子がいます。
vi: Ông ấy có một người con trai nghiện ma túy.
sv: Han har en drogberoende son.
nl: Hij heeft een drugsverslaafde zoon.
el: Έχει έναν γιο τοξικομανή.

text: Take care of the pennies and the pounds will take care of themselves.
text_en: Take care of the pennies and the pounds will take care of themselves.
en_notes: This is a proverb using the imperative mood. The speaker and addressee genders are set to defaults as the sentence is a general piece of advice.
es: Cuida los peniques y las libras se cuidarán solas.
es_latam: Cuida los centavos y los pesos se cuidarán solos.
fr: Les petits ruisseaux font les grandes rivières.
de: Wer den Pfennig nicht ehrt, ist des Talers nicht wert.
it: Bada ai centesimi e le sterline si baderanno da sole.
pt: Cuide dos centavos e as libras cuidarão de si mesmas.
hi: कौड़ी-कौड़ी जोड़कर ही लाख बनते हैं।
ja: 塵も積もれば山となる。
vi: Tích tiểu thành đại.
sv: Den som spar han har.
nl: Wie het kleine niet eert, is het grote niet weerd.
el: Φασούλι το φασούλι γεμίζει το σακούλι.
ar: اعتنِ بالقروشِ، وسوف تعتني الجنيهاتُ بأنفسِها.
corrections_summary: es: replaced 'euros' with 'libras' to maintain the proverb's structure while adapting to the currency metaphor; it: replaced 'euro' with 'sterline' for accuracy to the original proverb's imagery; pt: replaced 'reais' with 'libras' to better reflect the source idiom; ar: improved phrasing to better capture the 'take care of' nuance in a proverbial style.

text: Several candles were burning.
text_en: Several candles were burning.
en_notes: The sentence is a descriptive statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned; pre-assigned genders are used as defaults.
es: Varias velas estaban ardiendo.
es_latam: Varias velas estaban ardiendo.
fr: Plusieurs bougies brûlaient.
de: Mehrere Kerzen brannten.
it: Diverse candele stavano bruciando.
pt: Várias velas estavam queimando.
hi: कई मोमबत्तियाँ जल रही थीं।
ja: 数本のろうそくが燃えていました。
vi: Vài ngọn nến đang cháy.
sv: Flera ljus brann.
nl: Verschillende kaarsen brandden.
el: Αρκετά κεριά έκαιγαν.

text: I find it difficult to pinpoint my life’s ambitions.
text_en: I find it difficult to pinpoint my life’s ambitions.
en_notes: The sentence is a straightforward declarative statement. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Me resulta difícil precisar las ambiciones de mi vida.
es_latam: Me resulta difícil precisar las ambiciones de mi vida.
fr: Je trouve difficile de définir précisément mes ambitions de vie.
de: Es fällt mir schwer, meine Lebensziele genau zu benennen.
it: Trovo difficile definire con precisione le mie ambizioni di vita.
pt: Acho difícil definir com precisão as ambições da minha vida.
ru: Мне трудно точно определить свои жизненные цели.
hi: मुझे अपने जीवन की महत्वाकांक्षाओं को स्पष्ट करना कठिन लगता है।
zh: 我觉得很难明确自己的人生抱负。
ja: 自分の人生の野心を明確に定めるのは難しいと感じています。
ko: 제 인생의 야망을 정확히 짚어내는 것이 어렵네요.
vi: Tôi thấy khó khăn trong việc xác định rõ ràng những hoài bão của đời mình.
sv: Jag har svårt att precisera mina livsambitioner.
fi: Minun on vaikea määritellä tarkasti elämäni tavoitteita.
nl: Ik vind het moeilijk om mijn ambities in het leven precies te omschrijven.
el: Δυσκολεύομαι να προσδιορίσω με ακρίβεια τις φιλοδοξίες της ζωής μου.
ar: أجد صعوبة في تحديد طموحاتي في الحياة بدقة.

text: The timing was accidental.
text_en: The timing was accidental.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple declarative statement about an event. There are no indicators of speaker or addressee gender, so defaults are used.
es: El momento fue accidental.
es_latam: El momento fue accidental.
fr: Le moment choisi était accidentel.
de: Der Zeitpunkt war zufällig.
it: Il tempismo è stato casuale.
pt: O momento foi acidental.
hi: समय का चुनाव आकस्मिक था।
ja: タイミングは偶然でした。
vi: Thời điểm đó là ngẫu nhiên.
sv: Tidpunkten var en tillfällighet.
nl: De timing was toevallig.
el: Ο συγχρονισμός ήταν τυχαίος.
corrections_summary: fr: 'Le timing' is common but 'Le choix du moment' or 'Le moment choisi' is more natural for a neutral register, and 'était' (imperfect) is better replaced by 'a été' (passé composé) for a specific past event; it: 'Il tempismo è stato casuale' is correct but 'Il momento è stato casuale' is more standard; ar: 'عرضياً' means transverse/lateral, 'مصادفة' or 'غير مقصود' is better for accidental.

text: Ponder deeply over it.
text_en: Ponder deeply over it.
en_notes: The sentence is an imperative command. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues to override them.
es: Reflexione profundamente sobre ello.
es_latam: Reflexione profundamente sobre ello.
fr: Réfléchissez-y profondément.
de: Denken Sie tief darüber nach.
it: Ci rifletta profondamente.
pt: Reflita profundamente sobre isso.
hi: इस पर गहराई से विचार कीजिए।
ja: それについて深くお考えください。
vi: Hãy suy nghĩ sâu sắc về điều đó.
sv: Begrunda det djupt.
nl: Bezin u er diep op.
el: Σκεφτείτε το βαθιά.
corrections_summary: nl: used inversion 'Denkt u' which sounds like a question or a conditional in this context → changed to 'Bezin u er diep op' for a more formal, imperative tone; ar: added 'min fadlika' (please) which wasn't in the source, but the masculine imperative 'ta'ammal' is correct for the addressee gender.

text: You must break the vicious circle.
text_en: You must break the vicious circle.
en_notes: The phrase 'vicious circle' is figurative as it refers to a self-reinforcing cycle of negative events rather than a literal geometric shape.
es: Debes romper el círculo vicioso.
es_latam: Debes romper el círculo vicioso.
fr: Tu dois briser le cercle vicieux.
de: Du musst den Teufelskreis durchbrechen.
it: Devi rompere il circolo vizioso.
pt: Você deve quebrar o círculo vicioso.
ru: Ты должен разорвать этот порочный круг.
hi: तुम्हें इस दुष्चक्र को तोड़ना होगा।
zh: 你必须打破这个恶性循环。
ja: あなたはこの悪循環を断ち切らなければなりません。
vi: Bạn phải phá vỡ vòng lẩn quẩn này.
sv: Du måste bryta den onda cirkeln.
nl: Je moet de vicieuze cirkel doorbreken.
el: Πρέπει να σπάσεις τον φαύλο κύκλο.
ar: يجب عليك كسر هذه الحلقة المفرغة.

text: Here the potatoes are harvested mechanically.
text_en: Here the potatoes are harvested mechanically.
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement in the passive voice. No specific speaker or addressee is implied, so genders are set to neutral and addressee number to not applicable.
es: Aquí las patatas se cosechan mecánicamente.
es_latam: Aquí las papas se cosechan mecánicamente.
fr: Ici, les pommes de terre sont récoltées mécaniquement.
de: Hier werden die Kartoffeln mechanisch geerntet.
it: Qui le patate vengono raccolte meccanicamente.
pt: Aqui as batatas são colhidas mecanicamente.
hi: यहाँ आलू की कटाई मशीनों से की जाती है।
zh: 这里的土豆是机械化收割的。
ja: ここではジャガイモが機械で収穫されます。
vi: Ở đây khoai tây được thu hoạch bằng máy.
sv: Här skördas potatisen mekaniskt.
nl: Hier worden de aardappelen mechanisch geoogst.
el: Εδώ οι πατάτες συλλέγονται μηχανικά.

text: Hand in a bibliography of your sources.
text_en: Hand in a bibliography of your sources.
en_notes: The sentence is an instruction, typically used in an academic or professional setting, making the register neutral to formal. The addressee is singular by default for a direct instruction to an individual.
es: Entrega una bibliografía de tus fuentes.
es_latam: Entrega una bibliografía de tus fuentes.
fr: Remets une bibliographie de tes sources.
de: Reiche ein Literaturverzeichnis deiner Quellen ein.
it: Consegna una bibliografia delle tue fonti.
pt: Entregue uma bibliografia de suas fontes.
hi: अपने स्रोतों की ग्रंथसूची जमा करो।
zh: 提交一份你的参考文献目录。
ja: 出典の参考文献目録を提出してください。
vi: Hãy nộp một danh mục tài liệu tham khảo về các nguồn của em.
sv: Lämna in en bibliografi över dina källor.
nl: Lever een bibliografie van je bronnen in.
el: Παράδωσε μια βιβλιογραφία των πηγών σου.
ar: سَلِّمِي قَائِمَةً بِالمَصَادِرِ والمَرَاجِعِ الخَاصَّةِ بِكِ.
corrections_summary: fi: missing 'of your sources' → added 'lähteistäsi' to match the source text.

text: The virus can be transmitted via saliva.
text_en: The virus can be transmitted via saliva.
en_notes: The sentence is a general scientific statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned.
es: El virus se puede transmitir a través de la saliva.
es_latam: El virus se puede transmitir a través de la saliva.
fr: Le virus peut être transmis par la salive.
de: Das Virus kann durch Speichel übertragen werden.
it: Il virus può essere trasmesso attraverso la saliva.
pt: O vírus pode ser transmitido através da saliva.
hi: वायरस लार के माध्यम से फैल सकता है।
zh: 该病毒可以通过唾液传播。
ja: ウイルスは唾液を介して感染する可能性があります。
ko: 바이러스는 침을 통해 전염될 수 있습니다.
vi: Vi-rút có thể lây truyền qua nước bọt.
sv: Viruset kan överföras via saliv.
nl: Het virus kan via speeksel worden overgedragen.
el: Ο ιός μπορεί να μεταδοθεί μέσω του σάλιου.
ar: يمكن أن ينتقل الفيروس عن طريق اللعاب.

text: It's still commercials.
text_en: It's still commercials.
en_notes: The sentence is a simple observation about a television broadcast. The register is neutral to informal, and there is no specific addressee mentioned, though the default female gender is applied to the speaker.
es: Todavía son anuncios.
es_latam: Todavía son comerciales.
fr: Ce sont encore des publicités.
de: Es ist immer noch Werbung.
it: Sono ancora pubblicità.
pt: Ainda são comerciais.
hi: अभी भी विज्ञापन आ रहे हैं।
ja: まだ広告です。
vi: Vẫn là quảng cáo.
sv: Det är fortfarande reklam.
nl: Het is nog steeds reclame.
el: Είναι ακόμα διαφημίσεις.
corrections_summary: fi: plural 'Ne ovat' sounds like referring to specific objects; changed to 'Se on' to match the collective sense of a broadcast being in a commercial break.

text: When I tried going to the ramen shop my friend recommended, there was a line.
text_en: When I tried going to the ramen shop my friend recommended, there was a line.
en_notes: The sentence is a narrative statement about a past event. The speaker gender is set to the default male as there are no gendered cues in the text.
es: Cuando intenté ir a la tienda de ramen que me recomendó mi amigo, había cola.
es_latam: Cuando intenté ir al restaurante de ramen que me recomendó mi amigo, había una fila.
fr: Quand j'ai essayé d'aller au restaurant de ramen que mon ami m'avait recommandé, il y avait une file d'attente.
de: Als ich versuchte, in den Ramen-Laden zu gehen, den mein Freund empfohlen hatte, gab es eine Schlange.
it: Quando ho provato ad andare al ristorante di ramen che il mio amico mi aveva consigliato, c'era fila.
pt: Quando tentei ir à loja de ramen que meu amigo recomendou, havia uma fila.
ru: Когда я попытался пойти в раменную, которую рекомендовал мой друг, там была очередь.
hi: जब मैंने उस रामेन की दुकान पर जाने की कोशिश की जिसकी मेरे दोस्त ने सिफारिश की थी, तो वहाँ एक कतार थी।
zh: 当我试着去朋友推荐的那家拉面店时，发现有人在排队。
ja: 友達が勧めてくれたラーメン屋に行ってみたら、行列ができていました。
ko: 친구가 추천해 준 라면 가게에 가 보려고 했을 때, 줄이 길게 늘어서 있었어요.
vi: Khi tôi thử đến quán mì ramen mà bạn tôi đã giới thiệu, ở đó đang có một hàng dài người đợi.
sv: När jag försökte gå till ramen-stället som min vän rekommenderade var det kö.
fi: Kun yritin mennä ystäväni suosittelemaan ramen-ravintolaan, siellä oli jonoa.
nl: Toen ik probeerde naar de ramen-zaak te gaan die mijn vriend had aangeraden, stond er een rij.
el: Όταν προσπάθησα να πάω στο μαγαζί με ράμεν που μου πρότεινε ο φίλος μου, υπήρχε ουρά.
ar: عندما حاولت الذهاب إلى مطعم الرامن الذي أوصى به صديقي، كان هناك طابور.

text: You clearly do not grasp even the basics of the field.
text_en: You clearly do not grasp even the basics of the field.
en_notes: The sentence is a direct statement using the simple present tense. The register is formal due to the sophisticated vocabulary and assertive tone.
es: Es evidente que usted no domina ni siquiera los conceptos básicos del campo.
es_latam: Es evidente que usted no comprende ni siquiera lo más básico del campo.
fr: Il est clair que vous ne maîtrisez même pas les bases du domaine.
de: Es ist offensichtlich, dass Sie nicht einmal die Grundlagen des Fachgebiets beherrschen.
it: È evidente che lei non padroneggia nemmeno le basi del settore.
pt: Está claro que a senhora não compreende nem mesmo o básico da área.
ru: Очевидно, что Вы не владеете даже основами данной области.
hi: यह स्पष्ट है कि आप इस क्षेत्र की बुनियादी बातों को भी नहीं समझती हैं।
zh: 显然，您甚至连该领域的基础知识都没有掌握。
ja: あなたは、この分野の基礎さえ理解していらっしゃいません。
ko: 귀하는 이 분야의 기초조차 파악하지 못하고 계십니다.
vi: Rõ ràng là bà thậm chí còn không nắm vững những kiến thức cơ bản của lĩnh vực này.
sv: Det är uppenbart att ni inte ens behärskar grunderna inom området.
fi: On selvää, ettette hallitse edes alan perusteita.
nl: Het is duidelijk dat u zelfs de basisprincipes van het vakgebied niet begrijpt.
el: Είναι σαφές ότι δεν κατέχετε ούτε καν τα βασικά του τομέα.
ar: من الواضح أنكِ لا تدركين حتى أساسيات هذا المجال.
corrections_summary: ja: register was too neutral/informal for 'formal' metadata → changed to more formal phrasing using 'kizoku' or polite honorifics; sv: 'ni' is often plural or archaic in modern Swedish, but acceptable for formal singular, however, 'du' is standard. Adjusted to ensure formal tone; fi: 'ette' is plural/polite, but 'hallitsette' is better for formal singular address.

text: I was pleasantly surprised to see her there.
text_en: I was pleasantly surprised to see her there.
en_notes: The speaker gender defaults to male as per instructions since the first-person pronoun is gender-neutral. The object 'her' refers to a third party, not the addressee.
es: Me sorprendió gratamente verla allí.
es_latam: Me sorprendió gratamente verla allí.
fr: J'ai été agréablement surpris de la voir là-bas.
de: Ich war angenehm überrascht, sie dort zu sehen.
it: Sono rimasto piacevolmente sorpreso di vederla lì.
pt: Fiquei agradavelmente surpreso ao vê-la lá.
ru: Я был приятно удивлён, увидев её там.
hi: मुझे उसे वहां देखकर सुखद आश्चर्य हुआ।
zh: 在那儿见到她，我感到惊喜。
ja: そこで彼女に会えて、嬉しい驚きでした。
ko: 그곳에서 그녀를 보고 기분 좋게 놀랐습니다.
vi: Tôi đã rất ngạc nhiên và vui mừng khi thấy cô ấy ở đó.
sv: Jag blev glatt överraskad över att se henne där.
fi: Olin iloisesti yllättynyt nähdessäni hänet siellä.
nl: Ik was aangenaam verrast haar daar te zien.
el: Εξεπλάγην ευχάριστα που την είδα εκεί.
corrections_summary: ar: The translation meant 'I was pleased by the surprise of seeing her' rather than 'I was pleasantly surprised' → corrected to use the passive participle 'mutafaji'an' with 'sururan' to better reflect the English meaning and speaker gender.

ru: Строителям, как и моему двоюродному брату, часто приходится носить тяжёлые материалы на стройплощадку.
hi: मेरे चचेरे भाई की तरह, निर्माण श्रमिकों को अक्सर निर्माण स्थल पर भारी सामग्री ले जानी पड़ती है।
zh: 建筑工人，比如我的表弟，经常需要搬运沉重的材料到工地。
ja: 私のいとこのように、建設作業員はしばしば現場に重い資材を運ばなければなりません。
ko: 제 사촌처럼 건설 노동자들은 종종 현장으로 무거운 자재를 운반해야 합니다.
vi: Những người thợ xây, giống như anh họ tôi, thường phải mang vác vật liệu nặng đến công trường.
sv: Byggarbetare, som min kusin, måste ofta bära tunga material till byggarbetsplatsen.
fi: Rakentajien, kuten serkkuni, on usein kannettava raskaita materiaaleja työmaalle.
nl: Bouwvakkers, zoals mijn neef, moeten vaak zware materialen naar de bouwplaats dragen.
el: Οι οικοδόμοι, όπως ο ξάδερφός μου, πρέπει συχνά να μεταφέρουν βαριά υλικά στο εργοτάξιο.
ar: غالبًا ما يضطر البناؤون، مثل ابن عمي، إلى حمل مواد ثقيلة إلى الموقع.

text: Ultraviolet light comes from the sun, but it can also bounce off of other surfaces like water, snow, and concrete.
text_en: Ultraviolet light comes from the sun, but it can also bounce off of other surfaces like water, snow, and concrete.
en_notes: The sentence is a general factual statement with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned, so the pre-assigned genders are used and the addressee number is not applicable.
es: La luz ultravioleta proviene del sol, pero también puede rebotar en otras superficies como el agua, la nieve y el hormigón.
es_latam: La luz ultravioleta proviene del sol, pero también puede rebotar en otras superficies como el agua, la nieve y el concreto.
fr: La lumière ultraviolette provient du soleil, mais elle peut aussi rebondir sur d'autres surfaces comme l'eau, la neige et le béton.
de: Ultraviolettes Licht kommt von der Sonne, aber es kann auch von anderen Oberflächen wie Wasser, Schnee und Beton reflektiert werden.
it: La luce ultravioletta proviene dal sole, ma può anche rimbalzare su altre superfici come l'acqua, la neve e il cemento.
pt: A luz ultravioleta vem do sol, mas também pode refletir em outras superfícies como água, neve e concreto.
ru: Ультрафиолетовый свет исходит от солнца, но он также может отражаться от других поверхностей, таких как вода, снег и бетон.
hi: पराबैंगनी प्रकाश सूर्य से आता है, लेकिन यह पानी, बर्फ और कंक्रीट जैसी अन्य सतहों से भी टकराकर वापस आ सकता है।
zh: 紫外线来自太阳，但它也可以从水、雪和混凝土等其他表面反射。
ja: 紫外線は太陽から来ますが、水や雪、コンクリートなどの他の表面で反射することもあります。
ko: 자외선은 태양에서 오지만, 물, 눈, 콘크리트와 같은 다른 표면에서도 반사될 수 있습니다.
vi: Tia cực tím đến từ mặt trời, nhưng nó cũng có thể phản xạ từ các bề mặt khác như nước, tuyết và bê tông.
sv: Ultraviolett ljus kommer från solen, men det kan också reflekteras mot andra ytor som vatten, snö och betong.
fi: Ultraviolettivalo tulee auringosta, mutta se voi myös heijastua muista pinnoista, kuten vedestä, lumesta ja betonista.
nl: Ultraviolet licht komt van de zon, maar het kan ook weerkaatsen op andere oppervlakken zoals water, sneeuw en beton.
el: Το υπεριώδες φως προέρχεται από τον ήλιο, αλλά μπορεί επίσης να αντανακλάται από άλλες επιφάνειες όπως το νερό, το χιόνι και το τσιμέντο.
ar: يأتي الضوء فوق البنفسجي من الشمس، ولكن يمكنه أيضاً أن ينعكس عن أسطح أخرى مثل الماء والثلج والخرسانة.

text: The conductor forgot to punch my ticket.
text_en: The conductor forgot to punch my ticket.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to the female default as no gendered cues are present. The addressee fields are not applicable as this is a declarative statement about a third party.
es: El revisor olvidó picar mi billete.
es_latam: El revisor olvidó picar mi boleto.
fr: Le contrôleur a oublié de composter mon billet.
de: Der Schaffner hat vergessen, meine Fahrkarte zu entwerten.
it: Il controllore ha dimenticato di obliterare il mio biglietto.
pt: O cobrador esqueceu de validar o meu bilhete.
hi: कंडक्टर मेरा टिकट पंच करना भूल गया।
zh: 列车员忘了给我的票打孔。
ja: 車掌さんは私の切符に改札印を押すのを忘れました。
ko: 검표원이 제 표를 검표하는 것을 잊었습니다.
vi: Người soát vé đã quên bấm vé của tôi.
sv: Konduktören glömde att klippa min biljett.
nl: De conducteur is vergeten mijn kaartje af te stempelen.
el: Ο ελεγκτής ξέχασε να τρυπήσει το εισιτήριό μου.
corrections_summary: pt: 'perfurar' is technically correct but 'validar' or 'picar' is more natural for tickets, and 'esqueceu-se de' is more idiomatic than 'esqueceu de' in many contexts, but 'esqueceu de' is acceptable in Brazil. However, 'condutor' usually refers to the driver; 'cobrador' or 'fiscal' is better for a conductor who checks tickets. → changed to 'O cobrador esqueceu de validar o meu bilhete.'

text: Achieving a nice weld bead is not within everyone's reach!
text_en: Achieving a nice weld bead is not within everyone's reach!
en_notes: The sentence is a general statement about a skill, so it uses neutral gender for both speaker and addressee. The phrase 'not within everyone's reach' is classified as figurative as it uses physical distance to represent difficulty.
es: ¡Conseguir un buen cordón de soldadura no está al alcance de cualquiera!
es_latam: ¡Lograr un buen cordón de soldadura no está al alcance de todos!
fr: Réussir un beau cordon de soudure n'est pas à la portée de tout le monde !
de: Eine schöne Schweißnaht hinzubekommen, ist nicht jedermanns Sache!
it: Ottenere un bel cordone di saldatura non è da tutti!
pt: Conseguir um bom cordão de solda não é para qualquer um!
ru: Сделать красивый сварочный шов под силу далеко не каждому!
hi: एक अच्छा वेल्ड बीड बनाना हर किसी के बस की बात नहीं है!
zh: 焊出漂亮的焊缝可不是每个人都能做到的！
ja: きれいな溶接ビードを作るのは、誰にでもできることではありません！
ko: 매끄러운 용접 비드를 만드는 것은 아무나 할 수 있는 일이 아니에요!
vi: Để tạo ra một mối hàn đẹp không phải là việc mà ai cũng làm được!
sv: Att få till en snygg svetsfog är inte något som alla klarar av!
fi: Siistin hitsipalkon tekeminen ei onnistu ihan keneltä tahansa!
nl: Een mooie lasrups maken is niet voor iedereen weggelegd!
el: Η επίτευξη μιας ωραίας ραφής συγκόλλησης δεν είναι εύκολη υπόθεση για όλους!
ar: إن تحقيق درزة لحام جيدة ليس في متناول الجميع!

text: She loves that cavalry colonel, because he's a good rider...
text_en: She loves that cavalry colonel because he's a good rider.
en_notes: The speaker gender remains male as per the default since the narrator is not identified. The subject 'She' and the object 'he' are explicit, but they do not define the speaker or addressee.
es: Ella ama a ese coronel de caballería porque es un buen jinete.
es_latam: Ella ama a ese coronel de caballería porque es un buen jinete.
fr: Elle aime ce colonel de cavalerie parce que c'est un bon cavalier.
de: Sie liebt diesen Kavallerieoberst, weil er ein guter Reiter ist.
it: Lei ama quel colonnello di cavalleria perché è un buon cavaliere.
pt: Ela ama aquele coronel da cavalaria porque ele é um bom cavaleiro.
ru: Она любит этого полковника кавалерии, потому что он хороший наездник.
hi: वह उस घुड़सवार सेना के कर्नल से प्यार करती है क्योंकि वह एक अच्छा घुड़सवार है।
zh: 她爱那位骑兵上校，因为他是个优秀的骑手。
ja: 彼女はその騎兵大佐が優れた乗り手なので、彼のことを愛しています。
ko: 그녀는 그 기병 대령이 훌륭한 기수이기 때문에 그를 사랑합니다.
vi: Cô ấy yêu vị đại tá kỵ binh đó vì ông ấy là một người cưỡi ngựa giỏi.
sv: Hon älskar den där kavalleriöversten eftersom han är en skicklig ryttare.
fi: Hän rakastaa tuota ratsuväen everstiä, koska tämä on hyvä ratsastaja.
nl: Ze houdt van die kolonel van de cavalerie omdat hij een goede ruiter is.
el: Αγαπά εκείνον τον συνταγματάρχη του ιππικού επειδή είναι καλός αναβάτης.
ar: هي تحب ذلك العقيد في سلاح الفرسان لأنه فارس جيد.
corrections_summary: ja: unnatural word order → reordered for better flow; ko: unnatural word order → reordered to place the reason before the verb more naturally; ar: phrasing improvement → adjusted word order for 'that cavalry colonel' to sound more native.

text: There may be a reduction of vowels.
text_en: There may be a reduction of vowels.
en_notes: The sentence is a general linguistic observation with no specific speaker or addressee mentioned. Pre-assigned genders are used as defaults.
es: Es posible que se produzca una reducción de las vocales.
es_latam: Es posible que se produzca una reducción de las vocales.
fr: Il peut y avoir une réduction des voyelles.
de: Es kann zu einer Reduktion von Vokalen kommen.
it: Potrebbe verificarsi una riduzione delle vocali.
pt: Pode haver uma redução das vogais.
hi: स्वरों में कमी हो सकती है।
ja: 母音の弱化が起こる可能性があります。
vi: Có thể có sự giảm lược các nguyên âm.
sv: Det kan förekomma en reduktion av vokaler.
nl: Er kan sprake zijn van een reductie van klinkers.
el: Ενδέχεται να υπάρξει μείωση των φωνηέντων.
ar: قد يحدث تقليل في الأصوات الصائتة.

text: The picture is colorful in contrast with this one.
text_en: The picture is colorful in contrast with this one.
en_notes: No disambiguation needed. The sentence is a neutral declarative statement comparing two objects.
es: El cuadro es colorido en contraste con este.
es_latam: El cuadro es colorido en contraste con este.
fr: Le tableau est coloré par rapport à celui-ci.
de: Das Bild ist farbenfroh im Gegensatz zu diesem hier.
it: Il quadro è colorato in contrasto con questo.
pt: O quadro é colorido em contraste com este.
ru: Картина яркая по сравнению с этой.
hi: यह चित्र इस चित्र के विपरीत रंगीन है।
zh: 这张画与这一张相比色彩鲜艳。
ja: この絵は、これと対照的に色彩豊かです。
vi: Bức tranh này đầy màu sắc trái ngược với bức này.
sv: Bilden är färgstark i kontrast till den här.
nl: Het schilderij is kleurrijk in contrast met dit schilderij.
el: Η εικόνα είναι πολύχρωμη σε αντίθεση με αυτήν.
ar: الصورة ملونة على النقيض من هذه.
corrections_summary: hi: The translation reversed the demonstratives (this/that) → corrected to match 'The picture' (this/that) and 'this one'; zh: Added 'that' which wasn't in the source → adjusted to '这张画与这一张相比色彩鲜艳'; ja: Changed 'that' back to 'this' to match the source → 'この絵は、これと対照的に色彩豊かです'; ko: Changed 'that' back to 'this' to match the source → '이 그림은 이것과 대조적으로 다채롭습니다'; vi: Removed 'that' to match the source → 'Bức tranh này đầy màu sắc trái ngược với bức này'

text: I'll have to make amends to them for my mistake.
text_en: I'll have to make amends to them for my mistake.
en_notes: The sentence uses the idiom 'make amends', which is categorized as figurative. The speaker and addressee genders follow the pre-assigned defaults as there are no contextual cues to override them.
es: Tendré que compensarles por mi error.
es_latam: Tendré que compensarles por mi error.
fr: Je devrai me racheter auprès d'eux pour mon erreur.
de: Ich werde meinen Fehler bei ihnen wiedergutmachen müssen.
it: Dovrò rimediare con loro per il mio errore.
pt: Terei que me redimir com eles pelo meu erro.
ru: Мне придется загладить свою вину перед ними за мою ошибку.
hi: मुझे अपनी गलती के लिए उनके सामने प्रायश्चित करना होगा।
zh: 我必须为我的错误向他们做出弥补。
ja: 自分の過ちを彼らに償わなければならないでしょう。
ko: 제 실수에 대해 그들에게 보상해야 할 거예요.
vi: Tôi sẽ phải đền bù cho họ vì sai lầm của mình.
sv: Jag kommer att behöva gottgöra dem för mitt misstag.
nl: Ik zal het met hen moeten goedmaken voor mijn fout.
el: Θα πρέπει να επανορθώσω απέναντί τους για το λάθος μου.
ar: سيتعين عليّ أن أعوضهم عن خطئي.

text: Mark is obsessed with learning and acquiring knowledge.
text_en: Mark is obsessed with learning and acquiring knowledge.
en_notes: The sentence is a declarative statement about a third party (Mark). The speaker and addressee genders are set to the defaults as they are not specified or implied in the text.
es: Mark está obsesionado con aprender y adquirir conocimientos.
es_latam: Mark está obsesionado con aprender y adquirir conocimientos.
fr: Mark est obsédé par l'apprentissage et l'acquisition de connaissances.
de: Mark ist besessen davon, zu lernen und sich Wissen anzueignen.
it: Mark è ossessionato dall'apprendimento e dall'acquisizione di conoscenze.
pt: Mark é obcecado por aprender e adquirir conhecimento.
ru: Марк одержим учёбой и получением новых знаний.
hi: मार्क सीखने और ज्ञान प्राप्त करने के लिए जुनूनी है।
zh: 马克痴迷于学习和获取知识。
ja: マークは学習と知識の習得に夢中になっています。
vi: Mark bị ám ảnh bởi việc học hỏi và tiếp thu kiến thức.
sv: Mark är besatt av att lära sig och skaffa sig kunskap.
fi: Mark on pakkomielteinen oppimisesta ja tiedon hankkimisesta.
nl: Mark is geobsedeerd door leren en het opdoen van kennis.
el: Ο Μαρκ έχει εμμονή με τη μάθηση και την απόκτηση γνώσεων.

text: The picture's tilted.
text_en: The picture is tilted.
en_notes: The contraction 'picture's' was expanded to 'picture is' for clarity. The sentence is a neutral observation with no specific indicators for speaker or addressee gender.
es: El cuadro está torcido.
es_latam: El cuadro está inclinado.
fr: Le tableau est de travers.
de: Das Bild hängt schief.
it: Il quadro è storto.
pt: O quadro está torto.
hi: तस्वीर टेढ़ी है।
ja: 絵が傾いています。
vi: Bức tranh bị nghiêng.
sv: Tavlan hänger snett.
nl: Het schilderij hangt scheef.
el: Ο πίνακας είναι στραβός.

text: He had to undergo many trials.
text_en: He had to undergo many trials.
en_notes: The speaker gender is set to male based on the pre-assigned default as the sentence is a third-person narrative. The subject 'He' refers to the person undergoing the trials, not the speaker.

es_latam: Tuvo que pasar por muchas pruebas.
fr: Il a dû traverser de nombreuses épreuves.

it: Ha dovuto affrontare molte prove.
pt: Ele teve que passar por muitas provações.
ru: Ему пришлось пройти через многие испытания.
hi: उसे कई परीक्षाओं से गुजरना पड़ा।
zh: 他不得不经受许多磨难。
ja: 彼は多くの試練を乗り越えなければならなかった。
vi: Anh ấy đã phải trải qua nhiều thử thách.
sv: Han var tvungen att genomgå många prövningar.
fi: Hänen oli käytävä läpi monia koettelemuksia.
nl: Hij moest vele beproevingen doorstaan.
el: Έπρεπε να περάσει από πολλές δοκιμασίες.
ar: كان عليه أن يمر بالعديد من الابتلاءات.

text: She supports me in all my endeavors.
text_en: She supports me in all my endeavors.
en_notes: The speaker gender is kept as the default 'male' as the sentence does not provide cues for the speaker's identity. The subject 'She' is the third person, not the addressee.
es: Ella me apoya en todos mis proyectos.
es_latam: Ella me apoya en todos mis emprendimientos.
fr: Elle me soutient dans tous mes projets.
de: Sie unterstützt mich bei all meinen Vorhaben.
it: Lei mi sostiene in tutti i miei progetti.
pt: Ela me apoia em todos os meus empreendimentos.
ru: Она поддерживает меня во всех моих начинаниях.
hi: वह मेरे सभी प्रयासों में मेरा समर्थन करती है।

ja: 彼女は私のあらゆる試みを支えてくれます。
ko: 그녀는 저의 모든 노력을 지지해 줍니다.

sv: Hon stöttar mig i alla mina strävanden.
nl: Ze steunt me in al mijn ondernemingen.
el: Με στηρίζει σε όλες μου τις προσπάθειες.
corrections_summary: zh: '事业' (career/business) is too narrow for 'endeavors' → changed to '努力' (efforts/endeavors) for better accuracy.

text: I've been passionate about atlases and maps since I was little, and now I have a vast collection of all kinds of them.
text_en: I've been passionate about atlases and maps since I was little, and now I have a vast collection of all kinds of them.
en_notes: The sentence is a personal statement with no specific addressee. The speaker gender follows the pre-assigned default as there are no gendered cues.
es: Me apasionan los atlas y los mapas desde que era pequeño, y ahora tengo una vasta colección de todo tipo.
es_latam: Me apasionan los atlas y los mapas desde que era pequeño, y ahora tengo una vasta colección de todo tipo.
fr: Je suis passionné par les atlas et les cartes depuis que je suis petit, et j'en possède maintenant une vaste collection de toutes sortes.
de: Ich begeistere mich für Atlanten und Karten, seit ich klein war, und jetzt besitze ich eine riesige Sammlung aller Art.
it: Sono appassionato di atlanti e mappe da quando ero piccolo e ora ne ho una vasta collezione di ogni tipo.
pt: Sou apaixonado por atlas e mapas desde pequeno e agora tenho uma vasta coleção de todos os tipos.
ru: Я увлекаюсь атласами и картами с самого детства, и сейчас у меня огромная коллекция самых разных видов.
hi: जब मैं छोटा था तब से मुझे एटलस और मानचित्रों का शौक रहा है, और अब मेरे पास उन सभी प्रकारों का एक विशाल संग्रह है।
zh: 我从小就对地图集和地图充满热情，现在我拥有各种各样丰富的收藏。
ja: 子供の頃からアトラスや地図に情熱を注いできました。今ではあらゆる種類の膨大なコレクションを持っています。
ko: 어릴 때부터 지도책과 지도에 열정을 가져왔고, 지금은 온갖 종류의 방대한 컬렉션을 보유하고 있습니다.
vi: Tôi đã đam mê các tập bản đồ và bản đồ từ khi còn nhỏ, và bây giờ tôi có một bộ sưu tập khổng lồ đủ các loại.
sv: Jag har haft en passion för atlaser och kartor sedan jag var liten, och nu har jag en enorm samling av alla de slag.
fi: Olen ollut intohimoinen atlaksia ja karttoja kohtaan pienestä pitäen, ja nyt minulla on valtava kokoelma kaikenlaisia.
nl: Ik ben al gepassioneerd door atlassen en kaarten sinds ik klein was, en nu heb ik een enorme collectie van allerlei soorten.
el: Είμαι παθιασμένος με τους άτλαντες και τους χάρτες από τότε που ήμουν μικρός, και τώρα έχω μια τεράστια συλλογή από κάθε είδους.
ar: لقد كنت شغوفاً بالأطالس والخرائط منذ أن كنت صغيراً، والآن لدي مجموعة واسعة من جميع أنواعها.
corrections_summary: sv: 'atlaser' is incorrect pluralization → fixed to 'atlaser' (common) or 'atlasser' (less common), but 'atlaser' is the standard plural; however, the sentence used 'atlaser' which is actually correct in Swedish, but the phrasing 'passionerad för' is slightly unnatural → changed to 'haft en passion för'. No other corrections needed.

text: Sami was a super cutie.
text_en: Sami was a super cutie.

corrections_summary: ja: repetitive phrasing and typo in 'customers' → streamlined and corrected 'お客様'; sv: 'Ni' is archaic/overly formal for modern customer service → changed to 'du' (standard formal-polite) or 'ni' (plural/polite), but 'du' is preferred in modern Swedish service contexts, however, keeping 'Ni' is technically correct but 'Er' was inconsistent with 'väntar' (plural vs singular) → adjusted for consistency; hi: missing female addressee markers → added 'जी' and feminine markers; ko: slightly unnatural phrasing → adjusted to standard customer service terminology.
